sdon gleng /'di ni nags tshang zhi lu'i byis pa'i dus kyi skyid sdug ngo sprod kyi deb cig yin la/ nga la sems tshor che shos sprod sa ni kho rang bu span gnyis dang pha rgan sogs rogs pa bcu gnyis ‘gyod ya med pa'i dus 'gyurngo chen po'i nyanang pha yul rma sdechu kha ma nas ri byol la song ba'i brgyud rim dang /chu dmar leb nas btson khang dang bde skyid khang du sdod ring gi gnas tshul bris yod pa'i le tshan de dag yin/nags tshang zhi lus byung rabs de'i rgyab ljongs gnas tshul dang / rgya gzhung gi srid jus la dmigs bsal 'grel brjod ma byas par/ byis pa zhig gi rang gis dngos su mthong myong gi gnas tshul rkyang pa bris yod pa ste/ pha yul nas thon skabs kho rang lo bcu dang / a bo lo bcu bzhi red/ a pha yul dmag tu'ang zhugs med/ rgya dmag dgon par 'byor nyin grwa pa tshos ser phreng bsgrigs te dga' bsu zhus pa dang / dmag gis kyang 3 la bka' drin che zhes 'dzum gyi ler bstod pa byas/ zhag ma gcig gi rjes la rgya dmag de ma nyid du 'gyur nas grwa pa tshor btsan shed kyis dgon pa bshig tu bcug pa dang / yul mi rnams sa gzhan du bskrad pas/ kho tsho lha sa snyeg phyir bros byol gyi lam la zhugs yod/lam 'khel gyi sa gnas khag tu dgon pa dang / sbra gur ji ltar gtor bcom thebs lugs dang / stong lug bdag med du shor stangs/ tha na dbus nas phyir 'khor ba'i mjal ba sbra gur bcu kha zhig ‘sgor bud nas chu kha dang ri ngo la 'bro sa nas bsad 'dug nyapa dang / bros byol du 'gro mkhan gtor shul na lhag pa'i rgan rgon dang byis pa rmas ma tsho'i skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas stangs sogs

11ni ‘58 lo'i zing 'khrug )zer ba de red/chu dmar leb btson khang du tshud pa'i btson pa stong phrag du ma de dag khrod rgya la 'dzing nas bzung ba zhig yod rabs med par/ dpon gyi kha la nyan nas me mda' rgya gzhung la rtsis sprad de don med 'dzin bzung byas pa'i 'gyod pa'i smre sngags 'don mkhan dag yod la/ bla grwa dang bud med/ yul gzhan gyi tshong pa sogs kyang yod/ bde skyid khang du zla shas ring ru khag gsum du pha ma bsad bzung byas zin pa'i shul lhag phyug po'i bu phrug chig stong tsam nas lnga bcu dang / rgan rgon drug brgya lhag las bcu kha tsam ma gtogs thams cad mu ges srog 'phrogs pa'i dus mnyam du/ ra tshang slob grwa'i stod de rang la rgyal gnyer phyugs ra'i nang lug stong phrag du ma bskyil yod cing / rdzong thog tu yod pa'i rgya dmag gi rta chas brkus te/ nags tshang zhi lu span gnyis kyis mu ge las thar thabs bsten pa sogs ni rbad de tha dad pa'i zlojig rten gnyis yin/nags tshang zhi lus kho rang 1959 lo'i zla 12 tshes 30 nyin rdzong gi slob grwar tshud pas/ skyid kyi sne zin nyazhes skyid sdug lo rgyus de'i mjug bsdus 'dug kyang / dus yun 'di rgya gzhung gis lo gsum gyi rang byung gnod 'tshe rtazer ba'i lo thog ma'i gnas tshul tsam yin zhing / bod chol kha gsum tshud pa'i rgya nag rgyal yongs su mu ge tshabs che shos de da dung nyung mthar yang lo gnyis lhag byung yod/nags tshang zhi lu ni deng sang rgya gzhung gis 'dzin skyong dbye stangs ltar na kun lho khul rma chu rdzong (mtsho sngon dang kun su'u 'dabs 'brel ba'i rma chu'i khugs pa dang po/)khongs nas yin yang / kho'i skyid sdug gi myong ba phal che ba mtsho sngon zhing chen zer ba'i khongs su byung yod/ nga tshos nags tshang zhi lus bris med pa'i don rkyen de dag gi rgyab ljongs rob tsam gleng na/ deb 'di'i brjod don la go ba len rgyur cung stabs bde ba yod snyam/mtsho sngon ni bod kyi sa khul nang dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur byed snga shos

111kyi gras yin zhing / 1955 'o'i dgun khar/ rdzong khag bcu gcig la zhing las thon skyed mnyam las khang 876 btsugs zin pa ma zad/ 'brog khul du'ang ‘bgo bsha' mi rgyag 'thab rtsod mi byed )zer ba'i srid jus 'gyur ba btang ste/'brog las thon skyed mnyam las khang 'dzugs 'go tshugs/ srid jus de'i nang don gtso bo ni/ jingal rtsol nus shugs bcings 'grol dang / sa zhing dbang ba'i lam lugs bcings 'grol btang ste/ bshu gzhog lam lugs rtsa med du gtong ched yin nyalugs sgrog gi yod pa dang /‘chos lugs kyi dmigs bsal khyad dbang dang / dgon pa nang khul gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dbang bsgyur rtsa med gtong dgos pa dang /chos lugs mi sna ngal rtsol thon skyed du zhugs dgos pa'i btsan skul 'og 1956 lo mgo nas bka' ma log rdzong du sku rten bshig ga ba sgyugs nas tshab tu dgon pa mnyam las khang gi yig tshang du bsgyur 'dugamatsho sngon zhing chen 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gis 1959 lo'i zla 11 par bsgrigs pa'i ‘mi rigs chos lugs las don gyi yig cha phyogs bsgrigs rtartazhes par 'khod pa ltar na/ 1958 lo'i zla 4 nang mtsho sngon ya rdzi rdzong du paṇa chen rin po che'i yongs 'dzin gnang myong mkhan a lags rgya nag pas 'go khrid pa'i mi dmangs kyis rgya gzhung gi dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur sogs kyi srid jus la ngo rgol gyi drag po'i gyen langs byas par/ rgya dmag gis gyen langs pa 435dmar gsod dang / 2499 'dzin bzung byas shing / mtsho sngon zhing chen srid gzhung nas de'i skor 1958 zla 7 tshes 5 'khod pa'i snyan zhu zhig krung dbyang dang 'brel yod las khungs su phul bar/ 1958 zla 8 tshes 27 'khod bka' rgya'i nang / ‘‘dus rtag tu sems la 'dzin dgos pa ni/ gral rim gyi spyi tshogs nang /mi rigs gnad don gyi don dngos ni gral rim gyi gnad don yin/ gral rim gyi don ngos 'dzin ma thub na/ mi rigs kyi gnad don thag gcod dpyis phyin pa byed mi thub ces lam ston byas pa dang / ma'o ma shi ba'i bar du srid jus 'di rgyun bskyangs yod/ dmar po'i gzhung lugs ltar na/ gral rim gyi

agand don ni khyod shi nga gson gyi gnad don yin la/ der bstun gshib dang gu bshangs kyi lam zhig gtan nas med pas/ bod mi rigs hril po rgya gzhung gi gral rim gyi dgra zlar bzhag pa zhig yin/de bzhin mtsho sngon zhing chen gyis ‘‘mtsho sngon sa khul gyi gsar brje ngo rgol gyi drag po'i zing 'khrug de yongs khyab rang bzhin gyi gnad don zhig tu khyab zin/ zhing chen yongs kyi 'brog las khul drug por snga rjes su zing 'khrug 'dra min byung yod (gong gsal ya rdzi ni mtsho shar zhing las khul du gtogs pas 'di'i khongs tshud med//ces pa'i yig cha zhig phyi lo 1958 lo'i zla 6 tshes 29nyin krung dbyang la btang bar/ ma'o tse tung gis/ ‘‘mtsho sngon gyi ngo log shog khag gis zing 'khrug bslangs pa de ha cang yag po red/ ngal rtsol mi dmangs bcings 'grol gyi go skabs slebs ran pa red/ mtsho sngon zhing chen u lhan gyi byed thabs ni yongs su yang dag pa red rtartaces zing 'khrug langs rgyur gnon mi thub pa'i dga' 'bod byas yod/‘jimatsho sngon zhing chen u lhan gyi byed thabs ni yongs su yang dag pa redanyanyazer ba'i byed thabs ni/ skabs de'i mtsho sngon gyi hru'u ci des ‘ngo log zing 'khrug mgo 'bus pa'i skabs su rtsa gtor gtong dgos rtazhes brjod de/ tshogs 'dur skong 'gug byas pa'i bla dpon 'dzin bzung gis mi gter nyar ba dang /kho tshor btsan shed kyis so so'i khongs gtogs kyi mi mang la go mtshon rtsis 'bul byed du bcug yod tshul 'ba' ba phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyis bris pa'i blo mthun bkra shis dbang phyug rjes su dran pa zhes pa'i rtsom yig tu gsal ba de yin/btsan byol bod gzhung gis 1984 lor gsal bsgrags shig spel ba'i nang / rgya dmar gyis btsan 'dzul byas pa nas lo rabs brgya cu bar du bod mi 'bum bcu gnyis lhag rgya gzhung gi dbang bsgyur 'og dus ma yin par 'chi 'das su gyur yod tshul brjod yod la/ nga rang yang de'i thad zhib 'jug ched rgya bal 'brug gsum gyi gzhis sgar phal mo che dang bod nas mjal skor yong

༅mkhan mang dag cig la tshig tho len rgyu'i go skabs dngos su byung myong / mdo khams gnyis su dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyis/ rang yul du chages thabs med pa'i yul byol ba rir bros pa dang / khyu dang khyur byas te byang thang 'grim mkhan tshor rgya dmag gis don med bskor bcom rjes 'ded dang / mdel char phab ste dmar gsod btang ba'i lo rgyus ni drag po'i ngo rgol thar thor byung ba de dag las kyang drag gnon gdug rtsub che ba byung yod pa dang / bsad rmas kyang de dag las mang ba byung 'dug mtsho sngon gyi 'dzin bzung du tshud pa'i btson pa phal che ba zi ling dang tshwa 'dam gshong sa'i btson khang khag tu 'chi 'das su gyur yod la/ nags tshang zhi lus bris pa'i chu dmar leb kyi btson khang der bcug yod pa tsho ha lam nyes pa chung ba tsho yin par thag bcad chogangs deb 'di klog zhor du tshig tho sprod mkhan rgan rgon de dag gis yid skyo ba'i lo rgyus gleng bzhin mig chu khrum khrum du bzhur ba'i rnam pa re re sems la 'khor zhing / rang cag gi pha mes tshor 'di lta bu'i chag sgo yong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan la bsam blo gtong skabs/ nags tshang zhi lu'i byis pa'i dus kyi mthong thos myong gsum las kyang rgyu mtshan mang dag cig ra 'phrod song /o si kri li ya'i nyams zhib pa zhig gis bod kyi deng rabs lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byas pa brgyud/ rgya gzhung gis bod la dbang bsgyur byed stangs de ‘rigs rgyud rtsa gtor rtagyi bya spyod red ces tshig thag bcad nas bshad myong ba dang / bod mi rigs la byung ba'i chag sgo de jar man gyi na rdzi dang / su'u lan gyi dmar shog tshogs pa'i 'og tu sdug sbyong myangs pa'i mi rigs las kyang tshabs che ba 'dug ces gleng mol byas myong /nags tshang zhi lus ‘‘rang gis mthong ba ltar ji ma ji bzhin bris yod pa las/ rang nyid dga' ba la yag bcos dang / mi dga' ba la dma' 'bebs ci yang byas med nya ces dang / ‘‘ngas bris yod pa'i mi dang / sa cha sdodagon thams cad ni dngos yod kyi mi dang sde dgon 'ba' zhig yin gnyazhes deb chung 'di 'bri

༅1ba'i bsam 'dun nang bkod yod pa ni deb 'di'i rin thang ngo ma de red snyam/deb 'dis rgya gzhung gis sngon nas da bar dang / da dung mu mthud ‘dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur nyabargyud bod mi rnams rang khyim rang bdag byas te bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol thub par gyur lugs 'ud sgrog pa'i yig cha de rnams kyi rdzun khungs mthil brtol ba dang / bod kyi nyam nga ba'i lo rgyus kyi le tshan der rin thang gzhal du med pa'i kha skong byas yod/pha rgan bsad kyang mig chu mi 'don pa'i pho rgod 'di lo bcu'i skabs nas dka' ngal dang 'jigs skrag la mi zhum pa dang / rgas pa'i gnas skabs su'ang rgya gung khran gyi srid dbang sger 'dzin 'og mgo thog tu chag sgo ci rigs yong srid pa'i nyen kha gdong gis bsus te/ ‘lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul 'di mi rabs rjes ma tshor go ba lon du 'jug nyached bzhag pa ni/ blos gtong gi snying stobs ldan pa'i dpa' rgod cig gis ma gtogs 'bri ga la phod/kha ba dkar po bod kyi rig gzhung sri zhu khang gi 'gan 'dzin gser rta tshul khrims lags kyis deb 'di'i kha skad go dka' ba rnams bcos te/ phran la zhu dag dang bsam tshul mtshon pa'i sngon gleng zhig 'bri rogs zhes bka' nan g.yol ma thub par 'di tsam bris khul lags shing / nags tshang zhi lu'i deb 'dis rang rigs rgan rabs pa gang mang zhig gis bod kyi chag lha'i lo rgyus de mu mthud kha skong gnang rgyur gsal 'debs dang dran skul re byed thub pa'i re smon bcas sha 'brong bkra shis rgya mtsho ming can nas 2008 zla 9 tshes 22 nyin/

༅11nags tshang zhi lu'i skyid sdug ngo sprod/kha byang gi 'grel/ nags tshang zhes pa mi tshang gi ming dang / zhi lu zhes pa a mdo'i yul skad bu zhes pa'i don yin/ deb de'i ming la nags tshang bu'i skyid sdug ces zer ba red/deb kyi brjod don snying bsdus/deb 'di'i brjod bya gtso bo nags tshang bu nus ldan blo bzang kho rang gi mi che'i lo rgyus dang 'brel nas mthong thos myong gsum gyi tshor snang dang lo rgyus ngo ma dag sbas skung brkyang bskum med par bris 'dug la/ de'ang le'u chen po drug dang / le tshan chung ba 88 kyi nang du bsdus yod pa red/le'u dang po/ mi lus thob pa'i dga' skyo sdug gsum/le'u de'i nang don gtso bo ni nags tshang nus blo phyi lo 1948 lor bod shar phyogs a mdo rma chu'i rtswa thang nags tshang tshang zhes pa'i 'brog khyim du skyes shing /chung dus nas a ma grongs te dwa phrug tu gyur pa'i byis pa chung chung yin pa'i skabs kyi gnas stangs zhib phra bris 'dug la/ skabs de dus bod kyi 'brog pa dkyus ma zhig gi mi tshe skyel stangs dang / lhag par du a ma 'jig rten mi yul dang bral zhing / a pha dang dus rgyun du 'dris gshibs byed rgyu'i go skabs ma byung ba'i rkyen gyis phru gu chung chung zhig gi skyo gdung dang 'brel ba'i dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba sogs klog pa po rnams la glog brnyan bzhin gsal po mthong thub pa'i bro ba ldan yod/le'u gagis pa/ mi tshe'i skyid sdug rgo bo'i rwa tshigs/khong chung chung yin dus a ma grongs pa dang a pha yang sa cha gzhan du

༅111dus rgyun 'gro bskyod dgos par brten chung chung skabs/ khong gi phu bo 'ja' pe rma sde chu kha ma'i bkra shis chos gling dgon du yod pa'i sa ru bsdad pa dang /skabs de dus lo na chung ba dang grwa chung 'gas khong la mthong chung brnyas bcos byas nas chos ra'i rdo gcal gyi steng du gnyid khug pa'i skabs su mgo la gcin pa btang ba/ de bzhin khong gis dgon pa'i skor lam dang thab tshang bcas su thug lhag slong ba/ khyi phrug bdag med rtse rogs su nyar nas gso skyong byas pa sogs dang / 'brog pa'i ru nang du song nas rang dang lo mnyam gyi na chung byis pa chung chung me tog 'thu rogs dang / yang chung lu gu 'tsho rogs rnams dang lhan du rtswa thang steng nas 'tsho ba rol ba sogs klog pa po rnams la tshor ba dngos su sprod thub pa'i khyad chos ldan yod/le'u gsum pa/ dbus jo bo'i gser zhalta mjal ba/a pha dang / phu bo sogs yul mi brgya phrag kha shas dang mnyam du lha sar song ba dang / skabs de dus bod kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs dang / lhag par du sa thag ring a mdo'i yul nas rta zhon te spyi le stong phrag gsum tsam gyi sa thag gis chod pa'i nyi ma lha sa'i jo bo mjal du song ba/ de'i tshe de'i dus su bod kyi skye khams khor yug dang /sha ba dang rkyang / 'brong / gtsod/ rgo ba/ dred mong / spyang ki sogs ri skyes sems can gyi 'phel rgyas gnas stangs dang / de rjes su rgya mi dang / bod rigs bsam med re zung gis bod kyi ri dwags dang gcan gzan bsad nas/ da lta sa khul de dag gi ri dwags dang gcan gzan rnams rtsa stongs su 'gro bzhin pa bcas yid skyo dgos pa'i gnas stangs ji 'dra yin pa'ang gsal po shugs kyis rtogs thub/le'u bzhi pa/ pha yul du spebs pa'i snga rjes/khong pha bu rnams lha sar song nas phyir pha yul du slebs pa'i skabs/rang nyid kyi 'khos 'byor la ma ltos par chu kha ma'i dgon par rma bya'i sgro las grub pa'i gdugs shig phul ba dang / de'i rjes su dgon pa'i dge bskos wa sang

/༅klad dmar gyis bzang ngan dbye ba med par nags tshang 'dul kho la nyes med nag 'gel byas nas lcag tshan 1500 gshad pa/ khong pha bu gsum̐m bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du song nas paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa dang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug sogs mjal ba'i skor yin/le'u lnga pa/ sa mthar 'khyams pa'i skyo sems/de bzhin rgya nag gzhung gis bod shar phyogs nas bzung rim pa bzhin bod la btsan 'dzul byed 'go tshugs nas bod sa stod smad bar gsum btsan 'dzul drag gnon ji ltar byas pa dang / rang nyid kyi drin chen a phas gtsos rgya gzhung gi btsan gnon las g.yol thabs su/ rang yul bzhag nas mi yul du bros byol song ba dang / lam bar du rgya dmag gis bod rigs shi rmas ji ltar byas pa'i rim pa/ khams yul shul chu dmar leb kyi sa cha ru slebs pa'i skabs rgya dmar drag dpung gi mtshon cha'i 'og khong gi pha drin chen gyi tshe srog shor ba ma zad/ pha yul nas mnyam du bros byol la yong ba'i rogs pa gang mang zhig gi tshe srog shor ba/ khong dang khong gi gcen pos gtsos gang mang zhig 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas pa'i gnas stangs zhib phra bris yod pa red/le'u drug pa/ ya nga ba'i da phrug gi 'tsho ba/btsan gnon 'og bod mi gang mang zhig btson 'jug byas nas rdung rdeg mnar gcod mu ge bcas kyi 'og nas bod mi shi god ji ltar byung ba'i gnas stangs bcas zhib cing phra ba 'khod 'dug khong dang spun che ba nags tshang 'ja' pe gnyis lo na chung bas btson 'jug ma byas par glod grol btang yang / khong gnyis la spun mched dang gnyen nye dpal 'byor gang yang med pas dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba sna tshogs skyel dgos byung yod pa ma zad/ a bra bsad nas za dgos byung ba sogs dka' ngal chen po myangs pa/ skabs der lo na chung ba'i na gzhon brgya phrag mang po mug shi thebs pa sogs dngos su mthong ba'i lo rgyus khag kha gsal po dang zhib phra bris yod pa red/

༅deb 'di'i dmigs bsal khyad chos/1) deb 'di la mtshon na bod sa ma shor gong gi bod rigs mi mang spyi dang / lhag par du mdo smad sa khul gyi 'brog pa rnams kyi 'tsho ba skyel stangs zhib phra bris yod la/ gna' nas da bar 'di ltar mi mang dkyus ma'i 'tsho ba dngos kyi lo rgyus yig thog tu bkod pa'i deb ther thog ma lta bu chags yod/ de bzhin bod sa ma shor gong gi bod nang gi rang byung khor yug dang / ri skyes srog chags kyi 'phel rgyas dngos mthong yig thog tu bkod yod pa ma zad/ da lta bod nang gi ri skyes gcan gzan ri dgas kyi gnas stangs gnyis gshibs bsdur byas na blo pham skye dgos pa'i gnas stangs shig yin pa shugs kyis gsal po chags yod/2) bod nang du rgya dmar drag dpung gis btsan 'dzul byed pa'i skabs bod mi rigs dmar gsod btang ba dang / btson khang du mnar gcod dang rdung rdeg 'og mug shi thebs pa'i gnas stangs sogs khong gi mthong thos dngos la brten nas gsal po bris yod/ deb 'di la mtshon na dka' ngal sna tshogs kyi 'og nas bod rigs mug shi thebs pa gtso bo khams yul shul chu dmar leb rdzong gi gnas stangs gzhi la bzhag nas bris yod kyang / bod sa stod smad bar gsum gyi dka' sdug gi gnas stangs gcig mtshungs lta bu chags yod pas deb 'dis bod yul hril por rgya dmar gyi btsan gnon 'og dka' sdug ji ltar myong ba shes thub/3) khong gi deb 'di'i nang du rgya mi sdug sa dang / bod mi yag sa rkyang pa bris pa lta bu phyogs lhung gi lo rgyus ma yin par rgya mi'i ma 'grig pa dang 'grig pa/ bod mi'i ma 'grig pa dang 'grig pa bcas tshang ma gsal po bris 'dug la/bod sa ma shor gong gral rim dang mtho dman dbang shed la brten nas nyam chung la thub tshod btang ba kho rang gi pha la/ chu kha ma'i dgon pa'i dge bskos kyis grwa mang 'dus pa'i sar lus gcer bur phud nas lcag tshan gang mang gzhus pa

༅1lta bu yang gsal po bris yod pas/ tshad ldan gyi lo rgyus deb ther zhig gi mtshan nyid tshang yod/ 4) lhag par du khong la mtshon na da lta bod nang du bzhugs yod pa ma zad/ de sngon chu dmar rdzong gi rdzong dpon gzhon pa dang / yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul zer ba'i khrims khang sogs rgya gzhung gi gnas rim mtho ba'i dpon rigs kyi go gnas bzung nas da lta bgres yol du phebs zin yod pa'i gnad yod mi sna zhig yin pas/ phyogs mang po'i gnas stangs la rgyus mnga' chen po yod/5) deb 'di ni bod nang nas bris te bkram pa'i rgya nag gis bod la btsan 'dzul byas pa'i gnas stangs zhib phra 'khod pa'i deb dang po de chags yod/6) deb 'di lo rgyus la do snang yod mkhan zhig gis bklag na lo rgyus kha gsal gting zab kyis bris yod pas dus tshod de'i nang gi lo rgyus ngo ma shes thub pa'i phan yon ldan yod/ lo rgyus la do snang gtan nas med mkhan zhig yin yang deb de bklag na khor yug zhib 'bri dang / mi sna'i rnam 'gyur/ skad cha'i go rim sogs sgyu rtsal gyi bro ba ches cher ldan pa'i brtsams sgrung lta bu'i bro ba'ang ldan yod/deb 'di par skrun byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/deb 'di la mtshon na bod nang nas mtsho sngon nang khul du 'grems spel ched par skrun byas 'dug kyang / yongs khyab tu 'grems spel byed thub med pa ma zad/ deb 'di spyi yongs nas go thub pa'i yig skad du bcos te par skrun byed thub na legs tshul bcas phyi dril drung 'phar sha 'brong bkra shis rgya mtsho dang / da lta bod gzhung the wan don gcod gsar pa ba ri zla ba tshe ring gnyis kyis phran la deb 'di ngo sprod dang 'brel/ 'di ga kha ba dkar po bod kyi rig gzhung sri zhu khang nas par skrun byed rgyu'i skul ma gnang ba ltar/ thog ma deb 'di nyin zhag

sna 1gsum tsam gyi ring phran gyis zhib klog tshar gcig grub pa dang / spyi yongs kyi cha nas deb de bod rigs mi mang gis shes dgos pa tsam du ma zad/ yig rigs gzhan du bsgyur nas 'dzam gling mi mang gis shes rtogs dgos pa/ bod kyi dza drag skabs su byung ba'i dngos yod kyi lo rgyus gsal po 'khod pa'i deb ther gal chen zhig yin par brten/ tshags gron gang thad nas dka' ngal mi nyung ba zhig yod kyang dga' bsu dang bcas 'phral du khas len zhus shing / de nas da bar las brel sna mang gi bar gseng nas glog klad du 'jug rgyu dang / yul skad go dka' ba khag yig skad du bcos rgyu/ zhus dag sogs ru nga zhib tshags bgyis pa'i khul lags shing / de ring klog mkhan rnams kyi spyan lam bstar thub pa byung bar dga' tshor chen po byung / deb 'di la mtshon na bod kyi lo rgyus kyi dkyog mtshams gal che ba'i dus skabs su dngos mthong dngos myong gi drang gtam yig thog tu bkod pa zhig yin pas bod mi yongs kyis dang 'dod chen po'i thog zhib gzigs mdzad pa'i 'bod skul yang chabs gcig tu zhu bzhin yod/ glog klad du 'jug skabs dang bcos nor shor ba sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul gyi rigs kyang gang mang mchis srid pas rtsom pa po dang / blo ldan gzigs pa po rnams la dgongs sel dang sbrags nor bcos yo bsrang thad kur gnang ba'i 'bod skul dang bcas/kha ba dkar po bod kyi rig gzhung sri zhu khang gi 'gan 'dzin dang /bdun re'i gsar shog bod kyi bang chen gyi rtsom sgrig pa tog tsha tshang tshul khrims dar rgyas sam/ yongs grags gser rta tshul khrims su 'bod pas phyi lo 2008zla 9 tshes 3༷ nyin bris/

༅111dkar chagasngon gleng / (/)nags tshang zhi lu'i skyid sdug ngo sprod/ (511)rtsom pa po mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus/ — (1)deb chung 'di 'bri ba'i bsam don/ ( )sngon brjod skyid sdug gi rang gtam/ (9)le'u dang po/ mi lus thob pa'i dga' skyo sdug gsum/skyeb sngon mar bsags pa'i las 'bras/letshanadang po/ nga yopha yul skyid po/rma sdechu kha ma red/ (’ )le tshan gnyis pa/ namayang brjed pa med pa'i/rang sa rang sdedrin chen/ ( ༷)letshan gsum pa/ spro skyid 'dzoms pa'i khyim tshang/'byor phyug ldan pa'i pha sa/ (na /le tshan bzhi pa/ dal 'byor milus blangs nas/'jig rten 'di la slebs pa/ — ( )le tshanalngapa/ skal bzang dus dang 'phrad nas/dgonarsāchos gsum mjal song / — ( ’/lotshan drug pa/ las kyi skyid sngag ci yong /ming btags༄ bla ma'i gsungs pa/ ( )lotshan bdun pa/ las 'brel bla ma phebs nas/bu chung ngu kha blangs song / ( )

༅1༅le tshan brgyad pa/ las 'bras can gyi bza' tshang /mi rgyu phyugs gsum dar song / ( ’)le tshan dgu pa/ a ma'i 'dod pa bzhin du/bla dgon kun la mjal song / (4 )le tshan bcu pa/ mi 'dod chag sgobyung ste/drin can a ma bral song / ( 8)letshan bcu gcig pa/nags tshang sbra chen tshang la/chag sgo gcig 'phro gcig red/ — (52)le tshan bcu gnyis pa/nags tshang 'khor ba'i khyim las/g.yog mo zhig la brten song / (5 )letshan bcu gsum pa/g.yog ngan ma yi lag nas/rang zas rang la ma dbang / ( ’/le tshan bcu bzhi pa/ nga rang nang la slebs rjes/a mye bde zhing phebs song / ( )le tshan bco lngapa/ pha rganadrin chen khong gis/'khor ba gting rdzogs byas song / — — ( 8)le'u gnyis pa/ mi tshe'i skyid sdug rgo bo'i rwa tshigs/sems ngos mi zin pa'i skyid sdugale tshan bcu drug pa/ dgon pa'i skor lam nang nas/tshogs thug dang po blangs pa/ (7 )le tshan bcu bdun pa/kher rkyang 'tsho ba'i khrod nas/a zhang rgya khor drin chen/ — (7 )le tshan bco brgyad pa/ dgon pa'i chu len chung bas/bdag med khyi gu gsos pa/ (81)le tshan bcu dgu pa/ dwa phrug gnyom chung mgo la/brnyas bcos thog mar rag song / (84)

yasale tshan nyi shu pa/ dga' ba'i rtsed rogs rnam pa/bye'u phrug don du 'dzing song / (29/le tshan nyer gcig pa/zhag rtsam zos nas brnangs shing /khyi rgan rgya lus so btab/ ( )le tshan nyer gnyis pa/ a ther ba ther zos rjes/lu gu'i rdzi bor song ba/ ( 8)mtshan nyer gsum pa/g.yag rgana'aphongs sprug byed dus/thang brgyab dbang po shor 'dug (1༷da)le tshan nyer bzhi pa/ gtor ma brkus pas mitshad/ab phrug bzung nas sna phug (1༷ )mtshan nyer lngapa/ glo bur khyi smyon rgyugs nas/ru sde thams cad dkrug song / (’’ )le tshan nyer drug pa/ lug nang ri moshor skabs/a mchod ḍa ru phug tshar/ (’ /le tshan nyer bdun pa/rta lud 'khengs tho zhig gis/khra chung mig g.yas bcar song / (’smo )lotshan nyer brgyad pa/thegabya thengenas ma zin/rte'u phrug gsos nas bdag brgyab/ (’dan)le tshan nyer dgu pa/ sdig chen tsig phug blangs nas/pha wang skyi leb srog bskyabs/ ( ne/le tshan sum cu pa/ rta mang rku la shor yang /lug da nga la dbang song / (’ )le tshan so gcig pa/ rta rgan rku la shor nas/rkang thang mi 'gro ka med/ (1 5)le'u gsum pa/ dbus jo bo'i gser zhal mjal ba/skal ba bzang po'i byin rlabs/

༅༅1le tshan so gnyis pa/ 'di phyi gnyis kyi don du/lha sar mjal du song ba/ (1 9/le tshan so gsum pa/ a myes rma rgyal spos ra/gnam mtsho skya ring sngo ring / ( )le tshan so bzhi pa/ mna' ya'i nang nas zho 'thung /spyang dmag kha nas lug 'phrog (’48)le tshan so lngapa/ kha dkar rkyang gi srog gcod/a chen thang gi spyang dmag (’5 )le tshan so drug pa/ se bo'i skya chenasum mdo/dred mong long ba snying rje/ (157〉le tshan so bdun pa/ bre ser 'brong gi thad nas/gnyom chung smug chung gtsod red/ (’ da/lotshan so brgyad pa/ ma rgan rang srog shor yang /bu phrug spyang kir ma sprad/ (1 )le tshan so dgu pa/ chu dmar rab bdunabargal nas/dred jag gnyis nas thar song / (1 ’/le tshan bzhi bcu pa/ kha ba nyin 'bab mtshan 'bab/rlung dmar nyin g.yug mtshan g.yug (’ /le tshan zhe gcig pa/ brag dmar rgod tshang brgyud nas/nyi ma lha sar slebs song / (’81)le tshan zhe gnyis pa/ jo bo yid bzhin nor bu/yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam/ ( 85)le tshan zhe gsum pa/ yid bzhin nor bu mjal rjes/se ra 'bras spungs mjal song / (191)le tshan zhe bzhi pa/ dga' ldan ri bo'i rtse nas/bsam yas mchod rten dkar po/ (99 )le tshan zhe lnga pa/ lha sa'i grong nas lo sar/btson pa zhig gi srog skyabs/ /na ༷)

za༅11le'u bzhi pa/ pha yul du spebs pa'i snga rjes/mi shes med thug na snying rje med/le tshan zhe drug pa/ rang sa rang yul slebs rjes/lcag tshan stong dang lnga brgya/ ( ༷ 〉le tshan zhe bdun pa/ dge bskos wa sang drin gyis/grwa pa'i las 'phro rdzogs song / (2’da)le tshan zhe brgyad pa/ paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas/bla brang dgon nas mjal song / (na’ )le tshan zhe dgu pa/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma/gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs tshang / /2na9)le'u lnga pa/ sa mthar 'khyams pa'i skyo sems/dus chen po 'gyur na gyod ya med/le tshan lnga bcu pa/ dus ngan tshes pa'i snga ltas/yul dmag mi 'bud ka med/ (dan )le tshan nga gcig pa/ mgo btags byas pa sdug gyong /chag sgo gnam lhung byung song / (na da)le tshan nga gnyis pa/ drag po'i 'jigs snang 'og nas/rang dgon rang la bshig bcug (nanya7)le tshan nga gsum pa/ sde dgon thams cad gtor nas/rma chu'i pha rir phud song / (na na/le tshan nga bzhi pa/ dus ngan tshes pa'i mtshan mo/rang yul bral nas 'khyams song / (na )le tshan nga lnga pa/ skye ba sngon ma'i las kyis/skya ser bcu gnyis 'dzoms song / ( 5na)

〉ku//111le tshan nga drug pa/ blo sems mthun pa'i drin gyis/rma chu sngon mor thar song / (na5 〉le tshan nga bdun pa/ dus log chag sgo'i nang nas/dgon sde gnyis ka brlags 'dug /da /le tshan nga brgyad pa/ yar 'gro rgya dmag thug cing /dbus pa phyir yong brlags 'dug (2 )letshanang dgu pa/ rgya sgar kha nas thar kyang /yul dmag gdong thug brgyab song / (da7’)le tshan drug cu pa/ bdag po med pa'i zog lugabadag po med pa'i rmas ma/ (na 5)le tshanare gcig pa/ me mda' 'phrogs shing khal bcom/dmag dang mi 'dzing thabs med/ (na8༷)le tshan re gnyis pa/ mkhar ri rdzargan gzhung nas/yang bskyar rgya dang 'dzing song / (da85/le tshan re gsum pa/ mang snanyung gis ma brten/mtha' ma gtor shi thebs song / (da9༷/le tshan re bzhi pa/ las kyis lhasar ma slebs/drin chen a pha bral song / (295)le'u drug pa/ ya nga ba'i da phrug gi 'tsho ba/sa bsam bzhin ma red gseg gis red/le tshan re lngapa/ 'jigs skrag che ba'i mtshan mor/'dzin bzung byas pas sems bde/ ( ༷’)le tshan re drug pa/ rgyu 'bras med pa'i gshed ma/gdug tsub che ba'i mnar gcod/ ( ༷ )le tshan re bdun pa/ rogs pa'i dam tshig bsams nas/btson du 'gro rgyur ma skrag ( 9da)

〉ku1〉〈lotshan re brgyad pa/ btsonagrogs bla ma dbu bla/rag shul ja thog drin che/ ( )le tshan re dgu pa/ ngan par rgyu 'bras 'khor zhing /'thab rtsod rdung rdeg phog song / — — ( nad/le tshan bdun cupa/ snying rjemed pa'i dmar gsod/phan thogs med pa'i ngo log ( da8)letshan don gcig pa/rgan po bde zhing bskyal nas/nga tsho dong du g.yugs song / ( )le tshan don gnyis pa/btson pa gsum gnyis dgudagu/pha yul grogs por thug song / ( 8)letshan don gsum pa/ya nga yid skyo'i mnar gcod/mi gshis bral ba'i ngan gsod/ / ji /le tshan don bzhi pa/ nad dang muges ma shi/btson khang nang nas thar song / ( 8)le tshan don lngapa/ rdzong gi mtha' ru bsdad de/rang phyogs rogs pa bsgug bsdad/ ( 5 )le tshan don drug pa/ ra tshang slob grwar song nas/bde skyid khang du bsdad pa/ ( 8)le tshan don bdun pa/rmongs dad che 'dug zer nas/btsan po byas par ma skrag ( )letshan donabargyad pa/phyi bcom tsag dang lhags pa/nang bcom nad dang mu ge/ (sku 9)le tshan donadagupa/ zas chad mugobyung skeko lpags zos kyang shi 'dug ( 7 /letshan brgyad cu pa/ phyug phrug mug shi thebs sla/ro 'phen sprang phrug nga yin/ ( 9)letshan gya gcig pa/ sbra chung kha khar phub ske.a bra bsad nas zos pa/ ( 8 )
