rtsom pa po mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus/nags tshang nus blo/ nus ldan blo bzang / pho lo 58 bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa pho byi ba'i lo'i hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin/ kun lho rma chu rdzong chu kha ma sde ba'i nags tshang dgra 'dul tshang du skyes/ chung dus pha rgan dang mnyam du byang sku 'bum dgon pa dang / lha sa'i se 'bras dga' gsum sogs dgon pa grags can du mar mchod mjal du song myong / 1958 lo'i zla 11 par chu dmar leb rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring nas slob sbyong byas/ 1964lor yul shul khul mi rigs dge thon slob grwa nas mthar phyin/ 1965 lor mtsho sngon zhing chen mi rigs slob gyur slob sbyong byas/ 1965 lo'i zla 10 bar las kur zhugs te chu dmar leb rdzong slob chung gi dge rgan byas/ 1967 lor 'bar dgon slob chung gi dge rgan byas pa dang / 1971 lo nas 'bar dgon shang gi spyi bde ched mngags pa'i 'gan blangs/ 1979 lor rdzong mi dmangs khrims khang gi khrims dpon gzhon pa'i 'gan khur/ 1984 lo nas rdzong khrims 'dzin cu'u yi cu'u krang gzhon pa'i 'gan khur/ snga rjes su khul dang zhing chen gyi tang gi slob grwa ru song nas slob sbyong byas pa dang / khyad par du zhing chen dang krung dbyang gi srid khrims las byed slob gar song nas zab sbyong legs po byas/1987 lor chu dmar leb rdzong gi rdzong dpon gzhon pa'i 'gan khur/ 1990lor yul shul khul 'bring rim mi dmangs khrims khang la las gnas spar/ 199zhalo ngal gsos rjes lo 'ga'i ring / khong gis ming grags can gyi bla spral dang phyi rgyal gyi grogs po sogs kyi 'brel ba brgyud pa dang / khyad par du marne su'u zhing 1

ja shkatshe chen bla brang dgon pa'i gser khri gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug mchog gi rgyab skyor dang thugs khur 'og ma dngul bsdus nas chu dmar leb rdzong thog tu chos lugs byed sgo spel sa'i sa tshigs shig bzhengs pa ma zad/ da dung bka' 'gyur dang / yig brgya/ ma ṇi/ thar mdo sogs kyi 'khor chen bzhi dang 'khor chung lnga brgya tsam bzhengs te chos dad mang tshogs kyi re ba bskangs/snga rjes su khul mi rigs dge thon slob grwa dang rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring / pha yul gyi chu kha ma'i slob chung bcas la a sgor gyis rogs skyor byas myong /da lta kho mtsho sngon bod rigs zhib 'jug tshogs pa'i rgyun las blo 'dri sa dang / lis hri bcas kyi 'gan bzhes te lhag bsam rnam dag gis/ nga ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi bu phrug cig yin/ bod rigs mi dmangs la phan pa yod pa'i bya ba zhig yin na/ nga rang gis nus shugs ci yod kyis bsgrub rgyu yin zhes pa bzhin mu mthud du 'bad pa mdzad bzhin mchis so//

deb chung 'di 'bri ba'i bsam don/snying nye ba'i gzigs mkhan lags/ deb chung 'di bris nas khyed kyi phyag tu 'bul thub par/ nga rang ha cang dga' spro skyes yod/ khyod tshor khom pa re yod dus zhib tu gzigs par snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhu/deb chung 'di'i nang du/ rang gis 'bri bsam rgyu thams cad bris yod la/ rang gis bshad bsam ba'i don dag yod tshad dang / lo rgyus rgyu mtshan yang cha tshang bar bris yod/ da ni bris tshar bas sems cung bde song mod/ 'on kyang bris tshar dus/ rang gis zhib blta byas te zhib tu 'dang zhig brgyab na/ deb chung 'di'i mgo nas 'jug bar byis pa bsam med cig gi mthong thos dang /bsam tshul rkyang rkyang bris yod pa dang / brjid nyams ldan pa'i rgyan tshig dang /rlabs che ba'i bya ba ci yang med pas/ mi'i mdun du khyer bar don chung bar bsams song / yang 'dang zhig brgyab na/ nga ni lo rgyus kyi dus rabs dmigs gsal can zhig tu skyes pa'i mi zhig yin la/ mi rang gi las kyis yin na'ang 'dra/dus kyi 'gyur ldog gi rkyen gyis yin na'ang 'dra/ rang gis sdug mang po zhig myangs song / dka' sdug myong mkhan nga kho na ma yin par mi khri stong mang po yod/ mi re'i khog na rang gi skyid sdug gi gtam rgyud cha tshang re yod la/ sde khyim tshang re la rang sderang khyim dar rgyud skyid sdug gi lo rgyus bshad mi tshar ba re yod kho thag yin/ 'on kyang / lo rgyus de dag yig thog tu bris pa ha cang nyung 'dug yig thog tu ma bris na/ lo rgyus 'di rang gi sems su gsal ba las/ mi rabs rjes mas shes rgyu ma red/ lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul 'di mi rabs rjes ma tshor go ba lon du 'jug dgos na/ nges par du mi rabs sngon mas dus rabs de'i lo rgyus 3

tshe snyelo7 sogs yig thog tu gsal po bris nas/ mi rabs rjes ma'i lag tu 'jog dgos/lhag par du rang gi bu rgyud rnams la mi rabs sngon ma tsho'i skyid sdug gi lo rgyus shes thub pa'i cha rkyen dang go skabs bzang po re skrun dgos na/ lo rgyus 'di yig thog tu bris nas 'jog pa las lhag pa zhig yod rgyu ma red bsam/ mi zhig la bshad na 'di 'dra yin la/ khyim tshang zhig dang mi rigs shig la bshad na'ang 'di 'dra yin/pha a khu'i dus rabs kyi lo rgyus bu tsha bos dus nas ma shes tshe/ nam zhig la khyim tshang 'di dang mi rigs 'di rang gi lo rgyus brjed nas go med shul med du 'gyur rgyu red/ de bas lo rgyus 'di yig thog tu 'bri ba ni/ nga rang gis bsam na ha cang gal chen zhig red/ lhag par du nga tsho'i dus rabs 'di'i mi rnams dgung lo mthon por slebs yod la/ khong rnams kyi sku tshe ma rdzogs gong du rang sdorang yul dang rang gi mi rigs 'di'i dus rabs de'i lo rgyus don rkyen dang / dus 'gyur gyi gnas tshul sogs cha tshang ba re yig thog tu bris te 'jog thub na/ mi rabs rjes mar cha bzhag na/ rin thang bral ba'i nor rdzas lta bu red/ mi gcig gi kha nas ci 'dra bshad kyang / kho rang gi tshe thag ni lo drug cu nas bdun cu tsam red/ kho rang gi tshe rdzogs song na yod tshad mtshams bzhag song ba red/'on kyang khos bris pa'i dpe deb che chung ci 'dra yod kyang des mi rabs mang por phan thogs pa red/ de bas nga rang gis bsam na/ rig gnas cung tsam yod pa'i rgan rabs tshos/ rang rgyud dang rang gi mi rigs 'di'i ched du/ dka' khag la mi 'dzem par lo rgyus kyi don rkyen 'di dag yig thog tu bris te bu tsha bo'i lag tu bzhag na/ de ni snying don yod pa'i bya ba gal chen zhig red bsams/nga ni shes rig yon tan dma' la/ lta rgya mthong rgya chung bas/ rang gi chung dus kyi skyid sdug tsam 'bri ba las/ gting zab pa zhig bris te/ mi gzhan la slob gso gtong ba'i nus pa med/'on kyang nga rang gis bris pa'i deb chung 4

mapa ( nga ༅3rdziyom 'di ni/ bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus rgya mtsho'i nang gi chu thigs gcig yin bsam 'dug la/ chu 'thung 'dod mkhan re gnyis dang 'phrad tshe skom cung tsam sod rgyu red bsams/ sbrang dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis rgyags nas zhen pa log yod pa'i rgyags ro ma zhig la cha bzhag na/ 'dam dri bro ba'i chu thigs 'di 'dra re 'thung 'dod med pa nga yis shes la/ bka' bstan 'gyur bltas kyang shes 'don gyi re ba skong mi thub pa'i mkhas chen zhig la cha bzhag na/ ngas bris pa'i byis pa sems med cig gi rang rgyus deb chung 'di 'dra zhig la lta 'dod med pa ngas lhag tu shes 'dug de na mtshar 'dod che ba'i na gzhon lo chung re zung dang /yang na khom pa yod pa'i rgan rgon 'ga' res/ rdza ja zhim po zhig 'thung zhor la nyi ma skyel ched deb chung 'dir cung tsam blta na'ang thang / nga'i grogs po thub bstan dge 'dun gyis nga la 'di ltar bshad song / khyod kyis bris pa bzang yang /blta 'dod mkhan brgya dang mi 'dod mkhan stong yod pa red/ khyod kyis bris pa mi bzang yang / dpe deb 'di spyi tshogs thog thon tshar na/ de yang blta mkhan brgya dang mi blta mkhan stong yod rgyu red/ ngas zhib tu bsam blo zhig btang tshe/'di 'dra yin na chog 'dug yi ge ma bris/ deb 'di ma bud na/ mi gcig gi khog nas shes pa tsam yin pas/ phan pa ci yang yod rgyu ma red/ lo rgyus gnas tshul 'di yig thog tu bris shing / dpe deb cig tu gyur tshar dus/ blta mkhan bcu nas lnga bcu/ lnga bcu nas brgya tsam yod tshe/ nga yi deb 'di 'bri ba'i bsam don kyang 'grub song ba yin/ rjes su deb chung 'dir blta mkhan ci tsam yod pa dang / khyab rgya che chung ci 'dra yin pa/ yang na mi rigs dang / rgyal khab ci tsam gyi yi ger bsgyur thub pa/ rgya bod sog gsum gyi gzigs mkhan rnams kyi sems su/ dga' skyo sdug gsum gyi 'dod tshul ci 'dra re byung thub pa sogs ni/mi sus kyang tshod dpag byed thub rgyu ma red/ yang gcig bshad na/ blta mkhan rnams kyi blta ba'i 'dod pa yang 'dra rgyu ma red/ la las dpe deb nang du bris yod pa rang dang 'brel ba yod pas blta 'dod yod pa dang / la las dpe deb 5

tshe yaritshe nang du bris yod pa'i don dag dang lo rgyus sogs kho rang dang / yang na khong tsho'i sde dgon gyi rgyu mtshan dang lo rgyus rigs 'dra mang po yod pas blta 'dod yod rgyu red/ yang la las nags tshang bu chung 'di'i mgor skyid sdug 'di 'dra mang po re myong bar snying rje nas blta 'dod yod kyang srid/ de ni mi rang rang gi 'dod pa ltar red/ don dngos thog bshad na/ blta mkhan rnams kyi blta rgyu gcig yin na/ go ba len tshul 'dra rgyu ma red/ de ni ‘‘mi sum cur bsam pa sum cu/ bsam lugs mi gcig kha kha zer pa'i dpe ltar/ la las bsam na byis pa sems med cig gis rig rig mthong mthong bris par blta rgyu ci yang mi 'dug dran na'ang thang / la las bltas na 'di ni bod mi rigs kyi dus rabs gcig gi lo rgyus yin pas blta dgos pa dang /shes dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan re yod bsam nas blta ba yin rgyu red/ la las bltas na ‘‘mi rigs shig yin na'ang 'dra/ rgyal khab cig yin na'ang 'dra/ zhi bde dgos pa las nad mug 'khrug rtsod med pa ni ha cang gal chen yin pa gsal 'dug pas/ bod mi rigs kyi mi rabs rjes ma tshos rang sde rang yul/ rang re'i mi rigs 'di yi mgor nad mug 'khrug rtsod 'di 'dra mi yong ba'i ched du/ rang rigs la phan thogs pa'i bya ba cung zad bsgrub thub na bsams nas lta mkhan lhag tu mang rgyu red/ 'di ni na gzhon lo chung tshos bltas na/ lhag tu gsal ba zhig ni mi zhig gi tshe 'di'i skyid sdug ni rgo bo'i rwa tshigs 'dra bar mi su dang su yin yang rang rang mgo la skyid sdug mang po yong rgyu yod pa shes dgos la/ gal che ba ni dka' sdug ci 'drar thug kyang mi skrag par/ rang gi 'bad brtson brgyud de dka' ngal yod tshad bsal nas/ 'jig rten 'di ru 'tsho thabs dang / mi rjes mi yis chod pa zhig byed dgos pa de red/mdor na/ 'jig rten mi rerarang rang gi skyid sdug gi lo rgyus re yod la/ der 'dra ba brgya dang mi 'dra ba stong re yod rgyu red/ rig 'dra zhig gis bltas na/ 'o/ don 'di tsho ngo ma red/ nga rang la 'di lta bu'i mthong thos mang 6

5 ( nga rdzi milu po yod bsam la/ mi 'dra mkhan zhig gis rig na/ ya/ 'di rgan po smyon pa zhig gis rdzun bshad pa red bsam yang srid/ 'on kyang nga rang gi sems su ha cang gsal ba zhig ni/ nga dang na tshod 'dra ba'i bod rigs spun zla zhig yin na/lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul 'di'i thad nas/ nga dang 'dra ba'i mthong thos yod mkhan mang po yod rgyu red/ kho tsho ni lo rgyus kyi don rkyen 'di tsho'i bden dpang yin kho thag red/ nga rang gis bris yod pa'i lo rgyus kyi don rkyen tshang ma ni/ rang gis mthong ba ltar ji ma ji bzhin du bris yod pa las/ rang nyid dga' ba la yag bcos dang mi dga' ba la dma' 'bebs ci yang byas med/ nga'i bsam par/ lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul 'di ni dus rabs de'i skabs byung ba'i gnas tshul ngo ma yin pas/ lo lnga bcu tsam 'gor rjes/ ngas de'i skabs kyi gnas tshul ji ma ji bzhin 'bri ba las/ rang gi 'dod pa ltar yag bcos dang / yang na dma' 'bebs byed pa'i dbang cha ci yang med/ gal te rang gi 'dod pa ltar yag bcos dang / dma' 'bebs byas te bris tshe/ der don snying ci yang med snyam la/ ngas kyang de 'dra'i rdzun ma zhig bris nas/ mi rabs rjes ma rnams la mgo mi g.yog kho thag yin/ngas 'di nas gsal bshad byed 'dod pa zhig ni/ ngas bris yod pa'i mi dang / sa cha sdedagon thams cad ni/ dngos yod kyi mi dang sdodagon gyi gnas tshul 'ba' zhig yin la/ da bar mi tshe lo grangs brgya phyed tsam song tshar ba'i sngon gyi don dag rgyu mtshan dang lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul yin pas/ tshig 'ga' re yi mang nyung dang / don re gnyis kyi yar mtho mar 'jog sogs kyi nor 'khrul cung zad yod kho thag yin/ de ni ngas bsam bzhin du ngan 'bri byas pa min par/ rgan pos dran pa cha ma tshang pa'i skyon yin/ da lta gson por bsdad yod pa'i 'brel yod kyi mi mang pos deb chung 'di la gzigs skabs/ sdodagon sogs kyi lo rgyus don rkyen bris par/ mngon gsal gyi nor 'khrul yod pa mthong na/ ngas khyed rnams la snying thag pa nas dgongs pa mi tshom par zhu ba ma zad/ khyed rnams 7

3 lo'itshe kyis nor bcos byed pa dang bsam 'char 'don par dga' bsu dang bka' drin che zhu ba yin/‘6bshad rgyu mang na mi mi dga'/ dbyug ring 'phyar na khyi mi dga'’ zer ba'i dpe red/ da ni nga'i deb chung chung zhig la/ don dag mtho gang med sa nas/ bshad rgyu 'dom pa gang dgos don med/ bzang ngan yag btsog ci yod na/ gzigs mkhan rnams kyis bshad chog pa red la/ lo rgyus kyi lag len thog nas ra sprod byed thub rgyu red/ nga rang gis thog mtha' bar gsum kun tu lo rgyus la phyir blta byed dgos pa'i dmigs yul ni/ rang sa rang sde 'di dang / rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di/ yang na 'dzam gling yongs kyi mthun sgril dang / zhi bde yun ring gnas pa dang / nad mug 'khrug rtsod mi 'byung ba'i ched du yin la/ lhag par du bod gangs ljongs yongs dang / 'dzam gling yongs la dus dang rnam pa kun tu mthun sgril dang /zhi bde yong ba dang / nad mug 'khrug rtsod med pa'i smon 'dun yang yang zhu/nags tshang nus blo nas/ bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing pho bya lo'i zla 8tshes 15 nyin/ krung go'i mtsho sngon zi ling grong khyer nas bris/

sngon brjod skyid sdug gi rang gtam/lo rgyus 'bri ba ni dka' mo zhig red/ rang gi lo rgyus 'bri ba ni/ de bas kyang dka' mo red/ lhag par du tshe gcig gi skyid sdug gi lo rgyus cha tshang ba zhig 'bri dgos na ha cang dka' mo zhig red/mi zhig yin na/ su dang su yin yang rang rang gi tshe 'dir bsam yul las 'das pa'i dka' sdug mang po myong nges yin/ nga ni dus 'gyur chen po'i dus skabs su skyes pa'i mi yin pas/ nga'i mgo la bsam yul las 'das pa'i sdug bsngal mang po yong myong ba yin/ thengs re rang gis 'dang log re brgyab na/ lo chung chung nga 'dra ba zhig gi mgo la yong ba'i sdug bsngal 'di 'dra zhiga'ajig rten gyi mi su 'dra zhig gi mgo la yang yong myong rgyu ma red bsams/ yang bsam blo re btang na/ de 'dra zhig ga la yin/ nga ni nga dang nga 'dra ba'i mi brgya stong mang po'i nang gi gcig tsam yin rgyu red bsams/ ma gzhir/ skyid 'dod pa las sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa ni 'jig rten mi yi rang gshis red/ bde skyid 'dzoms dang mi 'dzoms pa rang lag la thug yod zer mkhan mang po yod la/bden pa yin yang srid/ 'on kyang / sdug bsngal ni btsan ya med cig yin pas/mi su 'dra zhig gi mgor yong tshe/ khyod kyis 'dod rung ma 'dod rung mi khur thabs med red/ mi zer ba 'di ni/ skyid brgyab rabs bshad na dga' ba yin nam/ sdug myong rabs bshad na dga' ba yin/ mi mang che ba'i dus rgyun rang gis sdug myong rabs bshad pa las/ skyid brgyab rabs de tsam bshad rgyu med pa la bltas na/ mi ni sdug bshad byed par dga' ba 'dra'o/ rgan po'i 'gro sdug 'dug sdug dang rgan mo'i za sdug 'thung sdug ste/ mgo nag mi'i skyid sdug 'dra 9

tshe lo'itshe yang / skyid rgyag mkhan dang sdug myong mkhan gyi sems kyi myong tshor ni mi 'dra kho thag yin/ rang sems dga' ba'i skad cha red/ sngon du skyid po yin rabs shig bshad na/ mi rang rang gi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen mi 'dra rung / skyid po yin snang shar ba'i sems ni gcig 'dra yin/ 'jig rten mi yi nang na/ las mi dgos zho dang 'o ma/ sha mar/ sbrang rtsi/ bu ram la sogs pa'i kha zas dang / 'gul mi dgos dar gos chen/ tshar slog gis rgyab g.yog 'gro na rta thog bsdad na gdan thog zas sder thog yin pa'i mi drag dang bla dpon tshos rang rang skyid po yin bsam rgyu red la/ sbra gur gnyis 'dzoms dang / rta zog lug bsum g.yang du 'khor ba'i phyug phrug tshos/ rta 'do ba bya 'dra ba rer zhon te/ bo'u (me mda'/khra ring thog 'dra ba re khur nas/ sde gang gzhom sa nas jag brgyab/ rdza gang mtho mgo nas ri dgas bda' dus/ kho ni ha cang skyid po yin bsam rgyu red/ yang mi sprang po sgo zog ra ma zhig med pa/ de ring ru nyul nas sha skal tshon po zhig gam/yang na mar dkar po'i rtsam pa snum po phor pa gang za rgyu lon pa ma zad/ khyim gyi gza' nyog tshor zas cung tsam re ster rgyu lon dus/ kho ni ha cang skyid po yin bsam kho thag yin/nga rang gi tshe 'dir bsam blo btang na/ ngas tshe 'dir skyid kyang mang po brgyab myong / chung dus nas shes rig yon tan slob thub pa dang / lto gos gnyis 'dzoms yod la/ sa gar song 'og la rta pho yod pa dang / rgyab la me mda' ring thung gnyis re khur ba/ dpon sa mthon por bsdad nas dbang chen po bzung myong / kha mgo rna yod dus lus rlung rta dar myong / skyid snang ba mtho myong /mi 'dra 'dra'i thad nas/ rang yan na skyid po med snyam/ skyid 'di 'dra yod na chog bsam mo// da smyo gtam mang po bshad nas ci byed/ nga min par mi sus kyang rang gi tshe 'di skyid po yin par 'dod do// gnad 'gag ni/ mi zer ba'i las ngan 'di'i skyid che na skyid ngo mi zin/ 'jig rten gtam dpe la‘‘skyid che na rta gong hu shi zer ba los bden/ skad cha bshad mtshams 'dir slebs na/10

nga 3 elu mi zhig skyid mi skyid zer ba rgyu che chung min par/ mi 'di yi sems kha gang min la thug yod/ sems kha gang na rtsam nag cig las za rgyu med kyang skyid po yin la/ sems kha ma gang na ‘6skyid chen khog pa sdug gis gang zer ba ltar ro//mi zhig gi tshe gang ni/ bshad mi shes pa zhig red/ mi la lar sdug chen po'i rgyab na skyid kyi nyi ma yod/ mi la lar skyid brgyab pa'i mtha' na sdug gi mun pa yod/ 6‘rum nang ci yod lag mgo'i rgyu/ skyid sdug ci myong rang gi sems/nya mi su dang su yin yang / rang la skyid sdug gi skad cha mang po bshad rgyu los yod/ yang sdug myong rabs shig bshad na/ mi tshe 'di ni/ mtho gser khri'i steng gi bla ma/dpon po/ bar 'khor ngan nang gi mi skya pho mo/ 'og rgya lam rgyud kyi sprang mo su yin yang / rgas na shi gsum gyi sdug dang bral thabs med par ma zad/ mi re rer rang gi sdug re yod pa smos ma dgos/ dpon mtho gsum dbang dang go gnas che chung gi sdug rgyu chen phyug po tsho/ rgyu gsog pa'i ham pa mi gang ba'i sdugasprang 'khyam po tsho zas gos mi 'dzoms pa'i sdug ste/ mdor na/ mgo nag mi la yod mkhan yod kyis sdug med mkhan med kyis sdug rang rang gi tshe srog mar me 'dra ba 'di rlung gis bsad ma song ba'i bar du mi re la sdug re bshad rgyu yod/nga rang gi mi tshe 'dir phyir bltas shig byas na/ skyid skyid sdug sdug skyid sdug mnyam 'dres/ dga' dga' skyo skyo/ dga' skyo gnyis ldan te/ skyid sdug mang po zhig myangs rjes/ mi che'i lo brgya yi phyed tsam brgal ba red/ 'dang yang yang brgyab na/ sdug dang sdug bsngal yod tshad nga rang gi mgor lhung myong / sdug bsngal de dag bshad na sems skyo la/ ma bshad na sems nang gi nad lta bu zhig tu gyur/ pha ma'i ngo ma zin gong nas/ ma drin can gyis/ nga rang shul du bskyur nas bde zhing du phebs song / nga rang lo ngo gnyis tsam nas/ pha drin can gyis mi gzhan la bcol ma phod par lag khrid byas nas/ ri 'khyams sde 'khyams byas te 'tsho ba rol/ pha drin can gyis nga lo bcu las ma son med cing / nar ma son gong nas sa mthar lhung bar 'gyod sems chen po skyes nas bde zhing du phebs 11

ja laskumarna song bas/ nged span gnyis sa mthar lhung / ya nga ba'i da phrug gi 'tsho ba'i dka' sdug myong ba derngo phyir dran byas tshe/ yid shin tu skyo ba zhig red/ yang bsam blo zhib tu btang na/ dus 'gyur chen po'i khrod du gangs ljongs yongs su chag sgo dang sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byung yod pas/ sdug 'di 'dra nga rang gcig pu'i mgor lhung ba ma red/ mi ha cang mang po zhig dmag 'khrug dang /nad mug btson khang sogs kyi sdug bsngal chen po las ma thar bar tshe las 'das/ der bltas na/ nga rang gis sdug chen po myangs nas ma shi bar skyid kyi sne mo zin yod pas/ sdug myangs bsams nas 'gyod pa skye rgyu ci yang mi 'duga'on kyang mi zhig yin na'ang 'dra/ mi rigs shig yin na'ang 'dra/ rang rang gi skyid sdug gi lo rgyus 'di ma brjed na de ni dga' 'os pa zhig red/ mi brjed zer ba ni/ khog tu bzung ba tsam la zer ba min par/ yi ger bris te mi rabs rjes ma'i lag tu bzhag na/ phyogs gang gi thad nas bshad kyang / kho tshor skul ma gtong ba dang spobs pa rgyas su 'jug par phan thogs los yod/nga rang chung dus nas/ pha drin can gyis nam rgyun nga rang la ‘6pha bzang bu/ dka' sdug phran tsam la sems shi lus shi byed mi nyan/ skyes pho rab cig gi lus thog na/ skyid sdug rgo ba'i rwa tshigs 'dra zer ba red/ khyod tsho'i mi tshe ring po rjes na yod/ skyid sdug mang po rig rgyu yod pa red/ a pha'i bu rgod/ khyod chung dus nas sdug gi nang nas 'tshar longs byung na/ lo che dus mi rjes chod kyi redanya’sogs zer ba brjed rgyu med la/ nga rang gi mi tshe 'di'i lo bcu phrag mang po'i nang du/ dka' sdug ci 'dra zhig la thug rung / sems ma shi ba'i rten gzhi ngo ma ni pha drin can gyi snying gtam 'di dag yin/ mgo la skyid sdug ci yong ni/mi rang rang gi sngon bsags kyi las yin srid la/ tshe 'dir rang rang gi 'gro lugs 'dug stangs kyi rkyen yin yang srid/ mi tshe gcig gi 'tsho ba ni/ nga rang lo chung dus su dran pa dang re 'dod ltar ha cang dga' ba dang / bde zhing skyid pa zhig ma red/ lo re lo re bzhin/ lo na je cher 'gro ba dang mnyam du bsam 12

5 ci ༅rdziyom yul las 'das pa'i dka' sdug kyang ha cang mang po zhig rang gi mgor lhung ba red/ de bas mi su dang su yin yang / chung dus nas rang gi sems su/ mi tshe 'dir skyid sdug mang por gdong gtug byed dgos pa'i bsam pa'i 'du shes dang bsam tshod brtan po zhig yod dgos/ nga rang chung dus su gtam dpe 'di 'dra zhig go myong ste/ ‘‘gro ma mar khu za myong / da ni mi dgos zer myong / phyur khu sngo rtag 'thung myong / da rung e yod zer myong /nya mi zhig gi tshe gang gi skyid sdug ni 'di 'dra'i mi rtag pa red/ tshe stod skyid na tshe smad sdug yang na tshe stod sdug na tshe smad skyid/ lo 'ga' rer skyid kyang 'ga' rer sdug de ni mi'i bsam pa'i 'dod pa ltar mi yong kho thag red/ brgyags dus mi zer ba 'dis gro ma mar khu za 'dod med la/ ltogs dus phyur khu sngo rtag 'thung rgyu mi lon pas/ skyid sdug zer ba ni/ mi re rer de 'dra cha mi stoms pa zhig red/chung dus su a zhang rgya khor gyis ‘‘mgo nag mi la blta rgyu ci yang yod pa ma red/ mi zer rgyu 'di las ngan pa red/ skyid khyog gi ma red/ sdug btsan po ya med red—/ mgo la lhung na mi khyog rang khyog redami zer/ ngas rang gi mi che'i khrod nas/ dus nam yang skad cha de sems su bzung ba yin/ rjes su bsam blo yang yang btang na/ skad cha de dag ni los bden/ de ni khong rnams kyi mi tshe gcig gi skyid sdug nyams myong red/ mgo nag mi zhig yin na/ dpon la mtho dma' med pa/ rgyu la phyug sprang med pa/ skyes pho mo dang lo na che chung med pa/chung nas che/ che nas rgas/ rgas nas shi ma song bar du/ nad dang mu ge bgegs dang bar chad/ mi shi rgyu gyong sogs don bzang ngan ci 'dra byung yang / lus skyid sdug ci 'dra yin yang / mi rang rang gis khur dgos pa yin la/ khyod kyi srog 'di ma shor ba'i khrod nas/ khyod dga' yang sdug kyang / mu mthud du 'jig rten 'dir 'tsho ba rol dgos pas/ sngar ltar kha la za ba'i zas dang / rgyab la gon rgyu'i gos kyi don du dka' las rgyag dgos/ 'jig rten gtam gyi dpe ltar ‘‘nyin gcig gi tshe las med kyang / tshe gcig gi 'dug chas dgos zer ba los 13

de 'jiye bden/ 'jig rten 'khor ba ni khom pa mig gis rig rgyu med kho thag red/ shi zin pa'i nyin nas yod tshad shul du bzhag ste/ khom pa chen po byung ba yin/ 'on kyang / mi sus kyang 'di lta bu'i khom pa yod na mi 'dod la/ ma 'dod kyang / 'chi bdag gi zhags nag 'di mi su'i ske la thebs kyang / de ni rang dbang med par tshe phyi mar 'khyam dgos pa kho thag red/ de'i nyin nas bzung / bde sdug ci yang med par/ yod tshad mjug rdzogs song ba red/mi re re la rang rang gi bde sdug mi snyoms pa'i mi che'i lo rgyus re yod pas/ ngas 'di nas rang gi tshe 'dir myong thos kyi bde sdug sogs bris dang ma bris mi gzhan la 'brel ba ci yang med/ yin na'ang / mi re re'i skyid na skyid sa kha kha/ sdug na sdug lugs so so zer ba'i dpe ltar/ nga rang chung dus nas/mgo ru lhung ba'i bgegs chag sgo sdug dka' khag dang / dwa phrug 'khyams sdom gyi 'tsho ba rol ba sogs kyi rang dngos kyi myong tshul 'di 'dra zhig phal cher nga dang na tshod mnyam pa'i mi zhig gis myangs yod rgyu ma red bsam/ nga rang ni dka' sdug mang po'i nang nas/ sems ma shi bar nar son pa dang / shi gson mang po'i bar nas yid ma chad par srog thar ba yin/ nga rang gis dngos su mthong ba yod tshad ji ma ji bzhin yig thog tu bris te/ mi rabs rjes ma tshos blta thub pa byung na/ kho tsho'i mi tshe zer ba ni 'di 'dra'i kyag kyog dang / 'di 'dra'i dka' sdug mang po brgyud dgos pa zhig yin pa lo na chung dus nas ha go thub rgyu red bsam/ de bas khong tshos chung dus nas/ mi che'i mdun lam la don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i re stong mang po mi bcangs par/ rang rang gi mi tshe 'di'i thog mtha' kun tu/ dka' sdug mang po la 'thab rtsod byed dgos pa dang /rang gi sems shugs dang 'bad brtson la brten nas/ rang rang so sos bde zhing skyid pa'i 'tsho ba zhig skrun dgos pa las/ gna' mi'i gtam dpe la ‘‘dka' mo'i las ka ma byas na/ zhim po'i za ma za rgyu medami zer ba ltar/ don med du skyid cig yong rgyu med pa lhag tu ha go thub rgyu red/ kho tshos ha cang gsal po shes 14

ma (ḍa ༅ 3 yom thub pa ni/ sdug dang chag sgo ni dus dang rnam pa kun tu rang gi mgor lhung ba'i nyen kha yod pas/ de la gcig nas mi skrag pa dang sems mi shi ba/ gnyis nas rang gi 'bad brtson brgyud nas dka' sdug sel thub pa'i snying stobs yod dgos pa de yin/ skyid po rang gis ma byas na mi yis mi ster/ rang gi mi che'i skyid sdug ci 'dra yin yang / gal che ba ni rang gi sems shugs dang / nus pa sogs la brten nas gom pa re re bzhin 'gro dgos pa de yin/ lo rgyus yig cha chung chung 'dis mi tsho'i sems nang du bsam tshul 'di 'dra re 'khor thub pa'i go re chod song na/ nga rang gi lo rgyus yig cha 'di bris pa'i bsam don 'grub payin/ lo rgyus ni 'das zin pa'i bya don yin pas/ don che chung ci 'dra yin pa dang / bya ba yag btsog ci zhig yin yang / skabs de'i gnas tshul dang don rkyen ji ma ji bzhin 'bri dgos pa las/ de ni deng sang gi 'dod tshul dang / chab srid kyi dgos mkho ltar yag bcos dang / yang na ngan 'bri ci yang byed dgos don med la/ de ltar byed kyang chog rgyu ma red/ nga rang gis deb chung 'di'i nang bris yod pa'i don che chung tshang ma ni/ rang gis dngos su mig mthong lag zin gyi don rkyang rkyang yin la/ rang gis ma rig mi shes pa/ yang na don dang mi mthun pa gcig kyang bris med/lo ngo lnga bcu'i sngon gyi don dang gnas tshul sogs yin pas/ nga rang dang na tshod 'dra ba'i mi tshos bltas na/ lo rgyus thog byung ba'i don rkyen 'di dag ni bden pa yin pa gsal por shes rgyu red la/ kho tsho rang rang la'ang 'di dang 'di 'dra ba'i mig mthong lag zin gyi lo rgyus don rkyen mang po zhig bshad rgyu yod kho thag red/ nga tsho ni dus rabs gcig gi dus 'gyur skabs kyi mi yin pas mthong thos tshang ma phal cher gcig 'dra yin rgyu red/ yin na'ang / de ring kha sang gi lo chung gzhon nu tshor cha bzhag na/ nga'i deb chung nang du bris yod pa'i don rkyen 'di dag bden pa e yin nam bsam yang srid/ der khag med de/ gcig na khong tshos pha ma dang / nye 'brel tsho'i kha nas lo rgyus kyi don 15

re yolo rkyen thar thor re go yod na ma gtogs rang gis dngos su mthong med pa dang /gnyis na/ don rkyen 'di'i thad kyi lo rgyus yig cha cha tshang zhig med pas rgyu mtshan ci yang mi shes/ skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi 'gyur ldog ni/ gnam sa mgo mjug bslogs pa 'dra ba'i dus 'gyur chen po zhig yin/ deng sang bde zhing skyid par 'tsho ba rol bzhin pa'i lo chung tshos/ lo rgyus thog tu byung myong ba'i don rkyen 'di bden pa yin par yid ches dgos na cung tsam dka' mo red/ 'on kyang / mi rabs rjes ma'i na gzhon tshos blo gtad chog pa dang / yid ches chog pa zhig ni/nga rgan po lo lon zhig gis shi khar don dag ngo ma med na/ don med du smyo gtam 'di 'dra mang po zhig bshad nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i bdag po rnams la mgo skor gtong dgos don rtsa ba nas med do//

6)(1 dzodadzod ces/mi lus thob pa'i dga' skyo sdug gsum//de/deskye ba sngon mar bsags pa'i las 'bras/le tshan dang po/nga yi pha yul skyid po/ rma sde chu kha ma red/‘6pha yul’’zhes pa'i yi ge 'di gnyis la mi su dang su yin yang / ha cang 'dang chen po zhig yod pa 'dra/ mi gnyis ngo 'phrad dus/ ‘‘khyod pha yul gang nas yin/nya zhes sngon du skad cha 'di 'dri bzhin yod/ nga'i sems su yang / chung dus nas pha yul zhes pa 'di rna bas go na/ sems su don med du brtse 'dang chen po zhig chags 'dug nam yin yang / rang gi pha yul gyi gnas tshul phran tsam re ci dran gang dran gyis mi gzhan la bshad pa ste/ pha yul gyi sa bzang rabs dang chu zhim rabs/ rtswa rtsi shing dang me tog mang po yod rabs/ rta zog lug gsum mang rabs/ pha yul skyid po yin rabs sogs mdor na/ kha gang dbugs kyis 'byon tshad pha yul la bstod pa byed pa dang / ma gzhi nga min yang / nga'i lo tshod kyi mi tshang ma ni pha yul bzang rabs bshad mkhan rkyang rkyang yin/ mi su yin yang rang gi pha yul de 'dra bzang zhing skyid po yin na/ pha yul dang kha bral nas sa mthar mi yong ba lta bu red/ 'on kyang / nga'i g.yas g.yon na yod pa'i mi mang che ba ni/ rang sa rang yul/ rang gi gces pa'i pha yul dang kha bral nas/sa mthar 'khyams yong ba rkyang rkyang red/ yang bsam blo re btang na/ mi su dang su yin yang rang gi pha yul dang kha bral 'dod med na'ang / kha mi 'bral thabs 17

rwaku ༅ li lu5 — 0 li checam 4la med kyi don rkyen re nga rang dang 'dra bar yod kho thag red/ 'on kyang / mi su dang su yin rung / ci 'dra'i thag ring sa mthar song yang / rang gi pha yul sems nas brjed thabs med/ rang sa rang yul du sdod mkhan tshos/ rang sa skyid pa dang / pha yul du bsdad yod pa skyid po yin par bsam gyin yod med mi shes/thengs rer ngas zhib tu bsam blo btang na/ rang gis ‘‘pha yul nyazer ba'i yi ge gnyis kyi go don gsal po zhig ha go gi med pa 'dra/ pha yul zer ba 'di/ rang gi pha drin can 'dug pa'i sa cha/ yang na sde ba 'di la ‘‘pha yul zer ba yin nam/ nga rang nyid skyes yul/ yang na skye sa/ ma drin can gyi lte khrag pho sa der ‘‘pha yul’ zer ba yin/ ci zhig yin yang / mi thug mi dang khyi thug khyi la bshad dgos pa zhig dang bstod dgos pa zhig red/ nga'i grogs po dge 'dun gyis ‘‘pha yul nas chu nag 'thung / rtsam nag min pa ci yang za rgyu med na/ sems 'grangs lto 'grangs red/ sa mtha' 'di tsho nas sha mar gyi kha zas yod na/ lto 'grangs sems mi 'grang pa zhig red ’zer ba dang / yang dus rgyun du lo chung tshos glu len dus 6‘nga'i pha yul gang zhig gang zhig yin/ rgyu chen po med kyang skyid po yin’ zer ba ltar/ tshang ma'i sems gcig pa red/ nga rang yang pha yul na yod dus/ pha yul 'di 'dra skyid po dang / pha sa 'di 'dra bzang pos nga bskyangs pas/ drin can yin bsam rgyu ma byung mod/ sa mthar slebs dus/ pha yul sems la dran na skyid po zhig red/ nga rang chung dus nas a phas khrid nas/ sa cha mang po zhig la 'khyams sdom byas myong / de dus a pha nam rgyun nged bu span gnyis la‘‘pha bzang bu gnyis ka/ sa gang la song na/ rang gi pha yul dang / zlo skad ma brjedanya’zer ba ni/ dus rgyun nga'i rna lam du grag 'dug bshad na mtshar po red/ thag ring ba'i sa mtha' ci 'drar song yang / pha yul na yod pa'i nye sa rnams dran rgyu ci yang med la/ pha yul gyi sa cha dang rang nyid chung dus su 'gro myong 'dug myong gi sa cha ni/ dus nam yang sems nas brjed med red/yang nga rang chung dus su/ stod nyam tsho'i rgad po zhig gis nga rang la‘‘ya 18

( 4 03 milu bu chung / da khyod sha tsha/ khyi sprang po gnyis la pha yul med/ lto ba gang nas 'grang na pha yul redaminyazer myong ba 'di nga'i sems su de ring bshad pe bzhin/ ha cang gsal po dran 'dug 'on kyang / nga rang chung dus nas/ nged bu span gnyis ni da phrug sa mthar lhung ba/ sprang po khyi 'dra ba yin pa ha go la/ nga rnong gnyis la pha yul med snang zhig zhe nas yod ma myong / de dus nga'i pha yul ni nyin dkar sems su yod cing / mtshan mor rmi lam nang na yod/ nga rang chung dus nas/mgo la dka' sdug ci 'dra byung yang / sems nas‘‘mtha' ci 'dra la thug kyang nga ni shi mi nyan/ nga rang snga phyi ma gtogs yin gcig min gnyis/ pha yul tu 'gro dgos’ bsam pa'i sems shugs ni ha cang brtan po yin/ 'jig rten gtam dpe la ‘‘bu skyes sa sa mtha' yin ’zer la/ nga rang yang / las nag po zad pa min na/ sa mtha' nas mgo dgye nas mi gras su slebs thub pa'i nyin zhig los yod/ de dus nga rang pha yul phyogs su slebs na/ dus 'gyur gyi rkyen gyis/ nye 'brel chen po lhag med kyang rma sde chu kha ma'i sa chu ri klung dang / u rgyan pan zhu sogs sngar ltar gnas yod bsam/ ngo ma bshad na/ nga'i pha yul na gal che ba'i khyim mi ci yang med la/ a khu a zhang / a ne sogs snying thag nye ba'i nye sa mang po yod/ nga 'dra zhig pha yul du ma slebs kyang / sdug rgyu de 'dra med/ 'on kyang ngas dus dang rnam pa kun tu pha yul dang pha yul gyi nye 'brel sogs dran zhing /pha yul gyi chung dus rtse rogs tsho dang / yang na be'u rgyud pa snabs zan dang / khyi rgan rgya lu sogs dran pa dang / lhag par du pha yul gyi sa chu ri gsum de sa gang du song na'ang dran zhing / lo ci tsam 'gor rung dran pa red/ de bas ngas chung dus nas sems thag bcad zin pa ni/ ‘‘shi ma song na/ nga rang snga phyi ma gtogs pha yul lha sde dkar por slebs thub pa byed rgyu de yin/nya’nga rang thog mar chu dmar leb ra tshang sde ba'i bde skyid khang gi slob grwa'i nang du slebs dus/ mgo log dge rgan tshe ring rdo rjes ‘‘a rogs mgo log zhi lu/ khyod kyi pha yul ngo ma gang nas redanya zer bar/ ‘‘nga'i pha yul ni rma sde chu kha ma redami ces bshad par/19

7 khya mi lu5 — 0 li 0 ca0 krul khong gis ‘‘'o/ de ngas shes ya/ dngul ra lha sde/ khro kho chu kha ma los shes/ nga chung dus 'gro myong / sa skyid po red/ sde btsan po bu rgod po red/mi zer bar/nga rang de dus lo chung yang / mi don med cig gis nga rang gi pha yul la 'di ltar bstod pa byas par/ sems nas ha cang dga' spro skyes song /khyod kyi pha yul ngo ma gang nas red zer na/ nga'i pha yul ngo ma ni/ bod gangs can gyi shar phyogs/ a myes rma rgyal sbom ra'i lho ngos/ shar dung ri mthon po'i g.yas zur/ rma chu ring mo'i khugs so bco brgyad kyi khugs dang po na gnas pa'i rma sde chu kha ma'am/ yang na khro kho chu kha ma zer pa'i sde ba de yin//le tshan gnyis pa/nam yang brjed pa med pa'i/ rang sa rang sde drin chen/ngan pas rang bstod min par/ rma sde chu kha ma'i sa cha de ni/ ri lung thang gsum kun la rtswa chu 'dzoms shing / rtsi shing me tog rgyas pa'i sa cha skyid po zhig yin pa ma zad/ sa cha bsod nams ldan pa zhig kyang yin/ ri gang mtho'i mgo ru sha ba dang / rgo ba/ kha shwa sogs ri dgas yod la/ rma chu'i chu kha'i nags dang shug pa'i gseb na dred mong dang / spyang ki/ wa sbe sogs gcan gzan gang mang yod/ lo re'i gnam gshis dro grang stoms la/ char chu mod pas rtswa dang rtsi shing skyes pa ha cang bzang / dper na/ rtswa rigs la nags rtswa/ spang rtswa/ rtswa ku sha/ rtswa gur gum/ ri bong 'bos rtswa/ rka rtswa dang / 'jag rtswa sogs yod la/ mis za rung ba'i rigs la sha mo/ gro ma/ brag star/ gla star/ star bu/ go lo/ ldum bu snyi lo/ ba glud/ ri sgog sogs gang mang yod par ma zad/ sman rtswa'i rigs la/lcum/ spang rgyan dkar sngon/ utpal dmar ser/ dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu/ 'jib rtsi dmar ser/ mkhan skya sogs ci 'dod ci dgos yod/ yang rma chu'i chu rgyud 20

5 ḍa rdzi'u lu du/ nags de/ ngang pa dkar ser/ skya ka khra mo sogs bya bye'u rigs mang po yod/ ru sde 'dug gnas kyi ri thang kun tu/ spang ljongs khyabe che zhing sa gshis 'jam la/ rtswa lhum skyes stobs bzang bas rta zog 'tsho sa bzang po zhig yin zer srol yod/ nga rang chung dus su/ nam yin yang a khu zho tshe yis mi gzhan pa dang kha rtsod rgyag pa go myong / khos‘‘ya zhi lu tsho/ nga tsho'i rma sde chu kha ma 'di sde rang ga ba zhig dang mi 'dra bar/ 'dug sa rma klung ring mo/ rma chu'i khugs so dang po/ ri thang lung gsum rtswa chu 'dzoms sa/ rta zog lug gsum g.yang du 'khor sa/ 'bri mdzo mo 'o ma mod sa/ rta 'do ba gom lag bde sa/ stag sha ra'i dpa' rtsal rgod sa/ sman bu mo skye gzugs yag sa/ chos dkar phyogs bstan pa dar sa/ dpon bla ma dbang thang mtho sa/ sde 'bangs mi stobs 'byor rgyas sa yin ’zhes skad cha ha cang mang po bshad rgyu yod la/ de ni ngo ma ‘‘bu bzang po'i kha na gtam yod/ sman bzang mo'i lag na zas yod’nyazer ba'i dpe ltar/ mi sus nyan yang sun rgyu med pa zhig red/ nga yi pha yul rma sde chu kha ma/ sa cha skyid po yin pas mi tshad/ lo re'i dbyar dgun ston dpyid kyi gnam gshis dro grang gi gnas tshul te/ sa phar 'khengs skor/ sa chu tshur dros skor/ rtswa ldum me tog skye skor sogs kyi 'gyur ldog ni/ dus tshigs ltar ha cang mngon gsal yin/ sa 'di'i mi rgan rabs kun gyi kha na/ lo re'i dus tshigs bzhi'i gnam gshis 'gyur ldog gi rtags mtshan cha tshang re bshad rgyu yod pa 'di ltar/ ‘‘bya zla chu nag lam nag khyi zla spo tho kha se/ phag zla ri skya thang sngon/ byi zla ri sngon thang sngon/ glang zla rtsa smyo chu smyo/ stag zla khra mer cig cig yos zla khra mo nas zan/ 'brug zla shing lo rlung khyer/ sbral zla rnga ma 'khyags 'byar/ rta zla chu kha dar chags/ lug zla kha phyid sna chad/ hphol zla sa gas rdo 'gadami’ces/ 'di ltar lo skor zla ba bcu gnyis kyi sa chu'i dros 'khyag gi 'gyur ldog ni re re bzhin ha cang gsal po byas nas bshad yod/ nga yi pha yul rma sde chu kha ma/ khyim tshang bdun brgya yod zer la/ rma chu'i g.yas 'gram g.yon 'gram/ rgyu chu'i phar ri tshu ri/ ru skor re re bzhin bsdad 21

leku khya yi lu5 — 0 li nyepo wal yod la/ mgo tsha/ rko chen/ bar zhi/ rgyu lag sogs ru tsho shog kha zhe mthun pa/bkra shis chos gling dgon pa/ grwa dge 'dun lnga brgya'i gdan sa/ rgyab ri rgod sgra g.yu sgra/ mdun ri u rgyan pan zhu/ sde dgon mgo 'dzoms yin la/ chos dang dge ba dar zhing / pho mo rgan gzhon med par/ bsam bzang gshis rgyud 'jam la/ las dang rgyu 'bras brtsi ba/ khrims dang ngo tsha srung ba/ yul sde stobs 'byor rgyas shing / 'bangs la lto gos 'dzoms pas/ skyid zer ba 'dzam gling sa yi lte ba/ spro zer ba khams gsum mi yi g.yang sa/ 'di ni rma sde khro kho chu kha ma'i sa red/nga'i sems su rang gi tshe sngon mar bsags pa'i las yin na'ang 'dra/bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje yin na'ang 'dra/ sa skyid po 'di 'dra zhig nas skye ba ni ha cang skyid po red snyam/ 'on kyang / yang 'dang brgyab na/ yid skyo ba zhig ni/ chung lo ngo bcu tsam nas/ rang yul lha yul 'dra ba bskyur te/ sa mtha' ru 'khyams nas da bar mi tshe lo brgya yi phyed tsam song 'dug 'on kyang nga pha yul dang kha bral nas da bar du/ nyi ma re re bzhin pha yul 'di nyin dkar sems su 'khor zhing / mtshan mo rmi lam du 'char bas brjed zer ba zhig gtan nas yod ma myong / nga rang pha yul dang bral nas lo ngo nyi shu tsam 'gor rjes/ ngas sa mtha' nas dka' sdug mang po myangs kyang ma shi bar/ dus nam yang brjed pa med pa'i pha yul rma sde chu kha ma la dngos su slebs thub song / nga'i pha yul gyi sa chu ri gsum mig gis mthong ba na/ de ni rang chung dus su sems la 'khor ba ltar/ ji 'dra'i mdzes shing / ji 'dra'i skyid pa zhig red/ yar bltas na rgod sgra dang lha chen rdo rje g.yu sgra sogs skye lha gzhi bdag rnams re re bzhin de ltar brjid nyams che ba dang / mar bltas na mdun ri u rgyan pan zhu/ g.yas na rgyu chu/ g.yon na rma chu/ mdun na bkra shis chos gling thang sogs ci 'dra'i skyid po zhig red ang / da ni ngo ma pha yul gyi pang du slebs song / 'di 'dra'i dga' ba la/ 'di 'dra'i skyid pa la/ lo mang gi re ba dngos gnas grub song /pha yul kyi nye 'brel rnams kyang lhag tu dga' spro skye 'dug la/ a khu nor 22

ḍa cha nyi yo bkras 6‘da bzang song / bu rgod gnyis/ khyod gnyis kyis chung dus nas pha yul dran pas/ rang yul gyi skye lha gzhi bdag gi skyor ma g.yor ma yod pa red/ de min sa mtha' ru shi na'ang thang nyazer bar/ a nee rtam khos 6‘'o ya snying rje dkon mchog mkhyen/ da ni shi gson ngo thug song / nga'i tshe 'dir ngo thug rgyu zhig yod snang ma shar/ khyed gnyis pha yul du yong bsams nas sems shugs che bas/shi ma thub pa red/ da ni rang sa ru 'dug dgos/ yum 'don 'gro mi chog nyaces sogs sems dga' sdug gi skad cha mang po bshad/ ngas kyang da ni mi rgan pa dag gis bshad pa los bden bsam/ dngos su pha yul du slebs dus kyang lhag tu dran rgyu ci yang med pa lta bu red/ cung ma 'gor bar yang pha yul dang kha bral nas sa mtha' ru song ba yin/ da thengs ni sngar dang mi 'dra bar/ sems bde blo bde byas nas lam du bzhud pa yin la/ a ne rnam khos ngu 'bod dang sems sdug byed par skrag nas/ 'gro ba yin zhes ma bshad pa ma gtogs/ nye 'brel kun gyis dga' dga' spro spro yis lam pa byas/ pha yul/ nga yi gces 'dang che ba'i pha yul/ nga rang chung dus 'dug ma 'dod par khyed dang kha bral ba ci la yin/ dus 'gyur chen po'i nang nas/ las bsam bzhin ma red gseg gis/nga bu chung sa mthar 'khyams kyang / rang ci srid bar du yin na/ mthar rang yul phyogs su yong bsam/ las skya mor rang dbang yod dus/ gzhis sa mthar mi chags sems thag ngas yang thengs re 'dang zhib tu brgyab pa na/ nga rang pha yul skyid pa 'di ru gzhis chags mi thub pas/ snga gzhug ma gtogs sa mtha' zhig tu shi dgos pa ni gzur rgyu med pa'i las yin pa 'dra zhig red/ de bas/rang gi sems su dran pa zhig ni/ ngo ma nga rang nyin zhig sa mtha' nas shi na/ de'i nyin mor pha yul phyogs kyi skye lha gzhi bdag yang na bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyis nga'i rnam shes sbrang chung 'dra por mgon skyabs re byed par thugs rje che zhu ba lags//23

le tshan gsum pa/spro skyid 'dzoms pa'i khyim tshang/ 'byor phyug ldan pa'i pha sa/'jig rten srid pa 'di chags nas bzung / 'dzam gling 'dir srog chags rigs khri 'bum yod pa'i nang nas/ mi zer ba ni ches ya mtshar dang /bshad mi shes pa'i mtho rim gyi srog chags shig red/ mi lus thob pa ni ha cang dka' zer la/ de ni sran ma spar gang gyang ngo la gtor na/ 'byar rgyu med pa'i dpe ltar/ rnam shes khri stong gi nang du mi lus thob pa re gnyis las med pa/dka' mo'i nang gi dka' mo zhig yin zer/ da yod kyi mi tshos bsam blo ci yang ma btang na/ kho tshos nyin re mi brgya stong skye bzhin yod pa mthong bas/ rang gi mi lus blangs pa yang ha cang sla mo zhig yin snang shar zhing / rang la mi lus thob pa yang de 'dra gal chen zhig tu mthong bzhin med pa 'dra 'o//skad cha drang mo bshad na/ mi zhig gi skye sa skye yul gang yin pa dang / skye sa'i khyim tshang ci 'dra yin pa/ rgya bod sog gsum gang du skye ba/ skye pho lus mo lus ci 'dra len pa/ skye mgo mtho dman ci 'dra yin pa/ skyes rjes yan lag 'dzoms min/ tshe thag ring thung / tshe gcig gi skyid sdug ci 'dra yin pa sogs ni/ rang rang la 'dem dbang med par ma drin can gyi lus nas skyes rjes mi lus thob pa yin/ nga rang yang 'di ltar yin rgyu red/ 'on kyang / nga rang chung dus nas/ a pha dang a ne ri sgron/ yang na a ne rtam kho sogs la‘6nga ni ji ltar skyes pa red/ nga'i a ma su redami’ces rgyun du thengs mang dris par/ khong tsho su zhig gis kyang nga la lan drang mo mi bshad/ de bas ngas lhag tu mtshar snang gis dus rgyun dris pa yin/ nyin zhig ngas yang a ne rtam kho la dris pas/ mos ‘‘dus rgyun du 'di dris nas ga re byed rgyu yin zer bar/ de dus a khu nor bkras ‘‘de zer 24

5 ḍa tshudelpi yog rgyuyod pa ma red/ 'di khos shes na bsam pa red/ kha dro khyod kyis nyin gcig kho la bshad yag gyis/ 'di tsho lo chung bas ci zhig bsam pa shes kyi ma redami ‘‘ngas yum bshad thub na/ shi bo mang po'i ming 'dzin dgos pas ha cang dka' )zer bar/ khong gnyis kyi bshad tshul la bltas nas/ gna' gtam bshad dgos na/ gna' mi shi bo mang po'i ming 'bod dgos pas bshad dka' rgyu red/yin na'ang / nyin kha shas rjes kyi dgong mo zhig la/ a ne rtam khos ma ṇi 'don zhor du/ nga skye skor gyi sgrung ring po zhig mgo rnga tshang ba bshad song /lo mang po zhig gi sngon la/ rma sde chu kha ma dang ma blon dme tshang gnyis ma 'khrug gong /chu kha ma rang sa na yod dus shig la/ rma chu sngon mo'i g.yas 'gram/rma sde chu kha ma'i yangs shing rgya che ba'i rtswa thang thog stag zla yos zla'i nang du/ sa phyogs kun tu me tog sna tshogs kyis ri thang yod tshad khra khor re brgyan 'dugayar bltas na bkra shis chos gling dgon pa'i nang du/ dgon grwa tshang yar tshogs gi chos sgra/ rnga rag dung rol mo'i ldir sgra grags shing / bsangs gsur mchod gsum gyi dri zhim 'thul ba/ skye pho mo rgan gzhon med par lag phreng ba bzung nas/phyag dang skor ba byed lugs phyogs gang nas bltas kyang / rma sde chu kha ma 'di ni/ chos dge ba dar sa zhig yin pa ha cang gsal 'dug yang bar ri thang kun gyi rdza mgo ri mgo kun na/ stag sha ras rta 'tsho/ lug 'tsho/ zog 'ded pa'i ki sgra dngas lugs/ 'ur phra mo'i tshag sgra che lugs la bltas na/ rma sde chu kha ma 'di/ru sde phyug po zhig yin la/ yang khyod kyis mar ru sde gsum gyi dkyil la ltos dang /sgo khyim phyi nang kun la sman bu mos mi khom shar re// 'bri mdzo mo'i ngur ldir nyi le// lag bzho zo 'o mas gang dus// sman bu mo spro sems 'khor bas// skad snyan mos bzho glu len lugs// khyim bza' mi'i dgod sgra grag lugs// dpon bla ma dbang thang mtho lugs// 'bangs mi ser kha zhe mthun lugs// ga sa gang du bltas na/ rma sde chu kha ma 'di/ ru sde ba skyid po zhig yin kho thag red/ lo de'i ston sa'i thog na/ mgo tsha yi sde ru skor sha mo skye 'dra byas nas bsdad yod la/ ru 25

leku khyami lu5ོ 0 i zeca wal skor gyi yar po'i ri rtsa na khyim tshang zhig yod la/ sbra nag gru bzhi sho 'dra ba zhig phub/ sbra rgyab na rlung gis lhab lhub tu skyod pa'i sgo dar khra nyi le/ sbra sgo g.yas g.yon na/ khyi rgya rgya mig bzhi stag gzig 'dra ba gnyis bskor yod pas/ thag ring thung gi mgron po'i thog tu kug langs spags 'then byed dus/ phur pa lhang nge phud la khad byed bzhin/ bu rgod pos rirke na mtshar snang skye ba/ gnyom chung gis rig na snying rtsa 'dar ba/ sde ru skor thams cad skrag dgos pa zhig red/dgong phyi dro rta zog lug gsum lhas la slebs dus/ rta dang nang na rta pho lcags la brgyab cing rgod ma lag 'dogs byas yod/ zog dang nang na 'bri dang g.yag sna/ mdzo dang mdzo mo rdang shar rdung shar/ lhas mtha' na/ lug g.yang dkar nyal khor leb be/ da cha rgyus yod kyang med kyang / phar bltas na mig gi rig sa nas/ 'di tshang ni khyim phyug po zhig yin pa shes thub/ yang bshad na/sde g.yas g.yon kun gyis khyim tshang 'di ni/ rma sde chu kha ma'i nags tshang rtam kho'am la las nags tshang rtam me mdung lo zer ba tshang yin pa shes pa red/ dus rgyun du sgo phyi nang gnyis kyi khyim las byed mkhan/ thag ring thung med pa'i mgron po yong na/ ngo 'dzum mdangs nyi ler bsu mkhan/ mgo la byu ru'i skra rgyan btags pa'i bud med skye yag ma de ni/ ru skor 'di'i khyim tshang phyug po bar zhi'i dme shul sbra chen tshang gi bu mo span bzhi nang gi chung ba ste/ tshe ring skyid zer ba de red/mo ni nags rtam tshang rke bu che ba nags tshang dgra 'dul te/ dus rgyun du mi tshos kho la nags tshang 'dul kho zer ba'i mna' ma red/rang sde nang nas bshad srol la/ dme bza' tshe ring skyid nags tshang tshang la slebs pa nas/ nags tshang tshang nyin re bzhin kha las rlung rta dar ba dang /rta zog phyugs g.yang 'khor ba/ rgyu gos zas gsum 'dzoms pas/ mo ni dme shul tshang gi g.yang bza' ma red zer/ nags tshang 'dul kho khong gnyis la da snga bu zhig skyes yod la/ a lags brag dgon pa tshang gis bu'i ming la 'jam dbyangs pad ma zhes btags/ de'i skabs su kho lo ngo bzhi la slebs yod//26

ma5 (ḍa gye skyi po le tshan bzhi pa/dal 'byor mi lus blangs nas/ 'jig rten 'di la spebs pa/lo dus hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i mtshan mor/ char smug 'khrigs pas/ lag pa bsring na mdzub mo mi rig la/ char ba ni 'bab bzhin 'bab bzhin je cher gyur/ glog dmar gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis 'khyug pa'i dkar 'od khrod nas/ nags tshang tshang gi sbra rgyab tu char rlung gis lhab lhub tu sdeb pa'i sgo dar dang / sbra g.yas g.yon gyi rta zog dang / 'jam cag ger nyal ba'i lug khyu tshang ma gsal tsam gsal tsam mthong thub/ sbra nang gi do rtsa'i mchod sgam thog tu/ me lce rlung gis sdeb pa'i mar me re zung yod la/ du ba 'thul ba'i thab khung du 'bar bzhin pa'i me lcoyis thab thog gi zangs dkar ni g.yas dkri g.yon dkri byed bzhin yod/ go dong nang du me dmar bong nger yod pa'i thog tu dem chung zhig bzhag yod la/ go kha na skra dkar por gyur pa'i rgan mo zhig gis lag tu phreng ba bzung nas ‘‘dkon mchog gsum mkhyen/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen/ ma bu bde 'tshams dang / tshe la bar chad med par smon’ sogs kher bshad byed zhor du glo lu re byed bzhin bsdad yod/ nam smad du slebs grabs yod dus drag char ni sngar ltar 'bab pa dang glog dmar 'khyug pa sngar las je drag red/ ngang shar shar/ ngang shar shar 'phros pa'i glog zhags khrod du/ khyim gyi do bo dang thab ka/ snod cha/ nyal yod pa'i khyim mi tshang ma gsal lham mer mthong thub/ yang glog dmar zhig 'khyug pa dang mnyam du sgug sgra dang ldir sgra snying la zug pa'i thog cig sbra 'gram la brgyab pas/ rkang 'og tu sa 'dar zhing sbra nang la gzhob dri bro yong / 'bri mo ma bu'i ngur ldir dang / g.yang dkar lug gi 'ba' ldir/ rta rgod kyi mtsher sgra bcas dang mnyam du sgo khyi yang ngu tshub be byas/ de dus thab rtsar bsdad yod pa'i rgan mos dngangs skrag dang bcas 27

miku1 ( 6 li lu5 — 0 'a 245 'thul1skad chen pos ‘‘'o 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen/ do dgong ci zhig ma nyan pa redanya zer bar/ skabs der khyim smad kyi do rtsar nyal yod pa'i nags tshang rtam mes6‘da khyod kyis skad rgyag gi ma 'dug khyod do dgong bsad mi 'gro ba los shes/ ya khyod kyis ltos dang bu mo ci 'dra 'dug’’zer/ rgan mos‘6gzer rgyug gi 'dug da yang je 'jam yin pa 'dra/ 'di yum shes na/ skye na skye rgyu mi 'dugashi rkyen re min namanyanya‘6da khyod kyis smyo bshad ma byed/ de shi mi 'gro ba los shes’nyazer zhor du/ nags tshang rgad pos yang ‘‘zhi lu 'dul kho/ khyod yar langs te sgo nas ltos dang / lug char smag gis ded song ba 'dra zer/ cung ma 'gor bar6‘o ya a pha zer zhor du/ khyim smad kyi do rtsa nas skra nag ring bzhag pa'i pho sar zhig khog stod gcer bur me mda' kha ring zhig bzung nas sgor bud song / de dus khyim na nyal yod pa'i bud med cig gis‘‘a yo a ma a ra ra/a na na/ a ma khyod 'dir shog dang’mi ‘‘'o ya ma kho/ pha bzang bu mo bzod bsran gyis/ shed gtod nas btsur dang / skye sla yi red/ dkon mchog gsum mkhyen/gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen’’zer/ char pa drag tu 'bab pa'i khrod du/ngang shar ra ra glog zhags 'phros pa dang 'brug gi ldir sgra dang mnyam du/ yang sbra yi phug rgyab la thog gcig brgyab pas/ sbra nang la du ba 'thib cing tshig dris khyab par byas/ skabs der rgan pos mgo yar bkyags nas ‘6gza' rgyag rgyu'i gnam ngan 'di do dgong ci zhig ma nyan pa redami’khos skad rnga ma tshar gong /khyim smad na nyal yod pa'i mna' ma'i 'gram nas 6‘a a wa wa’ zer ba'i ngu skad phra mo zhig brgyab song la/ a ye rgan mos skad chen pos ‘‘bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ skye thub song / skye thub song mi zer/ rgad po nags rtam gyis dga' spro'i ngang nas ‘‘'o ya da 'grig song / snying rje byis pa 'di do dgong glog 'khyug thog rgyag khrod skrag yod rgyu red/ da nga yar langs yong zer bar/ rgan mos ‘‘khyod yar langs nas ci byed/ bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rjes/ nags tshang tshang la yang bu zhig slebs song / yang bu zhig red’nyazer bar/ rgan po nags rtam 28

mazha ra rdzi'u yom gyis ‘‘'o da khrig se yin/ nga'i sngon ma zhig nas rmi lam rmis la/ de ni zhi lu zhig yin kho thag yin zer/ rgan mos‘‘da lab rgyag gi ma 'dug khyod kyi rmi lam gyis cang mi thig pa los shes 9‘6'o gser yum 'don rmis song’’khos yang 6‘ya zhi lu 'dul kho gang la phyin song / de ring tshes bco lnga yin/ da nam langs grabs 'dug mgyogs po song nas bsangs zhig thong’’sogs sems pa dga' ba'i skad cha mang po zhig bshad song / nam langs song / nags tshang tshang gi sbra rgyab na/du ba dgung la 'khyil ba'i bsangs chen zhig btang yod/ sbra nang du ‘‘a a wa wa nyazer ba'i ngu skad phra mo zhig khyim mi rnams kyi dgod sgra'i khrod du yang yang go 'dug sgo kha na dang las byed bzhin pa'i khyim mtshes ru rogs kyi rgan mo tshos kyang gcig gis gcig la ‘‘nags tshang tshang la yang bu zhig skyes 'dug ces/dga' snang skye bzhin skad cha mang po bshad bzhin yod/'di ltar/ bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa pho byi yi lo'i ston zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga'i tho rengs dus kyi char smug nang du/ glog dmar dang thog sgra zhig gi khrod du/ pha nags tshang dgra 'dul/ ma dme bza' tshe ring skyid gnyis kyi bu ru drin can ma lo'i lte thag dang bral te nga 'jig rten mi yul 'dir slebs song / a mye nags rtam gyi rmi lam bzang ba yin yang 'dra/ rmo mos gsol 'debs byas pa bzang ba yin yang 'dra/ yang min na pha ma drin can gnyis kyis tshe sngon mar bsags pa'i bsod nams yin yang 'dra/ gang ltar yang / nga ni bu zhig yin pas 'jig rten 'dir slebs nyin nas mgo yi phru ma ma skam gong nas khyim bza' tshang gang pos sa thog tu 'jog mi thub pa'i rin po che lta bur gyur/ nga yi mi lus ma thob pa'i rnam shes 'khyam po 'di/ bar do'i mun nag gi 'jigs skrag khrod du/ gar skye med par dus tshod ci 'dra zhig la 'khor yod pa sus kyang shes thabs med/ yin na'ang / de ring ni dkar 'od kyi 'jig rten 'di ru slebs pa ni dngos gnas red/ da ni thob dka' ba'i mi lus 'di thob song nga'i a yas dang a mye/ drin chen pha ma tshos/ lag gi phreng ba 'dzin pa dang / kha nas 29

rgya /yi li mu5 — 0 li / 60 4 ma ṇi 'don pa 'dir bltas na/ ha cang gsal ba zhig ni/ nga ni bod gangs can chos sa chos yul 'dir skyes yod pa ma zad/ chos dge ba dar zhing / las rgyu 'bras srung ba/ khrims ngo tsha yod pa'i dus skabs bzang po 'di dang 'phrad pa ni/ bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje'am/ yang na mi rang gis tshe sngon bsags pa'i las 'bras bzang po yin pas/ de ring nas mi lus thob pa ma zad/ 'jig rten mi yi 'tsho ba rol mgo brtsams pa yin/ ngas dus rgyun du pha ma dang / nye 'brel rnams kyis ‘‘snying rje 'di su zhig gi rnam shes yin nam’’‘ 'di skye ba sngon ma ci zhig yin nam’’zer ba sogs kyi go ba mi lon pa'i skad cha mang po bshad pa go 'dug 'on kyang / ngas 'di dag la lan 'debs mi thub la/ yang na nga ni gang nas yong ba dang su'i rnam shes yin pa sogs la bsam blo mang po zhig gtong dgos don mi 'dug chung dus nas sems su 'khor ba zhig ni/ nga 'jig rten 'dir slebs te mig phyes pa nas bzung / tshe ring thung ci yod mi shes la/ yang bskyar mi tshe 'di rdzogs te/ mig btsum nas rnam shes sbrang chung 'dra po 'di/ shi bar do la ma 'khyams bar du/ skyid sdug bzang ngan ci 'dra yin yang / 'jig rten mi yul gyi tshe gcig gi 'tsho ba rol dgos pa de yin/ rgyu che chung / mgo mtho dman/ mdor na/ mi tshe 'di'i skyid sdug rgo bo'i ru tshigs 'dra ba'i lam thag ring po 'di de ring nas mgo bzung ste/ gom pa re re spos nas 'gro dgos pa yin la/ skyid sdug gi mdun lam ci 'dra zhig yod pa/ sus kyang bshad dka'/a phas dus rgyun du ‘6las zer bar gseg rgyu med la/ skyid sdug mgo la ci yong /rang gi thod pa'i ri mo yin nyazer ba los bden/ nga chung dus ‘6o ma ṇi padme hūṃnya zhes pa'i ma ṇi yig drug 'don shes pa nas/ sems nas yang yang smon lam 'idebs rgyu ni ‘ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po/ snyigs ma'i dus ngan 'di ru/ skyabs med mgon med nga la/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtshor/ spyod pa'i lam re ston rogs/ mi rtag mar me'i tshe 'dir/ rlung bsil bar chad med par//nam yang mgon skyabs mdzad rogasanya’zhes pa 'di yin//30

le tshan lja pa/skal bzang dus dang 'phrad nas/ dgon sde chos gsum mjal song /kha nyin dgong mor/ a ne rtam khos nga rang skye skor gyi gtam rgyud ring po zhig bshad rjes nga rang gnyid song / de dgong nyal khar/ a ne rtam khos nga la ‘‘do dgong yang ngas khyod la/ khyod skyes tshar dus kyi lo rgyus mang po bshad rgyu yin’’zer bar/ nga yang kha nyin ltar/ a ne rtam kho'i pang du mgo bzhag nas zhib tu nyan/ston zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin/ nam langs dus nas/ nags tshang tshang gi gza' mi che chung kun gyi ngo la 'dzum mdangs shar zhing / la las bsangs btang ba dang mchod pa bshams pa/ la las mar me sgron pa/ ma sru mo rnams kyis ja bskol zhing / sha btsos/ khyim kun tu dgod sgra rgyun mi chad par 'dug dus mtshungs su sgo phyi nang gang nas nyan mi dgos par/ byis pa chung chung zhig gis ‘‘a a wa wa’ zer ba'i ngu skad gsal po zhig go thub pa de nga rang red zer/a bu 'jam pe/ kha nyin zhig nas a ne rtam khos khong tshang la khrid song /de ring snga mor nags tshang tshang la yang bu zhig skyes yod zer ba go nas/ a ne rtam khos a bu 'jam pe lag khrid byas nas/ nags tshang tshang la yong bar/ lhas mthar slebs dus/ nags tshang tshang gi mna' ma dme bza' tshe ring skyid sgor bud nas khyi bkag bsu ba byas/ a nes mo mthong dus ‘‘ya bu mo/ khyod smyos pa min na/ de ring nas yar ma langs ma gtogs/ ci zhig na yong /’9 ‘‘'o ya/a ne ne kho/ da ci skyon medanyanyazer zhor du a ne bsus nas khyim la song a yas nga rang pang nas ‘‘'o 'di de ltar byas nas ngu kha lon rgyu zhig ma red/ nam langs nas ngus pa redami’zer zhor du nga rang ma drin can gyi lag tu bzhag nga'i kha a 31

leku ༅ mibu 5 — 0 li ca0 55 ma'i nu mar thug rjes mi ngu bar nu ma nus/ rgan po nags rtam gyis ‘‘da khyod tshos bshad nas tshar rgyu med pa ci red/ mgyogs po 'gro rtsis gyis/ dgon nang du a lags kyi mdun du song nas skyabs 'jug re zhus/ bu 'di la ming zhig gnang rogs zhu dgosanya zer la/ nga sngar ltar ngus pas/ ma drin can gyi lag tu bzung ba dang 'jog pa sogs ci byas kyang ngu bas/ mos ‘‘bu 'di ci 'dra'i ngu mkhan zhig red/mi zer/ nags rtam gyis 6‘dgon nang du slebs na a lags la zhus/ 'di snying rje mdang dgong thog rgyag glog 'khyug nang nas skrag song ba min namanya)zer/ ci byas kyang ngu kha ma lon par yod/ de dus a bu 'jam pe yis 6‘a ma ma kho/ ga re/ zhi lu nga'i lag tu gcig zhog dang / ngas rum zer bar/ a mas ‘‘yum dgos na/ khyod kyi lag nas shor gyi red’1 6‘a ma ma lo/ma kho nga'i lag tu zhog dnganya zer/ de dus nags tshang rgan pos ‘‘khyod kyis zhi lu de 'ja' kho la pang du chug go song ngamanya zer bas/ a yas kyis ‘‘'o na khyod mar sa thog tu sdod/ lag nas shor yong zhes bshad zhor du nga a bu 'jam pe la rum du bcug a bu 'jam pes ‘6ya ya bu kho bu lo/ da khyod ma ngu dang a bus khyod bzung nas bsdad yod/ da ma ngu bu lo go song ngam’nyasogs zer zhor du bsdad nas cung ma 'gor bar/ nga rang ngu mtshams bzhag pas/ a mas ‘‘ya/da ngu mtshams bzhag song / nga tshos ci byas kyang nyan gyi mi 'duganyanyazer bar ma mye nags rtam gyis 6‘zer rgyu yod pa ma red/ byis pa ni byis par dga' ba dang /khong bu span gnyis mnyam du bsdad na mi ngu ba yin yang thang zer/ de dus a yas kyizlo ‘6ya da nga tsho dgon nang du 'gro/ rtam kho khyod kyis zhi lu che ba khrid/ da rung a lags la 'bul rgyu'i mar cung tsam de dang / zho 'di khyer shog mna' ma khyod da dung sgor ma 'bud dang dga'/ bu ngas pang chog zer zhor du/ nga rum du bcug nas thams cad rkang thang la dgon pa'i phyogs su song / mdang dgong gi drag char des/ rtswa thang yongs la chu khrus brgyab pa bzhin/ sa kun tu smug rlangs 'thib cing nyi ma shar ba'i khrod du/ me tog sna tshogs kha bkad nas 32

ma5 sa ba skutsheyiyo dri zhim sna lam du yang yang 'thul yong / dgon par thag mi ring mod/'on kyang /mdang dgong drag char babs pas/ lam nang du chu dang 'dam 'bag rtswa mgo'i zil chu sogs yod pas 'gro ha cang dka' ba red/ a ne rtam khos ‘‘a yas khyod kyi lag re brje dgos pa min nam/ 'gro thub kyi 'dug gam ’zhes dris par/ mos ‘‘'gro los thub/ kho ngu na ngu ru chugs/ da slebs grabs 'dug 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen zhes zer zhor du mu mthud du song / dgon 'dabs su slebs dus yar bltas na/ chos lung bar ma'i nyin khugs na/ rma sde chu kha ma'i bkra shis chos gling dgon pa'i 'du khang dang lha khang thog gi gser khebs ni nyi 'od 'og na ser lam mer yod la/ dgon nang du bsangs dud 'thib cing / spos mchod pa'i dri zhim khyab yod/ grwa tshang yar 'tshogs kyi chos sgra dang / rnga rag dung rol mo'i sgra yang go thub pas/ mig gis mthong ba tsam gyis dga' mgu yi rangs dang /dad pa skye ba'i chos sa chos yul zhig red/ nga tsho der slebs dus/ nga yi ma drin can yang 'tshab 'tshub nyil le der slebs song / a ne rtam khos ‘‘ya 'di ci red/khyod spyos pa min nam/ de ring mgo khyog rung / 'di ltar song na gyi log (na tsha bskyar log )re byas na ma bzang ba red/mi’zer bar/ a yas kyis ‘‘skyon yod kyi ma red/ nga tsho chung dus byis pa dgong mo skyes na/ phyi nyin nas 'bri bzho/ khyim las byas nas bsdad pa yin/ skyon gang yang yod ma myong / da nga tsho 'di nas ngal zhig gso/ khyod kyis bu la nu ma zhig snun dang / de nas ga le byas nas mjal skor du 'gro dang / a lags de ring bzhugs 'dug zer/ )zhes bshad/ a mas nga la nu ma blud rjes/ nga a yas kyi lag tu bzhagasngon la kun gyis dgon par phyi skor zhig brgyab pa dang / de nas lha khang dang grwa tshang 'du khang sogs kyi lha rten chos gsum du mjal rjes/ da gzod a lags stag ring khri ba tshang gi nang chen du song / rgyal sgo'i nang 'dzul dus/grwa pa zhig gis ‘khyod tsho sngon ma thab tshang du song nas za 'thung re gyis dang /cung tsam nas a lags kyis mjal kha gnang gi redanya’zer/ a ne kho tsho nang chen gyi 33

miku khya mi lu5ོ 0 'a ca0 glul thab tshang du slebs pa na/ de na yang rko chen dang / rgyu lag mtha' ba sogs nas kyang byis pa gsum khyer nas slebs 'dug byis pa thams cad mdang dgong dang de ring snga dro skyes pa yin la/ tshang ma a lags tshang gi mdun du skyabs 'jug zhu bar yong ba yin zer/ cung ma 'gor bar/ nga tsho slebs pa'i snga gzhug ltar/a lags tshang la mjal zhing / thams cad kyis rang rang so so'i mjal dar/mar/ sha/ zho/ dngul sgor sogs khong la phul/ khong gi nang chen gyi zhabs zhu dge slong zhig gis 'bul ba sogs phar khyer song //le tshan drug pa/las kyi skyid sdug ci yong / mirngo btags bla ma'i gsungs pa/a lags tshang gis gzim khri'i thog tu gzan sked par dkris te/ stod 'gag kher rkyang mnabs nas bzhugs yod la/ khong gis‘‘khyed tshos 'di 'dra mang po zhig khyer yong nas ci byed/ dgos pa ma red/ ya sdod dnganya zer/ khong gis de ring byis pa mang po yod pa mthong rjes ‘‘'o ya ya/ de ring 'di ci yin na/ nyin mtshan gcig la byis pa 'di 'dra mang po zhig skyes pa red/ lo mang po zhig la nyin rer 'di 'dra mang po skyes pa mthong ma myonganyamigasungs la/ de nas khyim tshang re re'i lo rgyus dang / pha ma'i ming sogs zhib tu dris pas/ kun gyis re re bzhin khong la zhus/ a mas nga rang pang nas zur zhig tu bsdad yod la/ci byas kyang nga'i ngu kha ma lon pas/ a lags kyis‘‘khyod kyis nu ma snun dang ngu ni ma red migasungs pas a mas nga la nu ma bstun par ma zad/ yar langs nas yar 'gro mar 'gro byas kyang da rung ngu mtshams mi 'jog pas/ a lags kyis(6ya da khyod sdod shog drag gi/ 'di ji 'dra ba'i ngu rkyal zhig redami’zer/ de dus a yas kyis ‘‘a lags/ mdang mtshan nged tshang gi sbra 'gram la thog brgyab song / byis pa 'di skrag snang re skyes pa e yin nam’ zhus par/ khong gis‘‘de 34

miku khya li phu5ོ 0 yi mi ca0ma 4la kyis bu 'di mi ngu thabs zhal phu zhig gnang rogs nyazhus par/ a lags kyis nga la yang yang gzigs shing ‘‘ya ya snying rje/ 'di lhag tu ngu ba 'di ni/ 'khor ba sngag bsngal gyi rgya mtshor skyes par yid skyo nas/ sems sdug gi mchi ma rgyun mi chod pa red/ byis pa la las chung dus nas ci yin pa shes kyi red/ yin na'ang /kho nyin re bzhin nar son dus/ sngar dran pa'i don re re bzhin brjed 'gro bas/de dus ngu ni ma red/ byis pa la las skye ba 'di yi sdug bsngal sogs sngon nas shes pas/ 'jigs skrag gis ngu ba yin/ de yang tshe 'di la sdug rjes nas myong dgos pa yin pas/ ngu rgyu'i dus tshod ring po rjes su yod pa red/ da ci yin yang / bu 'di'i mi tshe ni ha cang dka' mo yin na'ang thang / khyod tsho khom pa re yod na/ bla brang la mjal skor re gyis dang / gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs tshang la skyabs 'jug re zhus na dga'/ nga tsho 'di na dgon sde chung / bla 'go dma'/rgya chen po zhig thub kyi ma red’ sogs gsungs par/ a yas dang a ne rtam kho gnyis kyis ‘‘a lags khyed kyis ma mkhyen pa ci yang med/ bkra shis chos gling dgon pa'i grwa pa bzhi brgya dang / khyed rnam pas nga'i bu 'di tshe skyob srog skyob re byed pa thugs nas ma brjedanya sogs snabs spar gang dang / mchi ma kha gang byas nas ngu zhor du re zhu mang po byas/ de'i rjes nas a lags kyis byis pa bzhi por bde 'tsham yong ba'i phyag mdud de/ zhi lu gnyis la dmar po dang / zhi mo gnyis la ljang gu re gnang song / yang a lags kyis ‘6ya da khyod tshos sems nad ha cang gsog mi dgos/ ma gzhi nga 'dra zhig gis mi zhig gis tshe tshod 'dzin pa/yang na mi rang rang mgo la las kyis yong dgos pa'i bgegs bar chad/ cang khog gi ma red de/ da ngas dgon grwa tshang dang / bla ma dkon mchog la skyabs 'jug gsol 'debs re byed chog skyon chen po e yong’ zhes gsungs pas khyim tshang kun sems cung bde song /mjal skabs kyi dus tshod cung 'gor 'dug dgong mo mun rab rib cig la nga tsho rang khyim la slebs song / de ring ngu yun ring song ba yin nam/ yang 36

5 ma ḍa 43 nyi po na/ 'gro thag ring song bas rkyen yin nam/ khyim la slebs rjes/ a mas nga rang la nu ma cung tsam bsnun rjes/ bskal bzhag dus mi ngu bar cung tsam gnyid song zer/ de dus a yas kyis de ring dgon par song ba dang / a lags kyis ci gsungs khyim mi kun la zhib mor bshad/ mos ngu zhor du 66'di'i tshe sngon ma dran nas ngu ba yin na skyon mi 'dug ste/ tshe 'di'i sdug shes nas ngu ba yin na/ ma 'grig pa redami zer bas/ khyim mi rnams sems mi bde bar byas/ a myes nags rtam gyis‘‘der sems khral byed dgos pa ma red/ tshe sngon gyi sdug yin na song tshar ba red/ tshe 'di'i sdug yin na/ ha las dgos don yod pa ma red/ mi gzhan gyi mgor yong rgyu tsam las/ 'di'i mgo la lhag mo ci zhig yong 'jog kho rang nar son dus grwa pa gyis shog ’ces khyim mi tshor sems gso'i skad cha mang po bshad//le tshan bdan pa/las 'brel bla ma phebs nas/4bu chung ngu kha blangs song /nga rang ni sngar ltar ngu bas a phas nga bzung nas sgophyi nang kun la song yang / ngu mtshams mi 'jog par je sdug red/ ‘‘ha bo 'di la ci ma nyan pa red zer bar/ a mas ‘‘khyod kyis de 'dra skad chen po byed ki ma 'dug zhi lu skrag gi redami zer/ a phas ‘‘da 'di mi ngu ba'i thabs re e yod/ nyin ltar 'di ltar ngus na ha cang dka' nyazer zhor du/ nga rang ma drin can gyi lag tu bzhag nu ma nu dus cung ma ngus kyang cung 'gor rjes yang sngar ltar ngus/ a yas kyis ‘‘'di ci 'dra'i byis pa ma rabs shig red/ gnyid rgyu ni mi 'dug sang nyin nga yang dgon nang du song nas/ a lags tshang la bskyar zhu zhig byed dgosanya zer bar/ a mye nags rtam gyis ‘‘da khyod song ma song yod ni ma red/a lags kyis kha sang nas gsungs pa bzhin red/ byis pa 'di ‘sems sdug gi 37

rāku khya yi 45 — 0 yi zelo lul mchi ma rgyun mi chad pa red gsung song / da snying rje las ngan 'dir sdug ci 'dra zhig mgo la yong rgyu yin pa sus kyang shes rgyu ma red/ bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen’ zer bar/ a yas kyis‘‘'di chung chung nas sdug cig yong gi ma red/da nga tsho'i mgor sdug re yong 'dod pa e yin na 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen ’zer/ a mas nga'i ngu kha ma lon par ‘6'ja' kho 'dir shog dang / zhi lu 'di khyed kyis gcig zungs dang e dga'’’zer nas/ nga a bu 'jam per rum du bcug a bus nga bzung nas sgo la bud zhor du ‘‘ma ngu bu lo/ bu kho ma ngu a bus bzung bsdad yod ma ngu’ zer/cung tsam nas ngu mtshams bzhag song /'di ni khyim mi thams cad mtshar dgos pa zhig red/ pha ma gnyis dang a yas a ne kun gyis ngu kha mi lon par/ a bu 'jam pe'i lag tu bzhag dus nam yin na ngu mtshams 'jog pa red/ de dus a yes ‘‘snying rje yin na/ 'di 'ja' kho'i lag la slebs na mi ngu ba ci yin namanya’zer bar/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘khyod tshos bdag byed mi dgos/ ngas bdag byed chog bu kho ma ngu dang a bus rum chog ’zer/ a mye nags rtam gyis ‘‘da pha ma gnyis kyis ngu kha mi lon na/ ya zhi lu 'ja' khos pha ma gnyis kyi tshab byas na khrig se red’’zer/ rjes nas nyin mang po la pha ma gnyis dang / a ne sogs kyis nga rang thengs mang por dgon pa'i a lags mdun du khyer nas/ khrus gsol dang skyabs 'jug gang mang zhus kyang nga ni sngar ltar ngu bas/ bkod pa ci yang med par/ a bu 'ja' bes cung re bzung dus mi ngu ba ma gtogs nyin mtshan med par ngu bas/ khyim mtshes ru rogs kun gyis nags tshang tshang gi zhi lu ngu rkyal zhes mi shes mkhan zhig med/ la las ‘‘'di ci zhig na ba min namanyanyazer/ la las ‘‘byis pa don med du ngus na yag po ma red/ ci zhig ha go ba yin gyi red/ yul sde/ yang na pha ma tsho'i mgo la chag sgore yong 'dod ni e yin nam ’sogs/ kha mang gis mi bshad dgu bshad byed/ nyin zhig nged tshang la a khu sman ring zer ba'i ri khrod pa zhig phebs yong /de dus nga skyes nas zla gsum tsam yin/ pha ma drin can/ a yas sogs kyis 38

ske 5 (ḍa skutshe 3 yo nga ni skyes nas ngu 'dug pa'i lo rgyus zhib tu khong la zhus shing / khong gis 6‘a lagasatshang gis ci gsung ginya’zhes dris par/ a yas kyis ‘‘a lags kyis 'di ngu ba ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya tsho ru skyes par yid skyo bas/ sems sdug gi mchi ma rgyun mi chad pa red gsung gi’’zer bar/ ri khrod pas ‘‘de e yin nam/'di ngu lugs la bltas na/ tshe 'dir kho'i mgo la sngag mang po yong rgyu yin srid/de yin na da lta nas ngus nas phan gyi ma red’ zer rnor du nga rang pang la bzung nas/ nga'i rna nang du skad cha mang po zhig bshad/ khyim mi tshos ‘‘da khyod ngu ma 'dug sdug ci yong sngon las red’ zer ba tsam las gzhan ci yang ma go/ mtshar po zhig la/ cung tsam 'gor rjes nga rang ngu mtshams bzhag song / de dus ri khrod pas ‘6'o ya ya/ pha bzang bu/ da ma ngu/ khyod tshos ha mi go/ zhi lu 'di nged gnyis ka skye ba sngon ma nas ngo shes red/ de ring nas 'di nga'i tsha bo red/ da ngu ni ma red/ kho nar son na grwa pa byed dgos pa red/ da khyod tshos sems khral byed mi dgos/ 'di zhi lu 'ja' khos bzung na mi ngu bas/ des 'grig gi red/kho bu span gnyis ka tshe 'dir yun ring por kha bral thabs yod pa ma red/ 'di gnyis donags tshang tshang gi bu rgod gnyis red/ tshe 'dir khong gnyis mgo la dka' sdug ci 'phrad kyang / kho rang gnyis kyis gdong len byed thub kyi red/ 'di gnyis rjes nas mtha' yag po yong rgyu yod kho thag yin/ 'di ngas shes kyi red’ sogs/yang bza' khyim gang po sems spro 'dug dgos pa mang tsam gsungs/nad par 'phrod pa'i sman pa dang / shi bor 'phrod pa'i bla ma zer ba'i dpe ltar/ a lags bla ma rnams kyis khrus bka' bsgo byas la/ dgon grwa tshang la skyabs 'jug ci mang zhus kyang / byis pa bsam med 'di ngu kha ma lon/ ngu mtshams ma bzhag de ring las thug gi bla ma/ a khu ri khrod pas/ nags tshang tshang gi zhi lu ngu rkyal la mi gzhan gyis mi go pa'i lkog gtam ci bshad yod dam/da ni ngu mtshams bzhag song / la las gcod bton nas bla 'gugs byas pa red zer/ la las sngags brgyab pa red zer/ ci yin yang / bza' khyim gang po'i 39

྅ku /khya yi lu5 — 0 i 6lom 4la rig sa nas/ byis pas ngu mtshams bzhag pa ni mig mthong lag zin red/ de ni mi kun ha cang dga' dgos pa zhig yin la/ khong gis 66byis pa 'di'i mgo la sdug mang po re yong rgyu red rigasungs pa ga khyim bza' tshang kun la rang rang gi go ba re len rgyu yod pas/ thams cad kyi sems nad cig red/ a mye nags rtam gyis ‘‘ya da gang yang byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ mgo nag mi zhig gi mgo la skyid sdug mang po yong gi red/ nged nags tshang tshang pha a khu tsan dan sdong po 'dir/ bu tsha bo chu shing rul ba re skye dgos don med pa 'dra zhig yin/ bzang yang ngan yang rang gi las zer rgyu de bzlog thabs yod pa ma red/ skyid sdug ci yong yang / de'i nyin mor khong tsho rang rang la thabs bkod pa re yod rgyu red/'di nged cag gis da lta nas sems khral byed dgos don yod pa ma red/ sems khral byas kyang phan pa med’ sogs bshad par kun gyis bden par bsam/rjes su ngas bsam ngo zin dus nas/ a phas nam rgyun du/ a bu 'jam pe nged gnyis la ‘‘pha bzang bu rgod gnyis/ bu zer rgyu sa 'khyams rdo 'khyams nang nas nar son na/ rjes nas mi la ha cang re mi dgos pas rang mgo thon gyi red/ chung dus nas dka' sdug cung tsam re myangs na dga' ni redami zer ba sogs/tshe 'dir dus dang rnam pa kun tu sems nas brjed thabs med/ lhag par du rjes nas mi che'i khrod kyi skyid sdug mang por thug dus/ skad cha 'dis nga rang la sems shugs ha cang chen po dang / dka' khag mang po las rgyal thub pa'i nus stobs ha cang chen po gnang song / tshe 'dir dka' sdug 'di 'dra mang po zhig mgo la yong ba rang gis sngon nas ma shes kyang / nga rang gis ha cang gsal por shes pa ni/ a phas nged span gnyis chung dus nas/ dka' khag mang po'i nang du rang kha rang gso'i 'azlo bar rol ba'i sbyong brdar sprad med na/ nged gnyis 'jig rten mi yul du da bar du gson mi thub nges can yin//40

le tshan brgyad pa/las 'bras can gyi bza' tshang / mi rgyu phyugs gsum dar song /a ne rtam khos lag tu 'khor lo skor zhor du/ sngar ltar nga rang skyes rjes dang / nga rang dang 'brel yod kyi gtam rgyud bshad par/ ngas kyang a ne rtam kho la mig cer nas sems gtad de zhib tu nyan nas bsdad/ da ni phal cher dgun kha slebs nyer yod/ nyin re gnyis la ston kha'i kha char 'bab cing kha char 'dres ma'i nang nas kha ba mang tsam 'bab bzhin 'dug nam zla yang je 'khyag red/ ma drin can gyis nangs dgong thams cad la nga rgyab tu khur nas/rgyun du dgon par skor ba dang mchod mjal la 'gro ba yin/ gung 'bri bzho skabs su/ nga rang ni a bu 'ja' pes rum du pang nas sgo kha dang / zog dang mtha' ru bsdad yod/ a bu 'jam pe ni lo bzhi yin la/ kho'i mgo bo che la mig gnyis lhag tu che/ lo chung yang blo rig ha cang gsal ba'i byis pa rgyud 'jam zhig yin pas/ khyim mtshes ru rogs kun gyis 'dang che ba yin/ ma gzhi nga tsho'i sa nas/ byis pa lo gsum gyi thog nas mnol skra len mod/ a bu 'ja' pe'i mgo la mnol skra da rung bzhag yod pas/ spar re yod/ khos nga sgo phyi nang du khur yun ring bas/ nga'i kha ngo kun nyi mas 'tshigs nas nag por gyur yod/ pha ma gnyis dang / a myes nga la ‘‘nged tshang gi zhu lu nag yas mgo che zer/ de ring yang a bus nga bzung nas/ zog rdang mtha' na/ a mas 'bri bzho sa der bltas nas bsdad yod/ a mas 'bri bzho zhor du ‘‘'ja' kho ma lo/ khyod rdang mtha' la ha cang ma bcar zog gis rdung gi red/ chon mtshams nas sdodami’zer ba dang /yang ‘‘pa'o wa'o/ pa'o wa'o 'bri mo drin can ma/ kha 'o zho blud gi g.yang lha ma/ wa'o wa'o/ wa'o wa'o/ wa'o g.yang 'bri g.yang zog ma/ tshe gcig la g.yang gis srung rgyu ma risogs dbyangs la bkug nas bzho glu len zhor du 'bri dang mdzo mo bzho 41

3ku ( 1 li lu5ོ 0 li 945 'thupha bzhin 'duganyin gcig a mas nga khur nas ma tshang dme shul sbra chen tshang la song /khyim la slebs dus a yas kyis ‘‘ha bo ba'i zhi lu ngu rkyal ma slebs song / ga re nga'i lag la gcig zhog dang / 'o da ni chen po chags 'dug a khu sman grang gi drin min na 'di da rung ngu rgyu red go’nyazer bar/ a mas‘‘a khu sman grang gis khong gi tsha bo yin zer/ khong gi tsha bo re'i skye ba e yin nam’ zer/ ‘‘ya da su'i skye ba yin yang chog gi/ nged tshang gi zhi lu mgyogs por nar son dgos pa red/de nas grwa pa byed dgos’’ma yas kyis bshad bzhin pa'i skabs/ sbra nang du zhi lu nag sdug lo lnga drug can zhig 'dzul yong nas/ 6‘ga re/ nags tshang tshang gi zhi lu mgo che nga la gcig ston dang / a ne ne kho nga'i lag la gcig zhog dang ’zer bar/ a mas nga a yas kyi lag nas blangs te ‘‘ya/ khyod kyis yag po 'jus ma gtogs/ thang la brgyab yong zer zhor du/ nga byis pa de'i lag tu bzhag byis pa de ni a ma'i ming po/ dme shul mgon tshe zer ba'i bu che ba red/ ming la rab brtan zer/ kho chung dus nas kha ngo cung nag po yin pas/khyim mtshes ru rogs kun gyis kho la ‘‘rab brtan nag yas’ dang / yang na rab nag zer nas 'bod kyin yod/ de dus nga rang skyes nas zla drug tsam 'gor yod zer/ khyim la slebs thengs rer a mye nags rtam gyis cung re bzung na/ yang ngu 'bod byed 'dug pas/ a myes ‘‘'di ci 'dra'i khyad mtshar zhig red/ nga'i lag tu slebs na/ ngas sen btog byas pa lta bu red/ ngu rkyal 'di sgo khar g.yug shog’ zer zhor du/ nga a bu 'jam pe'i lag tu 'jog a bu 'ja' pes sngar ltar nga rang nyar nas ‘‘ya bu lo ngu mi nyan/ nged gnyis sgo la 'gro zer zhor du/ nga khur nas snokhar song / a bu'i slog pa'i thed khung nang nas nga'i rkang pa ya gcig phyi la thon 'dug sa mas lo bcu drug thog nas/ a pha dang mnyam du 'khor ba bzung zhing / lo bco brgyad thog nas a bu 'jam pe skyes/ lo ngo nyi shu rtsa gnyis thog nas nga skyes pa yin zer/ ma gzhi mo ni dme shul sbra chen tshang la ming sring 42
