leku khya li lu5ོ 0 i cabo lul phyug po zhig tu gyur yod/ nags tshang tshang gis zla ba re re'i nang du/ bla ma grwa pa gdan drangs nas bsangs gsol ka 'don zhing / thag ring thung gi nye 'brel ngo shes mang po mgron por yong rgyu mang ba yin/ ngo ma 'jig rten gtam gyi dper ‘6rgyu che dus song na shom che ba lta bu/ bshad na skad mtho ba lta bu/ bsdad na mgron mang ba lta bu/ khyim bza' dpon ming che ba lta bu/ ma sru mo ya rabs pa lta bu/yar khyim gi srung ma btsan pa lta bu/ mar sgo kha'i skor khyi ngar ba lta bu sogs zer ba ltar/ nags tshang tshang ni sde phyi nang kun tu ming grags cung tsam yod 'dug khyim mtshes ru rogs kyi rgan rgon tshos ‘6nags tshang tshang 'di/ de ring kha sang 'di 'dra je dar je rgyas 'gro ba/ dbyar zla gsum kha nas sha mi chad/dgun zla gsum khyim nas zho mi chad/ gar song 'og na rta zhon rgyu yod pa/ rgyab na me mda' khur rgyu yod pa/ khyim na bu skyong rgyu yod pa/ da skyid po 'di thams cad/ dme bza' tshe ring skyid kyi drin redami zer/ los yin/ de tshang ma bden pa red/ de ni nga yi ma drin chen gyi drin red/ nags tshang tshang kha las dar tshod la thon pa yin na'ang 'dra/ dme shul tshang gi rgyu g.yang nga yi a ma dme bza' tshe ring skyid la 'khor ba yin na'ang 'dra/ mdo don/ khong nags tshang tshang du slebs pa nas/ nags tshang tshang mi phyugs gnyis ka 'phel te/ je dar je dga' ru song ba yin//le tshan dgwa pa/a ma'i 'dod pa bzhin du/ bla dogon kun la mjal song /lo sar rjes kyi dpyid zla 'go ma'i nang zhig la/ a mas nga'i pha la ‘‘de ring kha sang zhig la/ snying mi bde ba 'dra zhig red/ mtshan mo mtshams rer skrag snang gis gnyid sad 'jog gi/ ci zhig na bsam pa 'dranya zer bar a phas ‘6na bsam pa e yin/ khyod dgon nang 'gro dus a lags tshang la ma zhus 44

5 / ci skutshe nyi lug samanya zer/ 6‘zhu rgyu zhus yod de cang gsungs ma song / nga shi song na zhi lu gnyis ka chung bas khyod khag po redami a mas de ltar zer zhor du/ mig nas mchi ma chu bzhur ba bzhin byung / a phas ‘‘khyod kyis de 'dra ngan pa re ma dran/ mgo na pho gzer zhig gis khyod la skyon gang yang medami zer zhor du/ a ma la mig chu 'phyi rogs byas/ a mas‘‘nga bla brang la song nas a lags gung thang tshang gcig mjal bsam gyi 'dug de'i zhor du zhi lu gnyis ka skyabs 'jug re byed kyi yin) zer bas/ a phas((khyod 'gro rogs bzang po re med na khag po red/ zhi lu chung ba khur thub ni ma redaminyazer/ a mas ‘‘zhi lu a ne rtam khos blta rogs byed kyi red/ da mgyogs po ma song na/ de nas mi slebs pa 'dra zhig ma red na zer ba na/ a phas lan du ‘‘da khyod kyis ltos/ 'gro rogs med na 'gro mi thub zer ba sogs nyin de'i dgong mo nga'i pha ma gnyis kyis kha brda yun ring byas/ phyi nyin nga'i a ma a ne rtam kho tshang la song nas/ mdang dgong pha drin can khong gnyis kyis bshad pa'i skad cha tshang ma ngu zhor du a ne rtam kho la bshad/a nes((khyod lo chung chung red/ sems sdug byed dgos pa ma red/ bla brang du 'gro thub na bzang gi/ zhi lu gnyis la ngas bdag byed chog der khyod kyis sems khral dgos pa ma red/ cung tsam bsgug na 'gro rogs re rag yonganya zer bar/a mas ‘6'gro rogs la skyon med/ nga'i a pha a ma gnyis la bshad med/ ha go na 'gro ru mi 'jug sems thag red/ da lo dgun kha smon lam skabs tshang ma mnyam du 'gro dgos zer gyi 'dug ngas de'i bar sgug khom med pa 'dra zhig redami’zer/ ‘‘ya de ci yin nam/ 'dis 'di ltar spyo bshad re byed kyi 'dug khyod de 'dra sgug khom med rgyu zhig yong gi ma red/ khong tshor de 'dra ma bshad)nyaces zer/ 'di ltar a ne dang a ma gnyis kyis kyang kha brda mang tsam byas/ yin na'ang / de dus sus kyang ma drin can gyi sems la ci zhig dran pa mi shes/ mo ni don med da 'di 'dra sems sdug pa dang / sems nas 'di 'dra brel ba che don yang suzlo kyang mi shes/ nyin bzhi lnga tsam gyi rjes/ dme shul tshang gi bu mo 45

3ku khya yi khu5ḍa 0 i 0cacag 'a5la zhig dang / ru skor nang gi bu mo gcig bcas gsum pos dro kha re khur nas/ nam ma langs gong nas rkang thang la bla brang bkra shis 'khyil la mjal skor du song /phyi nyin a mye nags rtam gyis a pha la ‘‘khyod yum smyos ni ma red na/ de mgo rjen rkang thang du 'di ltar mngags rgyu yod dam/ da mgyogs po rta dang dro kha re khyer nas rjes la 'gro dgos pa min nam zer bar/ a phas ‘‘gtan nas mi dgos/kho tshor rogs pa yod ces kha la nyan ma song / da drag gi red/ mo rkyang 'ba' zhig red gang yang skrag dgos pa ma red/ mo bla brang la mjal nas gang mgyogs tshur la slebs yong zer/9’ ‘‘'o na khyod kyis khong tshang gi nang la gcig bshad dgos pa red/mi’a myes de ltar bshad/ a phas ‘6dgos kyi ma red/ khong tshang nas 'gro rogs mo'i a ce yod zer zer zhing / yang a myes ‘‘de ltar ma bshad/khong tsho lkog nas bros 'gro ba yin na'ang thang’ zer/de'i phyi nyin a pha dme shul tshang la song nas bshad par/ khong tshang gis da rung bu mo gang la song ba shes med/ skad cha go rjes pha ma gnyis kyis ‘‘khong span gnyis mnyam du yod na skyon med/ rogs pa bu mo su tshang gi yin/ khyod song rnos ha go na/ de'i nang la gcig shod dang / pha ma tsho sems bde ni redanya zer/a phas6‘'o yanya zer bar/ a yas kyis ‘‘'dul kho/ khyod kyis zhi lu chung ba bdag byed thub kyi ma red/ 'dir khyer shog dang ngas blta zer’ bar a phas 6‘zhi lu gnyis ka da nangs nas a ne rtam khos khrid song / da drag ni redami zer nas tshur rang khyim du yong / a ma mo rang gi 'dod pa ltar/ bla brang la mjal du phyin song / a ne rtam kho dang a ne ri sgron gnyis kyis nags tshang tshang la thab las rogs pa brgyab cing / a bu 'jam pe nged gnyis la bdag skyong byas/ a bu 'jam pes nam rgyun du ‘‘a ne/ nga'i a ma gang la bud song ba red/ da tshur yong gi e red ’zer bar/ a ne rtam khos ‘‘de kho a ma bla brang la mjal skor du song ba red/ sang nyin gnangs nyin zhig la slebs kyi red’ zer/ de nas zla phyed drag tsam 'gor rjes/ a ma dang mo'i rogs pa tsho bla brang mjal nas phyir 46

( thi krude hri lu slebs/ a phas ‘6a lags gung thang tshang e mjal/ ci gsung gi ’zhes dris par/ mos 6‘mjal song / zhi lu gnyis skyabs 'jug re zhus pa yin/ khong gis thugs nas mi brjed gsung gi/ nga rang gcig zhus yod de/ khong gis de min cang gsung ma song / mjal skor tshar na mgyogs po yul la song gsung gi’’zhes ma drin can gyis bshad zhor du/ a lags gung thang tshang gis gnang ba'i phyag mdud dmar po re a bu 'ja' pe dang nged gnyis kyi ske la btags/ dgong mo bza' tshang kun la/ ma drin can gyis da thengs bla brang la song nas mjal skor byas tshul sogs mang tsam bshad par/ a mye nags rtam gyis ‘‘khyod kyi re ba 'grub song ba red/ zhi lu ngu rkyal 'di a lags gung thang tshang la skyabs 'jug zhus zin pas skyon yong gi ma redami zer la/ bza' tshang kun gyis mnyam du ja 'thung zhing / sha za zhor du kha brda byas nas nam gung la slebs/ phyi nyin yang a ne ri sgron dang / a ne rtam kho/ dme shul tshang gi a yas sogs nye 'brel mang po zhig a ma la lta ru yong / a mas ‘‘nga tsho a skyo byas nas song ba yin/ ca lag gang yang nyos medami zer zhor du/ nye 'brel tshor bla brang go re dang / sil tog dmar rig spar gang re byin/ a nee ri sgron gyis ‘‘nga la gang yang mi dgos/ khyod rkang thang du song nas mjal skor zhig byas pa bzang song / nga gzhes ning song ba yin/ dka' las mang po myangs song / cung min na tshur yul la mi slebs tsam zhig byas song zer bar/ a ne rtam khos ‘‘'o snying rje/ zhi lu 'ja' kho 'di go chod cig red/ za btung byas tshar na/ zhi lu chung ba la nyin ltar khos bdag byas pa redami sogs/ bud med rkyang rkyang 'phrad song na/ bshad nas tshar rgyu zhig yod pa ma red/ de dus a mye nags rtam gyis ‘‘ya sru mo/ khyod kyis 'di tshor sha re tshos dang / de ring da khyed tshos sha skom pa chu thog tu slebs pa lta bu byas nas zos/ lhod lhod byas nas sdod dang / mi khom rgyu yod pa ma red/ go song ngam ’zer bar/ ma drin can gyis ‘‘'o ya a mye’ zer zhor du sha dang g.yos rgyu ma sogs blangs nas btsos/ yang ja bskol nas/ rdza lu'i nang gi 'o ma rang rang gi phor 47

leku1 ༅ mi1lu5 — 0 li 060 4la pa'i nang blug tu bcug de dus a ne rtam khos a mye nags rtam la‘‘'o ya/ khyod nags tshang tshang gi rgyu la ser sna med na/ de ring nga tshos za yag 'thung yag cig byedanya zer bar/ a myes‘‘nags tshang tshang gi rgyu la ser sna gang yang med/ rgyu zer ba 'di mi rtag pa red/ de ring yod na sang nyin e yod mi shes/ de min na khyed tshos nyin rtag par yong nas zo dang / nga nags tshang rgan po gser yum 'don sha rtsa mi dgos spa rtsa zhig 'dar na nyasogs skad cha mang po bshad/ cung 'gor rjes a mas gazlor du bskal ba'i zho a ne tshor blud/ a ne ri sgron khong tshos ‘‘ya da 'grig song zer zhor du/ za zhor dang 'thung zhor du kha brda byas te dgong mo bar du bsdad//le tshan bcu pa/mi 'dod chag sgo byung ste/ drin can a ma bral song /nyin gnyis gsum 'gor rjes/ nga'i ma drin can gyis mgo dang skosogs gzer 'dug zer nas/ nyin mo yar langs re med par na/ ma gzhi ni bla brang nas tshur yong dus nas/ cham pa zhig phog 'dug zer la/ de ring nas bzung ste ske rmen skrangs shing / nad ni nyin re nas nyin re bzhin je sdug dang / da nangs las do dgong je sdug tu 'gro bzhin yod/ de dus dme shul tshang gi bu mo yang /cham pas ske gzer nas nyal sar lhung 'dug zer ba thos/ nyin 'di 'ga'i ring la/ nags tshang tshang gis nyin re bzhin/ bla ma grwa pa gdan drangs nas rim gro skyabs 'jug gang mang bton/ sman pa dang sngags pa gdan drangs nas sman sbyin sngags brgyab/ ci byas kyang rdo thog tu chu blugs pa bzhin/ ma drin can gyi nad je dga' ru ma song bar/ da nangs snga dro dme shul tshang gi bu mo shi song zer ba'i skad ngan go nas/ nags tshang tshang gi bza' khyim gang pos sems sdug bsags 'dug la/ skad ngan 'di ma drin can la ma bshad par gsang / nyin 48

5 ḍa cha rdziyom gcig ma drin can gyi mig nas mchi ma bzhur zhor du a pha la 6‘'dul pa lo lo/nga da ni gson rgyu'i re ba cang med pa 'dra zhig red/ ngas khyod la sdug dka' las dang / bu gnyis ka khyod kyi mgo la bzhag song / 'di gnyis ka chung bas snying rje/ ngas a lags gung thang tshang la khong gnyis skyabs 'jug re zhus yod/nga shi 'dra song na'ang khyod kyis 'khor ba re zungs/ zhi lu gnyis kur ma g.yar reyod na dga' yi redami zer bar/ a phas ‘‘da khyod kyis de 'dra ma bshad/ khyod shiyi ma redanya’zer zhor du mig nas mchi ma rang dbang med par babs/ ‘‘ya pha bzang bu da khyod ngu dgos don yod pa ma red/ shi dang mi shi mi rang rang la tshe tshad re yod pa red/ nga rang tshe tshad la slebs pa yin rgyu red/ nga bla brang dgon pa dang a lags gung thang tshang la mjal song / da sems mi bde rgyu gang yang med/ khyod kyis yin gcig min gcig 'khor ba re bzung nas/ zhi lu 'di gnyis la bdag skyong gyis/ sngon ma a lags kyis zhi lu chung ba'i mgor sdug yong rgyu red gsungs yod pa red/ snying rje 'di chung bas da rung gang yang shes kyi ma red/'ja' khos kho grwa pa byed dgos zhes mdud pa blangs yod pa red/ da khyod kyis sems sdug chen po byed ki ma 'dug gzab gzab gyis dang khyod bde 'tsham yod pas/ nga sems mi bde rgyu gang yang medami ces a mas mchi ma bzhur zhor du/ pha drin can dang shi gson bral ba'i snying gtam mang po zhig bshad/ dgong kha ri lung du grib chen 'gug dus/ nga yi ma drin can nyal sa'i nang du a phas mo'i khog stod bskyor nas bsdad yod/ ma drin chen gyi mtshams re mig phyes nas/a pha dang 'gram du nga rum nas bsdad yod pa'i a bu 'jam pe la yang yang lta bzhin/ lag pa bsrings nas a bu 'jam pe nged gnyis kyi mgo ru byil byil byas/de dus mos gdong nas mchi ma bzhur ba las kha mi grag cung tsam 'gor rjes nga yi ma drin chen la gzer ba dang na ba'i sdug bsngal ci yang med par/ nga yi pha drin chen gyi pang du gnyid song ba bzhin/ pha drin can dang / a bu 'jam pe/ nga rang / gzhis 'khor ba yod tshad la zhen chags med par shul du bskyur 49

miku khya yi lu5tshe 0 i /ma 655ma lul nas/ kha phyir 'khor med par bde ba can gyi zhing khams su phebs song / nags tshang tshang gi do rtsa'i mchod khri'i thog tu/ mchod me che chung bcu phrag 'ga' bsgron yod la/ grwa pa bcu lhag gis nyin ltar bskang ba sogs shi chos 'don gyin yod/rkang dung dang ḍa ru sogs kyi skad rgyang ring nas go 'dug khyim mtshes ru rogs dang / yul sde gzhan gyi nye 'brel dga' yag kun gyis lag rtags khyer nas/nags tshang tshang gi mig sngan la yong mkhan mtshams chad rgyu med/zhag gsum 'goje ba'i phyi nyin skya mda' bkyag dus/ ru skor gyi skya mi nyi shu tsam yong nas/ nga yi a ma'i phung po rta thog tu bkal te chu kha ma'i bkra shis chos gling dgon du song / shul na yod pa'i ru skor gyi bud med tshos rde'u mang po btus nas/ ma drin can gyi nyal sa'i shul du rde'u spangs blugs/ phung po 'gel mkhan tsho dgon nang du slebs pa dang / 'du khang༄ sgo kha'i rdo bcal thog tu grwa pa bzhi brgya tsam 'dus nas khrus chog 'don zhing / nga yi ma drin chen la khrus byas/ de nas mi tshos ma drin can gyi phung po rta thog tu bkal nas/ dgon pa'i dur khrod du song / dgon pa'i dur khrod ni/ chos lung gong ma'i yar gdong gi nyin khugs sa ha cang yag po zhig na yod la/ dur khrod kyi gong 'og thams cad du rdo brkos ma ṇi khri phrag mang po brtsigs yod la/ ma ṇi'i gong 'og kun la rdo dar dkar dmar ser gsum ha cang mang po 'then yod pa rlung gis brdab nas shog sgra 'ur 'ur grag pas 'jigs su rung ba zhig yin/ dur khrod nang du slebs rjes/ ro bsha' rgan po zhig gis mgo'i ral ba rgyab tu bsnar zhing lag brje dpung brdze byas nas/ nga yi ma drin can gyi rgyab kyi gon pa phud de gcer bur kha sbub tu bzhag cing / ske la rmu thag dkar po zhig btags nas der yod pa'i phur pa zhig la btags/ de dus dur khrod kyi gong na grwa pa bcu lhag gis rkang dung 'bud cing ḍa ru dkrol nas chos 'don bzhin yod/ cung ma 'gor par dud khrod kyi nub ngos nas rgod thang dkar dang / thang nag thang smug sogs bcu kha zhig 'phur yong nas/ dur khrod kyi mkha' dbyings su lding skor 'ga' 50

5 ḍa sgru miyo byasarjes/ gcig 'phro gcig byas nas dur khrod du babs shing / ma drin can gyi phung po'i rtsib tu slebs/ ro bsha' rgan pos nga yi ma drin can gyi rgyab gzhung dang / 'phongs sha'i thog gri gsha' mang po byas yod la/ da rung rgyab dang brla thog sogs nas sha rdog mang po blangs nas sa thog la gtor yod/'on kyang / bya rgod tshos phung po la skor ba byed pa las zos med/ de dus ro bsha' gcod rgan gyis nga yi ma drin can gyi lus thog nas sha rdog re zung bkog ste/ kho rang gi kha nang du bcug nas zos shing / bskyar ldad re byas rjes/ yang rgod thang dkar zhig dang / thang nag cig‘‘ya ya dkar chung / nag tho khyed gnyis kyis thog ma zos dang / ya 'di cung tsam re zos dang nyazer zhor du rgod gnyis la sprad/'on kyang / rgod gnyis kyis da rung ma zos/ mi tshos bshad na ro bsha' gcod pa 'dis 'di ru 'phur yong ba'i rgod thams cad re re bzhin ngo shes pa mi tshad/ rgod re la ming re btags yod la/ khos dus rgyun du rgod re re bzhin ming nas 'bod zhor dang skad cha bshad zhor du sha la dga' mkhan la sha dang / khrag la dga' mkhan la khrag rus pa yang yang brdung nas/ se go yor la ster ba yin/ de ring khos ci byas kyang bya rgod tshos ma zos par/ skabs der yang nub phyogs nas rgod dkar po dung 'dra zhig 'phur yong nas/ thad kur nga yi ma drin can gyi khog stod kyi rtsib logs su babs nas/ ma drin can gyi rgyab gzhung la 'khu1 tshug gsum bzhi zhig byas te 'phur song / rgod de 'phur ma thag sa der babs yod pa'i rgod yod tshad kyis gang mgyogs sgos/ nga yi ma drin can sha za pags 'then byas nas zos song / de'i tshe mi 'ga' res dur khrod kyi 'gram na ja skol nas bsdad yod la/ ro bsha' rgan po der yong nas/ lag par 'gos yod pa'i khrag thur sne la phyis shing / da rung khrag yod bzhin du gtsang btsog ci yang med par ja 'thung /rtsam pa zos/cung ma 'gor bar/ rgod mang che ba brgyags nas re re bzhin dur khrod kyi ri sgang la 'gos 'dug 'ga' res da rung za bzhin yod la/ ro bsha' rgan pos ma drin can gyi mgo rus brdung zhing / skra dang klad pa mnyam du bsnos 51

lekusnye ༅ li lu5ོ 0 i ca0 lal te rgod la ster zhing / brla rkang sogs rus pa che ba bdung nas rgod dang / se go yor la ster/ cung tsam nas grwa pa tshos kyang chos gsungs tshar nas phebs song la/ ro bsha' rgan pos kyang ma drin can gyi phung po gtsang ma gtsang dag byas te bya gtor tshar zhing / rogs pa tsho dang mnyam du rang rang gi khyim du song / dur shul na sha 'thor dang / khrag 'thor cung re yod pa/ pho rog dang / bya bye'u gzhan gyis btus nas za bzhin yod/ nyin 'di nas bzung / nga yi ma drin can 'jig rten gyi 'khor ngan dang bral nas/ rnam shes sbrang chung 'dra po/ phyi ma bar rdo'i mun nag nang du ci tsam 'khyams dgos pa sus shes/ rjes ma mi dang yang na rta zog ci zhig gi skye ba blangs kyang shes thabs med pa red/nags tshang tshang gi dgong zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i nang du chos 'don pa dang / yar dgon sde grwa tshang la rta zog lug gsum gyi 'bul ba rgya cher byas/mar khyi sbrang po la ja mar sha gsum gyi sbyin pa gang mang btang / de'i dus su a lags mi rdo tshang gis nga yi ma drin can ni/ lha sde'i khyim tshang phyug po zhig tu bu zhig gi skye ba blangs yod gsungs/ da ni shi rgyu'i mi ni shi tshar song / 'jig rten 'di na rig mthong med pas/ gang zhig na skye ba blangs yod kyang / dga' rgyu ci yang med/ 'on kyang khyim gza' tshang dang nye 'brel kun kyis/ a lags kyi gsungs de go rjes/ ‘‘ya skyid de/ bu mo 'di sems bzang bas skye ba yag po zhig len kho thag yin sogs sems dga' ba'i skad cha gang mang bshad 'dug sa lags kyis gsungs pa yin pas/ thams cad sems bde bar gnas so//le tshan bcu gcig pa/nags tshang spra chen tshang la/ chag sgo gcig 'bro gcig red/a bu 'ja' pe lo chung yang / ma drin can shi ba'i sdug ngo zin pas/ nyin rtag par dgong mo nga rang pang ste sgo chon rtsa nas ‘‘a ma/ a ma ma kho/ khyod gang 52

5la( ra 3 myi yo na yodanya zer zhor du ngu bzhin 'dug la/ nga yi pha drin can la nyin ltar sems sdug che bas mi ngo rang ngo med pa lta bu dang / nags tshang tshang nyi ma de nas bzung mdog shor song ba lta bu red/ yang nyin 'di gar khyim nas ma khom pas/ rta pho bcu phrag cig rkun mas ded song ba red/ ma drin can gyi phung po bya gtor byed nyin/ nags tshang tshang gi bu chung ba nor skyabs rta rkun gyi ra mda' ru song bas lug ri rgyag byas pa dang / dgong mo lug nang du spyang khu brgyugs te/ lug che chung bco lnga bsad cing / brgyad dgu zhig rmas yod pas/ ru skor kun shas rgyags par byas/ a mye nags rtam gyis ‘‘da nged nags tshang tshang hor gur dkar tshang la dus ngan tshes 'dra/ do tshigs nas 'go bzung ste/ da mtha' thur la 'gro ran pa 'dra/ shi rgyu de nor song ba red/ shi dgos rgyu de nga red/ gshin rje chos rgyal mig long song bas/shi lam khrid rgyu 'phyug song ba red sogs zer zhor du/ rang gi brang khar khu tshur gyis brdung nas ngu bshad thengs mang byas/ a pas ‘‘a pha khyod kyis de 'dra ma bshad/ shi zer ba rang gi tshe dang las red/ der brje rgyu zhig med pa los shes/ da shi rgyu shi tshar song ba red/ nga tsho shi bo'i rgyab kyi gson po tsho/ ci yin yang 'dug dgos song ba red/ shi bor dgos rgyu chos red/ de ni gzhi 'khor ba phyed ka zhig 'bul 'jog byas yod/ da ci yang byed rgyu yod pa ma red ces a mye la sems gso'i skad cha mang tsam bshad pas/ a myes kha ci yang mi grag par bsdad/ma drin can bral nas nyin bzhi lnga tsam nas/ nga la a ne ri sgron gyis bdag byas nas khong tshang du khrid song / de dus nga skyes nas zla bdun dang nyin bco lnga tsam yin zer/ a ne rtam kho dang a ye mtsho lo sogs kyis nyin ltar nags tshang tshang la sgo phyi nang gi las ka las rogs byas nas yun ring zhig 'gor song /de dus nags tshang tshang la lhag tu stabs ma legs pa zhig ni/ nags tshang tshang gi bu chung ba nags tshang nor skyabs dang rogs pa mi gnyis/ bla brang du nga yi ma drin can gyi don du shi chos 'tshogs par song nas/ tshur yong ba'i lam bar 53

rāku /khya li lu5ོ 0 li / 0khyelum 4 du/ dngul ra lha sde'i rkun jag dang thug ste/ me mdas rgyag res byas nas bsad song zer ba'i skad ngan de dgong mo zhig la go song / chag sgo gnam nas lhung 'dra gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis nags tshang tshang gi mgo la lhung song / rjes nas dgon pa dang dpon po tshos lha sde dang gyod bshad nas mi sha mi stong blangs yod rung / de dus nags tshang tshang la dgos rgyu ni mi rin gyi rgyu min par/ bu stag phrug 'dra bo shor ba'i gyong ni rin thang med pa zhig dang / sems sdug ni brjed thabs med pa zhig red/ rjes nas ha go ba ni/ mi gsod mkhan dang nor skyabs ni/ dus rgyun ngo shes par ma zad grogs po bzang po zhig yin/'on kyang /de'i dgong mo phar ngo tshur ngo ma shes par rgyang nas me mda' rgyag res byas nas lha sde'i mi gnyis rmas/ rta gcig bsad gcig rmas/ nam langs dus phan tshun ngo shes pas/ nor skyabs kyi ngo shes rogs pa tshos/ nor skyabs kyi phung po nyin der dgon nang du khyer zhing / ro bdag yag po byas yod zer/ skad cha go rjes a mye nags rtam gyis ‘‘lha sde mug ro tsho/ nga nags tshang tshang la ci zhig rtsod rgyu yod/ shi mgo khrag la skor rgyu tsho/ da nga tshar song / zhi lu mig 'dra bo shor song /gna' snga mo 'dra yin na ngas me kha gso mkhan med pa zhig mi byed na gser yum brgya tham pa/ da nga rgan po shi kha bu gces dmar ma de lag nas shor song zer zhor dang ngu zhor du nyal sa nang nas yong ldeb byed kyi 'dug de dus a mye lo bdun cu don bdun la slebs tshar la/ kho'i lus thog tu dme tshang dang 'dzing skabs kyi rmas da rung drag med/ de nas nyin mang po ma 'gor bar kho ni sems sdug dang / zhe sdang sogs kyis mnar nas mal du lhung zhing / mgo ma gtogs 'gul rgyu med par gyur/ kun gyis da yang a mye nags rtam shi rgyu red zer nas skrag snang dang brel 'tshub langs shing / rtsis pas rtsis bskor/ mo bas mo btab/dgon grwa tshang gis rim gro bton/ rjes su a lags rnams kyis nad yun cung ring yang srog la nyen kha cang med gsungs pas khyim mi nye 'brel kun sems cung bde song / nga yi ma drin can bral ba nas bzung / nags tshang tshang nang gi mi 54

5 (ḍa /cha'u lu ma dgos sde phyi yi mis bltas na/ nyin re bzhin je nyams je sdug la 'gro bzhin yod la/ sgo kha'i khyi zhig kyang kha nyin skor 'go nas nor gyis brdung nas rmas yod la/ nyin lnga drug gi rjes su shi song / da ni nye che chung med pa/ sde ru skor kun gyis ‘‘bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ da ni nags tshang tshang gi mgo la chag sgore yong mi nyan zer nas gsol ba smon lam 'debs kyin yod la/ nags tshang tshang da ni rta la lo bcu kha zhig dang / nor nag nu khe sa 'jog sum cu tsam/ lug brgya skor zhig las lhag med pas/ ngo ma 'jig rten gtam dpe la ‘‘mi shi ba'i thog la rgyu zadami zer ba 'di/ da nags tshang tshang gi thog la rig rig bltas bltas lhung tshar song / mi khog chen gyis bltas na yid skyo ba/ mi sems chung gis rig na ngu shor ba zhig byung tshar / yin na'ang / nags tshang tshang gi shi po'i rgyab kyi gson po tshos/ sdug che yang shi 'jog sa cang med pas sngar ltar rang rang gi 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod la/ nyin re bzhin nam langs pa nas rta zog lug gsum ri la ded/ dgong mo sngar ltar lhas la bskor nas dgos zas zos rjes/ rang rang so so nyal du 'gro bzhin yod/nyi ma ni nyin ltar sngar bzhin shar/ mun pa ni dgong ltar sngar bzhin rub/ nags tshang tshang yang nam langs nyi shar dang / mun pa rub pa'i bar nas/ru sde kun dang mnyam du go med grag med du/ rang kha rang gso yi 'tsho ba rol nas bsdad yod/ de'i phyi lo'i dbyar khar rma sde chu kha ma dang / ma blon dme tshang gnyis sa don du gyod thug nas dmag rgyag res byas shing / chu kha ma'i sa shor nas lha sde'i sa thog tu yong / rjes nas yang lha sde dang nang 'dzing brgyab nas/yang rma chu brgal te sog po'i sa thog tu thon zhing / khes sun tho log dang / chu 'go khya ra sogs la gtan 'dug byas pa yin zer/ nga rang gis a ne rtam khos bshad pa'i gtam rgyud ring po 'di tsho go rjes/ sems su bshad mi shes pa'i skyo snang zhig skyes song / nga'i ma drin can tshe thag thung ba yin nam/ yang na nga rang las ngan pa yin/ gang ltar yang / nga rang chung dus nas ma drin can gyi gces 55

rāku khya yi mu5ོ 0 i / hrica 4la skyong mig gis mthong ma myong zhing / sems la yange 'khor ma myong / sde ba'i byis pa tshos nga'i a ma kho'i a ma zer skabs/ nga rang a ma zhes 'bod sa med pas lkog nas sems sdug gi mchi ma thengs mang bzhur myong la/ nga la a ma ci la med pa dus rgyun sems la 'khor 'dug nga rang chung dus nas‘‘a ne/ a yas/ a pha nya'abod pa las ‘‘a ma ’zhes phal cher bos ma myong / nga rang chung sems ngo zin pa nas/ ru sde'i nang gi cig tshang gi ma shi song zer nas byis pa rnams ngu skabs/ ngas kyang mig chu dbang med du bzhur/ yang na sde ba'i byis pa tsho 'khyag ltogs gang byung yang rang rang la a ma zer nas ngu sa bshad sa skyo sa yod la/ nga la chung dus nas dga' sdug 'khyags ltogs ci 'dra yin yang / rang gi sems sdug gi mchi ma lkog nas mid pa las a ma zer sa bshad sa med/chung dus nam rgyun sbra sgo'i chon thag 'gram nas kher 'dang mang po brgyab myong / be'u la 'bri mo zer ba'i ma yod cing / rte'u la rgod ma zer ba'i a ma yod/ tha na sa thog gi 'bu dang gnam gyi bya kun la ni rang rang gi a ma yod cing / nga la dran sems yod pa nas snying rje dang gces skyong byed mkhan gyi a ma zhig med pa 'di ci yin nam/ nga rang a ma med pa'i sems sdug ni dus dang rnam pa kun tu sems nas bral ma myong ba yin/ rjes su a ne rtam khos nga yi ma drin chen bral ba'i lo rgyus sogs bshad pas/ dus rgyun nga'i rmi lam nang nas a ma la thug pa dang / yang na ‘‘a ma/ a ma ma kho zhes thengs mang 'bod pa rmis song / 'on kyang / nga gnyid sad dus sngas mgo mig chus rlon pa byas yod pa las/ nga la a ma zhig thug rgyu dang rig rgyu gang na yod/ rmi lam nang nas kyang/ nga'i a ma'i gdong rab be rib be zhig ma gtogs gsal po zhig mthong mi thub/ da ni ha go song / a ma nga la mi byams pa ga la yin/ mo rang ni shi bdag nag pos btsan gyis tshe phyi mar khrid song / nga la da rung a pha yod pas khong 'tsham por bsdad na/ nga rang ni skyid po yin/ sdug rgyu dang snying rje dgos pa ni/ gson por yod pa'i nga rang min par/ tshe phyi mar song ba'i a ma drin can/ bla dga' ldan la skye rgyu ma 'di 56

( 4 thun 3 yo los yin/ nga rang la nga'i drin can a mar drin lan mjal ba'i go skabs shig med pas/ chung dus nas bla ma dgon sde gang du mjal yang / sngon la nga'i ma drin can gyi don du ma ṇi re zung bton pa dang / nga'i zhe nas nga rang gi blo sems rtse gcig gis ma drin can gyi don du gsol 'debs dang / ma ṇi re 'don thub na/ de ni nga yi ma drin can tshe phyi ma'i bar rdo'i 'jig rten gang du yod na/ mo'i lus thog char ba 'bab pa bzhin phan thogs re yod rgyu red bsams/ de bas mi che ba dag gis nangs dgong kun tu ma ṇi 'don pa ci zhig gi don yin pa rang gi mi shes kyang / nga rang gis chung dus nas ma ṇi re 'don pa ni/ rnam shes bar rdo'i mun nag tu 'khyams pa'i ma drin can la phan cung re e thogs/ bsam nas 'don pa ma gtogs/ nga rang gi ched dang / yang na nga rang la tshe phyi ma phan thogs re e yod bsams nas bton pa rtsa ba nas min/ rjes nas rang gis bsam shes dus/ yang mi dar ma tshos bshad pa ltar/ ma ṇi tshar gcig 'don yang ‘6drin can gyi pha ma dang / ma 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo zhes smon lam yang yang 'debs kyin yod//le tshan bcu gnyis pa/nags tshang 'khor ba'i khyim las/ g.yog mo zhig la brten song /de ring nyin gung ha cang tsha ba che la/ a ne rtam kho sgoca na rkang pa'i pus mo gnyis dang / nya gdong thog rkang byugs te nyi mar lde nas bsdad yod/ ngas phor pa'i nang du rtsam 'gyog cig mdzub ldag byed zhor du/ gcer bur mo'i 'gram du lto ba sa la gtug nas bsnar yod/ de dus a khu nor bkra sbra sgor yong nas ‘‘yang khyod gnyis kyis gna' rabs da rgyus bshad bzhin yod dmanya zer bar/a nes ‘6nga la nyin rtag par bshad tshod mi 'duganya ces bshad/ 66da shod ya/ da los bshad/ nags tshang tshang gi lo rgyus gang shes bshad yag gyis/ de min zhi 57

rāku khya yi mu5 — 0 i khyeyo wal lu nus kho yang sems bde yi ma red nyam khu nor bkras de ltar bshad pa na/ a nes ‘‘ngas kha sang zhi lu gnyis kyi ma mtho ris ma shi rabs bshad nas nga'i snying nang du cig byas song / da rung mi bde ba 'dra zhig 'dug da kha dro khyod kyis shod dnganya zer/ ‘‘ngas bshad dgos kyang bshad chog de bshad mi thub rgyu gang yang yod pa ma redami zer zhor du/ yang a khu nor bkras nags tshang tshang gi skor gyi gtam rgyud ring po zhig bshad song /rma sde chu kha ma dang ma blon dme tshang gnyis dmag brgyab tshar te/ chu kha ma'i sa shor nas/ sog po'i sa thog tu slebs nas lo gnyis tsam 'gor song /nags tshang tshang gi ru de dus khes sin tho log na bsdad yod/ dme shul tshang dang / khong tshang gi a zhang mgur grags sogs nye ya mang po zhig gis nga yi pha la/ 'khor ba re 'dzin dgos pa'i skad cha thengs mang bshad kyang / a phas ‘‘da ni 'khor ba mi 'dzin/ mna' ma zhig blangs na/ ji ltar bshad kyang nga'i bu gnyis kyi thog la ma mtho ris ma lta bu zhig byed rgyu ma redanya zer nas/ ci bshad kyang 'khor ba zhig 'dzin rgyur mi 'thad/ a mye nags rtam gyis kyang ‘6zhi lu/ shi bo'i rgyab kyi gson po red/ ci bshad kyang 'tsho ba skyong dgos pa red/ 'khor ngan re bzung na dga' na'ang thang )zer bar/ a phas ‘‘da 'khor ba bzung nas gang yang 'dzon gyi ma red/ bu gnyis nar son na dgon par grwa pa byas/ de nas gzhan bsam rgyu yod pa ma redaminyazer/ nye 'brel thams can la gzhan gyis bkod pa cang med par/ g.yog mo re 'jog dgos pa'i gros byas kyang a pha 'thad pa ma byung / de dus nga da rung a nee ri sgron gyi 'gram na yod la/ mtshams rer a bu 'ja' pes sbra sgo nas/ nus kho dran gyi 'dug zer nas ngu 'bod byed 'dug la/ a mye nags rtam gyis 6‘da khyod ma ngu dang / lo sar tshar ba dang zhi lu nus kho tshur khrid yong gi red/ de dus khong tshos khrid ma yong na/ nged gnyis song nas khrid yong / go song ngamanya zer/ de'i cung sngon zhig la yang a bu 'ja' pes nga rang khrid shog zer nas ngus 'dug pas/ a phas kyang ‘‘da zhi lu nus kho 58

ma ba ༅eyo tshuranga'i rig sar khrid yong dgosanya zer nas/ a nee ri sgron yod sar song a ne ri sgron dang nye 'brel tshos zhi lu da rung lo chung gi/ lo sar rjes bskyal yong zer nas khrid du ma bcug dgong mo zog lhas la slebs rjes/ a mye nags rtam gyis a pha la‘‘do tshigs lo sar rgyab yin gcig min min gnyis song nas zhi lu nus kho tshur khrid shog nga tshos bdag skyong byed thub/ 'ja' khos dran gyi 'dug ces shod kyi 'dug shi rgyu ni shi tshar song ba red/ sems sdug na'ang byed rgyu cang yod pa ma red/ da gson po tsho kha kha byas nas sems sdug gsog dgos don yod pa ma redami’zer bar/ pha drin can gyis‘6'o ya pha lo/ da lo yin gcig min gnyis khrid yong nyazer/ de dus nags tshang tshang sngar ltar dar rgyas phyug 'byor med kyang / khyim tshang 'bring tsam yin rgyu red/ rta bcu lhag dang / zog che chung bzhi bcu tsam/ lug brgya phrag re yod/ rgan po nags rtam gyis dus rgyun ‘‘nged nags tshang tshang / rgyu thog la thon myong ba red de/ rgyu mi rtag pa red/ da bu dang tsha bo gnyis 'tshams bsdad na/ rgyu gsog rgyur dka' las yod pa ma red/ ci sdug kyang mi la g.yar ma dgos pa'i 'khor ngan re zin gyi red’nyazer la/ don thog nas bshad na skad cha 'di tsho bden pa los yin/ mi gson po red/ rgyu shi bo red/ mi 'tshams por bsdad na rgyu thog la su yin yang thon rgyu yod pa red/gzhan nas g.yar mi dgos pa'i 'khor ngan re/ las zad pa min na mi su yin yang 'dzin thub rgyu red/ma gzhi nags tshang rtam me yi pha yul ngo ma ni/ mdzod dge yin zer la/ lo chung dus rtam me mdung lo zer zhing / bu rgod po rkun jag dpe med cig red zer/ thog ma sa phyogs 'dir yong dus kho la span ya nags tshang ban rgan zer ba zhig yod la/ kho'i mig la skyon cung yod pa(ba kun gyis lkog nas/ nags tshang ban zhar zhes 'bod pa red/ sngon zhig la grwa pa yin zer/ rjes nas nags rtam gyis dbal ban sde ba'i gling skor ma'i nang du 'khor ba bzung nas bsdad/khong tshang la 'dul kho dang nor skyabs zer ba'i bu gnyis yod/ rjes nas nga yi 59

rwaku 6 li lu5 — 0 yi nyelug 4la pha drin can gyis kyang dbal ban tshang nas khyim tshang zhig dang nye gtam ste/chung skyid zer ba'i bu mo zhig dang 'khor ba 'dzin rgyu byas yod/ de dus a mye nags rtam dang dbal ban dpon tshang tshang gnyis nang gyod la thug nga yi a pha'i mna' ya kha rta rin chen rta so zer ba ni/ dbal ban dpon tshang tshang gi mi rkyang yin/ khos wa rgan tshang gis nags tshang tshang gi thog tu dmag rgyag dgos zer ba go rjes/ wa rgan tshang nas mtshan mo me mda' gcig khur gcig khyer/ rta gcig zhon gcig khrid nas nags tshang tshang la cha rgyag par yong zhing / nags tshang tshang de'i mtshan rin chen rta sos rogs byas pas/ mi rkyang rta rkyang gzhi 'khor ba yod tshad shul du bskyur nas ri shor du song / rjes nas ru rma sde chu kha ma'i nang du yong zhing / dme shul tshang dang gnyen bsgrigs nas 'khor ba bzung ba yin/ rir 'bro dgos thug pas nga yi pha drin can dang dbal ban tshang nang gi bu mo chung skyid gnyis gnyen sgrig ma thub la/ mo rang la lo der bu mo zhig skyes yod zer/skad cha 'di tsho ni bar gyi 'phros gtam red/ lo de'i ston kha zhig la a mye nags rtam gyis lag rten bzung nas sgol 'gro skabs/ thang la 'gyel te lag g.yon pa'i dpung pa bcag pa red/ ma gzhi lus thog gi rmas skyon drag med pa'i khar yang lag pa bcag pas/ de nas bzung nyin ltar na ste/ za 'thung 'gro 'dug rang mgo mi thon par gyur pas/ a zhang mgur grags dang / nye 'brel tshos rogs byas nas/ rko chen ru ba'i bud med cig nags tshang tshang la g.yog mor bzhag pa red/ de dus nags tshang tshang gi rta zog ni khyim mtshes ru rogs kyis 'tshos yod la/ nga yi pha ni rta dang me mda' la dga' zhing / lhag par du khyim mtshes ru rogs kyi pho sar tsho dang mnyam du ri dgas bda' ba dang / yang na jag rkun sogs la 'gro bar dga' bas/ dus rgyun khyim du 'dug yun ha cang thung / nga yi pha drin can la me mda' bu ra go thung zhig khur rgyu yod la/ kho rang ni ru sde'i nang nas cung ming grags yod pa'i me mda' rgyag mkhas pa zhig yin 60

5 kyo 4 chaskyi lum pas/ sde ba'i nang gi kha rta ru rogs kyi mi tsho yang kho rang dang mnyam du ri mgor 'gro bar ha cang dga'/ nga rang chung dus nas a phas nam yin yang / shwa ba bsad nas ra dang sha khyer yong ba dang / da rung pho gla dang wa sbe/ spyang ki sogs bsad nas khyer yong ba dran 'dug/le tshan bcu gsum pa/g.yog ngan ma yi lag nas/ rang zas rang la ma dbang /a pha ri mgor song rjes/ khyim nas g.yog mos nangs dgong 'bri bzho ba dang / a mye dang a bu 'ja' pe gnyis la za 'thung blud rgyu sogs rgyun ldan gyi khyim las byed bzhin yod la/ yun cung ring po zhig 'gor ba na g.yog mo de ni bud med ma rabs dpe med cig red/ khyim du slebs te zla gnyis gsum tsam nas/ nang la bdag mi byed pa ma zad/ khyi la lto mi ster/ nam yin yang nangs dus 'bri bzhos tshar rjes/ ja dro ma 'jam dem gang re a mye'i 'gram gyi go dong nang du bzhag rjes/ khyim nas sha skam dang mar sogs za rgyu ci yod khur nas/ mo rang gi nang la song nas dgong mo'i bar du mi yong / khyim la slebs dus a myes ‘‘bu mo/ khyod kyis khyi la lto blud rgyu ma brjed/ snying rje khyi tsho ltogs na/ kha ni grag mi shes/ sdig pa yod pa redami zer bar/ mos ma dga' shar re 66nga tsho'i khyi la nyin rer thengs gcig re las lto blud mi dgos/ khyed tshang gi khyi mug ro ma 'di tsho/ nyin rer thengs gnyis gsum rer blud mi thub zer zhor du sgor bud song / de dus nam yin yang a bu 'ja' pe song nas khyi la lto blud pa yin/ mun rub nas yun ring 'gor song yang / mo rang gis mgo go dong nang du bsgur nas ja 'thung ba las/ a mye dang a bu 'ja' pe gnyis la nub zas mi skol/ a myes ‘‘bu mo ci red/ do dgong dgong zas za rgyu med dam zhes dris par/ mos ‘‘khyed nags tshang tshang rgyu che bas/ dgong zas da los yodanya zer 61

le 4 li phu5ོ 0 i: nyesam lul nas/ rtsam sgam khyer yong nas/ khrog shir re g.yug nas song / yang a bu 'ja' pes a mye'i dkar yol nang du rtsam pa dang / ja blugs nas khong gnyis kyi kha ci yang mi grag par dgong zas zos/ mtshams rer g.yog mos nangs dus mo rang ru nyul 'gro ran khar/ rtsam sgam sbra yi thag pa'i gseb la bcug nas 'gro bas/ a bu 'ja' pe lo chung la bongs khe thung / a mye yar langs nas 'gro mi thub pas/ a mye dang a bu 'ja' pe gnyis la/ nyin gang du ja dro ma 'jam re 'thung ba las za rgyu ci yang med/ a myes a bu 'ja' pe la 66ya zhi lu/ do thog la 'byar nas rnyob dang / rtsam sgam len thub sa e red/ rkang zhabs la cig bzhag nas rnyeb dang / bar la rdo rgyag rgyu sprang mo 'dis nged gnyis mu ges gsod bsam pa red )zer/ thengs gcig a bu 'ja' pes zas tho kha sbrubs nas/ de'i thog 'gos te rtsam sgam len pa'i skabs ma theg par/ rtsam sgam dang mnyam du thang la brgyab nas/ rtsam chur thams cad kho rang gi mgo thog dang kha ngo kun la bshos pa ma zad/ ga sa gang du gtor 'dug a myes6‘ha bo skal chad po/ rtsam sgam zhig kyang mi theg pa/ ci ma nyan pa redanya zer zhor du/ nyal sa nang nas gog nur byas nas yong ste/ khong gnyis kyis gtor yod pa'i rtsam chur gtsang ma byas/dgong mo g.yog mo slebs dus mos ‘‘khyed gnyis kyis rtsam pa rku byas bsdad nas/yum 'di tshang gi mi la ngo tsha rgyu mi 'dug’’zer bar/ a myes ‘‘de ring rlung gis sbra brdab nas rtsam sgam lhung song’nyazer ba na/ mos ‘‘'o khyed kyi sbra 'di bya spu lta bu de 'dra'i yang mo zhig rdzun bshad mi dgos/ khyim mtshes rkun ma khyis mi khog nang gi rkun ma mis mi khog zer ba los bden zhes/ mi dga' mi 'dod pa'i skad cha mang po bshad/ de dus a myes spo langs nas‘‘ya tshe skum rgyu ma/ kha gso khom med rgyu ma/ khyod ci zhig ma nyan pa red/ khyim gza' tshang la zas za ru mi 'jug par/ rtsam sgam sbra yi thag pa'i bar du bcug zer ba zhig 'jig rten 'di nas go ma myong / da khyod kyis ci yang bshad mi dgos/ nang la song /nga'i mthong sar gcig shog dang / ngas du ba 'gyur ba zhig mi rgyag na/shul chad 62

5 ( 4 tshursha skyi/lug rgyu ma/ sgor songanya zer zhor du snyes mgo'i me mda' blangs pas/ g.yog mos lag gi dem sa der bzhag nas sgo'i phyi ru rgyugs song / de'i degong mo yang a bu 'ja' pes ja skol zhing / rdo kong nang du sha skam cung re brdung nas/ a mye khong gnyis kyi rtsam pa dang mnyam du zos/ mun rub rjes mchod me sbar nas/ go dong nang me gsos rjes rang rang so so nyal ba yin/de'i phyi nyin a ne rtam kho dang / ri sgron gnyis kyis g.yog mo khrid yong nas a mye dang skad cha mang po bshad/ mo yang sngar ltar nags tshang tshang gi khyim g.yog byas nas bsdad/ mos nam yin yang a mye dang a bu 'ja' pe gnyis la/zas ngan ja ngan byin yang / a myes skad cha bzang ngan ci yang mi bshad/ a bu 'ja' pes thengs rer mo'i thog la/ so kham bcings nas ‘6dmyal ba ma/bka' 'gyur mgo skor gyis gcig mi rgyag na’ zer la/ mos kyang4zhi lu kha zungs ma gtogs yum mi gshad na/ sdug khyod kyis kyang 'di 'dra byas nas nyazer zhor du/ a mye'i ngo la blta/ a bu 'ja' pe nyin dkar 'dug mi 'dod par/ khyim mtshes ru rogs sar song nas za 'thung byed kyin yod la/ thengs re khyim mtshes nas sha skal re dang rgyu ma cung re khyer yong nas a mye la ster/ a myes ‘‘khyod kyis sha gang nas khyer yong ba yin zhes dris pa na/ a bus ‘‘nga de ring nus khor blta ru song ba yin/ sha dang rgyu ma a bu dge lu tshang gis sprad song ’zhes lan btab/‘‘'o snying rje/ nus kho chen po chags 'dug gam/ ya ya sha 'di ngas za 'jog rgyu ma 'di do dgong nyar nas nged gnyis kyis nangs dus za’ a myes de ltar bshad pa na/ yang a bus 6‘nus kho nga mnyam du yong dgos zhes ngu bzhin 'dug kyang /a ne ri sgron gyis 'gro ru mi 'jug gi lo sar tshar na bskyal yonganya’zer/ ‘‘da drag gi red/ nyin re zung nas pha rgan slebs song na/ g.yog mo 'di bda' 'jogade nas nus kho tshur khrid nas/ nga tsho skyid po byas 'dug chog ni red/rinya.a myes kho la sems gso byas/ nyi ma mang po ma 'gor bar/ a pha dang rogs pa tsho ri dgas bda' sa nas tshur slebs pa dang / sha skam po dang / shwa ra/ ri dgas kyi 63

miku khya li lu5 — 0 li cas pa pags pa sogs khyer yod/ yang sgos dred mong gi pags pa chen po zhig khyer yod de/ a mye'i nyal sa'i nang du bting / a myes‘‘a wa 'di me dred ngo ma red/ 'di bting na ha cang phan gyi red’’sogs zer zhing ha cang dga' spro skyes 'dugadagong mo a pha dang / a mye gnyis kyis skad cha mang po bshad/ phyi nyin snga mo nas g.yog mo de rang khyim la mngags pa red/ de dus a mye ni sngar ltar na bzhin yod la/ ston kha nas bzung nad je sdug tu gyur/ nyin zhig khos a pha la ‘‘zhi lu 'dul kho/ khyod nangs dus song nas zhi lu nus kho khrid shog nga na tsha 'dis tshe ring po 'dug gi ma red/ zhi lu gnyis ka mthong sa ru yod na dga'/ lo sar ma sar med pas nangs dus yin gcig min gnyis khrid shog zer/ a phas 6‘o ya pha kho/ de sla mo red/ nangs dus khrid yong’’zer bar/ a bu 'ja' pe dga' nas‘‘'o skyid de/ nus kho khrid yong na nyin dkar ngas bdag byed dgos/ mtshan mo yang ngas rum choganya zer/ a myes‘ 'o ya 'ja' kho da khyod kyis bdag byed chog gi red ya/ chung dus nas khyod kyis bzung na mi ngu ba min nam/ da phyin chad pha rgan khyim na med dus khyod kyis bdag byed dgos pa red’’zer//le tshan bcu bzhi pa/nga rang nang la spebs rjes/ a mye bde zhing phebs song /de'i phyi nyin pha drin can snga mo nas song ste/ nga khrid nas nang la slebs/a bu 'ja' pes sgo kha nas/ nga dang lag sprel byas te a mye nyal sa ru song / a myes‘‘ya ya nga'i zhi lu nag yas mgo che slebs song / 'dir shog dang / a myes gcig blta/ 'o nga'i zhi lu chen po chags 'dug’ zer zhor du/ mig nas mchi ma 'bab la nga rang la byams po byed zhor du/ sngas mgo 'og nas sil tog dmar po re zung blangs nas/ a bu 'ja' pe dang nged gnyis la byin/ de dus nga rang lo ngo bzhi yin la/ mgo'i mnol skra blangs med pas ras rde nag spar re bzhag 64

ske 5 (ḍa ardziyo yod/ a nee tshang gis nga la be'u'i pags pa'i thog la/ phying bas lhan pa brgyab pa'i be'u slog chung chung zhig bskon yod la/ nga la lham gon rgyu med/ a myes ‘‘ha bo 'di tshang gi nga'i zhi lu slog pa yag po zhig bskon mi 'dug nangs dus a myes khyod la slog pa dron po zhig bzo yonganya zer/ phyi nyin a myes kho rang gi slog pa rnying pa zhig yod pa'i phu thung gnyis bkog nas/ yar dras mar glan/ mjug mthar nga rang la slog pa chung chung zhig bzos/ pags pa rnying pa yin yang ha cang dron po zhig red/ yang slog pa rnying pa'i skyi mo yod sa nas lham yu byas shing / lham ngo la slog lpags sbyar nas dgun lham zhig kyang bzos/ rjes su nga yi dran pa na/ 'di ni nga rang skyes nas thengs dang por rkang par lham zhig gon pa dang /rgyab la mgo rnga tshang ba'i pags slog cig gon pa yin/ 'di dag gi lo rgyus ni/a khu nor bkras bshad skabs/ nga rang gis kyang rab be rib be dran pa yin/lo gsar la nye dus/ a myes nags rtam gyi nad je miru song nas/ mal sa ru lhung / bla ma dang dgon pa grwa tshang la sku rim dang skyabs 'jug mang tsam byas la/ mi tshos sems nas 'di ltar byas na/ cung drag rgyu red bsam nas sems cung bde ba ma gtogs/ a mye'i nad ni je sdug las je dga' ru cung tsam yang ma song / nyin zhig a myes nga yi pha drin can 'gram du bos nas/ ‘6zhi lu drin chen po/ da nga rgyun ring mi 'dug sems thag red/ da sman pa 'bod mi dgos/ bla ma grwa tshang la skyabs 'jug zhu mi dgos/ rang gi tshe 'di red/ ha las rgyu yod pa ma red/ khyod nangs dus song nas dpon chung mgur grags dang /a khu rgya khor gnyis bos shog khong gnyis la bshad rgyu re yod/ 'o de'i zhor du a lags dga' ldan pa tshang yod na mnyam du bos shoganya zer bar a phas ‘‘a khu sman pa sang nyin yong rgyu yin/ sman re zos na dga' rgyu redanya ces bshad pa na/ ‘6da ngas shes kyi red/ nga lo brgyad cur son nyer yod/ da ni sems bde song / da 'gro dgos pa red/ sang nyin zhig la brgyad cu'i 'chol po/ skyid sdug go tshor med par bsdad ma bsdad yod pa ma red/ pha bzang bu/ khyod kyi bu gnyis 65

miku khya li lu5 — 0 i 6lo wal ka mi thog la 'jog thub pa gyis dang / nags tshang tshang rgyu chen po min yang / khyed tsho'i kha gso thub kyi red/ 'khor ngan re e 'dzin khyod kyis thag chod/ da ni nyal kha ja ma mang / shi kha gtam ma mang zer ba red/ nga gzhan bshad rgyu gang yang medaminyaces a pha la sems gso'i skad cha mang tsam bshad/ a phas ci yang mi bshad par mig mtha' mchi mas bskor nas nyan/phyi nyin a zhang mgur grags/ a zhang rgya khor dang / a lags dga' ldan pa rnams a mye nags rtam la blta ru yong / snga dro khong tshos skad cha mang po zhig bshad/ rjes nas a myes ‘‘nga ni mi sdig rgan red/ sku rim rim gro re zung gis dmyal khams su lhung mi dgos pa zhig yong gi ma red/ da ci yin yang tshe 'di yi dge sdig ri mo/ rang gi rkang lag gnyis kyis bris pa de/ mgo gnya' ba gnyis kyis khur ran red/ 'di tshor lo chung dus 'gyod ma shes pa red/ da shi ran kha 'gyod sa yod pa ma red/ da nga'i shul du zhi lu 'dul kho lhag yod kyang /kho la spun ya dpung rogs ci yang yod pa ma red/ kho'i zhi lu gnyis ka da rung lo chung bas/ rjes nas gar song gar bsdad/ khyod tsho'i mig gis 'tshos nas rogs pa re gyis/ gzhan rgad rdang la gang yang bshad rgyu medami zer bar sa zhang mgur grags kyis ‘‘khyod sems bde mo gyis dang / 'di la sems khral mi dgos/ khong pha bu rnams nged rma sde chu kha ma'i mo dud lnga brgya'i skyid sdug nang yod pa red/ 'khor ba re e 'dzin kho rang gis shes kyi red ma gtogs/ gzhan lag rogs dpung skyor nga tshos ci thub gang thub byed chog ’sogs sems gso'i skad cha mang po zhig bshad/ a zhang rgya khor gyis ‘‘rjes su 'dul khos 'khor ba rdzogs bzhag na/ sde dgon gang nas 'dug bsam yang / sdod sar sems khral mi dgos zer/ a myes ‘‘ya ya kha dro/ nged nags tshang tshang gis rma sde chu kha mar phan chen po thogs yod pa ma red de/ da snga brgyad cu'i nang gi rtswa zos/ dgu bcu'i gras nas chu 'thung / da gang thad nas bshad kyang/ sde dgon gnyis ka drin chen yin zer/ yang a lags dga' ldan pas kyang 6‘khyod dga' ldan na 66

5 4 ༅ milu 'bula'ajog dang skyabs 'jug zhus pa 'di/ nga'i da lo lo ma sar gong nas 'grub pa byed/ da bla ma dkon mchog la gsol 'debs re gyis dang / tshe phyi ma bar do'i khams nas yin yang / rogs skyor re yod nges red/ rang tshe 'dir nyes sdig ci ltar che yang / shi kha zhe gting nas 'gyod pa dang / nyes bshags re thub na/ de ni dge ba'i tshogs chen po gsog thub pa yin pas/ 'di phyi gnyis la phan thogs chen po yod pa red ’sogs/ chos phyogs nas gsung bshad mang tsam byas/ a myes 6‘'o lags so/ da shi kha 'gyod bshags shig gis cang e phan mi shes kyang / shi rgyur skrag snang spa tsam med/ da las bzang ngan ci zhig yin yang bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen’rinis bshad/ dgong mo khong tsho 'gro kha a zhang mgur grags kyis a pha la ‘‘da rgan po'i gnas stangs la bltas na/ nyin mang po 'dug sa ma red/ khyod kyis de lugs 'di nas gra sgrig re gyis dang / dgon nang nas nga yin’’zer/ nyin gnyis 'gor ba na/ a mye nags rtam gyi nad je sdug tu song nas/ lag brda re byed pa ma gtogs kha grag mi thub/ mdang nam smad nas mig gyen la rdzogs shing / dbugs 'jib pa thung zhing mngags pa ring la/ lag g.yon pas sa snyob rdo snyob byed bzhin 'dug nam langs dus/ lu thung gcig gnyis shig byas pa'i mtshams nas/ dbugs len ma thub par bde grongs song / nang du a pha la rogs byed mkhan la a ne rtam kho dang a khu nor bkra sogs yod la/ la las mar khu bzhu ba dang / la las mar me 'jog gi yod/a pha dang a ne rtam kho sogs skad mthon pos ma ngus kyang / gdong nas mchi ma sha ra ra bzhur bzhin 'dug nyin gung a zhang mgur grags kyis grwa pa bcu lhag khrid nas shi chos 'don pa sogs bkod sgrig byas/ de dus yang thag nye ring kun gyi nye 'brel dga' yag grogs po sogs mig sngon yong mkhan cung mang bas/a phas sgo phyi nang kun nas mgron po tshor sne len byed bzhin 'dug zhag gsum par a mye'i skar ma byed nyin/shar nas skya rengs bkyag dus/ skya mi mang po yong nas/ a mye'i phung po rta thog tu bkal nas dgon par phyin song //67

le tshan bco lda pa/pha rgan drin chen khong gis/ 'khor ba gting rdzogs byas song /da ni nags tshang tshang gi khyim du nga yi pha drin can dang / a bu 'ja' pe nged gsum las lhag med/ bza' mgo 'dzoms rgyu phyugs gnyis 'phel yin pa'i nags tshang tshang 'di/ nga yi ma drin can bral ba nas bzung / bza' tshang khyim nas 'thor/ rgyu sgo nas shor song / sbra nag rtsib bu bco brgyad/ sgal rta ka ra gsum re bkyag dgos pa red/ bza' mgo 'dzoms yod dus cung chung song ba lta bu yin yang / bza' kha 'thor tshar rjes/ sbra yang ha cang che song ba 'dra/nang kun stong pa 'dra zhig red 'dug nyin kha shas mtshams nas a zhang mgur grags dang / dme shul gyi a zhang mgon tshe/ a zhang rgya khor sogs nged tshang la yong / a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis sgo ru rtsed mo rtses nas bsdad/ khong tshos nyin gang por khyim nas skad cha bshad nas bsdad/ dgong mo 'gro ran dus/ a zhang mgur grags kyis a pha la‘‘da khyod kyis bsam pa bzhin gyis dang / gang yang mi 'grig rgyu med/ zog lug nyung tsam re nye 'brel tshor bcol na dga' ba red zer/ a zhang rgya khor gyis thog ma dgon nang du song nas/ khang pa'i nang 'dug chas re byed 'dug nga dgon nang du yun ring 'dug gi ma red/ khang pa'i nang khyed pha bu tshor yun ring sdod dang chogazhi lu 'ja' kho grwa pa red/ dgon nang du sdod/ nga dgon nang du yong na/ bu gnyis la ngas bdag byed chog dgon pa'i drin gyis khong gnyis ltogs shor ni ma redami zer la/ a zhang mgon tshes‘‘'bri dang mdzo mo re zung mtha' ba'i nang bcol na/ dus rgyun zho 'o/ mar phyur rer blta sa yod pas de ltar gyis/ mdzo dang g.yag re zung / lug rnams nged tshang gis 'tsho chog khyod rang gar 'gro gang 'dug sla mo redanya ces bshad/a phas‘‘ya ya/ da khyod tsho kha dro/ ngas 'di 'dra zhig byed rgyu las bkod pa mi 68

: ḍa rtsi milu 'dug da 'khor ba zhig bzung nas cang yong gi ma red/ de las ngas bu gnyis kyi ngor bltas bsdad na dga'/ khong gnyis nar son na/ ci bshad kyang / rang sde rang dgon nang nas cig drag ni red ’zer zhor du/ khong tsho la lam pa byas/de'i phyi nyin snga dro nas khyim mtshes ru rogs tshos rogs byas te/ nags tshang tshang gi sbra mgo nas bsgyel song / sbra phug rgyab kyi sgo dar blangs nas mi mngags te/lha chen rdo rje g.yu sgra'i lab rtse'i nang du bzhag rta che chung bcu lhag dang / zog che chung sum cu lhag lug bdun cu tsam yod tshad mi mngags nas ded de/ chu kha ma'i dgon par phul bar ma zad/ kha thab cha cung tsam re ma gtogs gzhis 'khor ba sbra dang bcas pa dgon par phul/ shul na mdzo mo re gnyis/ g.yag sna ma bzhi lnga/ lug sum cu lhag yod pa/ dme shul tshang dang a khu nor bkra sogs la bcol yod la/ de nas rta pho gnyis/ mdzo mo gsum/ 'bri gsum tsam las khyim 'dir ci yang lhag med/ a phas a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis khrid nas/ mdzo 'bri rnams ded de/ chu kha ma'i dgon par yong zhing / a zhang rgya khor gyi khang pa'i nang du gtan sdod byas/ mdzo mo dang 'bri rnams dgon pa'i mtha' ba a ne dkar tho tshang la bcol ba yin/a khu nor bkra yis nags tshang tshang gi skor kyi gtam rgyud bshad tshar song la/ de dus nga rang lo chung na yang / skad cha'i rgyu mtshan go ba gsal po len thub la/ dga' ba bshad na dga' zhing / sdug po bshad na sems sdug pa red/lhag par du/ a mye mtho ris po shi skabs/ nga yi sems sdug byed mi shes kyang /a bu 'ja' pes ngu 'bod byed pa dang / phyi nyin snga dro a mye'i phung po sbra sgo nas rta thog tu 'gel ba/ de'i rjes nged tshang gi sbra phab nas dgon par yong ba sogs/nga rang gis kyang mgo rnga mi tshang ba dang rab be rib be zhig dran 'dug la/ da ni a khu nor bkras 'di ltar zhib tu bshad rjes/ ngas kyang lhag tu gsal po shes song / nyin de nas bzung / nags tshang tshang gi 'khor ba sbra phab nyin nas mtshams bzhag song / da ni rma sde chu kha ma'i nang du/ nags tshang rgad dang pha 69

miku khya mi 45 — 0 li khyeyo 4la bu tsho zer ba zhig yod pa las/ nags tshang tshang zer ba'i sbra phub mkhan gyi khyim tshang zhig med song / tshe ni mi rtag pa yin zer/ rgyu yang mi rtag pa yin zer/ mi rgyu gnyis ka 'khor sa'i 'khor ba 'di yang lhag tu mi rtag pa zhig red/ lo re zung gi sngon la nags tshang tshang khyim la mi 'dzoms/ sgol rta zog lug gsum gyi g.yang 'khor yod zer ba'i khyim tshang phyug po de/ de ring kha sang rgad dang kher rkyang zhig dang / bu chung da phrug gnyis las ci yang lhag med/ 'jig rten 'khor ba 'di yang dka' mo red/ thog ma bza' che chung kun nam snga langs dgong phyi nyal/ mi rgyug khyi rgyug byas te/ za mi bra 'thung mi bra/ byi ba'i tshang bzhin bsags bsags nas/ tshe gcig la 'dug chas byas/ rjes nas rang gi drin can gyi pha ma/ yang na bza' tshe rogs kha bral 'gro nyin/ sems sdug gi rkyen gyis phyi 'dang ci yang mi rgyag par/ bsags pa spar gang de dgon sde chos phyogs la/ lag che shar re rta 'bul zog 'bul/ mtha' na gzhi 'khor ba gting rdzogs byas te 'bul sbyin btang tshar/ 'on kyang / shi bo'i rgyab kyi gson po tshos/ sngar ltar 'tsho ba rol dgos pas thabs sna tshogs kyis lto gos gnyis ka 'tshol dgos pa red/ sdug dka' las mang tsam ma brgyab na/ yang bskyar za bde 'thung 'dod kyi rgyu zhig sla mo byas nas mi yong kho thag red/ don 'di tsho la bsam blo zhig btang na/ dang po nas rgyu yod tshad dge chos phyogs la sbyin pa mi gtong zer srid pa zhig red/yang drin can gyi pha ma dang / snying nye ba'i bza' tshe rogs tshe las 'das dus/shi bo rnams sha tsha snying rje zhing / bsam rgyu dran rgyu chos las med pas/ yod tshad chos phyogs phul ba red/ dge chos phyogs 'bul ba 'di tshos/shi bo la phan thogs cung re yod na/ rgyu 'bul zog 'bul/ mtha' na 'khor ba yod tshad 'bul dgos kyang / de dus lag chung dang / ser sna spa tsam zhig sems la 'khor rgyu ma red/ rjes nas dka' sdug ci 'dra byung yarje / de la 'gyod pa spu tsam yang yod rgyu ma red/ngas dus rgyun du/ dgos yod dgos med kyi bsam blo mang po zhig 70

5 ma 4 189 yo gtong dgos byung / nga rang 'jig rten 'dir slebs rjes/ de snga 'khor ba'i skyid sdug gi go tshor gsal po med la/ da ni rang nyid lo re bzhin nar son nas/don rkyen mang po zhig gi gnas lugs gsal por ma shes kyang / mig gis mthong yod la/ gnyis na mi rabs rgas gsum gyis bshad pa'i nga rang dang 'brel yod kyi skyid sdug gi skad cha sogs go na/ lo chung chung gi sems nang du yang / bshad mi shes pa'i skyo snang dang sdug snang re dus rgyun 'char ba red/ nga rang gis gsal po shes thub pa ni/ da nas bzung phyin chad kyi 'tsho ba'i skyid sdug tshang ma mis bshad mi dgos par/ rang gis thad kur go tshor myong gsum yod dgos pa red/ skyid na skyid du chug sdug na sdug tu chug da nas bzung dge sdig las dbang gi ri mo ni/ nga rang gi rkang lag gnyis kyis 'bri dgos pa red/da thengs kyi le tshan bshad mtshams 'di nas 'jog rgyu yin la/ khyed rnams kyis sems gtad nas gzigs par thugs rje che zhu/ le tshan rjes ma'i nang du da rung rang sems dga' skyo sdug gsum gyi lo rgyus mang po mu mthud nas zhu rgyu yod pas/ khyed rnams kyi sngar ltar zhib gzigs mdzad par dga' bsu zhu//

le'u gnyis pa/mi che() skyid sdug rgo bo'i ra tshigs//de/desems ngos mi zin pa'i skyid sdugale tshan bcu drug pa/dgon pa'i skor lam nang nas/ tshogs thug dang po blangs pa/a phas a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis khrid nas/ chu kha ma'i dgon par slebs te/ a zhang rgya khor gyi khang pa'i nang du bsdad/ a zhang rgya khor ha cang dga' nas ‘‘'o ya/ da nga la 'dug rogs bu gnyis yod pas/ skyid po red/'dul kho khyod rang da gang du 'gro bsam yang song dang chog gi red/ bu gnyis kur ngas bdag byed chog’ ces bshad pas/ a phas6‘'o ya zhang kho/ da khyod la dka' las gtad song / khyed tshor za rgyu dang 'bud shing re ngas thabs shes byed/ da ni bu gnyis khyod nyar yod pas/ nga rang ru nyul dang yar 'gro mar 'gro re byas na sems bde ba yin ’zer/ nyin bzhi lnga tsam 'gor rjes/ a pha rnga ba'i a zhang tsho 'du tshang la 'gro dgos zer nas bud song / a bu 'ja' pe kha nyin nas a zhang rgya khor dang mnyam du dgon pa'i tshogs la 'gro dgos pas/ khang pa'i nang du dus rgyun nyin dkar nga gcig pu yin/ a bu 'ja' pe dang a zhang rgya khor gnyis nam ma langs gong nas dgon pa'i tshogs la 'gro dgos/ nga rang nyi ma shar dus yar langs nas/ tsha thab nang du me bus te/ ja nyung nyung re bskol 73

leku 35 5 li 73khye lha ca 4thi 3 5 nas 'thung zhing rtsam pa zos/ nyin gung a bu 'ja' pes tshogs thug phor pa gang re khyer yong nas nga la ster/ yang mtshams rer a bu 'ja' pes tshogs nas sha skal dang / mar lo/ rtsam pa bsnos nas khyer yong / a zhang rgya khor gyis kyang tshogs thug dang / sha/ mar lo sogs khyer yong bas/ nga tsho'i nyin rgyun gyi za rgyu la dka' khag ci yang med/ a bu 'ja' pe lo chung yang rig pa rno la/ gshis rgyud 'jam pa/ thabs bkod pa yod/ lhag tu nga la bdag byed dus/ pha ma bzhin lta skyong byed cing / khos grwa tshang 'tshog mi dgos pa'i go skabs btsal nas nged 'brel dang khang rogs kyi grwa pa su yin kyang ‘‘'di byis pa kha thabs can zhig red/ 'di min na pha rgan nam yin yang ru nyul phyin song dus/ byis pa gnyis gcig pus kha sos rgyu ma redaminyasogs zer/ khrid/ khos dus rgyun nga rang la‘‘nga grwa pa tshogs dgos pas nam yin na 'bud shing 'thu rgyu dang /chu len khom yod pa ma red/ las ka 'di khyod kyis snga mo nas shes dgos pa redami zer ba ma tshad/yang dgong mo nub zas bzo dus/ thug pa bskol na gro phye nga la rdzi ru 'jug pa dang / mtshams rer nged gnyis kyis mog mog bzos na khos phye brdal ba dang nga la bzo ru 'jug yang na nga la sha mi 35 5 li 'dzi 3 lu / phan 3 sha gtsab nas thab tu 'phen rogs byas/sha ma tshos gong / a bu 'ja' pe tshogs grol nas slebs/ khong gis de ring mar lo che chung gnyis dang /sha skal chen po zhig dngul sgor gsum bcas khyer yong 'dug a zhang gis ‘‘de ring dngul sgor zhig su tshang gis 'gyed brgyab song ’zhes dris par/a bus ‘‘a lags brag sgom pa tshang gi nye 'brel zhig shi ba red zer/ da rung nyi ma gnyis la 'tshog dgos pa red/ rtsam pa za ci thub 'dug ngas pags khug gang blugs yod/ yang grwa pa bzhi re'i bar na zog re yod pa red/mi’zer/ gang ltar yang grwa pa zhig gis dgon par rang kha rang gso byed thub pas mi tshad/ khyim mi re gnyis kyang gso thub pas/ dgon pa phyug po red zer ba bden 'dug nyin zhig a bu 'ja' pes nga la ‘‘sang nyin nyin phyed nas/ khyod kyis ha yang chung chung 'di khur nas/dgon pa'i ja khang thad kyi skor lam du song dang / der nyin ltar thug pa blug rgyu yod pas/ mtha' ba mang po 'dug khyed byis pa zhig ngo tsha dgos pa ma red/song nas thug pa re slong shog zer/ phyi nyin nyin gung nga rang skor bar 'gro zhor du ja khang rgyab kyi skor lam du slebs pa na/ de na rgan rgon lo lon dang byis pa mang pos ma ṇi bton nas bsdad 'dug nga slebs dus bud med bgres song zhig gis ‘6'di snying rje/ 'dul kho'o zhi lu chung ba yin pa 'dra/ a ma'i ma kho 'dir sdod dang thug pa blug ran ni red/nya zer/ nga rang yang der bsdad nas ma ṇi re zung bgrang zhor du bsgugs nas bsdad/ cung 'gor rjes grwa pa gsum bzhi zhig gis ཿṭāgs thug bsnams sku1nga nas/ bsgugs spusad pa'i mi rnams la blugs nas/ ‘‘ma ṇi thon/ dkor zas dkor chu las sla mo zhu thub kyi ma red/ ma ṇi mang po thon nyazer zhor du/ nga'i mtshams la slebs dus ‘‘'o 'di de ring gsar du yong ba zhig red/’’zer/ de dus gong du brjod pa'i a ma bgres song des ‘6'di nags tshang tshang gi bu chung ba red/’’ces ngo sprod byas/ grwa pa des ‘‘ya snying rje/ des na dme shul tshang gi bu mo mtho ris ma'i bu yin pa red/ ya bu chung khyod 'grul pa gsar ba red/ ngas khyod la sha yod sa nas blug ’ces zer zhor du/ nga'i 76

5 4 skutshe 3 lu snod kyi nang du tshogs thug skyogs chen po do blugs song bas nga'i snod chung drags nas thug pa ma shong bar/ mar khu ser tsa ra ra phyi ru bos song / nga'i snod tsha po yin stabs lag pas 'dzin mi thub par/ der cung tsam bsgug nas 'khyag tu bcug mi tshos rang rang gi thug pa khyer nas phyin song ba dang / thug pa lhag ma ni grwa pa tshos der yod pa'i khyi la blud song / snod cung 'khyags dus ngas kyang thug pa khyer nas nang du song / dgong mo a bu 'ja' pe slebs dus/ dgong zas bzo mi dgos par nged gnyis kyis tshogs thug 'thung / a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘sang nyin 'gro mi dgos/ nyin rgyun blangs na 'thung thub kyi ma red/ nyi ma gnyis re'i mtshams nas song ’zer/ de nas bzung ngas nyin gnyis kyi nang nas thug pa thengs gcig blangs pa yin//le tshan bcu bdun pa/kher rkyang 'tsho ba'i khrod nas/ a zhang rgya khor drin chen/nyin gcig a zhang rgya khor gyis nga khrid nas khong gis 'don pa 'don sa dgon mtha'i khyim tshang zhig tu song / nged gnyis der slebs pa na/ ma sgyed go kha na rmo mo zhig gis ‘6snying rje/ 'di nags tshang tshang gi bu zhig red dam/mi’zer ba/ a zhang gis ‘‘'di 'dul kho'i bu chung ba red/ da lta bu gnyis ka ngas bdag byas nas bsdad yodami ces bshad/ ‘‘'o ya/ de'i pha rgan ru nyul byed par dga' bas/ byis pa gnyis la bdag mi thub pas/ snying rje chung chung 'di 'dra zhig 'di ltar sdod thub pa de/ri zhes bgres song des bshad song / 6‘a zhang gis zhi lu 'di gnyis ha cang yag po yod/ che ba ma zad chung ba 'dis kyang / chu len me 'bud shing 'thu rgyu tshang ma thub kyi yod/ rang kha rang gso thub shag shag gnyis red/minyaces sogs a bu nged gnyis kyi skor skad cha mang po bshad song / dgong mo yong ran dus bgres song des nga'i rum nang du mar lo chen po zhig dang / a 77

3ku: 35 5 yi73 3 lha 4 phari lim zhang nged gnyis la sha skal chen po gnyis/ g.yos rgyu ma sogs sprad song / a zhang gis sha skal gnyis nga'i rgyab tu khur bcug nas/ nged gnyis dgon par song /de dus a bu 'ja' pes ja bskol nas bsgug bsdad 'dug nga'i rgyab kyi sha dang rum gyi mar len dus/ mar lo ni slog pa'i spa gseng la 'byar yod pas/ len ha cang dka' bar gyur 'dug nged gsum rmyos dgong zas za skabs/ a zhang rgya khor gyis ‘‘khyed kyi pha 'dis khyed gnyis la gtan nas phyir bltas shig byed kyi mi 'dug da res slebs song na ngas yum 'don kho la gshe gshe zhig mi gtong na/nya’zer/ nyin kha shas kyi rjes su nga'i a pha slebs song yang khong gnyis kha brda bshad rgyur dga' bas/ stod smad tshang ma'i skor gtam nyog bshad nas/ a zhang gis a pha la gshe gshe zhig sems nas brjed 'duganye 'brel tshos kyang dus rgyun du/ nga yi pha la ‘ khyod ru nyul 'ba' zhig byas nas/ bu gnyis ka yun ring por bskyur bzhag nas sdod thub kyi ma redami’zer/ a phas ‘6nga'i bu gnyis ka chung dus nas rang kha rang gso byed thub ni red/ lo re nas lo re bzhin je dga' ru yin pas sems khral byed dgos pa ma red/mi ces/ dgon nang nas nyin bcu kha rer bsdad rjes/ yang ru nang du phyin song / a bu nged gnyis kyang goms song bas/ a pha song ma song la khyad med/ ngas mtshams rer ‘‘a pha lo lo/ khyod da res mgyogs po shoganya ces brjod par/ a phas ‘‘'o ya/ a pha'i pha kho/ khyod kyis a bu 'ja' pe'i kha la nyon/ go song ngam/ a pha yun ring mi 'gor bar slebs yong /’ zhes brjod nas phyin 'gro/song tshar ba'i rjes su mi 'gor zer yang zla re gnyis re 'gor ba red/ a zhang rgya khor ni dus rgyun nged gnyis kyi mnyam du yod la/ khong gis kyang snying thag pa nas nged gnyis la gces skyong dang / thugs khur mdzad bzhin yod pas/ nga rang yang nye 'brel kun gyi nang nas khong la lhag par dga'/ nyin zhig a zhang gis kho rang la slog pa'i smad g.yog rnying pa zhig yod pa dbral nas/ nga la slog pa dron po zhig bzo dgos zhes nyin gcig gnyis shig la yar la bzos tshar dus 78

ga5 cha nga thunalpi yom yangamar dbral/ ci byas kyang nga'i rgyab la gon rgyu yod pa zhig bzo ma shes/ phyi nyin khong gis ‘‘ci 'dra'i bzo dka' mo zhig red/ ngas bzo shes ma song da khyed kyi pha rgan slebs na bzo rogs byed kyi red/nya ces bskyur dgos thug song /yang nyin zhig gi snga mor/ a zhang rgya khor gyis kho de ring ngag bcad yin zhes kha mi grag pas/ ngas sems la de ring a zhang khong gi ngag shor thabs shig byed dgos bsams nas/ nga kho'i sngon la song ste‘‘ja 'thung e dgosami zhes sogs skad mang po bshad pa dang / thabs ci drag gis dgod kha bslangs/ yang rgyab la song nas a zhang zhes bos kyang ngag ma shor/ cung tsam 'gor rjes khong gi rgyab nas ‘6a na nanya zhes ngu khul byas pa na/ khong gis ‘‘yang ci ma nyan thal zhes ngag shor song / de dus nga bgad pas ngas ngan byas pa shes te/ ‘‘ha bo 'di ci 'dra'i ma rabs shig red/ da nga'i ngag shor tshar song / oṃ badzra sa twa shuḥ rjes nas khyod yod sa zhig nas ngag bcad cig gtan nas mi 'dug sdig nyes yod tshad khyod kyis khur/ ya song nas ja khyer shog nged gnyis ja 'thung /da ngag shor tshar dus ga re byed/mi ces bshad song / de'i phyi nyin zhig la/ mtha' ba nas a ye dkar tho yong nas/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis khong tshang la khrid/a ye dkar thos ‘‘snying rje/ nga'i zhi lu gnyis ka/ da khyed gnyis la ngas bdag byed dgos pa red/ nags tshang tshang dar skabs/ nga khyed tshang gi g.yog mo byas myong ba red/ khyed kyi a pha de nga'i thog la yag po yod/ 'bri mdzo mo tsho yang nga'i sgo thog na bzhag yod pa red/ da khyed gnyis kyi bdag po nga yin pa red/nyanyaces skad cha mang po bshad song / dgong mo a bu 'ja' pe nangs dus snga mor 'tshog dgos pas yar dgon par phyin song / nga ma mngags par der bsdad/ de na a bu zla grags sogs byis pa rtse rogs yod pas/ nga tsho mnyam du nyin lnga drug cig la rtsed mo rtses nas bsdad pa yin/ de ring a ye dkar thos nga la sprad pa'i mar phyur rgyab tu khur nas/ dgon par bskyal/ dgon pa'i skor lam du slebs la nye dus/ grwa phrug re zung gis de rtsed rdo bsgrigs nas rtsed bzhin 'dug la/79

meshu 'thi5 5 li reng 3/yo 4 4'i lim5 a ye dkar tho nged gnyis kyis der cung tsam bltas/ de dus lam 'og nas/ dge rgan lo lon kha spa dkar po ha cang ring po bzhag pa zhig phebs song / khong nga tsho'i 'gram la slerās dus grwa phrug rnams la 'cham po byed zhor du zhim po gnang /nga'i 'gram la slebs dus/ khong gis ‘‘'di mgo ha cang che bas nags tshang tshang gi zhi lu chung ba ma red dam/nya’zhes gsungs song / a ye dkar thos ‘‘red/ ming la nus kho zer ba red/ khyed kyis ga dus shes’ zhes dris song / khong gis ‘‘ngas los shes/ 'di nga'i tsha bo red/mi zer zhor du nga'i mgo la byug zhor du nga la yang zhim po zhig sprad nas/ 66ya zhi lu khyod kyis nga mtshams pa sman grang e shes zer/nga chung dus nas a ne rtam khos a khu sman grang zer ba go myong / da snga rig ma myong yang / da 'di yin rgyu red bsams nas ‘‘a khu sman grang ngas khyod shes/ nga chung dus khyed nged tshang la yong myong zhes brjod par/ a khu sman grang ha cang dga' zhing / nga rang sked pa nas bzung ste yar bkyags nas 6‘'o ya bu rgod po/'dis nga khyed tshang la yong ba dran gyi 'dug zhi lu 'di rang ga ba'i byis pa zhig dang mi 'dra/ 'di nga'i tsha bo ngo ma redanya ces bshad zhor nga tsho mnyam du dgon par song /nyin zhig nga rang sngar ltar dgon pa'i skor lam nas tshogs thug blangs te tshur yong ba'i lam nas/ dgon pa'i chu len rgan po bzod pa zer ba dang thug96) mig ya gcig la skyon yod pas mi tshos lkog nas te1 la bzod pa skyag zhar zer/ khos ‘6ya nus kho/ khyod gang la song ba yinanya zer bar/ ngas ‘‘thug pa len du song ba yin nyazhes bshad/ ‘‘'o nangs dus nas khyod skor lam nang la 'gro mi dgos/ dgon pa'i ja khang nang la shog dang / thug pa ngas blug nged gnyis nye 'brel red/ khyed kyis e shes ’zer bar/ ngas ci yang ma bshad/ phyi nyin nga dgon pa'i ja khang nang du song / a khu bzod pa dang / ja ma rogs pa tshos nga la 'bras thug ha yang ba lu gang blugs rjes/ shing gi ca ne'i nang du'ang gang blugs/ ja ma grwa pa zhig gis ‘‘zhi lu khyed kyis rgyags tshad 'thungs/ ba lu'i 80

ga nga thun 3 lu :nang gi thug pa nang du khyer’nyazer/ nyi ma de nas bzung / nga rang nyin rgyun dgon pa'ija khang nang du song nas thug pa 'thung rjes/ khyim du khyere ba las skor lam du 'gro ma myong / ngas ja khang nang nas thug pa yag po rag pa'i ched du/ nam yin yang ja ma grwa pa rnams la 'bud shing khyer rogs dang / mtshams rer thab chen nang nas thal ba 'pho rogs/ ja ro bsho ba sogs byas pas/ ja ma grwa pa tshos 6‘snying rje/ 'di lo chung chung zhig gis 'di ltar las ka byed thub pa red’’ces/ nga la byams shing / dus rgyun nga'i kha ngo dang lag pa bkru rogs dang /thug pa blug dus sha yod pa blugs shing / mtshams rer mar rdog yang na sha rus btog mang po sprod kyi yod/ nga la las rgyu mang po med kyang / za rgyu 'thung rgyu dang da rung nang du khyer rgyu yod/ a bu 'ja' pe dang a zhang rgya khor gnyis kyang ha cang dga' 'dug/le tshan bco brgyad pa/dgon pa'i chu len chung bas/ bdag med khyi gu gsos pa/nyin zhig ngas dgon pa'i ja ro bshos pa'i nang nas cung zhig khyer nas skam du bcug ste/ ja rke'i nang brdung rjes yar bskyar ja bskol bas ja khu ha cang yag po bud 'dug sa zhang rgya khor gyis 6‘nus kho/ khyod kyis ja yag po 'di 'dra zhig gang nas rag song /mi zer/ ngas ‘‘ja ngo ma ma red/ dgon pa'i ja ro bdung ba yin’ zhes bshad pas/ khong gis ‘‘ja 'di ci 'dra'i zhim po zhig red/ rjes nas ja nyo rgyu ma lon yang 'dis chog gi ’zer/nyin zhig a khu bzod pas snga mo nas/ nged tshang gi rgyal sgo nas ‘6nus kho/ pha bzang bu/ khyod kyis de ring nga la chu len rogs gyis dang /nya zhes bos/nga sgor bud nas khong la rta 'khrid rogs byas nas mnyam du chu len par song /khong gis rta thog tu chu zo chen po gnyis bkal yod la/ ze'u zhig lag tu bzung 81

meku 35 5 ril 3 sa she ga 3 yod/ khong gi rkang pa'i nya gdong la kha sang rta yis 'phra brgyab nas/ de ring 'gro mi thub/ chu mgor slebs dus ngas rta kha bzung / khong gis ze'u yis chu gang re bcus nas rta rgyab kyi zo chen nang du blugs/ zo kha gang rjes ‘‘ya bu rgod khyod kyis ga le byas nas khrid nas song / ja khang nang la slebs dus grwa pa tshos chu blugs tshar rjes rta yang bskyar khrid shog ’zer/ ngas rta khrid nas ja khang du song /grwa pa tshos chu blugs tshar rjes rta nga yi lag tu bzhag ngas rta khrid nas chu kha ru yong / yang chu gang blugs rjes ngas rta khrid nas nged gnyis dgon par song /ja khang du slebs rjes/ khong gis a khu rogs pa tsho la ‘‘de ring zhi lu gces phrug 'di med na/ ngas chu mi lon sems thag red/ a khu grags pa/ khyed kyis de ring thug pa sha mang sa nas blug rogasanya zhes brjod song / a khu grags pas thug pa blug skabs ya dgon pa'i chu len chung ba/ de ring ngas khyod la dga' rtags shig sprad/ zer zhes sha mang po yod pa'i thug pa zhig blugs song / de nas bzung mtshams re ngas kho la chu len rogs byas/ khong gis sngar ltar chu mgo nas bsgugs/ nga yis rta khrid nas chu ja khang du bskyal rjes/ yang rta khrid nas kho yod sar song /nyin zhig la dgon pa'i ja khang gi 'bud shing spangs pa'i gseng na/ khyi gu btsas yod pa'i khyi mo rgya rgya zhig yod pa de ci yin miX skes par shi 'dug sa khu bzod pas khyi mo de'i ro drud nas/ dgon pa'i skor lam 'og gi gad pa'i nang g.yugs/ shul na mig phyes ma thag pa'i khyi gu gnyis lhag 'dug la/ de gnyis kyis ngu tsi byed bzhin sa 'gro rdo 'gro byed kyi 'dug nga'i khyi gu gnyis mthong rjes sems ha cang sdug byung / snying rje 'di gnyis a ma shi song bas nga rang dang 'dra 'dra red bsams te/ mig chu rang dbang med par shor/ ngas khyi gu gnyis la nyal sa gong gong zhig bzos zhing / ‘‘khyod gnyis skrag mi dgos 'di'i nang nyol dang / a ma med na'ang ngas khyed gnyis la bdag byed/ go song ngamanya zhes brjod zhor du rang gi phor pa'i nang du thug pa khyer nas khyi phrug gnyis la blud kyang /82

5 ma nga rdzi 7lha 'thung mi shes pas ngas re re bzhin khas blud/ de ltar nyin lnga drug cig 'gor rjesathug pa phor ba'i nang dus blugs nas khong gnyis kyi sngon du bzhag na/'thung shes kyi 'dug mtshams re thug pa 'thung rjes nga'i phor pa khong gnyis kyis so brgyab nas 'chos pas/ phor pa'i kha pags shad kyi so lta bur gyur 'dug nyin zhig ci yin ma shes par khyi phrug che ba de shi 'dug da nag ril chung ba de lhag yod/ ngas kho gcig pu der 'jog ma bzod par ‘‘ya snying rje/ khyod kyi a bu shi song yang sdug mi dgos/ da nged gnyis 'gro nyazer zhor du/ khyi gu rum la bcug nas nang du khyer/ a bu 'ja' pe yang dga' nas nged gnyis kyis kho la nyal sa khang chung zhig bzos te nang du bzhag kyang / mtshan mo nyal rogs mi byed pas nga'i rum nas nyal ba yin/ khos nga'i kha sna dang ngo sogs la lce ldag byas nas yun ring por nyal du mi 'jug yin na'ang kho la pha ma gnyis ka med pas lhag par du sha tsha zhing / snying rje bas kho ci 'dra skyo zhing / ngas kho la 'theb rde'u zhig rgyag ma myong / kho yang khyi gu gtsang ma zhig yin/ mtshan mo gcin skyag gtong dgos dus ngu tsi byas nas sgo ru thon 'gro/ nga rang gis kyang nyin dkar kho dang skad cha mang po bshad chog la/ rtsed rogs khyi 'dir ha cang dga'/ mtshams rer a bu 'ja' pe tshogs la 'gro mi dgos pa'i skabs nged gnyis kyis khyi gu khrid nas dgon mtha' dang / chu mgo ru rtsed mo rtse ru song ba yin/ nyin re bzhin ngas kho khrid nas dgon pa'i ja khang nas du song nas ngas ja ma la chu len rogs byed dus/ kho rang ja khang gi sgo rtsa'i 'bud shing gseb tu bzhag na/ nga ma slebs pa'i bar du sgug 'dug la/ yar 'gro mar 'gro mi byed/ ja khang nas thug pa blud dus nged gnyis kyis nga'i phor pa'i nang nas mnyam 'thung byas pa yin/ dgong mo ngas zas lhag 'thung lhag re bzung nas sngon du song / ‘‘khyod nga'i rjes su shog ma gtogs mgo 'khor yong /’ zhes brjod pas/ khos sde re re ril zhor du nga'i rjes su rgyugs yong / nyin zhig a bu 'ja' pes nga la khro ril chung chung zhig sprad nas/ khyi gu'i ske la thogs zer/ de nas bzung khyi gu gang du song yang khro lo si 83

3ku 3 li 77(smolu 4 4 0 khya ༷ li si li yod la/ dus rgyun nga gang du song yang kho yang nga'i rjes la 'gro bas/dgon pa'i grwa pa tshang mas khyi gu ngo shes shing / ‘‘'di nus kho'i rnga ma red’’zer/don du'ang khyi gu de nga'i 'dug rogs dang / skad cha bshad rogs/ rtsed rogs ha cang bzang po zhig yin/dgun tshes dus/ dgong mo mun rub skabs/ dgon pa'i grwa pa tsho dgun chos chos ra'i nang du dgong tshogs 'tshogs dgos/ a bu 'ja' pe dgong tshogs la 'gro dgos pas/ nga rang gcig pu khyim du 'dug ma phod pas/ a bu 'ja' pe dang mnyam du dgong tshogs 'tshogs sar song / dgun chos chos ra ni ri ngo na yod la/ mdun du rdo gcal ha cang mthon po zhig yod/ nga rang tshogs ra'i nang du 'gro mi chog pas/ nam yin yang rdo gcal kha ru bsdad de a bu 'ja' pe sgug dgos/ sgug yun ring bas nga nam yin yang gnyid khug gi yod la/ grwa tshang 'ur dir re grol yong dus nga'i gnyid dkrog pa yin/ tshogs grol tshar ba na grwa pa tshos chos rtsod cung tsam re byas nas mtshams bzhag rjes/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis nang du yong ba yin/ dgong mo zla ba yod dus/ a bu 'ja' pes nga la lag sprel byas nas nang du yong ba yin/ zla ba med dus nga rang 'gro mi thub pas/ a bu 'ja' pes nga khur nas nang du yong gi yod/ nang du slebs na khyi gu dga' nas yar mchongs mar mchongs byed cing / rgyugs yong nas nga'i kha ngo la lce ldag byed/ ngas kyang kho pang du bzung nas/ ‘6'o lo lo/ khyod gcig pur skrag e song’ zer zhor du lto blud de rum nas nyal ba yin//le tshan bcu dgu pa/da phrug gnyom chung mgo la/ brnyas bcos thog mar rag song /nam yang brjed rgyu med pa zhig ni/ dgong mo zhig la nga yang chos ra'i rdo bcal thog nas gnyid song ba'i skabs la/ nga'i mgo la chu dro 'jam zhig 84

5 khyi 83 nyi/yom blugs nas nga gnyid dkrogs te mgo yar bkyags nas bltas pa na/ grwa phrug cig gis nga'i mgo la gcin pa btang / da dung khos ‘‘ya zhi tshu/ ja dron po zhig 'thung dang’’zer/ zla ba gsal po yod kyang ngas su yin mi shes shing / da dung rogs pa grwa phrug gnyis 'dug pas/ ‘‘'o da gnyid dkrog thal ’zer zhor khrel dgod byed kyi 'dug de dus a bu 'ja' pe slebs nas gcin pa gtong mkhan grwa chung de la ‘‘shi mgo khrag la skor rgyu nyazhes dmod mo gtong zhor du/ mgo la chab ril gyi yu bas gcig brgyab nas/ rdo gcal steng du bsgyel ba ma zad/ grwa phrug rogs pa gnyis kyi skra la 'thams/ de'i skabs nga'i nye 'brel rtab bu zer ba'i grwa pa cung che ba zhig yod pa des/ nga'i mgo la gcin gtong mkhan grwa phrug de'i rna 'byog nas bzung zhing / ‘‘shul chad rgyu bo/ da khyod kyis gcin rang gis lce ldag gyis ma gtogs/ ngas khyod sa 'di nas gom gang mi gtong nyazer bar ga phrug de ngu zhor du/ nga yi mgo dang slog pa'i thog tu lce ldag byas/ kho'i mgo nas khrag bzhur 'dug de dus dge bskos slebs nas grwa phrug de dang / de'i rogs pa gnyis la 'gram lcag re gzhus nas ‘‘las lam la mi 'a11 rgyu ཿṭā/ byis pa bsam med cig la ngan byas nas ci byed kyi yin/’ zhes zer zhor du/ khong gi gzan gyis nga'i mgo dang gdong 'phyi rogs byas/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis lag sbrel byas nas nang du yong /de'i phyi nyin dgong mo/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘nga da rung nyi ma mang por tshogs la 'gro dgos red/ khyod tshogs rar yong mi dgos/ nang du 'dug mi phod na khyi gu dang khyed kyis rgya ra'i nang du sgug sdod dang / nga mgyogs po slebs yong zer/ de'i dgong mo a zhang rgya khor yong yod pas/ nga la 'dug rogs yod/ ngas a zhang la kha sang grwa phrug gis nga'i mgo la gcin btang ba'i lo rgyus bshad/ khos ‘‘khyod e ngusanyanyazer/ ngas ‘6a bu 'ja' pe rtab bu gnyis kyis khos mgo la rma byas song / da rung kho la kho'i gcin lce ldag byed du bcug song / nga ngus med ces bshad pa na/ ‘6'o bu rgod po ngu mi nyan/ skyes pho rab cig la/ skyid 85

miku sku'e5 5 yi'akhelpi lu khe ga'i i 5 sdug mang po yong rgyu yod pa red/ cung tsam re byung ma byung gis ngu rgyu gang na yod/mi’ces zer/ a zhang rgya khor nyin lnga drug cig la bsdad rjes yang phyin song /dgong mo yang a bu 'ja' pe tshogs la 'gro ran pas/ khyi gu nged gnyis kyis a bu 'ja' pe chos ra'i sgo mtshams su bskyal rjes/ rdo gcal kha ru cung bsdad/ de dus dge bskos yong nas ‘‘nus kho/ da mun rub la nye bas nang du song / yang khyod 'di nas gnyid shor yong / go song ngam/minyazhes brjod pas/ ngas khyi gu bang nas phyir nang du song / nged gnyis khyim du cung bsdad pa na/ khang pa'i nang nag dub be dang 'jam cag ger 'dug pas/ bsdad kyin bsdad kyin sdod mi phod par/ khyi gu bang nas rgya ra'i nang gi shing spangs pa'i thog tu nyal/ nyal thul slog rgan zhig yod pa de gon nas a bu 'ja' ṅge yong bar bsgugs/ yang gnyid song ba red/cung tsam nas a bu 'ja' pes rgyal sgo phyes nas nang du yong / nga yar ma langs gong nas khyi gu rgyugs te a bu 'ja' per 'thams shing rtsed mchongs byed bzhin 'dug 'di ltar dgon pa'i dgong tshogs mtshams ma bzhag bar/khyi gu nged gnyis kyis dgong ltar rgya ra'i nang gi shing sdong thog nas/ a bu 'ja' pe slebs par bsgugs pa yin/ lo ma sar gong a pha yong nas nga khrid de ru nang du song / sngon du nged gnyis a zhang mgur grags dang / a nee ri sgron yod sar song nas nyin bcu lhag bsdad/ de na a bu dge bkra dang / a ce phyug skyid/ a ce thug pa mtsho sogs yod la/ khong tshos nyin rgyun du nga la rtsed rogs byed/ a khu dge bkras nga khrid nas lug rdzi la song / de dus kun gyis nga'i ming la ‘‘nus kho zer/ sngon ma nas a ne rtam kho dang / a ne ri sgron sogs kyis nga la ‘‘a ne'i nus kho ’zer bas/ rjes su nus kho zer ba nga'i ming du thogs song ba red/bla mas btags pa'i ming mgon po bkra shis zhes 'bod mkhan gcig kyang med/nga rang chung dus a mye mtho ris des nam yin yang ‘‘khyod tshos nga'i zhi lu'i ming nas bos/ bla mas ming btags pa de 'bod dgos pa red/ mgon po bkra shis zhes ma bos na/ ming brjed 'gro rgyu red/’ zer yang / kun gyis yid 'jog mi 86

75 ci khutsheskyi/yo byed par/ da rung ‘‘nus kho’9‘‘nus khomi zhes 'bod kyi 'dug da ni bla mas btags pa'i ming de ngo ma brjed song nas 'bod mkhan med/nyin zhig a khu nor bkra dang / a bu mgon grab gnyis bsu bar slebs nas/ khong tshang la 'gro dgos zer/ phyi nyin 'gro khar a nee ri sgron gyis ‘‘da khyed gnyis kyis khyer dgos pa cang e yod/’nyaces brjod par/ a pas ‘‘da kha dro/dgos rgyu gang yang med/mi zer/ ngas ‘‘a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis la mar med/mar cung tsam zhig 'khyer dgos zhes brjod par/ a nes ‘6snying rje/ 'di 'dra chung yang bsam shes pa red/mi zer zhor du nged gnyis la mar dang phyur ba sogs sprad song / a khu nor bkra ni/ a pha'i sring mo'i bza' zla red/ kho la bu mgon grab dang / tshe dpal zer ba gnyis yod/ bu gnyis kyi ma sngon ma nas shi song /de'i rjes nas a ne rtam kho dang mnyam du bsdad pa red/ a pha nged gnyis khong tsho'i ru ba'i nang du slebs pa na/ a bu mgon grab dang / tshe dpal gnyis yod la/ khong gnyis nga la shin tu byams pas/ nyin rgyun du nga la rtse rogs byed/ a ne rtam khos ‘‘nus kho/ da ni dgon nang du ma 'gro/ nged tshang nas 'dug dgos zer’ bar/ ngas ‘‘nga ma song na a bu 'ja' pe la ja skol rogs dang / da rung khyi gu la bdag byed mkhan yod pa ma red/ri ces bshad/ a nes ‘‘khyod kyis ja zhig skol thub bam/mi zhes par/ ngas 6‘thub ni red/ a bu 'ja' pe dang a zhang rgya khor gnyis tshogs la 'gro tshar dus/ ngas khyim nas ja skol ba dang za ma bzo dgos pa red/ da rung chu len rgyu dang 'bud shing 'thu dgos/ri zhes bshad/ khong tsho la de tsam zhig yid ches med pa 'dra/ de dus a khu nor bkras/ ‘‘bden yang srid/ 'di chung dus nas mi shes dgu shes shes mkhan zhig yin/ da bzang lobs tshar ba yin rgyu red/mi ces zer/de nas nyin drug bdun 'gor rjes/ a zhang mgon tshe yong nas a pha nged gnyis dme shul tshang la song / de na a bu rab brtan dang / a bu skyabs kho sogs yod la/ da rung khyim mtshes ru rogs kyi byis pa mang po zhig yod pas/87

leku ma3515 mi33 3 lha snye dari 3ma5 nyin bcu kha zhig la ji ltar song ba'ang ma shes/ rjes nas a zhang mgon tshes a pha nged gnyis la lug bshas nas sha dang mar chur/ da rung thud dang rtsam pa sogs mang po sprad song la/ khong gis a pha dang nged gnyis dgon par bskyal/'o ya/ da nags tshang tshang gi 'khor ba med na'ang / pha bu tshos 'tsho ba skyel dgos/dngos gnas bshad na/ da ni sems khral ci yang mi dgos par 'khyam sdom gyi 'tsho ba yin/ sa gar song 'dir 'dug med la/ 'gro gar bsam/ 'dug gar 'dod kyi 'tsho ba yin/ gon pas rgyab ma 'khyag zas kyis lto ma ltogs na/'dang rgyag ci yang med pa red/ skyid po yin zer rgyu yod kyi ma red/ yar bltas mgo na sbra med cing / tshur bltas khyim na rgyu med/ mar bltas sgo na zog med pas/ da skyid ci zhig yod/ skyid po red ces bshad na mi'i rna bar 'gro rgyu ma red/ yang bsam blo re btang na/ mi skyid rgyu med/ a phas 'khor bar sems khur ci yang byed mi dgos par/ rang 'dod ltar ru nyul du 'gro chog la/ bu gnyis ka dgon pa'i drin gyis za ci 'dod dang / 'thung ci bsam yod cing / lo chung yang rang 'go rang thon byas nas bsdad yod pas/ phyogs gang nas bltas kyang mi skyid rgyu med pa 'dra/ nga rang la dpe bzhag na/ 'di lta bu'i 'tsho ba ni mi skyid rgyu ci yang med/ mtshams rer nga la a ma med bsam nas/ sems sdug dus rtag tu yod pa las/ de ring kha sang che sa nas a pha yod cing / nga'i 'gram du pha ma gnyis kyi go chod pa'i a bu 'ja' pe yod/ da rung nga la nyin re bzhin 'dug rogs dang skad cha bshad rogs/ rtsed rogs byed pa'i khyi gu nag rde yod pas/ mi skyid pa ci yang med/ nyin gcig la'ang nga rang sdug po red bsam ma myong //88
