5 (khyi ༅khyi yo ‘‘khyed gnyis e skrag ces dris par/ a bu nged gnyis kyis ‘‘mi skrag’ ces bshad/ de nas nga tshos chu rab re re bzhin brgal la/ chu tsho bdun du bgos 'dug chu chung ba gsum bzhi nas g.yag g.yeng mi thub la/chu che sa nas g.yag g.yeng 'dug chu'i pha rol gyi thang thog na dbus pa bsdad 'dug nga tshos gur phub tshar rjes/ a phas a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis khrid nas/ rdo a thu bye'u mgo rko ru song / 'bri chu rgyud nas thur du cung song dus/ rdo g.ya' ma sngon po'i de'u le chung ngu zhig yod pa'i mgo na dbus pa mang pos rdo a thu bye'u mgo rko bzhin 'dug nga tshos kyang rdo brgyab nas g.ya' ma brkos/ de'i bar na rdo bye'u chung chung re yod/ a phas ‘6'di ni rdo a thu bye'u mgo redanya zer la/ ngo ma bye'u dang 'dra ste/ mgo mig sgro tshang ma yod/ a phas ‘‘pha yul du slebs nas sbra thog tu bzhag na kha grag gi redami’zer/ ngas rdo bye'u lnga lon song / gnyis a ne la sprad/mos ‘‘ci 'dra'i yag po zhig 'dug da rung re zung zhig rko dgos ’zer bas a pas ‘‘bzhi lnga zhig brkos yod na tshang ma mo la sprod/’ zer/ a nee dga' nas tshang ma ske khug nang du bcug/ dgong mo bsangs khri'i gam nas/ yang sha bgos song /a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis sha skal len du song / de na g.yag gnyis bshas 'dug/rgan po zhig gis sha ster zhor du ‘‘bu gnyis ma ṇi thon/ nga'i g.yag sbrel ma zhig de ring chu nang du bsad song ba red’ zer/ dgong mo nga tshos sha btsos nas khu ba 'thung / nyal dus a phas gur mtha' bkyags nas nyal/ nga rang a ne'i rum du nyal yod/ mtshan phyed cig la me mda'i skad cig grag song / nga gnyid sad dus/ a phas ki 'debs zhor du sgo la rgyugs/ de dus thag nye sa zhig nas me 'da' brgyab song bas/ a pha sa thog tu gnar/ nga'i a pha la me mda' phog song bsam nas ‘‘a phanya zhes bos/ a phas me mda' 'ga' brgyab rjes/ yang yar langs nas rgyugs/ de dus ru rogs mang po slebs shing / klog dkar 'od nas bltas na/ nga tsho'i ru thag nye ba'i mtsho zhig gi nang du mi zhig yar langs 'dugamatsho kha na mi gcig rmas 'dug mi tsho song nas mtsho nang gi mi de bzung / rmas 173

7ku 93la pa lu5 rwas 'i sog8 la lang7 0 ma bskyor nas a phas rma las byas/ skad cha dris dus/ 6‘mi gcig mtsho chu'i nang bsad song la/ da rung rogs pa gnyis yodanya zer/ nga tsho'i rgan po zhig gis ‘‘ha bo rkun ma tshe zad/ nags tshang rgan po'i kha ru lhung song ba red’ zer/ de nas kho gnyis la 'bod dgos zhes ‘‘khu rgyan/ gdugs dkar ’zhes skad btang ba na/ kho'i rogs pa gnyis ru dkyil gyi g.yag rdang nang nas yar langs te yong/khong tsho'i lag nas me mda' rnams blangs rjes 'gro ru bcug khong tshos rogs pa'i ro chu khar blangs te/ rmas ma bskyor nas phyin song / de dus nga'i rkun ma tshos lham nya khra rkyang rkyang gon yod pa mthong song / a phas ‘‘rkun ma nya mtsho shag shul sde ba red zer/ yar khyim du slebs rjes/ a pha'i lag g.yon pa'i dpung sne la mda' brgyab nas sha lpags cung bkog 'dug par/ a nes phying ba cung tsam me ru bsreg rjes rma khar sbyar/ a nes ‘6sdug de khyod mdang nub cung tsam min na bsad 'dug gal srid bsad song na nga tshos ga re byed dgos pa redanya zer nas ngus/ a phas ‘‘drin chen ma/ ngu dgos pa ma red/ nya mtsho'i rkun ma dgra bu rgyud dang 'dra bar rgod po yod pa ma red/ nga rgan po da rung shi ran yod pa ma redanya ces bshad/ de ring ni 'bri chu brgal rjes nyin lnga pa yin/nga tsho brag ri mthon po gnyis bar nas 'gro dgos pas/ snga mo gnam zla ha cang 'khyag g.yag sna dang rta thams cad kyi kha ngo dang / mig mtha' na kha rlangs chags nas 'kheng yod pas/ dgod shor ba zhig red/ nyin gung la slebs dus dbus pa sngon ma tshos ‘‘'gro mtshams gyis nyazer ba'i skad brda slebs song nga tshos bsgug bsdad/ cung cam nas nga tsho sdod sa'i ri'i sum mdo nas/ dred mong khyu zhig yar ri la 'gos 'dug phar bltas na nyi shu lhag yod/ mi thams cad skrag snang chen po skyes song / la las dred than red zer/ la las dred dmag red zer/ dbus pa yod tshad kyis rta g.yag tsho yar mar 'drogs 'dug la/ mi mang gis ki ldir byas/ la las ha yang brdung / la las lcags leb brdung / ci byas kyang dred mong tshos mi go ba lta bu red/ cung tsam 'gor rjes ri shog nas yang 174

5 nga rdzi hri yo dredamos che chung bcu bdun/ bco brgyad cig yar ri ngor 'gos/ da ni nga yang g.yag 'phongs nas cung skrag 'dug skyabs mgon mkhyen/ 'di 'dra dred mong mang po/ sa 'og nas bud pa e yin bsam/ de dus yang dbus pa sngon ma'i g.yag 'drogs nas nga tsho'i 'gram du slebs/ de ring ru skor mang po'i g.yag sna 'drogs nas 'dres yod la/ thams cad kyis de ring chad pa yod rgyu ma red zer/ de'i skabs sngon ma tshos me 'bud nas du ba bdug cing / la las ras hrul lame sbar/ de cung legs pa 'dra/ ras dri bro na dred mong tsho mgo yar bkyags nas g.yas lta g.yon lta byed zhor du gom pa 'ga' re 'bro yi 'dug cung tsam nas khong tshos sa re slog rdo 'dra bkog 'dug pa las mi 'gro bar bsdad/ de dus a pha slebs song / sngon gyi thang thog na dred dmag gis sa bslogs nas gro ma brkos nas dbus pa'i 'gro lam bkag 'dug nga tshos me mda' 'phangs/ki btab/ ci byas kyang 'gro rogs ma byas/ 'bud shing btus te me sbar nas du ba bdug pas gzhi nas yar ri mgor ga ler song / de dus nga tsho'i thad kyi ri mgor 'gos nas da dung rjes ma ri rtsa nas yong gi yod pas/ ci tsam yod pa mi shes/ dred ma la las dred phrug gnyis gsum khrid yod pa dang / yar bltas na ri stod ngos su dred g.yag rag sug sug g.yag chung chung gi tshad lta bu 'dug la/ ngo gdong gi ring thung la gru gang gi mi tshad pa lta bu 'dug rgyang nas mthong na skrag pa zhig red/ ri 'dabs su ma cha bu khrid 'ba' zhig dang / kha phar 'khor na rkub ril zhig yin pas skrag dgos pa zhig ma red/cung tsam nas dbus pa gshar song / sngon du thang leb cig yod pa bslogs nas sa nag log ger bzhag 'dug dred mong 'ga' res/ da rung ri 'dabs su sa slog bzhin 'dug la/'gram nas dbus pa gshar ba la mi blta bas/ nga tsho dred dmag kha nas thar song / nga'i sems su a ho ho/ lha sa ni lam thag ring zhing / chu ni 'di 'dra che/ri ni ha cang mtho/ tsag lhags pa ni 'di 'dra 'khyags/ rkun jag pa ni 'di 'dra mang / lam 'di nas 'khyags myong la/ 'jigs skrag ldan zhing / dka' khag che 175

leku 55la 5 lug rwarngo 'i1mgun 0 langal 0 bas ya mtshar ba'i lam kha zhig red/ lha sar song nas slebs rgyu med pa'i lha sa/da khyod gang zhig na yod ces bsam byung //le tshan bzhi bcu pa/kha ba nyin 'bab mtshan 'bab/ rlung dmar gin g.yug mtshan g.yugade ring snga mor/ yang kha ba 'bab bzhin 'dug la/ dbus pa ni sngar ltar gshar/ lam ni chu thug brag 'gag cig na 'gro dgos la/ gang sa gang la 'dre rdo hre rig chen po mang po yod pas 'gro ha cang dka'/ nyin gung nyag stong zhig brgyab nas/ thang chen po zhig tu slebs/ kha ba 'bab bzhin 'bab bzhin je che red/ de'i thog tu rlung g.yugs pas/ cung tsam 'gor na/ dbus pa sngon ma'i rjes bsub pas 'gro mi shes par/ phan tshun 'bod res byas nas lam btsal dgos/ de dus dbus pa sngon mas thams cad dal mor 'gro/ gcig rjes gcig gis chod pa gyis/ mgo 'khor mi rung zer nas skad btang song / bar zhig la dbus pa sngon ma gshar mtshams bzhag kha ba ni sngar ltar 'bab 'dug rjes ma tsho sgugs nas bsdad/cung tsam 'gor rjes yang gshar song / nga tsho der slebs dus lam 'og tu dpon tshang tshang gi grwa pa 'gas 'don pa 'don bzhin 'dug a pha yang der yod/ ngas ‘ a pha nga tsho slebs yodanya zer nas bos/ a pha nga tsho yod sar yong nas/ ‘‘khyed tsho 'khyag e song’ zer bar/ a bu 'ja' pes 6‘nga tsho mi 'khyag gi’)zer/ ngas ‘‘a pha khyod tshos ci byed kyi yodami’ces dris/ lam 'og tu ‘‘a skyo re zung zhig shi 'dug a khu tshos chos 'don gyi yod pa red/mi’ces zer/phar bltas na lam 'og na grwa pa gnyis dang / rgan po gcig bcas gcig rgyab gcig la khen nas shi 'dug khog smad phal cher gangs 'og tu mnan 'dug nga tshos cung bltas rjes gshar song / a pha yang rjes la slebs yong nas/ nga rang 176

5 (ḍa rdzi nyi/lha kho'irta'i sngon du bzung / de dus a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘a pha/ nus kho g.yag 'phongs la dga' yi red/ bzung bsdad na khyod kyi lag pa 'khyag gi redanyanyazer ba na/ khos ‘‘drag gi redaminyazer/ a nes ‘‘'dul kho/ khyod kyis slog rgan gon gyi min namanya zer la/ khos da rung ‘‘drag gi/ ha cang mi 'khyag gi nyazhes bshad/ a nes ‘‘kha ba 'di babs tshar rgyu med pa ci redami ces bshad/ a phas ‘‘sa 'di ni kha ba nyin 'bab mtshan 'bab zer ba red/nya zer/ dgong mo kha ba babs pa je sdug red/ dbus pa tshos 'jam jag ger gcig rjes gcig gis ded nas gshar 'dug sa pha'i 'gram du skya dmag tsho sngon rjes gnyis la mngags nas ‘‘mi gcig mgo 'khor du ma 'jug mgo 'khor na ki thobs/ yang min na me mda' 'phangs nas brda rgyobs nyazhes bshad/ bar zhig la dbus pa thams cad nyag rtsa zhig na bsdad 'dug de ring nyin gang du zog gis rtswa ma rag mis zas ma zos da ha lam 'dug sar slebs song / dbus pa mi gcig mgo ma 'khor/ 'khyags nas ma shi/ bde mtshams nyi ler 'dzoms song /dgong mo ja 'thung dus/ ngas ‘‘a pha/ de ring a skyo shi ba gang nas red/minyaces dris par/ a phas ‘‘shes kyi ma red/ a skyo gnyis 'khyags nas shi ba chung chung red/ gna' snga mo/ thengs gcig la 'bos pa sde ba lha sar 'gro dus yang sa 'di la slebs dus/ sde ba gang nas yin mi shes pa'i dbus pa mgo 'khor nas 'khyags shi thebs pa/ skyes pho mo lnga bcu'i nang zhig gi ro dang / rta khal nyis brgya lhag cig shi 'dug nga tsho slebs dus ro khyi dang / spyang kis za yi 'dugang tsho dgong mo mgo 'khor nas/ 'gro ma shes par mun rub song / kha ba ni mtshan gang du babs song / de dus ngas lam mi shes/ rgan pa lo lon tshos lam sne ma zin na 'gro mi nyan/ lam nor thebs na mtsho yi dar khung nang du lhung gi red zer/ nal langs dus/ ngas sgang thog nas bltas na/ yar ngos nas rkyang re zung zhig 'gro bzhin 'dug de nas nga tshos rkyang gi rjes ded nas song bas/ nyin gung dus su lam sne zin song / de'i dgong mo nga tsho'i dbus pa'i nang nas/ byis 177

leku 55 5 lu5 rwa rtsi'i 78 ngal ba pa gnyis gsum 'khyags nas tsha ba brgyab nas shi song / cig min na nga tsho dbus pa khyim tshang bzhi bcu'i nang / mgo 'khor nas ro sa mthar g.yugs song ’zhes/nga tsho'i yid la dran yang skrag dgos pa'i gtam rgyud cig bshad song / yang ‘‘a phas de ring kha ba'i nang nas 'go ma 'khor na drag gi red/ da nyag 'di brgyab na sang nyin rlung g.yug gi red/ sa de'i ming la rlung dmar po nyin g.yug mtshan g.yug zer ba red/ mgyogs po nyol/ nangs dus snga mo 'gro dgos pa red’nyazer/de ring / nam ma langs gong lam du phyin/ a pha sngon du lam khrid la song / nyag brgyab tshar dus/ song gin song gin rlung je che red/ sa dmar gyis mig 'byed mi thub/ yin na'ang / de'u 'bur chung chung re'i thad du slebs na rlung cung drag rlung dmar po tsag dang 'dres ma 'di rlung grang mo zhig red/ a nes nga rang a pha'i slog rgan nang btum nas g.yag 'phongs la bsdams/ rlung dmar po bye ma 'dres pas slog pa'i phyi la brgyab kyang / nang nas sha nang la tsad shed rgyugs/cung tsam nas a nes a bu 'ja' pe/ slog rgan nang du btum nas g.yag 'phongs la bsdams/ nga mo'i am phrag nang du bcug nas rta rgan gro lur zhon nas song / nga 'khyags nas 'dar 'dug rlung dmar re g.yug yong dus/rta g.yag thams cad kha phyir 'khor nas 'dug pa las sngon la 'gro mi thub/dbus pa thams cad 'di ltar dka' ngal gyis sngon du gshar 'dug nga tshos kyang rjes ded nas song / bar zhig la sngon gyi de'u khug cig na/ a phas 'brong gi lci ba dang / rkyang gi lud kyis me phong zhig bsgongs nas mi 'ga' dang mnyam du du ba 'then zhor du nga tsho bsgugs 'dug nga tsho der slebs pa na/ a phas ‘‘ngas khyed tsho rlung gis khur song ba min nam bsam song’’zer/ a nes ‘‘cung tsam min na lam chod ma songanya zer/ de nas nga tshos ja bskol nas 'thung / de dus gshar bzhin pa'i dbus pa'i nang gi rgan po zhig gis ‘‘'dul kho/ 'di lta bu'i rlung ngan zhig ci red’ zer/ a phas ‘‘sa 'di ni rlung dmar po nyin g.yug mtshan g.yug zer ba red/ de ring nga tsho sa 'di nas phal cher 'bud thub rgyu ma 178

ga5 (ci khu3 3 lu red/nya zer/ khos ‘‘kha thal bas chod/ gser yum 'don slebs rgyu zhig mi 'duganya zer/ de nas nga tsho yang lam la phyin/ de'u 'bur degle rgyab tu bud ma thag yang rlung dmar po'i khug la btum pa lta bu 'dug dgong mo thang 'di nas 'bud ma thub par/ dbus pa tsho gral bsgrigs pa ltar/ rang rang gi thad nas sdod shog zer ba'i brda slebs song / khyim tshang so sos rang rang thad nas de'u 'bur chung chung re bsnyegs nas bsdad/ nga tsho g.yag nyung bas bye ma'i gad khug cig na/ rtswa cung yod pa der bsdad/ rlung dmar g.yug nas gnam sa tho thug pa lta bu 'dug kyang / gad khug 'dir rlung chen po med pas/ za 'thung tshar rjes/a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘a pha khyod lha sar song ba'i lo rgyus shig shod dang’ zer/ a phas 6‘nga thengs gnyis pa wa skor ma khrid nas lha sar 'gro dus/ khyim tshang bzhi bcu'i nang zhig yod/ bu rgyud dang nya mtsho'i sa cha nas jag par thengs mang po thug ste snga gzhug tu nga tsho'i mi gsum bsad/ mi lnga rmas/ rta bzhi bsad song /nga'i rkang pa'i nya gdong thog me mda' zhig brgyab song / nga tshos jag pa mi bcu gnyis bsad rmas byas pa yin/ rta bcu lhag bsad/ de'i lo yang sa cha 'di yar mar zhig red/ nangs dus nam ma langs gong / nga tsho skya mi bcu lhag sngon du lam khrid nas 'gro dus/ spyang dmag gis rkyang ro za ba dang kha thug brgyab nas/spyang dmag nga tsho'i thog tu rgyugs/ nga tsho me mda' yod pa brgyad yod la/ me mda' med mkhan yang re zung yod/spyang dmag de spyang ki brgya kha zhig yod/sngon la nga tsho'i thog rgyug mkhan spyang ki lnga bcu lhag yod/ nga'i rogs pa gnyis kyi rta la spyang kis so brgyab nas lung sa thog tu lhung 'dug nga tshos rta thog nas babs te rta thams cad dkyil la bzhag mis mtha' bskor nas/ me mda' yod mkhan tshos me mda' brgyab/ med mkhan tshos mgo skor g.yug ngas khong tshor me mda' ma 'phen mgo skor g.yug dgos par bshad kyang / la las da rung me mda' 'phen gyi 'dug de dus spyang ki je mang red/ phal cher brgya kha zhig yod sa red/spyang kis nga tsho bskor nas rgyug 'dug pas mi rta gnyis la so brgyab nas rmas 179

leku 'phyo 0 lu5khe rtsi'i bosku8 0la la ngal 0 song / sngon la rmas yod pa'i rta gnyis/ spyang kis drud nas bsad song / ngas khong tshor da me mda' kha bsgrigs nas spyang ki nag po gsum e sod ltos dang zer zhor du/ nga tshos me mda' 'phangs nas spyang ki nag po gnyis bsad thub song / de dus spyang kis tshod cung bzung / nga tshos rta shi rmas bzhi bskyur nas phyir chu kha'i ngo la song / spyang dmag yang rgyugs nas/ nga tsho'i rogs pa zhig gi phrag mgo nas bzung ste sa la bsgyel/ nga tshos me mda' kha bsgrigs nas brgyab pas spyang ki nag po rjes ma de gsod thub song / de nyin spyang dmag gis nga tsho'i mi gsum rmas song la/ rta bzhi bsad/ gnyis rmas song / spyang ki sum cu lhag cig bsad yod/ lhag par du spyang ki nag po gsum de bsad tshar rjes/ spyang dmag gi ngo lon song / de dus nga tsho'i mda' phal cher rdzogs songanyanyazhes zer bar/ nga cung tsam skrag snang skyes song /de ring dbus pa rlung dmar po nyin g.yug mtshan g.yug nang nas thar te nyin gsum yin/ da ni yang sa skyid sa zhig la slebs/ dbus pa tshugs nyin gsum bzhi brgyab song / a phas nga tsho khrid nas lam ltag ri ngos kyi brag phug ha cang chen po zhig gi nang du song / brag phug nang gi brag ngo na/ sku 'dra min ha cang mang po brkos yod/ a phas 66brag phug 'di dbus pa mang pos shes kyi ma red/’nyazer/ brag phug nang gom pa brgya song yang sku 'dra je mang red/ sku mdun du/ rdo'i kong bu'i nang mar khu dang phyur ba sogs blugs 'dug phar bltas na 'di'i nang du mjal ba yong mkhan mang po yod 'dug nang du yar song na mi mthong bas/ nga tsho phyir sgo ru bud/ a phas ‘‘zhi lu gnyis sa la rtags shig zhog rjes nas yong na mjal chog gi red’ zer/ nga'i sems su byang thang sa stong 'di 'dra zhig ni/ 'di 'dra'i rdo sku mang po rko mkhan su zhig yin/ sa 'di na/ gnas phug 'di 'dra yag po zhig yod pa mtshar po red snyam//180

5 ( ci rdzi 3 yom le tshan zhe gcig pa/brag dmar rgod tshang brgyud nas/ gi ma lha sar spebs song /yang nyi ma ci tsam song ba ma shes/ skabs shig la thang thog cig gi chu kha na dgon pa chung chung zhig yod sar thon/ dbus pa 'di nas nyin gnyis la tshugs brgyab/ a phas ‘‘'di ni nag chu zhabs brtan dgon pa redanya zer/ nged tsho snga mo nas mjal du song / lha khang dang 'du khang kun tu 'jim sku mang tsam bzhengs 'dug ga pa nyis brgya lhag yod zer/ phar bltas na/ dgon pa phyug po zhig red/ 'di ni nga tsho pha yul nas sgor bud de mjal pa'i dgon pa dang po yin/ a phas bla brang dkar yol bcu lhag btsong dgos zer nas khyer yong /dgon pa'i sgo rtsa nas/ a phas dkar yol gnyis sa thog tu bzhag ste/ ‘‘dkar yol re la dngul dkar po gnyis re dgos’ zer bar/ grwa pa mang po yong nas dkar yol thams cad nyos song / ‘‘da rung e yodaminyazer/ dgong mo yang dkar yol nyi shu lhag btsong / dkar yol kha chag yod pa zhig lhag yod pa/ grwa phrug zhig gis 6‘kho la tshong zer bar/ a phas ‘‘da nyo mi dgos/ 'di khyed la sprad pa yin zer/ grwa phrug des lag tu sgor mo gcig yod pa/ der 'phangs te dkar yol khyer nas phyin song / sa cha 'di na dkar yol dkon pa yin nam/ yang min na grwa pa tshor sgor mo mang ba yin/ bla brang nas dngul sgor gcig la dkar yol bdun brgyad re yod la/ 'di nas dkar yol re la dngul sgor gnyis byas na/ lag su mgyogs byas nas nyo ba red/ 'di ni bshad mi shes pa zhig red/phyi nyin nga tsho sngar ltar gshar song / chu chen zhig gi kha ru slebs pa na/ khang pa zhig gi nang na ma ṇi 'khor lo chen po zhig yod la/ a phas 'di ni ‘‘nag chu 'khor chen zer ba de redami zer/ dbus pa yod tshad kyis 'tshang kha brgyab nas 'khor chen bskor 'dug de nas song na dbus pa sna bcos khog la slebs nas/ rta 181

rṣaku155la10 lu5 swārtsi'i gnyi 0la la nga 0 khal mang che ba sa der bcol dgos 'dug nga tshos kyang g.yag rgan lnga dang / rta gcig der bcol/ kha la za rgyu dang rgyab la gon rgyu cung re rta rgan gro lu la bkal nas khrid pa ma gtogs/ ca lag kyang sa der bcol/ dbus pa mang che ba 'dra 'dra red/ nyin gung nga tsho 'dam cog rtse la yi nyag khar slebs shing / de na bsangs ha cang chen po zhig btang 'dug nga tshos kyang bsangs btang / de dus a phas nyag phar rgyab nub byang phyogs kyi rgyang zhig na/ gangs ri mthon po gnam la thug pa zhig yod pa/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis la bstan nas/ ‘6yar ltos dang / gangs ri gan byang gi gnyan chen thang lha red’ zer/ dbus pa mang pos de'i phyogs la phyag 'tshal/ a phas ‘‘da nangs g.yas nas gangs ri mthon po zhig mthong ba de ni/ bsam gtan gangs bzang redanya’zer/ ngas kyang chung dus nas gnyan chen thang lha ni/ bod gangs can spyi yi gzhi bdag btsan po zhig red zer ba go myong / de ring dngos su mjal bas dga' spro skyes song /nga tsho yang lha sa'i phyogs su gshar/ da ni dbus pa mang che ba rkang thang yin/ snga gzhug cang med par/ rang mgo gar thon byas nas 'gro chog skabs shig la yang chu chen po zhig la thugachu kha'i brag ngo zhig nas/chu pha rol la lcags thag 'then nas ko zam zhig 'phangs 'dug zam pa zer rgyu cang med la/ g.yas g.yon gnyis nas lag pa 'tham sa lcags thag gnyis 'then yod/ bar na rgyun bu'i khug lung gi sbrel ba'i thog tu/ rkang pa spo sa'i ka ra ring po zhig kher 'jog byas yod/ mi re res lag pa g.yas g.yon gyis lcags thag la 'tham zhing / ka ra kher rkyang thog gom pa spos nas 'gro dgos pas/ 'gro ha cang dka'/ ko zam 'di'i thog nas 'gro thub na/ shi tshar rjes dmyal ba'i 'phrang nas 'gro mi dgos par thar ba yin zer la/ dbus pa'i nang nas pho sar re gnyis ma gtogs//'gro phod mkhan med/ a phas ‘‘ya khyed gnyis 'gro e phod zeranya bar a ne dang mi mang pos rgan po khyod smyos pa red dam/ byis pa chung chung lhung yonganya zer/a phas ‘‘skyon med/ nga'i bu gnyis las sla po byas te ga nas lhung’’zer/ de nas 182

ga5 ( ba ༅ 3/yo nged gnyis ko zam thog nas song / dbus pa thams cad chur brgal nas song /nged gnyis ko zam thog nas 'gro skabs/ ko zam yor yor byed kyin 'dug la/lag pa ma shor na lhung mi 'gro kho thag red/ gang ltar yang ko zam nas bde blag tu chu'i pha rol tu slebs/cung song na lung pa zhig gi nang gyen du 'gro dgos/ lung pa de'i phu la thon ran khar/ nyin ngo'i brag mtshams na shing dang / shug pa cung re skyes 'dug a phas ‘‘bu gnyis yar ltos dang / brag dmar se le rgod tshang zer ba gan redanya’zer bar/ yar ri ngo la bltas na/ nyin ngos kyi brag ri ha cang mthon po zhig gi dkyil na khang pa chung chung re 'dug pa/ nga tsho ri ngo la 'dzegs nas mjal du song / brag ngo'i khang pa'i nang du grwa pa 'ga' re bzhugs yod la/ sku 'dra mang po mjal rgyu yod/ khang thog nas yar brag ngo la bltas na/ brag gseng na shing skya ring po zhig 'dzer yod/ grwa pa zhig gis ‘6'di ni tshong dpon nor bu bzang po'i phyag mda' redami’zer/ ‘‘da rung lha khang gi ka ba'i ngo la yang mda' ha cang ring po zhig bkal yod/ 'di ni rgod rmas ma zhig gis khur nas 'dir yong ba red/ de nas dgon pa 'di brag ngo rgod tshang 'dir chags pa red ’zer/lha khang brag kha nas mar ri ngo la bltas na/ mgo yom 'khor ba red/ mdang dgong / a phas ‘‘do dgong nyag mtshams na 'dug dgos pa red/ nangs dus nyi ma ma shar gong / nyag kha nas jo bo'i gser gyi rgya phibs mjal dgos pa redami zer bas/ dgong mo dbus pa thams cad sgo la nyag mtshams su bsdad/de ring snga mo nas/ dbus pa'i skyes pho mo dang lo rgan gzhon thams cad/ 'phan po sgo la'i nyag mtshams su yong nas nyi ma shar bar bsgugs/ a phas ‘‘sgo la g.yas kyi ri mgo la nyi ma shar dus/ lha sa'i jo khang thog nyi ma phog yod/ de dus nyag kha nas bud de bltas na/ mi rang rang gi las dbang dang / bsod nams che chung gis jo bo'i gser khebs mjal che chung yod la/ las ngan bsod zad la las mjal thub kyi ma red ’zer/ skabs shig la nyag kha nas grwa pa zhig gis 183

le 55la 0 lu5gleng 'i bog la ngal 0 ‘‘da nyi ma shar song’ zer bar/ der yod dbus pa yod tshad nyag khar gtad nas rgyug nga tsho bar ma yin/ sgo la nyag khar 'byor dus/ lag g.yon phyogs ོkyi thang gzhung chen po zhig na/ du ba dang smug pas btum pa'i dkyil na/ dgon pa'i lha khang gi gser khebs dang / gser tog 'ga' re nyi ma'i 'od phog nas ser lam mer mthong 'dug nga tshos kyang dbus pa thams cad dang 'dra bar/de nas phyag 'tshal zhing / bsangs btang / da ni mi mang dga' nas ki ldir nyil le yod cing / nga rang yang sems su bshad mi shes pa'i spro snang zhig skyes nas/ rang dbang med par mig nas mchi ma bzhur song / a bla ma dkon mchoga.a jo bo yid bzhin nor bu/ da ni ngo ma lha sar thon ni red bsam song / de dus a phas 6‘mjal 'dug pa de jo khang gi gser khebs red/ de ring dud smug che bas po tā la'i gser tog da rung mjal thub kyi mi 'dug zer/cung tsam nas po ta la dang / ra mo che sogs dgon chung mang po'i gser khebs dang / gser tog re re bzhin mjal thub song / sgo la ni ha cang mtho bas mar 'bab sa ni phar dkyog tshur dkyog byas pa'i lam zhig yin la/ 'bab ha cang dka' 'dug ri sked du slebs pa na/ smug pa dngas song pas lha sa'i grong pa yod tshad mthong thub la/ yar chab gtsang po'i chu rgyud kyi bye thang chen po zhig gi dkyil na po tā la dang / lcags po ri gnyis khra btsugs pa bzhin/ thang dkyil na yod la/ grong pa'i mtha' ru chu yis bskor yod/ nga tsho der slebs rjes/ grong pa'i shar ngos chu kha ru sgar brgyab nas bsdad/a/ ngo so bstod/ da lha sar slebs song / da ni ngo ma nyin mtshan kun tu slebs na bsam pa'i dbus nyi ma lha sar slebs song / sprin dkar po thod la bzung / sa nag po 'dom la 'jal nas/ zla lnga drug gi lam thag ring po/ ri brgya la brgal/ chu stong la bud/ dgra rkun jag mang po las thar te/ de ring ngo ma dbus nyi ma lha sar slebs song / dgong mo dpon tshang tshang gis yang dbus pa bsdus nas/ ‘‘nyi ma re rer dgon chen re la mjal nas mnyam du 'gro rgyu 184

5 ( nga rdzi milu yin/ nangs dgong rang rang ci bsam yin/ rgyag res 'dzing mo mi chog jag phar rgyag mi chog rku tshur yong 'gog dgos la/ thab kha rang rang gi khyim srung 'jog dgos/ mjal skor 'gro dus me mda' thams cad dpon tshang tshang la 'jog dgos’nyazhes/ dbus pa'i sgrig lam mang po bshad song / lha sar slebs pa'i dgong mo der a phas nga la dngul dkar po gnyis sprad nas/ ‘‘'di ni lha sa nas 'dug skabs khyod rang gi sgor mo yin/ de ring nas khyod rang gis bdag gyis/ khyod kyis lha la 'bul bsam na'ang / za rgyu nyo bsam na'ang khyod rang la dbang’’zer/ nga ni thengs dang po/ rang la dbang ba'i dngul sgor yod pas ha cang dga' song / ngas sgor mo gcig a ne la bcol/ gcig rang gis bzung /yang a phas a bu nged gnyis khrid nas/ grong mtha'i tshong ra'i nang du song / a pha'i ngo shes shig la thug cing / khos tshong khang nas dngul dang dong tse brje rogs byas song / phar bltas na zho dang dong tse bsres ma lnga bcu lhag cig nga'i lag tu bzhag nas khyod la lhag ma re zung sprad yod zer/ ngas sems su a ho ho/ da ni nga la sgor mo 'di 'dra mang po yod pas/ nangs dus nas lha la 'bul dgos la/ zhim po cung tsam re nyo dgos/ da rung ha yang par bu chung chung zhig nyo dgos la/ byis pa sprang po yod na re gnyis sbyin dgos sogs/ mi dran dgu dran byas/nang la slebs rjes a nes nga la khug ma chung chung zhig bzos nas nga'i ske la btags shing / dong tse dang zho sogs de'i nang du bcug de'i khar a bu 'ja' pes kyang nga la dong tse spar gang sprad song / da ni khug ma gang song / mtshan nga rang nyal dus kyang / khug ma lag tu bzung nas gnyid song //le tshan zhe gnyis pa/jo bo yid bzhin nor bu/ yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam/de ring snga mo nas/ rma sde chu kha ma'i mjal ba yod tshad/ gral bsgrigs nas jo khang rdzokhar slebs/ thams cad kyi mjal dar dang / mchod me kha gsab 185

leku 93la 5 lu5 rwa1 6tshe thog8 la ri 0 kyi mar/ la las da rung ja/ mar/ thud sogs mchod pa bshams rgyu khyer yod/jo khang sgo da rung phyes med/ nga tsho gcig gi gcig la 'thams te gral bsgrigs nas bsdad/ jo khang sgo kha g.yas g.yon na/ khyi sdom dang sprang po ha cang mang/sprang po thams cad gon pa rnying rul/ rkang rjen ma/ kha ngo dang rkang lag nag ༵ ṭwāṃsna rji rnodukṣiṃ ༵sa/ ṭwāṃṭwāṃ ༵ma ༵sa ca /yuṭwāṃ hā kā ṭwāṃ ༵ ༵ ṭwāṃg/ ༵/lta/ ṭwāṃng ldakā snatā trī rdog thog la/ mi khyi gnyis gas su mgyogs bltas nas 'phrog res dang / 'then ṭwāṃ~X ༈ ༵ṭwāṃ na/ ༵ṭwāṃ spya~Xs shārarmi ༵ ༵/ ༵/ dan zlo dzi ṭwāṃs skyo na sna/༷ sna/ /༷ ṭwāṃX / a ho ho/ lha sar 'di 'dra'i khyi dang / sprang po mang ba ci yin bsam ste bsgugs nas bsdad/ jo khang sgophyes song / a phas nga sngon du khrid de/ lha khang re re bzhin mjal zhor du dar kha 'bul ba dang / phyag 'tshal/ gsol 'debs byed pa/ṭwāṃṭwāṃ ༵ ༵ ༵ ༷ kyā~X ṭwāṃṭwāṃrdo ṭwāṃrno ma/ spyaX ༵ zlog ༵ rno ༵ ༵ 'a~Xl ba ༵ ༷ //maṭwāṃsdo ṭwāṃ trī ṭwāṃ/ ༵nghruX ṭwāṃ rnor/ ༵ ༵tyā ṭwāṃṭwāṃ ༵༵'i zlo ra ba~Xṭwāṃ rnyi/ ṭwāṃga~X rshangu ༵ sad kyā~X / de nas lha khang mang po skor ba brgyab nas mjal rjes/ da gzod jo khang nang du slobs/ nga tshos phyag gsum 'tshal rjes/ jo bo rin po che'i g.yas ngo nas mjal/ ngas dong tse gnyis gsum jo bo'i sku mdun du bzhag sa phas nga rang dhiṭwāṃ ༵ ༵sna te hūṃ sngu kyā ༵ ṭwāṃ di ༵ ༵sdiga~Xd/ ṭwāṃ ༵ thaṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ~Xṭwāṃ~X ṭwāṃ~X rdoṭwāṃ ṭwāṃkyā ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ da ༵/ṭwāṃ ༵zlo ṭwāṃngaya/ra ṭwāṃ~X ṭwāṃ trī rdo ༵rsha ༵ trīs zha/la ༵ ṭwāṃ~X ༵ ṭwāṃ~X hāṭwāṃshā le bzhad 'dug pas/ khong gis nga tsho'i skyid sdug dang / gsol ba btab pa thams cad ha go rgyu red/ da ni shi yang sems bde mo yin snyam/ de nas yang 186

(ḍa 43lpi lu jo bo'i g.yon sa nas mjal/ thod pa thug ma thug gis yang rdob rdob cig gis drud song / de nas thog tu song ste/ jo bo ma cig dpal lha sogs lha sku mang por mjal/ rjes nas jo bo ra ma rgya mo la mjal/ de ni lha khang zhig gi lag g.yon gyi gyang rtsa sgo chung zhig gi nang du yod la/ phar bltas na/ ra ma chung chung khu tshur tshad ser po zhig kha phyir 'khor nas bltas bsdad yod pa zhig red/ nga tsho mjal nas sgor bud tshar dus/ a pha sgo la 'bud rgyu med pas/ nga tshos lha khang phyi yi 'khor chung bskor tshar dus/ sgo rtsa nas sgug bsdad/cung tsam nas a phas ngo mdzum gyis gang nas grwa pa zhig dang mnyam du sgo ru bud yong / khos ‘‘nga la dkon gnyer ngo shes zhig gis rogs byas nas shwa bo'i khrag ra zhig dang / dngul sgor phul nas/ khri dar lung zhig blus yod’ zer nas ha cang dga' 'dug sa bu 'ja' pes ‘‘a pha khri dar lung zer ba ci redaminyazer bar/ a phas gos chen ser pos btum yod pa'i/ ril bu bya sgong 'dra ba zhig bstan nas ‘‘'di red/ril bu zhig red/ gnam mthong ma shor na mtshon khog gi redami zer/ pha yul du slebs rjes/ a phas nyin dkar sgos nas/ gnam rig ma rig khyad par med par/ ril bu'i ngo nas cung re bkog ste nye sa dga' yag tshor ster/ de dus ngas khri dar lung zer ba ni ril bu nag po bya de'i sgo nga 'dra ba/ dkyil na dar tshon sna lnga phran bu re btags yod pa zhig mthong / jo khang la mjal tshar rjes/nga tsho grong bar nas byang la cung song nas/ lha sa'i ra mo che jo khang la mjal sa pas ‘‘jo bo rin po che ni rgya bza' kong jos rgya nag nas gdan drangs yong ba red/ ra mo che'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje ni/ bal bzas bal po'i yul nas gdan drangs yong ba redami zer/ rwa mo che'i jo bo mjal dus rang rang dal mo byas nas mjal chog la/ rdob rdob drud mkhan med/ ngas dong tse gnyis blangs nas rdo bo'i mdun du bzhag nga tshos nang la mjal tshar rjes/ jo khang phyi yi 'khor chung skor zhor du sgor bud/ ra mo che mjal tshar rjes/ dbus pa kun gyis sgo rtsa nas za ma zos/ khyi sprang po mang bas sems bde ba zhig 'thung ma bcug de nas thams 187

rāku 55 pa lu5 swārtsi'i mgarna la langs 0 cad pho brang po twa lar mjal du song / mtho zhing brjid nyams ldan pa'i pho brang po ta la ni/ ri mgo zhig la chags yod cing / ri rtsa nas yar bltas na/ mgo ru log yong snang skye 'dug pa zhig red/ lha khang re re mjal tshar dus/ yang skas ha cang gzar mo re'i thog nas 'gro dgos/ zangs gser las grub pa'i sku 'dra dang / gser dngul gyis brdung ba'i sku gdung re re bzhin mjal/ lha khang la la'i nang lham gon mi chog skabs shig la pho brang gi rten gtso bo red zer ba'i jo bo lo ki sha ra zhes pa la mjal/ sgo gnyer grwa pa zhig gis nga rang yar bkyags te/ nga'i mgo sku mdun gyi sgam chung zhig gi nang du/ mgo skog sgra grag pa zhig gtugs rjes/ khos ‘‘jo bo lo ki sha ra zhes gsungs song / ngas sku mdun du dong tse gcig gnyis shig bzhag a phas 6‘kha nyin nas khyod kyis lha mjal dus/ sku gsung thugs rten gtso bo tshor dong tse re gnyis zhog lha sku che chung thams cad la ma 'jog ma gtogs/ dong tse tshang mas nyin gcig la 'dang gi ma red’ zer bar/ de ring lha sku brgya stong mjal yang / ngas jo bo gsum gyi mdun ma gtogs dong tse ma bzhag sku che ba rer mjal dus 'jog bsam kyang / nga la dong tse mang po med pas 'jog ma thub/ pho brang po tā lar mjal tshar dus/ yang nga tshos lcags po ri yi brag ngos kyi dgon par mjal/de dus a phas dbus pa tshor ‘6zla shel nyo dgos na/ de ring 'di nas nyosanya zer bar/ thams cad kyis zla shel dang / brgya rdo sogs ril bu mang po nyos/ de nas lcags po rir skor ba brgyab la/ ri rgyab brag 'phrang nang nas 'gro dgos shing / brag rtsa na chu chen po zhig ljang mer re yod pas 'gro dus skrag sa zhig red/de dus a nes nga rang rgyab tu khur song / ri rgyab tu slebs dus brag ngo ru rdo sku mang po brkos yod pas/ nga tshos mjal zhor phyag 'tshal zhor byas nas song /skabs shig la gling skor lam du slebs song / de nas nga tshos gling skor lam ded nas song la/ skor lam nang du lha khang che chung mang po mjal rgyu yod/ sprang po mang pos lam rgyud na gur thed dang / ras hrul re phub nas bsdad yod/ lam 188

5 ('i1krecelpi yom zurazhig na sprang po gnyis shi yod la/ ngo thog tu ras thed po re bkab nas bzhag yod pas/ rul dri sna lam du khyab 'dug nad shi mug shi ci yin sus kyang mi shes/ yang sngon du song na tshong cung re bshams 'dug nga tsho'i skor ba 'gro zhor du/ tshong ra nyul/ cung tsam nas rgyu ma dron po btsong mkhan zhig la thug a bu 'ja' pes rgyu ma cung nyos nas nged gnyis kyis zos/ dbus pa la las ‘‘za nyan gyi ma red/ khyi yi rgyu ma redaminyazer/ ci yin yang zhim po zhig red/ nged gnyis kyis za bzhin pa'i skabs/ a pha dang / a ne gnyis slebs song ngas ‘‘a pha 'di khyi yi rgyu ma e redami’ces dris par/ 6‘ma red pha kho/ zo dang drag gi redanya zer zhor du/ cung nyos nas a ne khong gnyis kyis kyang zos/ nga tsho yang skor lam du song / rgya ra chen po zhig gi nang du mi 'gas mi gnyis gcer bur phud de/ lcag tshan gyis gzhu bzhin 'dug rgya ra'i gyang rtsa na mi 'ga' re gcer bur ka ra khe lu can re skel bkal rjes/ rgya ra gyang ngo la gtad nas yar langs bcug 'dug de'i nang nas re gnyis sha mdog nag por gyur 'dug la/ phar bltas na gyang ngor yar langs langs khar shi bsdad yod pa lta bu 'dug nga tsho yar cung tsam song ba na/ da rung lcag tshan gyis gzhus pa'i tshag sgra dang / ngu 'bod byed pa go 'dug a phas ‘‘'di sde ba gzhung gis nyes chad gcod bzhin yod pa redami zer/ ngas sems su yang bshad mi shes pa'i skyo snang thengs gcig skyes song / nga tsho yang skor ba byed zhor du song la/ lam nang du zha bo dang /rkang chad lag dum yin pa'i sprang po/ lkugs pa/ long ba mang po yod la/thams cad lam 'gram du bsdad nas slong mo byed pas/ dbus pa tshos za lhag 'thung 'phro dang / mar skogs sbyin zhor du yong / ngas byis pa sprang po re gnyis la/ dong tse re gnyis sbyin/ de dus a nes tsa dkon mchog mkhyen/ 'di ci red/ sprad tshod cig mi 'dug’’zer bar/ a phas ‘‘'dzam bu gling gi zha long lkugs gsum dang / sprang po lha sa na yod pa red/ khyod kyis sprad nas gang yang phan gyi ma red zer/189

leku wal 5 ludzice sa'i bsku8snye la la ngal 0 de dus yang nga tsho'i thad kyi skor lam du/ mi 'ga' re rkang lcags lag lcags brgyab cing / ske la shing leb gru bzhi re bskon nas slong mo byed zhor du 'gro bas/ dbus pa tshos dro kha lhag ma mang po sprad/ ngas a pha 'di ci red zer bar/ a phas ‘‘'di thams cad sde ba gzhung gis nyes chad bcad pa red/ da rung mig 'dru ba/ rkang lag gcod pa/ sgo ske skon pa/ tshe lcags rgyag pa/ pags pa bshu ba dang / mgo srin bal gyis dkris te mar khu blugs nas mchod mer sgron pa/ 'jig rten mi yis mi dran pa/ sde ba gzhung gis dran pas mi tshad byed shes pa redaminyazer/ da ni gson lpags bshu ba dang / mgo mchod mer sgron pa rang gis mthong ma song / de min lha sa'i skor lam du/ ci ngan ci sdugasha tsha bas bltas na sha tsha ba/ yi mug pas bltas na yi mug pa/ ma rig ma mthong ba gcig kyang med pas/ de dus nga'i sems su/ sngar go myong ba'i dmyal khams kyi sdug bsngal la blta dgos na/ lha sa'i grong du 'gro dgos pa red zer ba'i skad cha de yang yang dran byung / yang nga'i sems su bshad mi shes pa'i skyo snang thengs gcig shar song / nga'i sems su/ lha sa dag pa'i zhing 'dir/ dga' ba ci dga' gang skyid/ sdug pa ci ngan gang sdug btsan po btsan che/ ci bsam gang 'dod chog pa/ gnyom chung gzhom chung nas bcar sa gab sa med pa/ phyug po phyug che nas/ khyim nas sha mar rul 'dug la/ sprang po sprang che ste/ lam 'gram nas rtswa ldum za 'dug da ni brgya bshad stong gleng ci byas kyang / dge sems rgyu 'bras ldan pa'i jo bo gcig gi mdun nas/ rang rang mgo la skyid sdug bzang ngan ci yong thams cad/ mi rang gis sngon bsags kyi las re los yin snyam song //190

5 (ḍa ༅ lpi lha le tshan zhe gsum pa/yid bzhin nor gu mjal rjes/ se ra 'bras spungs mjal song /dpon tshang tshang gis ‘‘rma sde chu kha ma'i dbus pas sang nyin nor bu gling kha nas/ rgyal ba rin po che mjal rgyu yin nyazer nas skad btang song / nged tshos skya mda' 'then dus za 'thung byas la/ nor bu gling gar slebs dus/ bar ma'i gras shig red/ sngon ma rnams nam ma langs gong nas slebs pa yin zer/nyi ma shar dus mjal ba yod tshad gral bsgrigs te/ sngon du lha khang chung chung gnyis gsum nang du mjal/ nor gling rgya ra'i nang du shing mang po skyes yod la/bya bye'u 'dra mi 'dra mang po grag 'dug lha khang sgo kha dang / lam 'gram na sku drag re gnyis dang / sgo srung bsdad yod la/cung 'grig ma 'grig la lcang g.yug gis gzhu ci thub byed/cung tsam nas rgyal ba rin po che'i gzim khang gi sgo rtsar slebs song / mi snga ma tshos mjal tshar nas phyir yong gi 'dug bod kyi rgyal ba rnam gsum go myong ba las mjal ma myong / de ring da dngos su mjal ba'i dus bzang re tshes pa los yin/ nga tsho tshang ma mdang nas rgyal ba rin po che la mjal rgyu red zer ba go rjes/ ha cang dga' spro skyes/ rang rang thad nas mjal ba'i gra sgrig mang po byas/ da ni mjal sa ngo mar slebs song / a phas nga'i lag tu dar kha zhig bzhag song la/ ngas kyang rum khug nas dung tse gnyis gsum blangs nas/ dar kha dang mnyam lag tu bzung nas mjal skabs 'bul rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/ sgo rtsar slebs dus grwa pa zhig gis ‘6lham gon mi chogami zer bar nga tshos lham thams cad phud nas sgo 'gram du bzhag skas thog nas yar song ste khang pa gnyis thog nang du slebs/ yang sgo chung zhig gi nang du 'dzul dgos la/ de'i sgo mtshams nas nang la mi re re ma gtogs 'dzul mi chog pas/ nga rang gcig pu sgo chung nang nas yar 'dzul ba na/ rgyal ba rin po che g.yon gyi khri mthon po 191

le4 'phyol 5 lu5 ye nga'i le8 7 laril:0 zhig gi steng na bzhugs yod la/ sku zhal 'dzum mdangs nyil le/ phyag na mjal kha 'jog ched mda' dar zhig bsnams nas/ nga rang la gzigs 'dug nga rang cung skrag 'dug par/ a pha sgomatshams na bkag yod pas/ khos ‘‘yar skumadun la song nyazer 'dug nga rang gis dar kha dang dong tse lag tu bzung nas yar khri rtsar song / rgyal ba rin po ches sngar lhar nga la gzigs nas bzhad 'duganga'i lag gi dong tse zhig sa thog tu lhung song ba yar blangs rjes/ dar kha dang dong tse khri mdun du bzhag ste yar khong gi mdun du song / khri mtho bas ngas mjal mi thub par/ yar bltas na/ khong gi mda' dar phyag g.yon pa'i nang du bzung ste/ ci zhig gsungs zhor du yang bzhad 'dug ci gsung ngas ci yang ma go/ de dus khri mdun nas grwa rgan zhig gis nga yar khong gi mdun du bkyag par/ khong gi nga la mda' dar gyis mjal kha ma gnang bar/ nga'i thod pa'i thog tu 'theb rdas kyis skag sgra grag pa zhig brgyab song la/ khong yang mang tsam bzhad song / cung gzer te mig nas mchi ma bzhur la khad byas song yang sems nas dga' spro ha cang chen po zhig skyes song / grwa rgan gyis nga sa thog tu bzhagayang phar cung 'gro sa na grwa pa zhig gis bum chu blud pa dang / phyag mdud gnang song / a pha dang nged gnyis sgo khar slebs nas lham gon/ a phas ‘ rin po che khong gis khyod la 'theb rdas brgyab pa de bzang ba red/ khong gi phyag dron po'i mjal kha redami zer bas/ nga rang lhag tu dga' song / rgya ra'i nang slebs dus/ mi re la thug pa dkar yol chen po gang re blugs song / thug pa'i nang du phye ril lu ma rkyang gtub yod la/ phye thug 'di'i ming la zan do yas zer 'duga'adi ni rgyal ba rin po ches ched du rma sde chu kha ma'i mjal ba tshor gnang ba red zer la/ dbus pa thams cad kyis thug pa 'thung zhor du ma ṇi mang po 'don 'dug nga tshos kyang thug pa 'thung zhor du ma ṇi bton/ mjal ba la las‘‘rgyal ba yid bzhin nor bu kha dro bkra shis/ thugs rje byin rlabs ma chung )zhes dang /6‘rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yang yang mjal ba'i smon lamanya’zhes/ gsol 192

ma5 ( thi ༅ 3 yo 'debs mang po byed 'duganor bu gling ga mjal tshar rjes nga tshos se ra'i bye thang khra mo nas chu brgal te/ se ra dgon par mjal du song / bye thang khra mo nas yar yong dus/rgyang nas bltas na/ se ra dgon pa ni/ nyin khugs shig na dgon pa'i gser khebs dang gser tog ser gyi ler yod/ dgon nang du slebs pa na mjal ba thams cad sngar ltar gral bsgrigs nas lha khang re re dang / sku 'dra ha cang mang po la mjal/ skabs shig la yang se ra dgon pa'i rten gtso yin zer nas/ sku rta mgo can zhig la mjal la/ a phas ‘‘'di ni se ra'i rta mgrin dmar po redaminyazer/ a phas nga'i mgo rta mgrin sku mdun khri zhabs kyi sgam chung zhig gi nang du bcug nas mjal bcug da rung grwa rgan zhig gis nga'i sna mgo la dud dreg nag po zhig bgos shing ngas kyang sku mdun du dung tse gsum bzhag ngas phar bltas na a bu 'ja' pe'i sna thog tu nag po bgos yod la/ nag po 'di de ring dag nyan pa ma red zer/ da lta yag byas na mjal mkhan byis pa thams cad kyi sna mgor nag po re bgos 'dug de nas nga tsho yang lha khang mang por mjal du song / skabs shig la se ra grwa pa bdun stong bdun brgya 'tshogs chog pa'i tshogs chen 'du khang gi nang du slebs/ 'du khang du de ring grwa pa stong phrag gsum dang / brgyad brgya tsam 'tshogs yod zer/ nga tshos phyag 'tshal zhing 'du khang nang skor ra byed zhor du mjal du song / dbus pa tshos grwa mang 'tshogs yod sar bsngo yig dang / dar kha/ sgor mo mang po bzhag song / 'du khang mjal tshar rjes/ yang lha khang mang tsam mjal nas song / skabs shig la rgya ra chen po zhig gi nang du mjal ba thams cad sgug tu bcug yod/ nga tsho yang der song ste bsgugs nas bsdad/ de dus rgya ra'i dkyil gyi ka ba zhig gi rtsa na spre'u phrug chung chung zhig btags 'dug la/ byis pa tshos rgyang nas sprel phrug la kha gtse bzhin yod/ nga der song nas kho la za rgyu phyur ba cung tsam zhig sbyin par/ khos nga'i slog pa'i phu dung la 'byar nas/ cung tsam zhig bkog song / de dus yang 193

leku 'thu4 7 lu5khe rtsi'i ge la la ngal 0 mjal ba mi re la zan do yas thug pa dkar rgan gang re blug song la/ grwa rgan zhig gis ‘6'di ni se ra dgon pa'i chu kha ma'i mjal ba tshor gnang ba yin ’zer bar/ thams cad kyis 'o kha dro zer zhor du ma ṇi 'don/ de nas mjal ba thams cad se ra dgon pa'i ri 'dabs nas mar song ste/ se ra dur khrod nang du mjal du song / nga tsho dur khrod nang slebs pa na/ se ra dur khrod kyi rdo chen po zhig gi thog tu/ mi gnyis kyi phung po bya gtor byed kyin yod pas/ nga tshos rgyang nas phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'debs pa las/ dur khrod rtsib tu yong mi 'jug phar bltas na bya rgod lnga bcu lhag gis ro 'then res byas nas za bzhin 'dug la/dur khrod kyi ri shog na zos tshar nas bsdad yod pa'i rgod brgya lhag yod 'dugabya gtor tshar dus/ nga tsho mjal ba yod tshad rdo chen po de'i thog tu song nas/phyag 'tshal zhig 'phag ra byas la/ rang gi skra dang / sen mo bkog nas der 'phangs/ dur khrod mjal tshar nas phyir nang la slebs dus mun rub 'dugadering yang / nam ma langs gong nas mjal ba thams cad/ 'bras spangs su mjal du song / nyi ma shar dus dgon par slebs song / lam nas rngo rang rkang rjen yin pas/ rkang ngo la gze ma ra mgo mang po zug song / nga tsam min par lham gon yod mkhan tsho la'ang zug 'dug mi tshos lha sa dag pa'i zhing na/ ma dag gze ma ra mgo zer ba ngo ma bden pa red 'dug ri rtsar slebs dus yar 'bras spangs dgon pa la bltas pa na/ ri ngos la chags yod pas ngo ma 'bras dkar je spangs 'dra/ rig na yid du yong ba'i dgon chen zhig red/lha khang gcig la brnyis na gcig mtho zhing / gser khebs dang gser tog gcig la bltas na gcig yag pa red/ dgon par slebs pa na mjal ba thams cad sngar ltar gral bsgrigs nas/ lha khang dang sku 'dra re re bzhin du mjal/ mi rang rang gis phyag 'tshal/ gsol 'debs byas/ dar kha 'bul ba dang / mchod me kha gsab byed pa/ sku 'dra re re'i mdun du/ sgor mo 'bul ba sogs byed bzhin yod/ da rung 'bag skyare yi rtsib nas sen btog byas te cung re za bzhin 194

5 ya thi ༅ 3 samasnyeyod/ cung tsam nas yang sku 'dra ha cang yag po zhig gi mdun du slebs dus/a phas 'di ni 'bras spangs dgon pa'i rten gyi gtso bo/ rgyal ba byams pa mthong grol red zer/ nga radro gis kyang dung tse gnyis phul/ de nas yang lha khang mang po nang mjal rjes/ da ni 'bras spangs dgon pa'i grwa pa lnga stong lnga brgya 'tshogs chog zer ba'i tshogs chen 'du kharngo nang du slebs song / 'du khang nang du grwa pa ha cang mang po 'tshogs 'dug la/ dkon gnyer gyis ‘‘de ring grwa pa stong tsho bzhi dang sum brgya 'tshogs yodanyanyazer/ nga tshos sngar ltar phyag 'tshal/ mjal ba mang pos bsngo yig bsngo rten sogs bzhag rjes/ yang 'du khang nang skor ba byed zhor du mjal ba yin/ 'bras spangs dgon pa'i lha khang thams cad mjal tshar rjes/ dgon nang nas mar badros te/ dgon pa'i g.yon gyi ri 'dabs na yang dgon pa chung chung zhig yod par mjal du song / dgon chung de'i nang du slebs pa na/ lha khang gi ka gdung dang / gyang ngo thams cad la/ sbral dkar khra ser khra mang po bris 'dug sa phas ‘6'di gnas chung lha khang red dmor/ nga tshos btsan khang nang nas gnas chung gi sku 'dra mjal tshar rjes/ sgor bud de rgya ra'i nang gi bsangs khri'i thog tu mjal ba thams cad kyis bsangs btang 'dug la/ nga tshos kyang bsangs btang / da ni 'bras spangs dgon pa dang / gnas chung grwa tshang mjal tshar bas/ yang mjal ba tharmos cad snga gzhug tu lha sa'i phyogs su yong / ri 'dabs kyi thang thog tu slebs pa na/ mjal ba sngon ma tshos de na dro kha zos nas mjal ba rjes ma bsgugs 'dug nga tshos kyang de nas dro kha za zhor du bsgugs/ cung tsam nas mjal ba rjes ma slebs nas tshang ma mnyam du yong bar/ yang mun rub kha 'dug sar slebs song //195

rwaku 55la 5 lu5 rwartsi'i bosku la lang 0 le tshan zhe bzhi pa/dga' ldan ri bo'i rtse nas/ bsam yas mchod rten dkar po/mdang dgong / dpon tshang tshang gis nangs snga mo/ dga' ldan du 'gro dgos pa'i brda btang song / nga tshos gon pa dang dro kha sogs 'gro chas gra sgrig byas/ de ring nam ma langs gong nas dbus pa tsho mnyam du/ lha sa'i shar phyogs kyi gtsang po'i chu kha brgyud nas/ dga' ldan du 'gro sa'i phyogs su song / nyin gung la slebs skabs/ phu mdo lcags zam zer ba'i zam kha zhig tu slebs/ dbus pa snga ma tshos der ja bskol nas bsdad 'dug nga tsho yang der slebs nas ja bskol nas za ma zos/ cung tsam nas zam pa brgal te chu rgyud nas yar song na/ ri rtsa zhig na dgon pa chung chung zhig yod/ nga tshos kyang dgon pa der mjal/mjal tshar rjes dbus pa thams cad yang chu rgyud nas mar song ste/ lung pa chenapo zhig gi nang 'dzul/ lung pa'i phu la slebs pa na/ khyim tshang bcu lhag can gyi grong pa chung chung zhig yod/ mjal ba thams cad dgong mo grong pa de'i nang du bsdad/ nga rang ni de ring rkang thang 'gro yun ring bas snga mo nas gnyid song /nam ma langs gong nas/ mjal ba sngon ma gshar 'dug nga tshos nam langs rjes/ ja 'thung tshar nas ga ler ri ngos gyen la 'dzegs pa yin/ nga tsho nyag khar slebs dus/ mjal ba mang che ba der slebs 'dug nyag kha nas bud de g.yon du cung song dus/ 'o ya ya/ ri 'di'i rgyab na yang ri zhig yod la/ de'i nyin khugs na/ nyi ma'i 'od nas gser khebs mang po zhig dang / gser tog sogs ser bong nge / bltas na mig gis mi bzod pa'i dgon chen zhig mig sngon du shar 'dug mjal ba mang che bas de nas phyag 'tshal 'dug la/ a phas ‘6dga' ldan dgon pa 'di red/ dga' ldan ri bo'i rtse na chags zer ba redaminyazer/ dgon nang du slebs dus mjal ba thams cad/ sngar ltar gral 196

ga0 (ḍa rdzi nyi po bsgrigs nas lha khang re re bzhin mjal du song / skor gcig lha khang zhig gi nang du/ gser gyi mchod rten ha cang chen po/ thog na g.yu bye ru mang pos phra brgyab yod pa zhig gi mdun du slebs song / a phas ‘‘dga' ldan gser gdung chen mo 'di red/ rje rin po che'i sku gdung redami zer/ ngas der dar kha phul rjes dong tse gsum sku gdung mdun du bzhag de'i 'phros nas dga' ldan sum stong sum brgya shong pa'i tshogs chen 'du khang nang du mjal ba yin/ de ring 'du khang du grwa pa stong tsho gnyis dang / brgyad brgya tsam 'tshogs yod zer/ nga tshos sngar ltar phyag 'tshal/ bsngo yig bsngo rten bzhag nas nang skor byas te mjal ba yin/ sgor bud rjes/ yang mjal ba tsho mnyam du ri mtho sa'i lha khang mang po'i nang du mjal/ skabs shig dga' ldan byang rtse'i bla khag cig gi rgya ra'i nang nas/ mjal ba thams cad la 'bras thug sprad song / chu kha ma'i dbus pa la mgron kha byas pa yin zer/ de nas nga tsho mnyam du dga' ldan ri mgo bskor nas song / dga' ldan skor lam du rdo nag po'i thog tu/ rdo dkar gyis bya/ rta/khyi dang sku 'dra sogs ya mtshar can mang po bris yod/ ri rgyab kyi dur khrod du slebs dus ro bya gtor byed 'dug pas mjal ba mang che ba yong du mi 'jug sa pha song nas/ nga'i ma drin can dang / a mye/ a khu sogs shi bo'i skra sen dang /lam bar spyang kis bsad pa'i bud med kyi skra sogs dur khrod nang du bzhag nga tsho yang ri rgyab shar ngos la slebs pa na/ rje rin po che'i mtshams khang la mjal rgyu yod la/ dgong mo mun rub kha zhig ma gtogs sdod sar slebs ma thub/mjal ba thams cad dga' ldan dgon par/ nyin gsum la bsdad nas mjal skor byas/ dga' ldan dgon pa gzhung dang / bla khag re gnyis kyis nga tsho'i mjal ba rnams la thug pa sogs za 'thung mang po sprad song / rma sde chu kha ma 'di/sde ba kha zhe mthun po mgo rna can/ sa gang du slebs kyang dpon po rnam pa'i drin gyis sde ba ngo chen dang grags chen zhig red/ da ni dga' ldan dgon pa mjal tshar song / de ring skya rengs shar dus mjal ba lam du chas/ dga' ldan nas 197

leshu 44 5 lugagle ngasasnye ta : la la ngal 0:tshur nyag brgyab ste/ kha nyin 'dug sa'i lung pa de'i phu chen ri rtse nas lho ngos nas nyag stong chen po zhig yod pa nas bud/ nyag khar slebs pa na bye ma'i ri zhig red/ thur du gom pa spos nas 'gro mi thub la/ bye ma'i nang nas nud de mar ri 'dabs su 'bab dgos/ mjal ba mang pos rang gi lag rten la rta zhon zhon byas te/ bye ma'i ri ngos nas mar babs/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis dang /byis pa mang po gcer bur bye ma'i nang nas mar nud zhor dang ril zhor byas na ha cang spro ba zhig red/ ri sked du slebs pa na shing nags mang po skye yod la/brag ngo ru sgrub phug dang mtshams khang mang po mjal rgyu yod cing / brag phug re gnyis nang du grwa pa 'ga' re mtshams la bzhugs 'dug dgong mo mun rub kha mjal pa tsho ri rtsar bsdad/da nangs mjal pa tsho lung khog gi chu rgyud ded nas/ mar mdo la yong dgos/ rgyang nas bltas na/ thang gzhung na yar klung gtsang po mthong gi 'duganyin gung lung mda' la slebs dus/ nags shing mang po skyes yod pa'i thang thog tu/ lha khang chen po zhig gi gser khebs mjal 'dug la/ mjal ba thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal/ a phas ‘‘gser khebs mthong 'dug pa de/ bsam yas bakhu1ga lag khang red/ bsam yas bye ma'i dkyil na chags zer banya red zer/ cung ma 'gor ba'i rjes bsam yas dgon par slebs song / dgon pa chen po zhig ma red kyang / ra skor gor gor zhig gis bskor nas/ mchod rten dkar po chung chung mang po zhig bzhag 'dug nga tsho sgo chen du 'dzul te sngon du gtsug lag khang nang du mjal/ de nas lha khang che chung kun la mjal/ yang a phas mjal ba tsho khrid nas bsam yas mchod rten dkar po dang / bsam yas bya de dkar po sogs la mjal/ bya de dkar po zer ba'i grags che ba de ni/ gyang ngos su bya de dkar po zhig bris yod pa de yin zer/ rgya ra'i nang gi lha khang rnams mjal tshar rjes/ nga tsho bsam yas has po ri la song / bsam yas ngo ma bye ma'i nang du chags 'dug gom gang song na bye ma dkar po 'ba' zhig red/ has 198

5 /ḍa po 3 yom po ri ni mthon po zhig ma red/ ri mgo na u rgyan rin po che'i sgrub phug dang bsangs khri yod/ nga tshos kyang de la mjal zhing bsangs btang / de nas nga tsho bsam yas dur khrod nang du mjal du song / dur khrod ni ri rtsa'i bye khug cig na yod la/ dur khrod nang du gri dang sta re mang po bzhag 'dug mjal ba tshos kyang gri dang sta re mang po bzhag song / a phas ‘‘lho 'dzam bu gling gi mi thams cad/ shi tshar dus gzugs med kyi phung po/ dur khrod 'di nas gtsab dgos pa red/ dgong re shi bo khri stong mang po gtsab bzhin yod pa red/ nga tshos de ring bzhag pa'i gri star tsho ni/ nangs dus bltas na kha log tshar rgyu red/ de ni do dgong yang shi bo khri stong gi phung po gtsab spyad byed kyi redaminyaces go thos mang po bshad song / phyi nyin mjal ba mang po/ rang rang gis bzhag pa'i gri star la blta ru song la/ mi mang po zhig gi rang gi gri star ngo ma kha log 'dug zer/ yang mjal ba mang po'i rang gson po yin dus/ dur khrod 'di'i nang mjal thub na/ shi tshar dus rnam shes 'di na 'khyams dgos pa ma red ces sogs mang po bshad song /bsam yas mjal tshar dus/ gtsang po brgyud nas gyen la bye thang zhig nas nyin mang por song zhing / skabs shig gru shing rta mgo'i thog nas gtsang po la brgal te/ mu mthud nas bye ma'i nang nas 'gro dgos/ mjal ba thams cad mang che ba rkang thang yin pas/ 'gro ha cang dka' 'dug a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis bye ma'i sgang brgyud ded nas song na/ 'gro cung bde la/ ngo ma 'gro re med dus/ a nes nged gnyis la/ chu 'khyags nang rtsam pa re brdzis te byin pas yang bskyar song ba yin/ nyi ma bcu lhag la song la/ nyin gung zhig la gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i dgon 'dabs su slebs song / dgon pa ni brag ri mthon po zhig gi nyin khugs na/ kha lho phyogs su 'khor nas chags yod la/ lha khang mang zhing / gser khebs gser tog mang bas/ mig gis mthong ba na sems nas dad pa skye yong ba'i dgon pa ya mtshan zhig red/ dgon nang du slebs pa 199

7ku khrul 5 lu5ye po'i 78 la lang 0 na/ sngon ma nga tsho gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i rten gtso bo/ rgyal ba byams mgon gyi sku/ khang brtsegs gsum gyi mtho tshad can zhig yod pa de la mjal/ mjal ba kun gyis sngar ltar phyag 'tshal/ dar kha bzhag mchod me kha gsab byas/ ngas kyang dar kha phul rjes yang dong tse gsum sku mdun du bzhag de nas sgor bud rjes/ yang lha khang mang po la mjal/ de'i nyin gtsang gi bkra shis lhun po'i tshogs chen 'du khang du/ grwa pa stong gnyis dang sum brgya tsam 'tshogs yod cing / yon bdag ni chu kha ma yin zer/ ma gzhi chu kha ma'i dbus pas jo khang / se ra/ 'bras spangs/ dga' ldan sogs dgon par mjal dus/ yon bdag byas te tshogs zlotshogs yod la/ dgon pa gzhung gis kyang nga tsho la mgron kha byas song / nga tshos sngar ltar grwa tshang tshogs sa nas phyag 'tshal/ bsngo rten/ bsngo yig sogs bzhag yang grwa tshang la nang skor byas nas mjal ba yin/ dgon pa mjal tshar rjes/ rgya ra chen po zhig gi nang nas/ bla ma zhig gis mjal ba thams cad la/tshe dbang bskur zhing khrus byas/ yang bla khag de'i dgon pa gzhung gis chu kha ma'i dbus pa la mgron kha byas pa yin zer te/ nas chag gi khu ba zhig blugs song /gtsang nas nyi ma bzhi lnga tsam bsdad rjes/ phyir lha sa'i phyogs su yong zhing / lam zhig nas rgyang rtse zer ba'i ri rtsa zhig na/ mchod rten ha cang chen po zhig la mjal/a phas ‘‘'di ni rgyal rtse'i dpal 'khor mchod rten zer ba redami zer/ de'i phyi nyin/ ri nyag ha cang mthon po zhig brgyab nas/ mu mthud du lha sa ru yong / nyi ma ci tsam la yong ba ma shes par dgong mo mun rub kha zhig la lha sar slebs song //le tshan zhe lja pa/lha sa'i grong nas lo sar/ btson pa zhig gi srog skyabs/lha sa ru slebs pa na/ mjal ba tsho rang mgo gang thon byas nas mjal skor dang tshong rar song / nga tsho yang bar skor tshong ra'i nang du song / tshong khrom 200

5 ba ༅ nyi po nang dusha rgyu ma/ mar phyur/ ja/ zho 'o ma/ bu ram rta rmig ma/ rtsam pa sogs btsongargyuyod/ lo sar skabs yin pas lha khang thams cad kyi nang du/ mjal ba ha cang mang pos 'tshang kha rgyag la/ sku drag dang rdob rdob tshos mjal ba tshor lag cizin gyis gcar rdung byas/ nyin zhig la jo khang nang nas rdob rdob cig gis/ nga tsho'i rogs pa mjal ba rgan po zhig gi mgo la/ rgyal sgo'i lde mig gis brgyab ste/ mgo nas khrag bzhur/ de dus rgan po'i bus/ rdob rdob de'i mgo lalcags 'khor gyis brgyab nas bsgyel/ yang rdob rdob dang grwa pa 'ga' yis rgan po'i bu la gcar dung byas/ de dus khong tshang gi mag pa dang rogs pa mjal ba thams cad kyis grwa pa dang / rdob rdob thams cad kyi mgo dang lus la gri/ mgo skor sogs lag la ci yod kyis brgyab nas grwa pa re zung rmas yod la/ rdob rdob gnyis gsum sa thog tu bsgyel 'dug rgyang na grwa pa mang po yod kyang / ‘6a mdo jag pa redami zer nas 'bod pa las/ rgyug mkhan med/ de dus dpon tshang tshang gi mi slebs nas 'dzing ma bcug par rang rang sar phyin song / de'i rjes nas nyi ma 'ga' la nga tsho'i mjal ba jo khang nang du 'gro ru mi bcug do dgong ni lha sa'i lo sar yin/ mun rub tshar dus/ khyim tshang so sos me rdza bkad zer nas/ sa rdza re'i nang na 'gad rdzas ci yod mi shes/ bkad tshar na rten 'brel yin zer/ nyin gung nga tsho ra mo che'i lha khang sgo nas tshur yong dus/ lha sa'i sku drag 'ga' res rta zhon nas yong gi 'dug la/ mi thams cad kyis lam 'gram nas lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar nas mgo sgur/ lce bsnar nas 'dug rta ba'i 'phro na da rung mi gnyis gsum gyis mi yi ske thog nas zhon te/ rta pa tsho dang mnyam du 'gro 'dug 'di ni ngas thengs dang po mi yis mi zhon nas 'gro ba mthong ba yin/ de'i dus lha sa'i jo khang nang 'tshogs yod pa'i grwa pa rnams 'tshogs grol song / grwa pa tshos rang rang gi grwa phor dang / pag khug lag mgor bkyag nas 'tshang kha rgyag zhor du/ rgya srang / grong bar/ thang thog kun tu grwa pas gang nas 'gro sa med/ ngo so bstod/ chos sa chos yul zer ba los 201

leku 93 5 lu56rtsi'i bocarna thil goril 0 yin/ ci 'dra 'dra'i grwa pa mang po zhig 'dug 'di na se 'bras dge gsum gyi grwa pa thams cad yod zer la/ ngas thengs dang po 'di 'dra'i grwa pa mang po zhiga'atshogs yod pa mthong ba yin/ mjal ba tsho ha las dgos pa zhig red/ dgong mo dbus pa thams cad mnyam du jo khang mjal bar song la/ nangs dus nas phyir rang yul la 'gro rgyu yin zhes/ dpon tshang tshang gis skad btang song / munarub kha zhig la/ a phas me mda' zhig dang mda' brgya lhag nyos nas slebs song/khos ‘‘'di ni rgya gar mo tsa zer ba de redanya zer/ thams cad kyis ltad mo bltas/me mda' de la sha ra brgyad lag cig sprad pa yin zhes bshad/de ring ni pha yul phyogs su 'gro ran pa yin pas/ snga mo nas dbus pa thams cad/ grwa bzhi lha mo yod sar song nas bsangs btang tshar nas/ lha sa'i gtsang po'i tshu rol rgya sgar thad nas yong dus/ rgya sgar sgo chen thog lgang bu dmar po chen po mang po btags 'dug la las rgya nag gi lo sar red zer/ nga tshos skor lam ded nas 'dug sar slebs la nye dus/ lam nang du nga tsho'i dbus pa mang pos skor ra byas te ki dir byed cing / mi thams cad kyis lag tu gri dang me mda' bzung 'dug nga tsho 'gram du song nas bltas pa na/ mi mang gi dkyil na bod dmag me mda' khur mkhan bcu lhag gis/ pho gsar lo chung zhig bzung nas lcags brgyab ste khrid 'dug nga tsho'i rogs pa tsho dang bod dmag tsho 'dzing grabs byas/ nga tsho'i mi zhig gis ‘‘khyed tshos de ring mi 'di ma mngags na/ gom gang 'gro mi bcug kho thag yin zer/ yang gcig gis ‘‘mi 'di de ring nga tshos srog bskyabs nas/ pha yul la khrid nas 'gro rgyu sogs zer la/ bod dmag mgo ba des ‘‘a mdo rgod po yin na/ mi nyes chen gsod dgos rgyu 'di 'phrog dang / srog bskyabs zer ba'i dpe yod ma red/ khyod tshos ha go song ngam/ khyod tsho 'dra zhig gis sde ba gzhung gi btson pa 'phrog thub kyi ma red/ sde pa gzhung dmag gis khyed tsho rtsa gtor gtong gi redami’ces/ rna bar mi 'gro ba'i skad cha mang po bshad/ de dus chu kha ma'i skya dmag brgya lhag der slebs 'dug la/ mi 202

gas ('i sredelpi po mang gis ki dir byas nas/ btson pa de phyir 'phrogs pas mi tshad/ bod dmag 'ga'i lag gi me mda' yang 'phrogs/ de'i skabs nga tsho'i dbus pa snga ma lam la chas nas gshar 'dug la/ mi mang gis btson pa de dpon tshang tshang la bskyal zhing / bod dmag bcu lhag yod pa bzung ste/ thag sbrel byas nas dbus pa dang mnyam du khrid/ nyin gung dbus pas tshugs brgyab nas ja 'thung / de dus dpon tshang tshang gis bod dmag rnams la ja blugs/ ma tshad kho tsho'i mgo ba de la dar kha zhig dang / dngul sgor sum cu sprad cing / khong tshos me mda' thams cad phyir sprad nas nang du 'gro ru bcug 'gro dus dpon tshang tshang gis ci bshad ma go bar/ bod pa des ‘‘mgo sgur zhor du lags so/ lags lags so’rimang po zer zhor du me mda' stong pa tsho khur/ rogs pa tsho khrid nas phyir rang khyim du phyin song / de nas bzung / nga tsho dbus pa'i dmag mang che ba nyin gnyis gsum la/ dbus pa'i rjes nas yong zhing / sde pa gzhung gi dmag yong bar dogs gzab byas/ nyin bzhi lnga 'gor song la/ dbus pa sna bcol khog la slebs nas/ nyin gnyis gsum la phyir 'gro ba'i gra sgrig byas/ 'on kyang sde ba gzhung gi dmag ma dgos skad cig go rgyu med pas/ btson pa de dpon tshang tshang gis pha yul la khrid song / rjes nas gar yod ngas go ma myong / dbus pa rang yul phyogs su 'gro dus ha cang mgyogs/ rta g.yag sogs 'ded mi dgos par/rang yul dran pa red zer ba ltar 'gro ba ha cang mgyogs/ mi thams cad de 'dra red/ 'gro dus mgyogs shing sems su spro snang chen po yod 'dug a phas lam nas skya dmag tsho dang mnyam du/ rgo ba dang / gtsod 'ga' re bsad nas dro sha byas song / nyin zhig nga tsho nyag kha zhig la slebs dus/ ri ngos na marga'i ra gor gor can gyi ri dgas ha cang mang po zhig yod la/ a phas ‘‘ra gor gor chen po can de gnyan g.yag red/ ra leb leb can rnams gnyan mo red/ ngas kyang de ring ma gtogs gnyan 'di 'dra mang po rig ma myong zer/ phar bltas na gnyan khyu 'di la/ sum brgya bzhi brgya yod kho thag red/ de'i sngon nas/ gnyan 203

le4 lus10 lu5glengathi nya la1lang7 0 red zer ba'i mgo chen po can re rgyang nas rig myong la/ de ring ni thag nye sa nas ngo ma ci 'dra zhig yod pa zhib tu rig song / ri dgas chen po dang yag po zhig red/dgong mo 'dug sar slebs dus/ a ne nged tshos a phas lha sa nas nyos yong ba'i phye brdzis te/ gtsod sha 'thag nas mog mog bzo rgyu'i gra sgrig byas kyang/phye 'di 'thor song nas leb leb byas te mog mog bzo thabs med/ cung tsam nas a pha slebs te/ ‘‘'di gro phye ma yin par/ sran ma 'thag bzhag pa red 'dug/da thug pa skol 'joganya zer nas/ nga tshos sran phye yi thug pa bskol nas 'thung ba yin/ mtshan phyed cig la dbus pa'i stod phyogs nas/ ki dir byed cing /me mda' re 'phangs song ba dang khyi yang zug bzhin 'dug sa phas me mda' khur nas sgo khar rgyugs/ a nes ‘‘khyed kyis de 'dra ma byed/ ci yin gang shes zer la/ a phas cig byas na sde ba gzhung gi dmag yin rgyu red zer/ de dus a zhang mgon tshe sogs dmag bcu lhag slebs song / a phas ‘‘sdeb gzhung gi dmag yin na/ da ma 'dzings/ nga tsho 'di phyogs kyi dmag gis/ rtsib kyi de'u 'bur mgo'i sa 'di 'dzin rgyu yin ’zhes/ dmag khrid de de'u 'bur gyi thog la bud/ de dus skya dmag bzhi bcu tsam slebs 'dug stod phyogs nas da rung me mda' 'ga' re 'phangs song / de dus rgan po zhig gis ‘‘'dul kho/ gong du rogs byed par 'gro dgos pa min namanyanyazer bar/ a phas ‘6me mda'i skad la nyan na dgra mang po med pa 'dra/ gong du dmag mang bas skyon med/ nam ma langs bar 'di nas sa 'dzin rgyu yin zer/ skya mda' 'then dus stod nas da rung me mda' 'phen bzhin 'dug de dus a phas dmag khrid nas rgyugs song / cung ma mgor bar me mda'i skad mang po grag song zhing / chu pha ri nas rta ba bcu lhag ri mgor 'bro bzhin 'dug la/ yang me mda' mang po 'phangs song bas/ pha ri nas rta ba gnyis gsum 'gyel song / de dus yang pha ri nas rta ba bdun brgyad/chu 'gram ded nas bros kyang / me mda' 'phangs nas/ yang 204

zhag5 kyo 4 ༅ hri pog mirta gnyis gsum 'gyel ba mthong song / mi re yar langs nas bros 'dug la/rtabasad pa red/ nyi ma shar dus/ nga tsho'i dmag phyir slebs yong / mi gnyis cungarmas 'dug sa pha'i rta yi drug thog la mda' shad cig byas yod la/ nyi ma mang por khrag bzhur song yang 'gro gnod cang mi 'dug a phas ‘‘sde ba gzhung gi dmag ma red/ nya mtsho'i jag pa red/ da nangs dpon tshang gi ru skor dang 'dzing 'dug nga tshos jag pa'i rgyab nas me mda' brgyab nas/ jag pa'i sa shor song / dpon tshang gi ru ba'i mi gnyis rmas shing / rta g.yag bzhi bsad 'dugajag pa mi gsum bsad yod/ gnyis rmas/ bu chung gnyis bzung yod/ rta lnga drug shi rmas byas yod/ mang che ba da nangs nga tsho slebs tshar rjes shi rmas byas pa red nyasogs/ jag rkun dang 'dzing pa'i skad cha mang po bshad song / lha sa nas phyir nang du slebs yong tshe/ jag rkun rgyugs pa 'di yin/ de min bde mtshams byas nas slebs yod la/ jag rkun gcig la'ang thug ma song //da thengs kyi le tshan bshad mtshams 'di nas 'jog rgyu yin la/ khyed rnams kyis sems gtad nas gzigs par thugs rje che zhu/ le tshan rjes ma'i nang du/ da rung rang sems dga' skyo sdug gsum gyi lo rgyus mang po mu mthud nas zhu rgyu yod pas/ khyed rnams kyis sngar ltar zhib gzigs mdzad par dga' bsu zhu// //205

le'u bzhi pa/pha yul du slebs pa'i snga rjes/mi shes med la thug na snying rje med/le tshan zhe drug pa/rang sa rang yul slebs rjes/ lcag tshan stong dang lnga brgya/dbus pa mgo log gi smad cig la slebs dus/ ru tsho gnyis chags song / zer rgyu ni lam gong 'og gnyis yod/ la las gong nas 'gro dgos zer/la las 'og nas 'gro dgos zer/ dpon tshang tshang gis rang rang gang nas song yang chog zer bas/ dbus pa tsho gnyis chags song ba red/ nga tsho'i phyogs su khyim tshang sum cu lhag yod/ nyi ma bcu tsam mgor rjes/ nyin zhig a phas nga rang rta 'phongs la bzhag ste/ lam nas rgo ba re bsad/ dgong mo 'dug sar slebs dus/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘a pha/ a ne sang nyin mo'i nang la 'gro dgos nyazer/ nga rang sems ha cang sdug song / lo gcig tsam gyi ring la/ dka' sdug ci 'dra myangs kyang a ne drin chen mas/ a bu nged gnyis la ma bzhin du 207

leku 0ci 7 0 tsolagu/295/i 2res gces skyong byas/ ngas chung dus nas a ma zer ba ci 'dra yin pa mi shes/ na ning a ne nged tshang slebs pa nas nga la a ma yod pa dang 'dra ba yin/ da ni glo bur kha khar 'gro dgos dus/ sems nas bshad mi shes pa'i sdug snang zhig skye nas/ mig chu rang dbang med par bzhur song / ngas 6‘a pha/ a ne gang du 'gro dgos pa redami’ces dris par/ a phas ‘‘sang nyin a ne mo rang gi yul gyi 'brog sde gong mar thug na/ a ne mo rang khyim la 'gro dgos pa redanyanyazer/ ngas ‘‘a ma ne ne/ khyod ma song bar nged tshang du bsdad bzhag na mi chog gamanya’zer bar/ a nes nga rang pang du bzung ste/ mig nas mchi ma bzhur zhor du/ ‘‘nus kho/ gces phrug sa nes pha ma gnyis bdag byed dgos pa red/ a ne rjes nas khyed gnyis la blta ru slebs yongari zhes/ dgong mo der sems mi bde ba'i skad cha mang po bshad/ a phas a ne la ske rags dmar po zhig ras gos bzo spyad cig dang / zhim po sogs lha sa nas nyos pa'i ca lag sna kha 'ga' re sprad/ dgong mo sngar ltar a nes nga rang rum nas nyal la/ mos ‘‘nus kho gces phrug nangs dus a ne 'gro dus ngu nyan ni ma red go )zer/phyi nyin dbus pa gshar nas nyin gung slebs skabs/ smad kyi ri 'dabs zhig na ru skor chen po zhig yod la/ a nes mo rang gi ca lag rgyab tu khur nas rang khyim la song / 'gro khar a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis la byams po re byas/ de dus mo'i mig nas mchi ma bzhur 'dug la/ ‘‘a ne khyed gnyis blta ru slebs song / khyed gnyis a ne yod sar shog go song ngamanya zhes zer zhor du/ phyir bltas med par phyin song / de'i rjes nas nga tsho ngo thug ma myong la/ nga'i dus nam yang a ne sems nas brjed med red/ a ne song tshar bas/ nyin 'gar nga rang sems ha cang mi bde/ nga tsho'i dbus pa yang mang che ba ru nang la song tshar yod/ de dus chu kha ma'i ru sog po'i sa thog tu yod pas/ dgon par 'gro mkhan nged tshang dang / khyim tshang gsum bzhi tsam las med/ nyi ma ci tsam song ba mi dran mod/ nyin zhig la nga tsho rma chu'i gru kha la slebs song na 208

ga5 yo(li ༅ nyi pog ning da lta'i dus 'dir 'di nas lam la chas la/ da lo yang phyir dgon par slebs song / a ho ho/ gang du song yang rang sa 'dra ba'i skyid po zhig thug rgyu med/ dgon nang du slebs na ngo shes mang po dang thug la/ rang gi sems nas ha cang dga' 'dug yang a pha nged gnyis a ne dkar tho sogs khyim tshang mang po la song / a phas lha sa nas nyos pa'i phreng ba dang / zhim po re a ye dkar tho la byin/ nyin 'ga' 'gor rjes/ a phas lha sa nas nyos yong ba'i rma bya'i spro'i gdugs gnyis bzos nas dgon par phul/ da rung bka' thang sde lnga sogs chos yig nyos yod pa dgon par phul/ 'di ni chu kha ma'i dgon pa'i lo rgyus thogathengs dang por rma bya'i gdugs phub rgyu yod pa yin la/ de'i lo nas bzung lo sar bcu drug byams pa gling skor nyin/ rma bya'i gdugs phub nas gling skor byed pa la/ de dus nags tshang tshang gi rma bya'i gdugs zer ba grags chen zhig red/a zhang rgya khor gyis a pha la/ ‘‘khyod ha cang bzang song / dbus pa khyim tshang brgya kha song yang / dgon par 'di 'dra 'jog mkhan yod pa ma redami zer/dgon nang du slebs rjes/ nyin bcu lhag 'gor rjes/ a phas nga rang khrid nas dgon par song ste mdud pa blangs shing / a lags mir rdo tshang gi mdun nas rab byung bsgrubs/ de nas dngos su dgon par zhugs te grwa pa byas pa ma zad/dge rgan thogs med mdun nas dpe cha bslabs/ nyin 'ga' 'gor rjes pha drin can rnga ba ru song / nyin drug bdun 'gor rjes/ dgong mo mun rub dus shig la/ a pha nang la slobs song / de nas nged pha bu gsum gyis ja 'thung nas bsdad yod/ de dus dgon pa'i grwa pa 'ga' yong nas a pha khrid de rgya sgo'i kha nas skad cha cung bshad rjes/ a pha yar khyim la yong nas/ 6‘khyed gnyis sdod dang / a pha do dgong don dag cig yod zer nas grwa pa tsho dang mnyam du phyin )song / a bu nged gnyis nyal bsdad/de ring snga dro/ dgon pa yar 'tshogs dus/ 'du khang nang ma song gong /grwa mang 'du khang rdo gcal thog tu bsdad nas skyor sbyang byed skabs/ cung tsam 209

leku 0nga 0 0 malagu 215 i 2 rwasbyo nas grwa mang gis ske bsrings nas/ rgyal sgo'i nang blta gin 'dug dedus grwa pa zhig gis 6‘ya 'di ci red/ nags tshang rgad po bzung nas khrid yong gi ’zer/nga rang gi skad cha 'di go dus/ mgo nang nas sang sgra 'dra zhig grag song / ngas kyang rgyal sgo'i phyogs su bltas pa na/ rgyal sgo nas grwa pa gnyis gsum gyis/ pha drin chen gyi lag gnyis la lcags brgyab ste khrid 'dug nga'i sems nang nas sdug dang / khong khro langs shing mig mtha' mchi mas bskor song bas/ a pha'i kha ngo gsal po mi mthong / skabs der a phas lcags brgyab yod pa'i lag pa gnyis gnam du bkyags te/ skad mthon pos ‘‘rma sde chu kha ma'i grwa pa bzhi brgyas de ring ltos dang / nga nags tshang rgan po chung nas che bar/ dgon sde grwa tshang 'di la rang gi srog ltar 'dang bzhag nga rgyu chen po min yang / nga'i dbus nyi ma lha sa nas/ bu gnyis la sbyin ma bra/ nga rang gi za ma bra/ rma bya'i gdugs sogs nyos nas dgon par bzhag yod/ de ring dge bskos wa sang glad dmar gyis/ nga mdang dgong dgon nang nas rta zhon/ me mda' khur nas/ kho'i sngon nas chas song zer nas nyes 'gel byas pa red/ rma sde chu kha ma'i dgon pa btsugs nas dar ma myong ba dgon pas mi bzung lcags brgyab pa 'di red/mi a phas yang lag pa gnyis kyis lcags brgyab yod pa yar bkyags nas/ ‘‘rang sde rang dgon gi grwa pa rnam pas gcig ltos dang / dgon par dar ma myong ba zhig de ring wa sang glad dmar gyis byas pa red/ grwa dge slong zhig la las rgyu 'bras med pa ci red/ ltos dang / 'di nga la dgon pa tshang gis bzang lan ngan mjal byas pa redami ces skad cha mang po bshad/ de nas grwa pa tsho 'du khang nang du phebs/ yang a pha tshogs kyi gral rnga la khrid yong nas/ dge bskos wa sang gis 6‘nags tshang 'dul khos/ dgon pa'i chos khrims dang 'gal ba ma zad/ dgon pa grwa tshang la kha dmod brgyab/ de ring kho la lcag tshan stong dang lnga brgya gshad dgos/ de'i thog la g.yag gnyis kyis chad pa yod/ nangs dus nas dgon grwa tshang la 'tshogs bskol dgos nyazhes bshad/ de dus a phas ‘‘de 210

5 ( ci ༅ 3 po ring khyodawa sang klad dmar dge bskos red/ dgon pa'i chos khrims 'gal mkhanangamared/ khyod red/ dgon pa grwa tshang gis mi bzung lcags brgyab zer rgyuzhig mi tshe 'dir ma dar ba/ khyod kyis de ring ci bsam ci 'dod gyis dang /las rgyu'abras re 'khor rgyu yod pa red/ de ring ngas lcag tshan stong zhig khur ma thuban/ nga nags tshang tshang gi ske rags khyi la bcings pa yin ’zhes bshad/grwa pa 'du khang gang 'jam cag ger bsdad 'dug de nas grwa pa tshos/a pha'ilag lcags blangs shing / slog pa phud de gcer bur gral rnga nas slog pa'i thog tu bsnar bcug cung tsam nas grwa pa gnyis kyis mi res lag la glang thur gsum re mnyam du bzung ste/ a pha'i g.yas g.yon gnyis nas langs shing / a pha'iyong sha'i thog la glang lcag gis res bskor nas gzhus/ gcig gis gshad tshar na yang gcig gis gzhus/ de ring lcag tshan gzhu mkhan grwa pa bzhi yod la/lag brje res byas te gzhus/ thog ma gzhu dus/ pha drin chen gyi ong sha'i thog nas thal ba lta bu 'phyur gyi 'dug yun cung mgor rjes ong sha khrag mig rgyas nas dmar log ger song / grwa pa tshos sngar ltar lag brdzeras byas te gzhu bzhin 'dugacung tsam nas a pha'i ong sha'i thog nas khrag phan tshun mchod bzhin 'dug la/lcag tshan gzhu mkhan grwa pa tshos lag pa dang sham thab la'ang khrag 'gos 'dugayang grwa pa tshos khog stod phud de/ gzan sked par dkris nas mu mthud du/ a pha'i ong sha'i thog glang lcag gis gzhus/ ngas mar bltas na/ a pha 'gul rgyu med par gyur 'dug gzhu mkhan grwa pa la la chad nas mgo nas rngul chu 'bab kyi 'duganga'i sems su ci 'dra snying rje med pa'i grwa pa 'ga'/ kho tshos lcag tshan gzhu sa ni mi zhig yin pa ha go med pa 'dra red/ rdo la gzhu ba bzhin/ sha tsha lag yang spa tsam med par gzhu bzhin 'dug ga gos gon pa'i dge slong zhig la/ 'di 'dro sha tsha snying rje med pa mtshar po red/ mi ma dgos rta zog zhig la'ang 'di 'dra gzhu dgos na sems kyis bzod sa ma red bsam zhor du/ thabs ci yang med par bltas nas bsdad/ shir tshag shir tshag glang lcag gis gzhus pa'i tshag sgra ni/ 'du khang nang 211

leku 0thi 5 malagu215 yi 2nge5 du brag cha bzhin du grag 'dug la/ grwa pa kun ngo gnag nas/ 'jam jagagobazhugs 'dug lcag tshan gzhus pa'i tshag sgra 'di ni/ lcags nag gi 'dzer ma bzhin nga yi snying nang du zug gtong gi 'dug/le tshan zhe bdun pa/dge bskos wa sang drin gyis/ grwa pa'i las 'bro rdzogs song /rma sdechu kha ma'i bkra shis chos gling dgon pa'i tshogs chen 'du khang nang du/ dgon pas mi bzung nas lcags brgyab pa ma zad/ 'du khang gi gral rnga nas lcag tshan gzhus pa ni/ dgon pa btsugs tshun chad yod ma myong / la las/ 'di dge bskos wa sang gi chos khrims dkrug pa red zer/ yang la las 'di bkra shis chos gling dgon pa'i bstan pa nub pa'i snga ltas tshang ba red zer/ mdor na/ de ring chag sgo 'di nged pha bu tsho'i mgor lhung song / 'du khang gdong gral gyi gral rnga na dgon pa'i grwa pa bzhis da rung lag brje res byas te/ a pha'i ong sha'i thog la glang lcag gis gzhu 'dug khrag ni sngar ltar lcag tshan yar bkyags par 'byar nas/ phyogs bzhir dmar tha re gtor 'dug a phas kho rang gi slog pa'i sne mo zhig kha nang la bzung ste/ thog mtha' bar gsum kun tu kha gcig kyang ma grag skabs shig la grwa pa tshos/ lcag tshan stong dang lnga brgya gshad tshar zer nas mtshams byas/ grwa pa res glang lcag gsum re mnyam du bzung nas gzhu bzhin yod pas/ thengs lnga brgya gzhus tshar na/ lcags tshan stong dang lnga brgya gzhus tshar ba red zer/ de dus a phas ‘‘ya wa sang klad dmar/ da khyod shi ba min na gshod dang / dge snying rje ni khyod la med/ khrims ngo tsha ni khyod la med/khyod kyis de ring grwa pa bzhi brgya'i sngon nas/ nga nags tshang rgan po sod shog dang /khyod shi sems bde rgyu redami’ces zer nas skad brgyab/ 'du khang nang du sngar ltar 'jam cag ger yod/ de dus nga rang 'du khang g.yas kyi mtha' gral na 212

ma5 ma ci rdzi skyi/sam bsdadayod la/ a pha la grwa pa tshos snying rje ci yang med par/ lcag tshan gyis gzhus nasakhrag mchod pa mthong rjes/ bsran ma thub par cung ngus pas dge bskos wasangayong nas/ ‘‘'dre phrug ho 'debs ki ma 'dug sdug khyod kyis ci zhig bsam pa yin ’zer zhor du/ lcag g.yog gis nga'i mgo la skag sgra grag pa zhig brgyab song / nga'i mig lam du skar ma lta bu 'tshub song la/ ci yang mi dran par gyur song / rjes nas mi tshos de dus 'ja' pe ngu zhor du yar langs nas rgyugs te/ dge bskos wa sang gi ngo la sbar shad byas nas/ gdong la dmar shar re byas 'dug wa sang gi 'ja' pe la snud tho brgyab nas bsgyel zhing / yang lag gi lcag g.yog gis rgyag rtsis byed skabs/ gral rnga nas a khu smon lam yar langs te/ wa sang gi lcag g.yog la 'thams nas/ ‘‘da khyod kyis tshod gyis/ pha la gshad dgos na/ bu la rdung dgos don cang med/ da ni khyod kyis tshod gyis ma gtogs/ ngas khyod gser yum 'don/ ro gyen du lang rgyu med pa zhig mi byed na zer zhor du/ nga rang khur nas 'du khang sgo ru song / de dus a zhang rgya khor yang gral nas yar langs te dge bskos wa sang gi thad du slebs nas 6‘las lam la mi 'gro rgyu/ khyod la khyi smyon gyis bzung ba e red/ 'di dgon pa'i 'du khang red/ khyod kyi khyim ma red/ byis par yang brdungs nas/ khyod la ro dgos samanya zer zhor du sgo ru bud song / dge bskos wa sang gis ci yang bshad ma phod par/ yar langs nas bltas bsdad song zhes bshad song / rjes su a bu 'ja' pes kyang 'di ltar bshad song /nga rang dran pa sos dus/ a bu 'ja' pe dang a zhang rgya khor/ a zhang smon lam gsum gyis nga rang bskyor zhing / chu len rgan po bzod pas nga'i mgo la chu 'khyag blugs zhor du/ ‘‘srog chad 'gro rgyu wa sang klad dmar gyis nga'i zhi lu 'di 'dra zhig brdung nas ro dgos pa e yin na ’zer la/ de dus grwa pa thams cad 'du khang nas sgor bud 'dug rgan po bzod pas skad bkyags nas 6‘shi mgo khrag la skor rgyu/ wa sang klad dmar/ ngas kha rog gcig bskyur song na/213

gyis yinanya zer/ de nas tshogs grol song / a pha yar langs mi thub pas/ mgo tsha ru ba'i grwa pa tshos phya ra zhig khyer yong nas/ phya ra'i khug thog tu bzhag nas khyim la khyer song sogs bshad/ 'thung gi 'dugad rung dgod zhor du grwa pa tsho dang kha brda byed bzhin yod pas nga rang sems cung bde song / sngon ma nga'i sems su lcag tshan stong dang lnga brgya gzhus tshar na/ phal cher shi rgyu red bsam/ nga der slebs nas a pha'i ske la 'thams nas cung ngus par/ a pas ‘‘pha bzang bu ngu mi nyan/ skyes pho rab cig gi mgo la sdug ci 'dra mi yong / 'di tsho chung chung red/ bu rgod yin na
