5snye ( 4 sku'e nyi yog redami ces bshad/phyi nyin/ nged tshang gi g.yag rgan gnyis dgon pas bshas nas tshogs bskol spyad byas tshar la/ chu len bzod pas g.yag mgo gnyis dang / g.yag sha rkang pa zhig ko ba gnyis khyer nas nged tshang la yong / a phas g.yag mgo gcig kho la byin/ dgong mo zhig la wa sang gis yang grwa pa gsum mngags nas/‘6nags tshang rgad po'i me mda' dgon par sprad dgos ’zer bar/ khong tsho len du yong ba yin zer/ de dus pha khong khro shin tu langs nas 'dar gin 'dug la/kho da rung nyal sa nang nas yar langs re med/ a phas grwa pa de tshor/ ‘‘'o ya khyed rnams song nas wa sang klad dmar la/ da kho la ci byed rgyu yod kyang ma 'phyug nga'i me mda' len dgos na/ sde dgon su yin na'ang / ngas dme lag khrag gi gtor res zhig byas med na/ da nags tshang rgan po shi song ba yim/ da khyed tsho me mda' len mkhan bu rgod po su yong rgyu yod kyang shog ngas blta rgyu'i ltad mo zhig mi ston na gser yum brgya tham pa/ 'ja' kho/ nga'i me mda' khur shog mda' ra khyer shog zer bar/ a bu 'ja' pes me mda' dang / mda' ra a pa'i lag tu bzhag de dus a zhang rgya khor dang / der yod grwa pa tshos ‘‘lha sang gis de zer rgyu zhig ga re yin nam/ da khyod sdod dang nga tsho song nas skad cha re bshadaminyaces zer la/ a phas ‘‘da khyed tsho 'gro mi dgos/ kho klad dmar me mda' len par yong du chug mi su yong na'ang ngas dme zhig ma byas na/ nga nags tshang tshang shul chad pa'i rtags yin zer zhor du/ me mda'i khog la mda' brdzangs/ a zhang rgya khor gyis grwa pa gsum po khrid nas sgor phyin song / a khu smon lam sogs grwa pa tshos da rung ci zhig 'don 'dug de dus ngas ‘‘a pha nga grwa pa byed rgyu min zer bar/ a phas 6‘pha kho de gyis/ nangs dus nas khyed gnyis 'tshogs la 'gro mi dgos/ da wa sang gi lag zhabs nas grwa pa byed thub kyi ma red/ a pha yar drag na nged pha bu tsho sa thag ring po zhig la chas 'gro/ wa sang klad dmar zhabs nas mi 'dug kho thag yin/ nged pha bu tsho sa gang du song 215

miku 0ci 5 spulagu675 i 2 re0 yang kha sos ni ’red zer/a zhang rgya khor gyis skad cha bshad nas yin dang / wa sang gis cang ma phod pa yin nam/ de'i rjes nas nged tshang gi me mda' len dgos rab kyi skad cha cang ma go/ zla gcig tsam gyi mtshams nas a pha drag ste yar langs nas 'gro thub pa red/ cung ma 'gor bar kho yang rnga bar phyin song la/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis khyim du bsdad/ a bu 'ja' pe yang tshogs la 'gro yi med la/ khos khyim nas dpe cha blta bzhin bsdad/ nga rang gis grwa gos phud nas/ sngar ltar khyim nas ja bskol ba dang 'bud shing 'thu ba/ chu len pa sogs byas/ nga rang grwa ba yag po zhig byed bsam pa'i rmi lam ni/ dge bskos wa sang gi lcag g.yog gcig gis bsad song / tshe 'dir ni grwa pa zla gsum tsam la byed pa'i las ma gtogs med song / rjes nas ngas yun ring por sems su/ rta zhon me mda' khur nas mtshan mo dgon nang nas dge bskos dang thug song yang / nyes chad 'di 'dra gcod dgos don med pa 'dra bsam pa yang dang yang du dran//le tshan zhe brgyad pa/paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas/ bla brang dgon nas mjal song /nga ni grwa pa min yang dgon par bsdad yod pas/ nga rang sngar ltar dgon pa'i ja khang nang du/ tshogs thug len du song ba dang / yang ja ma dang chu len tshor rogs cung re byas pas/ za lhag 'thung 'phro mang tsam re khyim du khur rgyu yod/ da ni nga rang lo bdun brgyad yin pas/ 'bud shing rang gis 'bud rgyu yod par ma zad/ mtshams rer 'bud shing nyung nyung re a khu hir dge dang /khyim mtshes a khu khyo dge sogs la phul bas/ khong tshos nga la 'bras dang / rtsam phyur sogs sprod kyi 'dug mtshams rer ngas ri mgo nas lcum dang / khu bud btus nas grwa pa tshor sprad na/ khong tshos kyang nga la za lhag 'thung 'phro ci dgos 216

ma5 ('a thunalpi pog ster/ yang de'i skabs a ne dkar thos mar chur re sprad yong / da ci bshad kyanganged gnyis kyis rang kha rang gso byed thub pas/ za 'thung gi phyogs nas dka'akhag ci yang med/ dbyar khar/ a phas nged gnyis khrid nas/ bla brang dgon par mjal du song / lam nas chu kha ma'i ru nang nas/ a zhang mgon tshe tshang nas nyin drug bdun tsam bsdad rjes/ nga tsho mnyam du bla brang la mjal du song / lam nas nyin bdun tsam song nas bla brang du slebs/ bla brang bkra shisa'akhyil/ grwa pa stong phrag gsum gyi gdan sa/ gtsang chu sngon mo'i g.yas 'gram gyi/ gling chen 'gying ri'i khugs so na/ lha khang mang ba/ gser khebs gser tog mang ba/ sku gsung thugs rten mang ba/ gung thang mthong grol chen mo/ mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa skye sa/ ci 'dra 'dra'i dgon pa yag po/ gson da ngogs su mjal rgyu rag pa 'di ni/ rang gis tshe sngon ma bsags pa'i las red bsam song /nga tsho bla brang du slebs pa na/ gung thang mgron khang nang du bsdad pa yin/ nyin zhig a phas a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis khrid nas/ a lags gung thang tshang la mjal du song / a phas khong tshang sngon nas sku ngo shes 'dug nga tsho der slebs pa na sngon ma nang chen nang nas za 'thung byas/ de nas khong gi sku mdun du song /khong ni dgung lo nyi shu lhag yin la/ zhal ngo 'dzum gyi gang nas ‘‘'o ya/ 'dir shog 'di gnyis ka khyod kyi bu red dmanya gsungs par/ a phas ‘6red lagasanya zer/ khong gis ‘‘snying rje/ 'di gnyis kyi ma ma shi song ba ma yin namanya)zhes gsungs/ ‘‘red lags da zhi lu gnyis nar son bzhin 'dug khyed la tshe skyabs srog skyabs zhus pa yin/ rjes nas nga rgan po yod med re chags dus/ khyed kyis 'di gnyis thugs nas ma 'bor ba zhu zhes a phas de ltar zhus pa na/ khong gis ‘‘ya ya/ rjes nas don dag re yod na nga 'tshol du yong chogache ba grwa pa red mo/ chung ba nus kho zer ba min nam’)zhes gsungs shing / nged gsum la khong gis thud dang / ko re mang po gnang song / nga tsho phyir 'dug sar slebs rjes/ a zhang mgon tshes kho'i ngo shes shig gi sar 'gro zer nas/ a pha 217

mi4 0ci 5 phulasku ye e 2 res nged gsum yang dgon par song / gyang bar zhig la slebs dus/ grwa rganayo lon gnyis kyis grwa phrug cig khrid nas phebs yong bar thug sa pha khong tsho sanas bsdad de phyag 'tshal zhing / dge rgan tsho dang kha brda byas/ grwa phrug desanga'i rna 'byog 'then zhor du 6‘khyod lo du redami ces dris song / ngas ‘‘nga lo brgyad yin nyazhes bshad pa na/ khos ‘‘'o ya/ nged gnyis na mnyam red/ nga byi ba red/lo brgyad yin’ zer/ de nas khong gi nga'i mgo la thal lcag gnyis brgyab nas phebs song / de dus ngas ha go song / khong ni bla brang dgon pa'i khri chen/ 'jamadabyangs bzhad pa skyabs mgon rin po che red/ dus skabs khong dgung lo chung bas phyi nas mjal kha med/ de ring nga tsho las kyis 'di nas mjal song la/ khong gi phyag dron pos nga'i rna 'byog 'then pas mi tshad/ mgo la thal lcag gnyis brgyab song / a phas ‘‘khong gis khyod kyi rna 'byog 'then pa de yag po redaminyaces zer/ bla brang dgon pa nas/ mjal skor nyin 'gar byas rjes/ mi tshos sang nyin paṇa chen rin po che phebs rgyu red zer 'dug phyi nyin snga mo nas/ nga tshos dgon pa'i mdun ri'i ngos kyi nags gseng nas rgyang lta byas/ dgon pa'i bla ma dang grwa pa thams cad kyis chos gos gon nas ser phreng bsgrigs te bsgugs yod/ mtshams zhig la rlangs 'khor mang po rgya grong nas yar dgon pa'i phyogs su yong / sngon ma rlangs 'khor chung chung zhig gi thog tu rgyang 'bod skad brda btsugs yod pa zhig gis/ rin po che rlangs 'khor gsum pa'i nang du bzhugs yod zer zhor sngon du song /cung tsam nas rlangs 'khor thams cad nga tsho'i thad du slebs dus/ rlangs 'khor gsum pa'i nang du/ gon pa ser po gyon mkhan zhig yod pa ha cang gsal 'dug de nas khong bla brang dgon pa'i chos ra'i nang du phebs song / de ring chos ra'i nang mi khri tsho mang po 'dus yod la/ paṇa chen rin po ches nang nas song / de nas kyang rgya dmag 218

5snye (khri ༅ 3 po gnyisakyis bkag 'dug pas 'gro ru mi 'jug de dus grwa pa 'ga' res mchod cha sogs khyer nas gochung nang nas 'dzul/ de'i skabs a phas nga pang du bzung /a bu'aja' pe khrid nas sgo chung nang 'dzul/ da rung a zhang mgon tshe sogs mi bzhilnga yod pa thams cad sgo chung nang nas 'dzul/ rgya dmag gis rkang tho dang /me mda'i nya rnga yis mi rnams la brgyab kyang / ma khog par nang du 'dzul thub song / yang nang gi rgya dmag 'ga' yong nas nga tsho ded de sngon du 'dug bcug song / da ni paṇa chen rin po che'i khri dang thag ha cang nyer slebs 'dug de dus a pha'i mgor sgo rtsa nas rgya dmag gis brgyab pas khrag cung bzhur gyi 'dugazhabs zhu grwa pa zhig yong nas/ ras sngon po zhig byin nas khrag 'phyi ru bcug paṇa chen rin po ches dbang bskur tshar dus/ sngon du bsdad yod pa'i bla ma dpon po dang mjal ba tsho re la mjal kha gnang / 'dug sa thag nye bas rgya dmag gis nga tsho ded nas mjal ba'i nang du gral sgrig bcug cung tsam nas khong gi bzhugs khri dang thag nye sar slebs dus/ mi re re byas nas 'gro dgos la/ nga rang gis dar kha khur nas khong gi khri rtsar slebs dus/ khri ha cang mtho la/ khri mdun du dngul dkar po ha cang mang po spangs yod pas/ nga rang yar khri rtsar song na/ dngul sgor thog brdzis nas phyir rnyed nas/ khri rtsar slebs thabs med/de dus ngas yar bltas na/ khong gis nga la bltas nas/ bzhad zhor du phyag gi mjal kha 'jog spyad mda' dar mgo gzhug brjes nas bzung 'dug de skabs rgya dmag cig gis nga'i rgyab nas yar ded de khong gi khri rtsar gcar du bcug de dus khong gis mda' dar gyi yu bas nga'i mgo la skag sgra grag pa zhig brgyab song /nga rang gzer nas mig mtha' mchi mas bskor song / mjal tshar nas phar la song dus/ nga'i mig nas mchi ma bzhur song / grwa pa zhig gis mjal ba re la ja la dmar po'i mdud pa re dang / bum chu blugs/ yang grwa pa zhig gis rtsid skud kyi lung btags yod pa'i/ go re snum btsos chen po gnyis re sprad song /phar cung song bas/ rgya dmag gis nga tsho ltag sgo nas phud song / nga tsho skor lam 219

miku 0nga snye0 phu0gu 215 i 2 stes du slebs rjes rgan po rgan mo 'ga' res/ a drin chen po/ nga la tshogs cung sprod dang zer bas/ ngas go re nas sen btog byas nas khong tsho cung tsam re byin/ cung ma mgor bar nga'i go re gcig tshar song /nyin zhig nga tsho yang dgon pa'i 'du khang mjal du song / ngas lam nas gyang rtsa zhig la gcin skyag btang / yar langs ma langs la/ grwa pa zhig gis nga'i skra nas bzung ste/ ‘‘skyag pa 'pho ru song’ zer/ nga la bkod pa med par/nga rang gis btang ba'i skyag pa lag pas bzhab nas chu shur nang du 'phangs/ grwa pa des nga'i skra nas bzung ste yar bkyag nga'i rkang pa gnyis sa la mi thug cing/mgo nas srag sgra 'dra zhig grag 'dug de dus grwa pa des shed kyis nga rang rdo yi chu shur nang du 'phangs song / nga rang gis ci yin mi shes par gyur/ cung tsam nas nga rang sad dus/ grwa pa gnyis kyis bskyor 'dug la ‘‘'o skyabs mgon mkhyen shi ma song zer/ nga'i mgo la rma byas nas khrag bzhur bzhin 'dug grwa pa de gnyis kyis nga'i mgo'i rma kha la spyi pags sbyar zhing / gdong gi khrag 'phyi rogs byas rjes/ nga khrid nas 'du khang gi sgor slebs/ de na a zhang mgon tshe sogs yod la/ ngas ‘‘ril song ba redami ces bshad pa las/ brgyab song ba sogs ma bshad/ nga'i sems su dgon pa yag po 'di'i nang / 'di 'dra'i grwa pa sems ngan re 'dug dge slong gi gon pa gyon yod mkhan thams cad/ byang chub kyi sems yod mkhan rkyang rkyang ma yin pa red snyam/ grwa pa stong phrag gsum gyi nang du dkor gzan sems nag 'di 'dra re gnyis yod pa mtshar rgyu cang mi 'dug kyang dran byung /de ring / yang a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis/ bla brang rgya grong tshong rar nyul du song / dgon pa dang rgya grong bar gyi thang thog na/ tshong ra ha cang mang po yod/ a bu 'ja' pes go re gnyis nyos te nged gnyis kyis za zhor du rgya grong 'grim pa'i skabs/ tshong ra zhig na ja la dmar po chung chung btsong bzhin 'dugangs ja la chung chung zhig lag nang du bskungs nas yong / cung song rjes/ rgya 220

skem5 (ḍa rdzi nyi/cag zhig yong nas nga la 'gram lcag zhig brgyab nas/ ja la dmar po 'phrogs song /sabu'aja' pes nga la rgyag pa mthong nas/ sa thog nas rdo zhig blangs te 'phangs pas/ rgya de'i gdong la brgyab nas khrag bzhur gyi 'dug rgya des a bu 'ja' pe larkang tho brgyab nas bsgyel ba ma zad/ yang nga la rkang tho brgyab nas bsgyel song / de dus nga tsho'i rogs pa mjal ba 'ga' re rgyugs yong nas/ mgo skor gyis brgyab ste rgya de'i mgo rmas te/ sa thog tu bsgyel 'dug pas/ der yod mi mang gis ki dir byas shing / mi 'ga' res rdo brgyab nas rgya yi tshong khang gi shel sgo bcag de dus rgya dmag mang po yong nas bar byas te 'dzing ma bcug nga rang yar langs dus sna khrag bzhur 'dug rogs pa tshos nged gnyis khrid nas phyir 'dug sar slebs/ da thengs bla brang nas rgyag rdung skor gnyis rag song /yang nga'i don du a bu 'ja' pe la yang rgyag rdung skor gcig rag song //le tshan zhe dgu pa/drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs tshang /pha drin can la spyang lpags shig btsong rgyu yod la/ de ring snga dro nged gnyis rgya grong nang du song nas btsong / nyin gung gung thang mgron khang sgo ru slebs dus/ de na rlangs 'khor dkar po zhig bsdad nas/ rgya zhig gis ci zhig byed bzhin 'dug ngas de nas bltas bsdad/ yang rgya 'ga' re a lags tshang nas sgor bud de/ rlangs 'khor nang du 'dzul/ rlangs 'khor gyi dos dos zer nas kha grag bzhin 'dug kyang / ngas ha ma go bar da rung bltas bsdad/ de skabs rlangs 'khor sngon du rgyugs te nga gom pa gnyis gsum mtshams la g.yugs song bas/ nga mgo yom 'khor nas langs mi thub/ rna 'byog nang sang sgra grag 'dug pa las ci yang mi go zhing / phar bltas na rlangs 'khor nang nas rgya gnyis sa la babs nas nga'i rtsib tu slebs song / grwa pa zhig gis nga bskyor 221

leku 0na 5 7 malagu225 i 2nge5 nas 'dug pa sogs mig gis rig la/ kha grag rgyu med/ cung tsam nas dngas song / mgo yom cung tsam 'khor ba las skyon med pas/ de dus rgya zhig gis nga'i lag tu shog sgor 'ga' bzhag grwa pa des nga la zhim po dang / go re mang tsam sprad/ de nas khong tsho rlangs 'khor nang bsdad nas chas song / nga yar nang la slebs dus/ pha la gnas tshul de bshad la/ phas ‘6ya drag gi red/ nga'i zhi lu bu rgod red/ de 'dra zhig gis skyon yod ni ma red/ ya pha kho 'di nas kham bu gang 'thung )zer zhor du/ lag gi dkar yol nang chang yod pa nga'i lag tu bzhag ngas kham bu che gang 'thung / cung tsam nas yang mgo yom 'dra 'khor nas gnyid song /de ring phas ‘‘'ja' kho/ khyed gnyis nyi ma 'gar 'di ru sdod dang / khyim mtshes a ye sgron mas khyed gnyis la rogs byed kyi red/ don dag 'dra yod dus/a lags tshang la zhus dang / ngas khyed gnyis khong la bcol yod/ nga sku 'bum la song nas slebs yongami’zer/cung tsam nas/ a pha rogs pa 'ga' dang mnyam du sku 'bum la song / a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyis bla brang dgon par mjal skor byas/ mtshams rer mdun ri'i ngos nas 'bud shing re btus/ za rgyu ni yod la nged gnyis skyid po byas nas bsdad pa yin/ nyin zhig nga rang nang chen rgya ra'i nang chu len du 'gro dus/ a lags tshang la spre'u phrug zhig yod pa dong chu'i nang lhung 'dug ngas grwa pa zhig skad btang nas bshad par/ grwa pa 'ga' yong nas yar blangs/ de dus a lags gung thang tshang yang der phebs song la/grwa pa zhig gis 66byis pa 'dis mthong nas brda brgyab songanya)zer bar a lags kyis 66ya 'di nga'i ngo shes grogs po red/ nus kho zer ba red/ khyed kyi pha da rung slebs ma song ngam’rigasungs/ ngas ‘‘da rung ma slebs ma song ’zhes zhus par/ ‘‘ya 'gro/ de ring nga'i nang du 'gro migasungs nas/ nga khrid de khong gi gzim khang nang du song / der slebs pa na grwa pa zhabs zhu zhig gis ja dang /sha sogs khyer yong nas nga'i sngon la bzhag sa lags kyis ‘‘ya nga'i grogs po/222

5snye (ḍa tshursha 3 lu pho sar zo dang’’zhes gsung zhor du khong gis gsol ja bzhes/ yang 66nus kho khyod kyis yi ge e shes nyagasung / ngas ‘‘ka kha sum cu shes/ de min mi shes) zhes zhas/ ‘‘'o bzang gi/ yi ge shes na bzang gi red/ yi ge ma shes na glo'u (glen tho )red/ rjes nas yi ge shes pa gyis dang phan thogs mang po yod pa red nyagasung / de nas khong gis nga khrid nas gzim khang sgo kha'i me tog ltum ra'i nang du bsdad/ yang khong gis ‘‘khyod kyis me tog 'di tsho ngo e shes’nyagasung / ngas ‘‘'di me tog rgya sman red/ de min mi shes ’zhus par/ khong gis 66red ya/ nga tshos me tog rgya sman zer/ 'di rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gdan sa na skyes yod pa red/ der brten la las 'ja' dbyangs me tog zer gyi red rigasungs/ cung tsam nas khong gis ‘‘nus kho khyed tsho lha sar e song zhes dris/ ngas ‘‘na ning song ba yin zhus pa na/ khong gis ‘‘rgyal ba rin po che e mjalanya gsungs par/ ngas ‘‘nor bu gling ga nas mjal song zhus/ khong gis 6‘'o bzang gi/ chu kha ma nga'i a zhang tshang red/ nged gnyis yul phyogs gcig redaminyaces sogs mang po gsungs/ cung tsam nas yang grwa pas ja khyer yong la/khong gis bzhes shing nga la gnang zhor du/ 66ja 'thung / a pha med na khyed gnyis e sun namanya’gsungs/ ngas ‘‘sun gyi mi 'dug yo pha nam yin yang nged gnyis bskyur nas ru nyul du 'gro yi redaminyaces zhus/ khong gis ‘‘ya snying rje/ byis pa chung chung 'di tshor bzang lob song na yag po red ’gsungs/ cung 'gor rjes grwa pa zhabs zhu ba des zhim po dang / sil tog bla brang go re mang po zhig khyer yong nas nga la sprad/ nga 'gro ran khar khong gis ‘‘khyed gnyis la don ci yod na'ang nga la shod/ go song ngam/ khyed kyi pha rgan gyis khyed gnyis nga la bcol yod pa red migasungs/ ngas ‘‘lags so/ a lags khyed kha dro9)sogs bshad zhor du/ phyir a bu nged gnyis 'dug sar yong / a bu ni ha cang dga' song /nyin bdun brgyad 'gor rjes/ a pha sku 'bum nas phyir slebs song /ngas a zhang khong tsho la nga a lags gung thang tshang dang mnyam du/ me tog ldum 223

leku ban 5 yo polaskuye༅5 i 2ches ra'i nang nas ja 'thung ba sogs bshad/ a pha yang ha cang dga' nas/ ‘‘nga'i zhi lu gnyis a lags gis dngos gnas byams skyong gnang gi redaminyazer la/ a zhang dgon tshes ‘‘skyabs su mchi/ khong gi thugs nas gtan du 'bor gyi ma redami’ces sogs sems dga' ba'i skad cha mang po bshad/ dgong mo nga tsho rgya srang du glog brnyan la blta ru song / bla brang na bcings 'grol dmag mang po bsdad yod pas/ dgong mo dmag gis rgya srang du glog brnyan ston bzhin yod/glog brnyan bltas tshar dus rgya dmag mang po gral sgrig nas 'gro 'dug la/ mi tshos da glog brnyan nang nas 'dzings 'dug mkhan rgya dmag ni 'di tsho red zer/ngas kyang yin rgyu red bsam myong / rjes nas a phas ‘‘de ma red/ ten yin tsi ni rgya nag gis mig 'khrul ston pa red ’zer/ da ni bla brang mjal tshar nas phyir 'gro ran song / de ring snga mor nged pha bu gsum rgya srang du song nas sil tog dang / bla brang go re nyos/ bla brang go re dang / sil tog ni grags che bas phar khyim du slebs na/ nye sa dga' yag tsho la 'bab sbyin rgyu yag po red/ a phas bla brang go re sgam gang dang / sil tog sgro ba do nyos song / sil tog nyo sa nas/ a phas sgro ba'i nang blugs te rgya ma bkyag 'dug tshe/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyis za ci thub byas/ nyos tshar rjes sil tog btsong mkhan rgya rgan gyis/ da rung nged gnyis la sil tog rum gang re blugs song / nga tshos kyang thug pa skam po bag cha 'ga' re dang / rtsam pa khug ma phyed tsam nyos/ da ni nyo dgos pa yod tshad nyos tshar song / bla brang dgon nas zla gcig tsam bsdad la/de'i ring la bla brang dgon par mjal skor mang po byas pas mi tshad/ paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas/ skyabs mgon 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ a lags brag sgom pa sogs bla spral mang por mjal thub song bas/ de nas yang rang yul phyogs su yong / nye ma drug bdun tsam song rjes chu kha ma'i ru nang du slebs/ sngon ma nga tsho dme shul tshang du nyin 'ga' re bsdad/ yang a tshang 'gu grags tshang du nyin drug bdun zhig bsdad/ a zhang 224

ga5 tri thutshelpi lum 'gu grags tshang gi a ce thug pa mtsho/ a bu dge bkra sogs nga tsho nam yin yang chu khar song nas rtsed mo rtses/ a ne ri sgron gyis ‘‘a 'dul kho/ da nga'i zhi lu nus kho khrid ma 'gro/ ngas bdag byed chog zer bar/ a phas da lo khrid 'gro rgyu yin/ cig thang na nga tsho sang lo lha sar 'gro dgos ’zer/ rjes nas yang nged gsum a zhang nor bkra tshang nas nyin 'gar bsdad/ 'gro ran khar ‘‘a ne rtam khos/ nus kho bskyur shog dang / sang lo dbyar kha bskyal yong zer bar phas ‘‘da lo khrid 'gro rgyu yin/ cig byas na sang lo nga tsho lha sar 'gro dgos pa 'dra/de min na dgon nang kho gnyis mnyam du yod na dga'’nyazer bar/ a nes 6‘'o sdug de/ da yang rgyun ring zhig la thug thub kyi ma redami’zer/ de nas nga tsho lam la chas te chu kha ma'i dgon pa'i phyogs su nyin gnyis la song / de ring nyin gung chu kha ma'i dgon pa'i thad kyi gru kha la slebs song / gru ba blo chos kyis nga tsho rma chu'i tshu rol tu bskyal rjes/ yar dgon pa'i nang du song / nga tsho sngar ltar a zhang rgya khor gyi khang pa'i nang du bsdad/ phyi nyin nas a bu 'ja' pe dgon nang du tshogs la song / de dus dge bskos wa sang brjes tshar la/ da ni dge bskos 'jang 'jug yin/ de'i skor a zhang rgya khor gyis ‘‘'ja' kho/ da ni dge bskos brje tshar ba red/ rang sde rang dgon gi grwa pa/ rang dgon nang du mi 'tshogs par 'gro sa gang yang yod pa ma red/ khyod sang nyin nas dgon nang du tshogs la song / nus kho 'dod pa red/ da grwa pa byed ma thub pa redami’ces bshad song /a bu 'ja' pe de nas bzung tshogs su song / a pha nged gnyis/ nyin rgyun dgon nang dang / mtha' ba'i nang nas nye sa khyim mtshes sar ru nyul du song zhing / a phas khong tsho la bla brang go re dang / sil tog 'ga' re sprad/ mtshams rer nga rang khyim 'dug dang ja ma byas/ a pha ru nyul du 'gro gi 'dug dgun zla 'go ma'i nang zhig yin rgyu red/ ri thang kun skya bor gyur 'dug nyin gung zhig la dgon pa'i g.yas lung / chos lung gong ma ltag ring khri pa tshang gi 'gram nas me shor te/ dgon pa'i g.yas ri ngos su thon/ grwa pa thams cad dgon pa'i skor 225

skeku 0nga snye5 0 ma7gu675i 2wa5 lam du gral bsgrigs nas me mi yong ba'i sngon 'gog byas yod la/ me 'bar nas skor lam nang cung ma slebs gong du grwa pa thams cad rgyugs nas me bsad/ de dus rlung 'tshub cig brgyab yong bar/ me lce dgon pa'i rgyab ri ngos nas 'bar te nyag brgyab song / dgon pa'i rgyab ri ngo tsha dkar nag byas yod pa las/ mes dgon par skyon ci yang ma byas/ grwa pa tshos chos skyong srung mas me kha bskor song ba red zer gyi 'dug la/ de la nga rang yang yid ches kyi 'dug cung ma 'gor bar gangs char 'dres ma zhig gis me bsad song /da thengs kyi le tshan bshad mtshams 'di nas 'jog rgyu yin la/ khyed rnams kyis sems gtad nas gzigs par thugs rje che zhu/ le tshan rjes ma'i nang du/ da rung rang sems dga' skyo sdug gsum gyi lo rgyus mang po mu mthud nas zhu rgyu yod pas/ khyed rnams kyis sngar ltar zhib gzigs mdzad par dga' bsu zhu// //

le'u bzhi pa/sa mthar 'khyams pa'i zlesgro sems/dus chen po 'gyur na gyod ya med/le tshan lja bcu pa/dus ngan tshes pa'i snga ltas/ yul dmag mi 'bud ka med/de ring kha sang zhig la/ mi thug mi/ khyi thug khyi/ skad cha yag po gcig kyang go rgyu mi 'dug kha sang mgo log sbas dga' ru nang du slebs song / khos ‘‘da rgya dmag zer na'ang 'dra/ rgya than slebs nyer 'dug sog sde nas nyin dkar mi gsod bzhin 'dug mtshan mo khyi gsod bzhin 'dug zer/ mgo btags na ske breg la/ rir bros na rgyud pa gcod/ rgya mā chi tshang red zer bzhin 'dug ces skad cha mang po bshad/ a phas bzang ngan ci yang ma bshad/ dgong mo a khu khyo dge yong nas/ ‘‘a rogs 'dul kho/ da res yong ba'i rgya 'di tshang gis rgas pa 'bu dong nang g.yug rgyu dang / byis pa tshor zho rgyags tshad re blud nas/ khang thog nas 'phangs te bkad 'jog gi zer/ ngo ma de 'dra zhig yin nam’ zer bar/ phas ‘‘de yang bden gyi ma red go/ bcings 'grol dmag nga tshos mang po rig myong / de 'dra ngan pa zhig byas e yong / rgya mā chi tshang yin na de ltar byed kyang srid zer/ nga rang lo chung yang / skad cha 'di tsho go rjes sems ha cang mi bde ba zhig red/ yang rjes nas a zhang mgon tshe slebs nas/ 6‘rgya 227

miku 0ba 5 5 la 09la5 lichu3 5 dmag bcings 'grol dmag gis mig 'phrul gyis mtshan gcig la/ rma chu'i thog ko ba rlon pa'i zam pa 'phangs 'dug mda' tshan sde ba rgya dmag gis shul med byas tshar 'dug da ni 'brong mda' rgya sgar thog stong dmag mang po slebs 'duga.a mchog rgya rag gis gdong blangs nas bkag med na/ nga tsho'i sde ba'ang mda' tshan ltar tshar rgyu red ces mang po bshad/ da ni nyin re bzhin je skrag red/ nga min na mi che chung thams cad skrag dgos pa gcig red 'dug la/ gsol 'debs re byed pa las thabs gzhan ci yang med/ a zhang rgya khor gyis ‘‘bla ma dkon mchog dus ni 'gyur kho thag red/ da lo skar ma du ba mjug ring shar bas mi tshad/ kha sang de sngon nub phyogs nas/ sprin sga ri shar 'dug 'khrug pa chen po zhig rgyag kho thag red/ sprin sga ri shar rgyu ni 'khrug pa rgyag pa'i rtags red/ sngon ma thengs gcig shar nas/ u ru su dkar dmar 'khrug pa red/ da ni dus ngan tshes ran dus/ dgon pa'i mthu gtor ma zhig gis ngo ga nas lon zer bar/ a zhang gis ‘‘khyod kyis kyang de 'dra'i smyo bshad ma byedanya ‘‘a/ngas smyo bshad gser yum yin na/ kha sang dgon pa'i gtor rgyag byas song /gtor ma ma 'phangs gong nas mgo chad song / da rung a lags ltag ring tshang gi gzan gyi sne mo mes tshigs song zer/ de dus ngan tshes rtags min na ci red zer nyal/ a zhang rgya khor gyis ‘‘bla ma dkon mchog da mtha' ci red shes rgyu ma red/ dmag rgyag dgos ma thug na cung e drag 'dzing sar slebs dus nga tsho 'dra zhig gis/ rgya dmag gi ngo lon rgyu ma red/ ru sde dgon gsum kun la chag sgo yong rgyu red zer nas/ sems mi bde bar bsdad/ da ni phyi nang mi che chung su yin yang dus 'gyur dus log skor gyi skad cha ma gtogs ci yang bshad rgyu med/ nga'i sems la yang / bshad mi shes pa'i 'jigs snang zhig skyes song la/ dus log zer ba ci yin/ dus log dgos don ci yin/ mi che chung med par dus log par 'di 'dra skrag dgos don ci yin/ dus log na nga tsho'i mgo la chag sgo ci 'dra yong rgyu yin nam sogs rang sems 'khrul ba'i 'dang rgyag 228

ga5 tshe(ḍa rdzi nyi lu dang / lan 'debs mi thub pa'i 'dri tshig re re bzhin/ mi dran dgu dran byas song / ngas ‘‘a pha dus log song na nga tsho gang du 'dug dgos pa red/mi’dris par/ a phas ‘‘nga tsho dgon nang 'dug chog red/mi yang ‘‘'o na dgon par dus log song na’ zhes dris pa na/ ‘‘kha ngan ma bshad/ da ja skol shog ’zer bar/ nga rang ja skol du song / nga'i sems la kha ngan min na/ da ni dus log rgyu yin pa mi che chung sus kyang ha go 'duga'on kyang dus ni ji ltar log pa/ dus log na su la phan zhing / su la gnod pa/ phyug po sprang por bsgyur zhing / sprang po rgyu thog slebs pa'i dus shig log rgyu yin na/ bzang po rnams tshe thung la/ ngan pa thams cad ngo che ba'i dus zhig log rgyu yin/ rgya dmag gis btsan gyis bod kyi dus 'di bsgyur ba yin na/ bod 'di las ngan pa'i dus ngan mgor lhung ba yin/ skad ngan gcig 'phro gcig red/ ngo ma ha go ba'i lan gcig gis kyang 'debs thub kyi med/ da ni rang rang ci bsam gang 'dod bshad chog la/ dus ngan tshes pa'i nyin zhig chag sgo yod tshad kun gyi mgo la yong rgyu red/ de'i nyin mo sus kyang lan 'debs mi dgos par/ rang rang gi las bsags pa'i 'bras bu ltar skyid sdug ci yod/ tshang ma rang rang gi mgo la khur dgos rgyu red sogs dran song /a pha sde ba'i nang du song / a bu 'ja' pe tshogs nas nang la slebs dus/ ‘‘de ring dge bskos 'jang 'jug gis rgya dmag slebs nyer yod pa red zer/ rma sde chu kha ma'i skyes pa thams cad yul dmag bud nas song tshar ba red la/ bla ma dpon po tsho'i bka' red/ skyes pa gcig kyang dgon nang 'dug mi chog su bsdad na des dgon par gnod byed bsam ni yin zer/)mi ngas ‘‘a pha slebs na ci yod’nyaces dris pa na/ ‘‘a pha da rung yong rgyu ma red/ ngas a ne rtam kho la/ a pha yong na dgon nang du mtshan mo shog ces skad bskur yod zer la/ de'i skabs a zhang rgya khor slebs nas ‘6da ma bzang ba red/ chu kha ma'i dmag dang rgya dmag 'dzings tshar song zer/ nor bkra pha bu thams cad 229

leshu 0ci 0 5 la 8 rgyal5 ikhye3la5 dmag nang du song 'dug da pha shi bu shi yong gi red/ khyed kyi pha da rung mi yong/de dmag la song ba e yin namanya zer bar/ ngas ‘‘a zhang khyod dmag la 'gro e dgos dris par/ a zhang gis grwa pa dmag la 'gro dgos pa ma red de/ sangs rgyas bstan dgra 'di tshos dgon sde med pa byas na/ grwa pa yin yang mi 'dzing ka med red/ bla ma dkon mchog 'di 'dra zhig mgo la mi yong bar shog nyaces zer/mtshan mo nyal rjes/ ngas rmi lam ngan pa zhig rmis song la/ du ba nag po 'khrig pa'i mtshams shig nas/ rgya min bod min rta ba brgya stong mang pos me mda' khyer nas rgyug 'dug par/ skabs rer me mda' 'phen res byas nas/ mi zer ba lcang ma 'breg 'breg byed 'dug nga rang la gab sa med par/ ngu 'bod byed zhor du a pha'i rjes su rgyugs kyang / rkang pa gnyis rtsa 'khum ste gom pa spo mi thub la/ a pha zhes bos kyang / a pha'i gdong la khrag bzhur zhor du sngon la rgyugs song / ngas kyang skad bkyag nas ngu zhor ‘‘a pha’ zhes bos pas de dus ‘‘nus kho/ a rogs khyod ci red thal zer zhor/ a bu 'ja' pes nga la khu tshur brgyab nas gnyid dkrog song / nga'i snying da rung lding 'dug la/ skrag snang chen po skyes song / de'i skabs khang pa'i rgyal sgo brdung song / a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyis ‘‘a pha slebs song zer zhor/ yar langs nas sgo khar brgyugs/ a pha rkang thang du me mda' khur yod la/ sgo nas 'dzul dus 6‘nged tshang la 'grul pa e yodanya zer/ a bu 'ja' pes/ ‘6'grul pa med/ nged gnyis gcig pu yin zer nas/ nged gsum nang la slebs/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘a pha khyod dmag la ma song ngam zhes dris/ ngas ‘‘khyed gnyis bskyur nas 'gro rgyu ga nas yodami’zer/‘6dgon pas ha go na yang chad pa gcod rgyu red/) a bus de ltar bshad pa na/phas 6‘dgon pa'i rang mgo thon gyi yod pa ma red/ chad pa gcod thub kyi ma red/nus kho khyod sang nyin song nas a zhang rgya khor bos shoganyanyazer/ ngas ‘‘a pha khyod sgo la ma 'bud ma gtogs 'dzin rgyu red ’ces bshad/ ‘‘drag ni red/ khyod kyis a zhang bos shog sa pha khyim nas 'dug chog sa pha slebs pa su gcig la ma 230

zham5snye (li spode skyi yog shodami’zer/ phyi nyin ngas a zhang bos nas yong / a zhang gis ‘‘khyod 'di ci 'dra'i smyonabazhig red/ dmag la ma song na/ sang nyin kha tshur 'khor nyin/ sde dgon gnyis kyi ngo ya yong ngam/ dgon pas ha go na nyan ni ma redami zer bar phas ‘‘nga'i zhi lu gnyis 'di 'dra chung gi/ dmag nang du 'gro mi thub/ skyes pa tsho dpon po'i bka' ltar/ lo bco lnga yan chad dang / drug cu man chad dmag la bud nas sog po'i sa thog tu song tshar 'dug da rung dmag gis rgya'i sa zhib blta mkhan dang / rgya dmag brgya kha zhig brlags tshar zer/ gtsos sa blo'i kha zhabs gi bla ma dpon po yod tshad/ kha nyin rgya nag tshang gis mgo bskor nas bzung tshar 'dug sa mchog lha sde sa cha nas dgon pa yod tshad gtor tshar 'dug rgya dmag lnga brgya nang / kha sang nas nga tsho'i sde ba'i thog la yong bzhin 'dug phal cher nangs dus slebs rgyu red/ da ni mgo 'dogs sa med kho thag red’’ces skad cha mang po bshad song / da ni nyan na skrag 'dar dgos pa zhig red/ a zhang rgya khor gyis ‘‘dgon pas mjal dar phul nas mgo 'dogs byas tshar song / grwa pa gcig gis rgya la ngan pa byed mi chog zer/ kha sang nas skad cha bshad tshar song / khyod kyi me mda' 'di skung shog ma gtogs/ rgya dmag gis mthong chog gi ma red/ a ha bo/ da ma bzang ba red/ kha thal bas gcig chod/ dus log song ba redami ces bshad cing / ma gzhi mgo btags rjes bde mo byas nas 'dug bsam pa'i re ba yod tshad stong log tu gyur song / ngas ‘‘a pha khyod khyim nas gab sdod/ dgon pa'i mi sna yong na/ ngas sgo mi phye ’zer bar a phas ‘‘dgon pa ni da yong khom med pa los shes/ sang nyin nas tshar ba red/ rgya dmag tshor sgo mi phye ba tsam gyis khog gi ma red/ ya da drag gi/ rma sdechu ma'i dgon sde chos gsum ci red na'ang / nged pha bu tsho de las lhag ci yong / da ni rang gi las red/ g.yol sa gab sa cang yod rgyu ma red ’ces sems mi bde ba'i skad cha mang po bshad song / 'di'i nyin gcig gnyis ring sems mi bde zhing / rgya dmag slebs rgyu red bsam nas skrag dgos la/ a pha dmag la ma song bar khyim 231

leku 0na 5 5 la 9la ikhyesel la gab yod pa dgon pas ha go rgyu red bsam nas skrag dgos/ yang skabs rer bsam na/ a pha dang a bu 'ja' pe gnyis yod pas nga skrag dgos don ci yod bsam 'dug sa pha skrag rgyu med par/ mtshan mo sgo la bud nas nam langs kha ma gtogs nang la mi slebs par/ gang la song ba dang ci zhig byed pa mi shes//le tshan nga gcig pa/mgo btags byas pa sdug gyong / chag sgo gnam lhung byung song / mdang dgong char pa babs pas/ de ring snga dro sa 'jam ri dngas/ nyi ma ha cang dron po red/ dgon pa'i mdun gyi bkra shis chos gling thang du smug long 'thib pa'i khrod du/ston kha'i me tog dkar ser dmar ljang ha cang mang la/ tshang ma nyi ma'i phyogs su 'khor zhing / dri zhim gyis gang sar khyab ste/ bya bye'u 'ba' 'bu tshos kyang / skad sna tshogs sgrog bzhin/ rang rang gis skyid sdug mi 'dra ba'i 'tsho ba bskyal nas bsdad yod/ nga rang gis sngar ltar ja bskol nas ‘‘a pha yar longs/ ja 'thung zer bar/ phas ‘6'o ya/ a ne dkar thos mar phyur re bskyal song ngamanya zer/ ngas ‘‘kha sang nas bskyal song / da rung 'o ma bskyal song / ngas de ring 'o ja bskol yodaminyaces bshad/ de'i skabs a bu 'ja' pe rgyal sgo nas/'tshab 'tshub nyil le nang du 'dzul zhor du/ ‘‘a pha/ a pha rgya dmag chu khar slebs song/ de ring 'tshog rgyu mi 'dug de'i 'phror ser phreng bsgrigs nas rgya dmag la sngon bsu byed dgos pa red zer ’zer bar/ a pha yar langs nas/6‘da de red/ dgon pa mgo 'dogs rgyu red de/ sdug gyong yin kho thag redami zer/ngas ‘6a pha mgo btags na ske gcod rgyu e redami ces dris par/ ‘‘ske gcod rgyu ma red de/ da dgon pa bshig rgyu redanya zer/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘dge bskos 'jang 'jug gis mgo btags na dgon pa bshig gi ma red zer/ mgo ma btags na mi gsod/ rgyu 'phrog dgon pa gtor gyi red zer’ zer bar a 232

ma5 (khri ༅ skyi yo phas ‘‘da snying rje/ bod 'di glen pa red/ dgon pa bshig ma bsam na dmag yong nas ci byed/ bla brang dgon pa yang gtor tshar 'dug zer/ nga tsho'i dgon chung bya tshang 'dra bo 'di/ shul du bskyur mi yong ba kho thag red’’zer/ de dus a bu 'ja' pes nga la ‘6mgyogs po ja 'thung / nged gnyis rgya dmag la blta ru 'gro’ zer/ ngas ‘‘a bu 'ja' pe/ de ring yong ba'i rgya dmag ni bla brang du yod pa de dang / na ning nga tsho dgon nang yong ba'i bcings 'grol dmag e red’ ces dris/ 6‘ma red/ bcings 'grol dmag gi rgyal po ma'o kru'u zhi'i dmag red/ da res yong ba ni rgya than dmar po'i 'dre dmag red’ zer/ ngas ‘6rgya dmag gis nged gnyis bzung e 'gro ’zhes dris par/ a phas ‘‘rgya dmag gis byis pa tshor gang yang byed kyi ma red de/ thag nyer ma bcar )zer/ de nas a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis sgor bud/ chos lung 'gab ma'i rgya zor thod mgo na mi mang po zhig gis rma chu'i kha la bltas nas bsdad yod/ dgon nang dang mtha' ba'i nang yod tshad nas mi tsho don med du yar rgyug mar rgyug byed bzhin 'duganged gnyis thod mgo la 'byor dus/ rma chu'i chu kha pha ri na/ rgya dmag ser nyob be/ gral bsgrigs nas chu la brgal ba'i gra sgrig byed bzhin 'dug mi zhig gis ‘‘rgya dmag stong rkyal byas nas chur 'bud rgyu redanya zer/ yang gcig gis ‘‘gru pa blo chos kyis de ring rgya dmag la gru 'phen rogs ma byas pa redami’sogs zer zhor du bltas bsdad/ de dus rgan po zhig gis ‘‘a rogs tsho/ da 'dir 'dug mi nyan par/ rgya dmag gi ri mgo bzung 'dug bsam nas/ me mda' 'phen srid’ zer bar mi mang che ba ri rtsar babs song / a bu nged gnyis kyis da rung thod mgo nas bltas bsdad/ de dus chu'i pha rol nas rgya dmag gis me mda' re zung 'phangs song la/ rgya dmag yod tshad lag sprel byas te/ rma chu'i nang du mchongs song / chen po ma 'gor bar/ mang che ba re re bzhin rma chu'i tshur rol tu bud song /de dus dgon pa'i grwa ba thams cad/ ser phreng bsgrigs nas/ dgon 233

leku 0ci 0 la mi༅la5 i 33la5 pa'i zhabs kyi lam chen sne na bsgugs yod/ chu kha nas skad gtong mkhan zhig slebs yong la/ khos ‘6rgya dmag mang che ba chur bud tshar song / gru pa blo chos bzung tshar song / rgya dmag lnga drug cig chu nang shi nas ro khur 'dug’’ces bshad/ der blta mkhan mang che ba rir bros song / nga tsho cung skrag cing / rgya dmag 'gram nas ma mthong na 'gro 'dod med par bltas nas bsdad/ dgon pa'i grwa mang dang bla ma dge bskos tshos lag tu dar kha bzung nas bsgugs yod/de dus rgyang nas mi zhig gis ‘‘da slebs yong gi 'duganyanyazer bar/ mi mang 'ur dir nyil ler song / rma chu'i kha'i nags mtshams nas rgya dmag brgya tsam gral bsgrigs te glu dbyangs len zhor du gshar yong / nga tsho'i thad kur slebs dus dmag yod tshad kyis me mda' phrag tu khur zhing / gom pa mnyam spos byas te 'gro bar/ mtshar ngam chen po zhig red/ dmag mang che ba'i gon pa da rung skam med/ngas ‘‘ha go song / a bu 'di bcings 'grol dmag red’ zer bar/ ‘‘red/'di rgyal po ma'o kru'u zhi'i dmag red/ skrag dgos pa ma red’ zer/ de'i sngon nas bcings 'grol dmag dgon nang nas/ phar 'gro tshur yong byed pa mang po rig myong la/ da rung nga tsho la rgya sran dang zhim po sprad myong / de ring dmag mang gshar zhor/ gdong 'dzum gyis gang nas nga tsho la blta bzhin yod pas/ da ni skrag snang spa tsam med par dmag gi rtsib tu song / dgon 'dabs su slebs pa na dgon tho'i bla spral tshos rgya dmag la dar kha phul ba dang / rgya dmag gis kyang dar kha len zhoro dang thal mo rdeb zhor/ dgon pa'i bla sprul tshar dar kha phul/ rgya dmag rjes ma da rung rma chu kha nas yong gi yod la/ mi ༷dzas dmag sum brgya tsam zhig yod rgyu red zer 'dug de nas dgon pa'i bla spral rnam pas dga' dga' 'dzum 'dzum gyis rgya dmag khrid nas dgon par spyon song / nga tshos da rung lam kha nas dmag rjes ma yong bar bltas nas bsdad/ rgya dmag dgon par slebs rjes/ dgon pa'i mgon khang dang a lags brag sgom pa'i gzim khang / da rung grwa khang mang po bzung nas nang du bsdad cing / khang thog 234

5 ( ba 43myi lum (lcags kyi ka ba mang po btsugs song / de'i dgong mo dgon pa'i dgun chos chosar nang du/ rgya dmag gi tshogs 'du 'tshogs song la/ grwa pa dang dgon pa'i mtha'aba'i mi skya pho mo thams cad chos ra'i nang 'dus yod/ rgya dmag gis me mda' bzung nas chos ra'i mtha' nas bskor yod/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis tshogasas ru song / rgya dpon zhig gis gtam bshad par/ skad bsgyur brgyud nas/ ‘6khyed tsho'i dgon pas de ring dga' bsu zhus par bka' drin che/ tshang ma skrag mi dgos/ nga tsho rgya bod khyim gcig yin/ nga tsho nyin lnga drug nas 'gro rgyu yin/mi’zhes skad cha mang po bshad/ tshogs 'du grol ran khar yang skad bsgyur brgyud nas ‘‘do dgong nas bzung dgon nang gi grwa pa dang / sde nang gi mi yod tshad/ mtshan mo yar 'gro mar 'gro byed mi chog dmag gis mtshan mo skor g.yeng byas nas 'gro rgyu red/ khyod tsho mtshan du 'gro rgyu mang nas bsad song na 'gan rang gis khur dgos/ sang nyin snga dro dbyar chos chos ra'i nang du tshogs 'du 'tshog dgos/ sde dgon thams cad kyi mi gcig kyang ma yong na mi chog mi yong mkhan ha go na nyes chad dang / yang na btson du 'jug rgyu yinanyanyazhes go mi 'dod pa'i skad cha mang po bshad song la/ skad cha 'di tsho go rjes nga'i sems su sngar byung ma myong ba'i 'jigs skrag cig skyes byung / ci zhig la skrag pa rang gis kyang bshad mi shes shing / da lta sngon la kha yag mang po bshad pa ni/ mgo skor ba yin rgyu red bsam song / de ring nam langs dus nas/ dgon pa'i ltag 'og kun tu rgya dmag gis me mda' bzung nas skor ba byed 'dug de ring nas kha sang dar kha len skabs kyi gdong gi 'dzum mdangs de med par/ khong khro'i mig sdang gis phar 'gro tshur yong gi mi tshang mar cer 'dug de dus khya dge zer ba'i grwa pa zhig gis skad chen pos/ ‘‘'o/ rgya dmag gis dgon pa'i grwa pa thams cad/'du khang nang du shog zer gyi 'dug grwa pa tsho 'du khang nang du shog zer bzhin 'dugazi’zer zhor 'bod zhor byed bzhin 'dug sa khu sngon tshes ‘‘a rogs skad cha cang go rgyu e 'dug ces dris par/ khos ‘‘skad cha mang po ci go ma song nyanyazer 235

leku spyo4 0 khu 81 rgyal5 ikhye3la51zhor du/ yang skad dma' mos ‘‘da ni mi nyan kho thag red/ dge bskos 'jang 'jug dang / khri pa tsho kha sang dgong mo nas bzung tshar song / de ring yang mi 'dzin rgyu red zer/ da 'du khang nang song dang ha go rgyu red zer/ ‘‘tshogs la ma yong na e drag nyaces dris par/ khos ‘‘'o gser yum nyan ni red na’ zer zhor du phyin song / nga'i sems su dus log pa e yin na/ mdang dgong bka' drin che/ rgya bod khyim gcig yin zer ba/ rdzun yin pa red/ de ring nas bla ma dge bskos bzung 'dug 'di bcings 'grol dmag ma yin pa e yin nam/ 'di ngo ma rgya dmar 'dre dmag zer ba e yin nam bsam zhor du/ 'dang mang po rgyag dgos byung / ci byas kyang go ba mi lon kho thag red/ de nas nga rang yang / grwa pa tsho'i rjes ded nas 'du khang sgo khar slebs/ de dus dmag thun pas nga rang bkag song / cung tsam nas skad bsgyur ba yong nas byis pa 'du khang nang 'gro mi chog zer la/ ngas sgo rtsa nas bltas bsdad/ 'du khang nang du grwa pa rnams rang rang khang tshan ltar/ gor gor byas nas 'tshogs 'dug la/ sus kyang kha mi grag par bsdad yod/ cung tsam nas rgya dpon zhig gis skad bsgyur brgyud skad cha bshad pa ‘‘da khyod tshos kha ma grag pa byed thub kyi ma red/ dgon pa 'di dgos dang mi dgos khyod tshos bshad dgos pa red/ rgya dpon gyis bshad bzhin 'dug kha mi grag pa ni mi dga' ba red/ mi dga' ba ni ngo log byed bsam pa red/ khyod tsho ngo log bsam pa min na kha grag dgos’’zhes bshad/ de'i skabs rgya dmag gnyis kyis dge bskos 'jang 'jug lag lcags brgyab ste/ khrid yong nas lha khang nang phyin song / smad g.yog cig ma gtogs gzan sham ci yang gon med la/ a khu tshe chos kyis ‘6da 'di red/ kha sang dga' bsu byas pa'i drin lan 'di red/ da kha grag na'ang dgon pa bshig rgyu red/ kha ma grag na'ang dgon pa bshig pas mi tshad mi 'dzin rgyu red’’zer/ yang a khu bstan rgyam gyis ‘‘da kho tshos ci bsam na de gyis/ bshig na bshig song / ma bshig zer sa yod pa ma redaminyazer/ de dus skad bsgyur ba yong nas ‘‘da khyod kyis de 'dra ma bshad/236

ma5 (ḍa 6tshe nyi lu de ring khyed tshos dgon pa e dgos zhes 'dri bzhin 'dug’ zer bar tshe chos kyis‘‘dgon pa los dgos/ khyod bod pa zhig yin pas shes tshod red/ de ring dgos zer sa zhig med pa khyed kyis mthong ma song ngam’’zer/ a khu shes rab kyis 6‘rgya 'dis 'di 'dra smyo bshad byed kyi 'dug dgon pa'i grwa pa rnams la khyod tshor dgon pa e dgos zer rgyu yod dam/ 'di dgon pa gtor bsam nas/kha g.yar sa btsal ba redami ces bshad pas skad bsgyur bas ci yang ma bshad par phyin song / ngas sgo rtsa nas skad cha thams cad go song / nga'i sems su ya snying rje/ dus 'gyur zer na'ang chag sgo gnam lta bu dgon pa'i mgo la lhung tshar song / da ci bshad kyang sdug gyong red bsam song //le tshan nga gnyis pa/drag po'i 'jigs snang 'og nas/ rang dgon rang la bshig bcugadagon pa'i grwa pa tsho sngar ltar/ 'du khang nang du 'tshogs nas/ dgon pa dgos dang mi dgos zer nas gros byed du bcug cung tsam 'gor rjes rgya dpon de yong ste skad bsgyur brgyud nas/ 6‘da khang tshan gzhan pa tshos dgon pa mi dgos zer/ khyod tshos ci bsam yod/ dgos dang mi dgos thag gis chodanya zer bar/ a khu sngon tshe khong khro langs nas ‘‘da khyod kyi kha thal bas chod/dgon pa mi dgos sus zer/ ya sus zer’)zer bar/ skad bsgyur gyis rgya dpon la ci bshad ma shes/ rgya dpon khong khro langs nas/ ‘‘da khyod 'dug re med na sgor budanya’zer zhor/ lag brda byas te dmag gnyis yong nas a khu sngon tshe btsan gyis khrid song / a khus kha phyir 'khor nas 6‘bstan dgra tsho/ da khyod tshos ci bsam gyis/ kha gso khom med rgyu bstan dgra tshomi zer bar/ dmag gnyis kyis a khu drud nas sgor bud song / rgya dpon gyis skad bsgyur brgyud nas/ ‘‘ya 237

les 0ra 5 5 la 8 4la5 ikhye3la5 da sgor 'gro bsam mkhan su yod/ de min na kha grag dgos nyazer bar/ grwa pa 'ga' res ‘‘ya da khyod tshos bsam pa ltar gyis/ nga tshos mi dgos zer thabs yod pa ma red nyazer/ a khu mkhar dges ‘‘ya da mi dgon gnyis ka mi mtshams kho thag red/ de las dgon pa mi dgos zer na/ mi ma shi na dgon pa dar ba'i nyin re los yodanyanyazer/ rgya dpon gyis skad bsgyur brgyud nas ‘‘da khyod tsho thams cad kyis dgon pa mi dgos pa de blor babs pa red dam )zer bar/ grwa pa la las ‘‘'o red’)zer/ mang che bas ‘‘da khyod tshos ci bsam gyis nyazer/ de nas cung 'gor rjes grwa pa mang che ba mnyam du 'tshogs te/ rgya dpon gyi gdong 'dzum gyis gang nas/ skad bsgyur brgyud de ‘‘de ring 'tshogs pa ha cang bzang / da lta ni grwa pa mang che ba dang / mang tshogs tsho'i re ba ltar/ dgon pa 'di mi dgos zer/ khyod tsho'i re ba de nga tsho yang blo babs pa yin nyazhes skad cha mang po bshad rjes/ yang ‘‘de ring 'dir yod grwa pa rnams kyis rogs byas te/ 'du khang nang gi lha sku dang / chos yig rgyu rdzas tshang ma phyogs gcig la spangs dgos la/ nyin gnyis gsum mtshams nas rma chu rdzong thog la bskyal dasdukos zer/ skad cha bshad ma tshar gong grwa pa mang che ba 'ur dir nyil ler yar langs song la las skad chen pos ‘‘bshig dgos na khyod tshos bshig nga tshos mi bshig kho thag yin )zer la/ yang la las da ‘‘nga tshor mgo g.yog nas dgon pa bshig rgyu red))zer/ ‘6da khyod tshos bshig sdod/ nga tsho 'gro yi yin sogs/ mi bshad dgu bshad kyi 'ur cha brgyab/ de skabs gang nas yong ba ma shes/ rgya dmag mang pos 'du khang phyi nang kun bskor nas/ me mda'i khog tu mde'u ded nas 'duga'adu khang rgyang mthong kha la rgya dmag gnyis gsum gyis ci kon me mda' bzhag nas grwa pa la gtad 'dug phag shir/ phag shir glo bur du me mda' gnyis brgyab song / ngas yar bltas na/ rgya dpon gyis thung mda' yis gnam la 'phangs song / khos skad bskyur brgyud nas/ ‘‘thams cad mar sa la sdod/ dgon pa 'di mi dgos zer mkhan khyed tsho red/ da ni khyed tsho dga' yang ma dga' yang 238

ga0 ('i malpi/lu bshig dgos pa red/ sus bka' brtsi mi 'dod na yar longs shogaminyazer/ glo bur du me mda' 'phangs pa'i 'jigs snang dang btsan shed kyis mgo gnon 'ogagrwa pa thams cad mgo bsgur nas sa thog tu bsdad/ de dus dmag yong nas sngon gyi grwa pa kha shas btsan gyis ded de/ 'du khang mchod khri'i rtsib tu song nas/ mchod sgam nang gi sku 'dra dang / bka' bstan 'gyur sogs sku gsung thugs rten rnams sa thog tu 'phen du bcug 'du khang nang du yod pa'i grwa pa dang / 'du khang sgo kha na bkag yod pa'i mang tshogs kyi nang du ngu 'bod dang / ho 'debs mkhan mang tsam yod pas/ 'ur lhang nge 'dra zhig red/ lo lon 'ga' res 'du khang sgo nas phyag 'tshal 'dug de dus dmag tsho gcig yong nas/ sgo rtsa'i mang tshogs mang che ba btsan po byas nas ded song / rgan gon 'ga' re ma song ba rnams/ btsan gyis sa thog la 'dug tu bcug nga rang yang sgo rtsar bsdad nas bltas bsdad/ 'du khang nang grwa pa lo che ba rnams phyogs gcig la bkag yod la/ grwa pa mang pos sngar ltar dgon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten dang / mchod cha sogs phyogs gcig la spangs 'dug sku 'dra che ba rnams mchod khri mtho sa nas 'phangs te/ mthil shing ṭwāṃg brdab na sgug sgra ha cang chen po yod/ de dus 'du khang ltag 'og kun nas thal 'tshub nyil le 'dra byed kyi 'dug cing / kha chag zer ba'i grwa pa zhig gis thag pa ring po zhig khyer nas/ btsan khang nang gi chos rgyal sku yi ske la skon nas 'then pas/ chos rgyal sku 'khor bcas pa khrog dir nyil ler bshigs nas sa thog tu brdab song / mi mang pos bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen zer nas gsol 'debs byed la/ skrag snang ha cang chen po skyes 'duganga'i sems su ci 'dra'i grwa pa snying chen/ gshin rje chos rgyal ske la thag pa brgyab nas drud phod pa/ kho phog thug 'gro bar mi skrag pa/ mi 'dre ngo ma red snyam song /cung tsam nas kha chag dang rogs pa grwa pa tshos/ chos rgyal gyi 'dam sku drud yong nas/ thal 'tshub nyil le 'du khang nang du spangs yod pa'i sku 'dra tsho'i nang du 'phangs song / de dus nga'i sems su dus zlon rtsib nas kha chen po grag mi phod 239

leku 0nga 5 5 0rgya 5 i rme la pa'i/ gshin rje chos rgyal/ de ring thal 'tshub nyil le drud song yang / gang yang byed rgyu med pa de mtshar po red/ lha 'dre thams cad de ring gang zhig la chas song ba red/ 'o da ni dus log pa ngo ma red/ dus log nyin/ lha yis phan 'dogs pa'i bkod pa med la/ 'dre yis gnod byed pa'i nus pa yang med pa yin rgyu red snyam/ yang 'dang re brgyab na nga ni mi lam 'gro med pa zhig red/lha rten 'di tsho yar bzhengs ba'i skabs nga slebs ma myong / dus rgyun du lha chos rten gsum 'di tshor zhib tu mjal ma myong / de ring bshig pa'i nyin nga rang 'di ru slebs song la/ sku 'dra re re bzhin mchod khri'i thog nas bkog ste sa thog tu 'phen pa dang / chos thum re re bzhin dpe khri'i steng nas blangs te thang la 'phen pa thams cad mthong song / grwa pa mang po zhig gis dngangs skrag dang 'tshab 'tshub ngang / phyi 'dang med par bshig gi 'dug khyo dges bka' 'gyur dum pa zhig sa thog tu bzhag nas/ skad chen pos ngu 'bod byas te/ ‘‘a ha bo/nga'i mgo la sdug 'di 'dra zhig ga re byas nas lhung ba red/ las lam la ma 'gro rgyu rgya ngan tshomi’zer 'dug par/ rgya dmag gnyis kyis khong khyi ro bzhin du drud nas sgo ru phud song / de dus mchod khri'i 'gram na yod pa'i grwa pa tsho skrag snang gis yar rgyug mar rgyug byed la/ dmag mang po 'du khang nang du rgyugs nas skad log mang po rgyag gi 'dug yar bltas na rgya dmag gcig gi mgo nas khrag bzhur gin yod la/ dmag gnyis kyis bskyor nas sgo ru bud song / de dus mchod khri'i 'gram du rgya dmag gis grwa pa bzhi bzung nas/ lcags brgyab ste 'du khang sgo ru khrid song / rjes nas nga tshos ha go song / da lta mchod khri thog gi grwa pa zhig gis sku 'dra 'phangs nas/ dmag de'i mgo la brgyab ste bsgyel song bas/rgya dmag gis rgyag mkhan su yin ma shes par/ der yod pa'i grwa pa bzhi bzung song ba red zer/ dgon pa'i 'du khang gi dkyil na/ phyogs so so nas bshig yong ba'i sku'adra dang / chos yig 'bor chen spangs yod/ grwa pa tshos da rung bshig gi 'dug la/ rgya dmag tshos rgyang nas blta༄ bzhin bsdad yod/ dus log na/240

ma ( na ༅ nyi pom btsan drag zer ba ni 'di 'dra ya med red/ drag shugs kyi btsan shed 'og rang gisami'adod kyang / thabs med par rang gi bstan pa rang gis bshig dgos thug song / gnyom chung rlung langs nas ci byed zer ba'i dpe ltar/ da ni lag su mgyogs byas te bshig pa las thabs gzhan med song / sngon ma bla dpon tshos dgon pa la gnod mi byed pa'i ched du/ grwa pa gcig kyang rgya la ngo log mi chog zhes bka' phab/ kha nyin ser phreng bsgrigs te dar kha dkar pos sne len byas nas mgo btags mthar/ 'bras bu ni sne len dga' bsu byed par/ bka' drin che zer ba'i tshig stong zhig dang / rang dgon rang gis rmang nas bshig bcug pa las gzhan ci yang med/ ngas 'di ltar sems nas mi dran dgu dran byed zhor du/ sku 'dra spangs yod sa nas 'gro skabs/ rkang zhabs su dog rdog cig thug song bar marno bltas tshe/ ston pa'i sku mthe bong tsam zhig red 'dugangs yar blta mar blta byas kyang / rgya dmag 'ga' res ca lag mtha' nas srung yod pa las/ nga la mnyam bzhag med pa 'dra/ ngas sku 'dra de yar blangs nas/pho bar du bcug nas do snang med khul gyis 'du khang sgo ru song / sgo khar slebs ran dus sgo bkag dmag mi zhig gis ngo 'dzum ril le nga la ci zhig bshad kyi 'dug ci zer ba ngas ma go yang / nga'i sems su sku 'dra khyer ba rig song ba e yin na bsam/ yang 'dang zhig brgyab na de yin rgyu ma red/ 'di'i rig yod na kho'i ngo la 'dzum zhig yod rgyu ma red snyam song / de'i skabs yang dmag cig thon yong nas/ bzang ngan ci yang ma bshad par/ nga rang la 'gram lcag tsha drag pa zhig brgyab ste/ nga'i rum nas ston pa'i sku blangs shing / yang sku des nga'i mgo la gcig brgyab song / de dus rgya dmag sngon ma des kha bkag nas rgyag tu ma bcug nga rang sems pham dang / yid skyo bas mig nas mchi ma bzhur song / de dus yang dmag rgan pa zhig yong nas nga'i mgo la byug zhor du/ nga rang khrid nas 'du khang sgor bud yong / nga'i sems su 'di tsho sngon chad mthong myong ba'i ya rabs spyod bzang gi bcings 'grol dmag ma yin par/ 'di da a bu 'ja' 241

leku 0ba 5 5 zha9 5 i ze3la5 pes zer ba'i 'dre dmag yin rgyu red 'dug sogs dran zhor du/ 'du khang rdo gcal thog nas phyir babs/ rgya ra'i nang slebs rjes ngas phyir bltas shig byas par/ 'du khang gi sgo g.yas g.yon gyi ka gdung thog tu ma'o kru'u zhi dang / kro'u tsung li gnyis kyi par sbyar 'dug pa rig song / nga'i sems su 'o sngon gyi bcings 'grol dmag red 'dug 'di tsho sngon dang mi 'dra/ 'di 'dra ma rabs/ 'di 'dra zhe sdang che ba ci yin nam/ da ni nga 'dra zhig gis ha mi go sems thag red bsam song //le tshan nga gsum pa/sde dgon thams cad gtor nas/ rma chu'i pha rir phud song /nga rang nang du slebs rjes/ de ring 'du khang nang du gang mthong ba tshang ma a pha la zhib tu bshad/ phas ‘‘ga pa tshos bshig song ngam’ zhes dris par/ ngas 66bshig mkhan grwa pa tsho red/ btsan khang nang gi chos rgyal gyi sku ni kha chag gis ske la thag pa brgyab nas drud song zhes bshad/ ‘‘a zhang rgya khor dang / 'ja' kho gnyis e 'duganya ces dris pa na/ ngas ‘‘a zhang rgya khor mi 'dug a bu 'ja' pe da nangs nas a ye dkar tho tshang la phyin song / da rung slebs ma song ’zhes bshad/ ngas a pha la ‘‘dgon pa bshig tshar dus/ nga tsho ci byed dgos red’ ces dris par/ phas ‘‘da ci dgos mi shes/ skyid po zhig yong rgyu med kho thag red/sde dgon yod tshad mgo la dus ngan 'di 'dra re tshes song zer/ de dus mi zhig gis rgyal sgo brdung song / nga sgo rtsar thon dus/ a khu bstan 'dzin rgyal sgo nas 'dzul yong ste/ ‘‘nus kho/ a pha e yodami dris song / ngas ‘6a pha slebs ma song nyazhes bshad/ khos ‘‘rdzun ma bshad/ a pha nged gnyis kha nyin 'grogs yong ba yin zer/ ‘6a la ku re yin/ a pha nang du yodami ces bshad par/ a phas khang pa'i dkar khung nang nas/ ‘‘ya a rogs bstan 'dzin/ da ci 'dra 'dug242

ga5 ci sredelpi yom mgyogs po nang du shog’nyazer bar/ kho rang khyim du 'dzul nas de 'dra las yong rgyu zhig mi 'dug de ring nas nyin gsum gyi mtshams nas/ mtha' ba ru yod tshadarma chu'i pha rir phud thub dgos zer/ nga tsho'i ru ba de ring nas chu khar ded tsharasong / ngas khong gnyis kyi skad char nyan bsam yang / a phas ‘‘nus kho/khyod song nas mdang gi phye cung tsam de a ne dkar tho la sprod shog zer bas/sgo la mi 'gro thabs med red/ nga'i sems su khong gnyis la ngas go mi nyan pa re bshad rgyu yod pa red bsam zhor du/ rgyal sgo phyi nas lcags long bskon/ nga rang mtha' ba'i nang du slebs pa na/ a ho ho/ mtha' ba ni ri thang gnyis ka sre log ge 'dra bzhag tshar 'dug skyes pho mo kun gyis rang gi rgyab tu khur po re khur te/ zog lug thams cad bsres nas 'ded zhor du/ byis pa tsho ngu sgra sgrog bzhin khrid nas rma chu'i chu khar 'gro bzhin 'dug nags mtshams dang ru nang na me mda'i skad 'ga' re grag 'dug la/ sgo khyi bdag med ri thang kun tu ngu zug byed cing / rta po'i mtsher skad/ 'bri mo'i ngur sgra/ lug g.yang dkar 'ba' dir nyil le gshar bzhin 'dug par/ ci blta 'di blta med par/ don med yid sems skyo ba zhig red 'dug nga rang a ne dkar tho'i sar slebs dus/ phye de a ne'i lag tu bzhag a ne dkar thos ‘‘ya nga'i zhi lu sdod dang / a nes zho blug sang nyin nas rgya mis nga tsho rma chu pha rol la ded 'gro yi red/ de nas nga tsho e thug yum 'don shes na ’zer la/ go kha na a ye lo lon zhig yod pas ‘‘'o sdug de yin na/ da ni rgya 'dre kha thal bas gcod rgyu tshos 'bu dong nang g.yug gi red/ dgon pa 'di bde mtshams yin dus/ nga las ngan pa shi thub ma song /da rgya lag nas shi rgyu redami’zer bar/ a nes ‘‘glen bshad ma byed/ rgya khong tsho la lo lon yod kyang / tshang ma 'bu dong nang g.yug gi ma red/ sdug rgyu byis pa tsho sa thag ring zhig tu khrid 'gro rgyu red zer zhes bshad/ ngas 6‘a ne/ byis pa tshor zho rgyags tshad blud tshar na bkad 'jog gi red zer ba e bden nam ’zhes dris par/ ‘‘bden gyi ma red/ bsad e yong / slob grwa'i nang bzhag 243

leku 0ci 5 5 la 8 09la5 i hri3la5 nas klad pa brje 'jog gi red zer gi’ zhes bshad 'dug skabs/ a bu 'ja' pe dang / a bu zla grags gnyis slebs song / a bu zla grags kyis 6‘a ma/ mtha' ba gong ma rgyas ded nas rma chu phar rir ni phud tshar song / ca lag mang po chus khur song / rta zog lug gsum mnyam bsres byas nas chu phar rir ded tshar song’’zer bar/ a yas ‘‘nga tsho nam 'bud dgos zer gyi 'dug nyazer/ ‘6sang nyin snga mo red zer/ gnangs nyin dgon pa'i grwa pa tsho phud dgos red zer/'o las lam la ma 'gro/ dgon pa gtor tshar dus grwa pa tsho bzung 'gro yi red/ a ha bo/ de las mgo ma zhig nas phar dmag phud song na ci ma rung ’zer gyi 'dugade nas yang a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis/ rma chu kha la blta zhor du yar dgon par yong / da ni lam kha na lo lon tsho ngu zhor du/ mi skya pho mo tsho brel 'tshub nyil le rgyug cing / chu kha na khyim tshang mang pos ca lag spangs shing / mi tsho de bskor nas bsdad yod/ rma chu'i nags mtshams nas/ rgya rdomag gis bskor nas thun pa bsdad yod la/ g.yas g.yon na khyi re zung bsad pa'i ro 'dug rgya dmag gis nged gnyis ma yong zer ba'i lag brda byas song / de nas nged gnyis/ yar nags mtshams brgyud nas dgon nang du yong / mtshams shig la nags gseb nas ‘‘'ja' pe/ nus kho zer nas 'bod 'dug nga phar cung song na nags bong zhig gi gseb nas/ gru pa blo chos kyis 'bod bzhin 'dug ‘‘nus kho khyod kyi pha nang du e yod )zer/ ngas ‘6yod/ gru ba khyod rgya dmag gis bzung song ba ma red dam zhes bshad/ ‘‘nga mdang mi mang 'dzin dus bros thub song / khyed kyi pha la nga do dgong slebs yong lab shog da khyed gnyis yar nang du song / 'di nas 'gro rgyu ma mang ma gtogs/ khyis bzung yong nyazer zhor yang nags gseb 'dzul song / a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis nang du slebs pa na/ a pha dang a zhang smon lam gnyis kyis kha brda byed bzhin 'dug sa phas ‘‘da ni dus ngan 'di 'dra zhig red/ thag rang rang gis gcod dgos pa red/ da mo 'debs rtsis rgyag cig gis cang phan gyi ma red/ mtha' bzang ngan gang yang shes ma song /244

5 ci rdzi nyi yo 'gro 'dug gi thag thams cad rang rang gis chodami zer ba la/ a zhang smon lam gyis‘‘de red/ 'gro bsam 'dug bsam rang rang red/ 'gro tshar dus bzang ngan ci red kyang / gang yang bshad rgyu yod pa ma red de/ da mo re babs na/skyabs 'jug zhu sa dgon pa ni med/ a lags la zhu thabs med/ nga dga' ldan pa tshang la thug na gcig zhu yong nyazer/ ngas 6‘a zhang da mun rub 'dug khyod song ma gtogs rgya dmag gis 'dzin yong ’zer bar/ khos ‘6'o ya gces phruga'adis bsam 'di 'dra shes kyi 'dug drag gi red a zhang gi mi rig sgrub zhwa nag ril gon yod pas/ rgyas mthong gi ma redanya zer zhor yar langs nas sgor 'bud ran kha yang ‘‘a rogs 'dul kho/ khyod gtan nas sgor ma 'bud ma gtogs/ mthong song na tshar ba redami zer nas song / nga gnyid song ba dang gnyid med pa nga rang gis kyang mi shes shing / nga'i mig lam du mtha' ba'i ru spor nas rta zog lug gsum/ lo lon byis pa dang / ri khyi sogs khra 'tshub be rma chu kha ru g.yeng nas 'gro ba shar 'dug la/ rna lam zhig nas ‘‘da dus log pa rig e song / da khyod kyis dus log pa mthong e song’ zer ba lta bu go 'dugayang mig lam du sku 'dra chen po re re bzhin nga'i thog tu log yong ba dang /mchod khri'i thog gi chos yig thams cad nga'i mgo la lhung ba shar song / de dus yang da khyod kyis dus log pa mthong e song zer ba zhig go 'dug la/ yang nas yang du go 'dug de'i skabs sgo phyes ba'i tsir sgras nga rang gnyid dkrogs song la/ mi 'ga' khyim du 'dzul yong nas/ a pha khong tshos skad cha mang po bshad 'dug nga'i skar ma'i 'od nas gru pa blo chos ma gtogs grwa pa gnyis yod pa su yin mi gsal/ nga rang gnyid khul byas nas kho tshos skad cha bshad par nyan/mang che ba mi go zhing / mtshams rer rgya dmag dgon pa'i rta/ mi mang las nyung ba dga'/ lha sa/ rgya gar sogs tshig mgo rnga can gcig kyang ma go/ ji ltar gnyid song ba ma shes/ 6‘nus kho/ yar longs ja 'thung / a phas nged gnyis a zhang tshang la song zeranyanyazer nas/ a bu 'ja' pes nga rang gnyid dkrogs 245

leku 0ci 5 5 la 9la5 ikhye3l5snyesong / ngas ‘‘a zhang tshang la song nas ci dgos’ zhes dris par/ ‘‘rta srab gnyis g.yor shoganya zer/ ‘‘nged tshang la rta med pas srab g.yar nas ci dgos zhes bshad par/ ‘‘g.yo rkyal da mgyogs po yar longs ma gtogs/ nga sngon du 'gro rgyu yinanya zer bar/ nga yar langs nas ja 'thung rjes/ nged gnyis sgor bud/dgon mtha' nas a zhang rgya khor thug song / khos ‘‘khyed gnyis gang la 'gro ba yinanyanyazhes dris song la/ a bu 'ja' pes‘6nged gnyis a phas srab g.yor shog zeranya zhes bshad/ 8‘da yar nang du 'gro dang srab ngas khur yodanya zer/ nang du slebs rjes a zhang rgya khor gyis 6‘a pha la khyod 'di ci 'dra'i rgan po smyon pa zhig red/ rma sde chu kha ma ci byung gcig mazhesangs los yin/ da 'gro sa zhig med pa 'e1sa shes/ khye1da kyis zhi lu gnyis sa mtha' zhig tu g.yugs bsam pa redaminyasogs zer bar/ a phas nang sgo brgyab song / de nas khong gnyis kyis ci bshad mi go la/ cung tsam nas a khu bstan 'dzin slebs nas nang du 'dzul song / nyin phyed khong tshos skad cha bshad tshar rjes/ a zhang dang a khu bstan 'dzin gnyis bud song /a phas khyed gnyis kyis ‘‘nga tshos skad cha ci bshad go song ngamanya dris song bar/ ngas ‘6ma go thal/ a pha da nga tsho gang la 'gro dgos pa red/ khyod sgor ma 'bud ma gtogs rgya dmag gis 'dzin rgyu redami zer bar a phas ‘‘gnangs nyin nas dgon pa'i grwa pa thams cad chu la 'bud dgos pa red/ de dus rgya dmag gis khang pa bshig rgyu red/ de'i sngon nga tsho gang zhig la 'gro thub dgos pa redami’zer/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘a pha da ni dgon pa gtor tshar song /nged gnyis 'dug sa yod pa ma red/ da res khyod gang du song yang nged gnyis khrid dgos’nyazer bar/ a phas ngas ‘‘dpon bla ma'i bka' la ma brtsis chu kha ma'i dmag nang mi 'gro ba khyed gnyis bsam nas ma song ba yin/ da khyed gnyis bskyur nas a pha 'gro sa gang yang med/ da ni shi gson skyid sdug ci byung yang / nged pha bu tsho mnyam du 'gro rgyu yin )zer/ a bus 6‘a pha da nga tsho gang 246

ma5 ( ci 43 rtsi/pog zhig la 'gro rgyu yin/ rgya dmag gis khyod mthong nyan gyi ma red/mi zer bar a phasa'adang zhig brgyab nas/ ‘‘gar 'gro da rung mi shes te/ da rogs pa tsho slebs na/ do dgong sang dgong zhig la dgon nang nas thar dgos pa redami zer/ nga rang gi sems su ci shar 'di shar med par 'dang rgyag gi nang du lhung song //le tshan nga bzhi pa/dus ngan tshes pa'i mtshan mo/ rang yul bral nas 'khyams song /a pha dang a bu 'ja' pe nged gsum sems ma bde bar/ gar 'gro gar 'dug sogs kyi skad cha bshad nas bsdad yod dus/ rgyal sgo nas a ne dkar thos 6‘a 'ja' pe/ 'dir shog dang )zer nas 'bod kyi 'dug nga rang sgo khar song nas/ ‘‘a ne/ yar khyim du 'gro zhes par/ mos ‘‘'o nus kho nga da yong khom med/ nga tsho chur 'bud dgos/ mar phyur 'di yar khyer song / khyed gnyis kyi pha rgan yod dam’ zer/ ‘‘a ne kha dro a pha khyim na yod mings de ltar bshad pa na/ mos 6‘khyod kyis a pha la shod dang / da mgyogs po gang zhig la song ma gtogs/ mdang nas rgya mis khyed kyi pha gar yod 'dri bzhin 'dug sang nyin dgon pa'i grwa pa tsho chur 'bud rgyu red/ de nas gab 'dug sa zhig yod pa ma red’nyazer/ ngas ‘‘'o ya a neri zhes bshad pa dang / mos kyang ‘‘'o ya nus pa/nga tsho da rung thug gi redanya zer zhor du phyin song / mar bltas na/ dgon pa'i skor lam na rgya dmag gi thun pa bsdad yod la/ dgon nang nas phyir 'gro mkhan tsho'i rum sngog gi 'dug ngas mgyogs po sgo brgyab nas nang du song / ngas a ne dkar the'i skad cha dang / skor lam na rgya dmag gi thun pa yod pa sogs a pha la bshad/ cung tsam 'gor rjes a phas 'dang zhig brgyab nas/ ‘‘nga tsho lha sar mjal du 'gro e red zer/ a bu 'ja' pes rgya dmag gis 'gro ru 'jug rgyu ma redanya zer/ 6‘der thabs yod pa red/ da sde dgon thams cad brlags 247

leku 0ci 4 5 la rna 0rgyal i hri3la5 tshar song / lha sar mi 'gro sa gang yang med pa red/nya’a phas de ltar bshad/ ‘6nga tsho rgya dmag gi mi mthong sa nas ri bros dgos pa e red ri’ces a bus de ltar dris pa na/ a phas8‘nga tsho gcig pu ma red/ da rung rogs pa re zung yod pa red/ mtshan dgon nang nas thar song na/ de nas drag rgyu redanya zer/ nga 'jigs skrag ha cang chen po zhig skyes song / rgya dmag gis nyin mtshan med par dgon pa bskor bsdad yod pas da rir bros sa zhig gang na yod bsam zhor du/‘‘a pha nga tsho rir bros na rgya dmag gis gsod rgyu red/ de nas nga tsho lha sar slebs rgyu ma red/ de las ma song na los dga'’ zhes bshad par/ a phas ‘‘pha kho/ nga tshor rogs pa yod/ rgya dmag gis gsod thub kyi ma red/ lha sar slebs nas lo re zung bsdad na/ rgya dmag phyir 'gro yi red/ de dus nga tsho phyir yong chog gi redami zer/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘da nga tsho rir mi bros ka med red/ a pha rir ma bros na sang nyin nas rgya dmag gis 'dzin rgyu red/ de las thar rung ma thar rung / lha sar song na dga' rgyu red zer nyal/ a phas 6‘rta dang / rogs pa thams cad gra sgrig byas tshar/ do dgong ma song na/ nangs dus nas rgya dmag gis nga yod pa ha go na 'dzin rgyu red zer zhor du/ a bu khong gnyis kyis zas gos dang / thab cha sogs bsdu gsog byas/ nga rang thab rtsa ru bsdad/ da ni ngo ma dus log ste/ rang sa ru 'dug dbang med par/ sa mtha' ru 'khyam dgos song / ci bshad kyang mtha' yag po zhig yong rgyu med pa ha cang gsal/ thabs gzhan ci yang med song /dgong mo nga chu len du song nas yar yong skabs/ rgya dmag gis mi 'ga' bkag nas rum sngog cing / gri dang mda' ra sogs blangs rjes/ ska rags bshigs nas sa thog tu 'dug bcug yod la/ rtsib tu a ye 'gas rgya mi la ngu bshad byed la/ ci zhig bshad bzhin yod pa mi go/ ngas lta ma phod par chu khur nas nang du yong / sgo kha nas a khu khang dge thug song / khos skad dma' mos ‘‘a rogs nus kho/ khyod kyis pha rgan la shod/ rgya dmag gis khyim tshang re re 248

5 ci ༅ nyi/yo bzhin yong nas sngog bzhin 'dug go song ngamanya zer nas chas song nga'i sems su khos a pha khyim du yod pa ji ltar shes song ba yin bsam zhor khyim du 'dzul/ a pha dang / a khu bstan 'dzin/ a bu 'ja' pe gsum gyis ja 'thung zhoraduskad cha bshad nas bsdad yod/ ngas 'khang dges bshad pa khong rnams la bshad par/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘'di gser yum mi bden na/ nga 'gro rgyuyin/ zhon rta nga yin sems khral mi dgos/ khyod kyis thabs ci drag gyis/rgya lag tu shor du ma 'jug zer zhor du sgor bud song / mun rub kha zhig la rgyal sgo brdung song / sgo rdung lugs la bltas na 'di nga tsho'i 'brel yod cig min pa shes 'dug nga tsho skrag snang cung skyes song la/ a pha mgyogs por lag snod khang chung nang du gab/ nga rgyal sgo phye ru song / sgo srub nas bltas pa na/ sgo rtsa ru me mda' khur yod pa'i rgya dmag bzhi lnga zhig slebs 'dug nga'i sems su da ma bzang ba red/ 'di tshos a pha khyim du yod pa shes song ba yin rgyu red/ da rir bros ma thub par a pha 'dzin rgyu red sogs bsam zhor du rgyal sgophyes kyang /dmag tsho nang du ma yong par/ dmag tshos nga'i mgo la byug pa dang / rna 'byog nas cung re 'then zhor du skad log mang po rgyag 'dug skabs der a khu khya dge dang skad bsgyur ba zhig da rung rgya dpon yin pa 'dra zhig sogs slebs yong /skad bsgyur gyis ‘‘zhi lu khyed tshang gi khyim du mi ga tshod yod/ 'grul pa e yod ces dris song / ngas khyim nang a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis yod/ 'grul pa med zer bar/ de dus ‘6a khu khya dges 'di tshang la pha bu gsum ma gtogs med/ pha rgan sde ba'i nang bros song bas da lta gar yod mi shes/ khyim du byis pa gnyis las yod pa ma redanya’zer bar/ skad bsgyur gyis ‘‘khyim du kha rogs sdod/ mtshan sgo ru song na dmag gis gsod rgyu red/ go song ngam’’zer zhor du phyin song / nga'i snying lding gi 'dug kyang / nang du ma song bar khong tsho gar 'gro la bltas bsdad/ khong tshos khyim tshang re re bzhin sgo rdung zhor thag ring du bud song / de nas ngas rgyal sgo brgyab ste khyim du yong / yar bltas na/ a phas 249

leku 0ci 5 5 la 8 9la5 ikhye3la5 lag tu me mda' bzung nas/ ja khang dkar khung kha nas bltas bsdad 'dug la/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘rgya dmag gi ci zer nyazhes nga la dris/ ‘‘'grul pa e yod zer/ ngas med lab pa yin/ a khu khya dges 'di tshang gi pha rgan sde ba'i nang nas bros song ba red/ da lta gar song yod pa ma red ces bshad song / skad bsgyur gyis mtshan sgo nas song na dmag gis gsod rgyu yin zer zhes lan btab/ a phas ‘‘mdang dmag mi'i rta bcu kha zhig rku la shor song zer/ des mi tshad/ gzim khang thog gi lcags kyi ka ba la rdo brgyab nas bcag 'dug nyazer bar/ ngas ‘6'di 'dra'i rkun ma ngan pa su yin namanya zhes dris/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘grwa pa yin gyi ma red/ mtha' ba yin rgyu red zer/ a phas ‘‘slog skud ka ba la rdo rgyag mkhan grwa pa tsho yin kho thag redami’zer/nub zas zos tshar rjes/ a phas ‘‘a bu khyed gnyis nyol sdodami’zer bar/ kho rang gis ja 'thung nas bsdad/ nga rang gnyid song / mtshams zhig la khang rgyab nas gyang rdung ba'i rdig sgras nga'i gnyid dkrog song / ngas mgo bkyag nas bltas pa na/ a bu 'ja' pe khyim nang bsdad 'dug a pha mthong rgyu med la/ khang brgyab nas yang gyang rdig rdig rdung gi 'dug nga rang cung skrag song la ‘‘a pha gang du phyin song zhes zer zhor du ngu shor song / a bus ‘‘khyod ngu ma yong / a pha sgo phye ru phyin song / rogs pa tsho slebs song / da 'gro ran pa redanyanyazer/ ‘6nga mi 'gro/ rgya dmag gis skor lam nang nas bsgugs 'dug nga tsho gsod kyi red nyaces bshad par/ de dus nag yor re mi zhig nang du 'dzul song / ngas dkar me'i 'od nas bltas pa na/ 'o gru pa blo chos red 'dug khos ‘‘ya nus kho/ bu rgod po yar longs 'gro ran song )zer/ nga rang ci snang med par yar langs nas sgo ru bud/ 'o ho ho/ rgya ra'i nang du rta sga ma mang po dang /grwa pa re zung slebs 'dug rgyal sgo brgyab 'dug la/ khong tshos rta sga'i yob chen thams cad sga ngo ru sgrog gi 'dug do dgong zla ba shar yod kyang / sprin gyis bsgribs nas gsal po mi rig cung tsam nas thams cad khyim du yong nas/250

skem5 (khri tshude skyi yog 'jam cag ger ja 'thung zhing rtsam pa zos/ de dus ngas gru pa blo chos kyi bu skal bzang dang / a zhang rgya khor sogs yod pa mthong song / a zhang rgya khor gyis 6‘bla ma dkon mchog cung bsgugs na slebs mi yong ngam/ da dung ma slebs na 'gro rgyu ma gtogs yod pa ma redami zer/ a phas ‘6da ci byung yang mi sgug thabs yod pa ma red/ yang min na khyed tsho sngon du song dang / ngas sguganya’zer skabs/ yang khang rgyab nas gyang brdung song bar/ da slebs song zer/ rgyal sgo phyes rjes yang rta gsum khrid pa'i grwa pa gnyis slebs song / su yin gsal po mi mthong bar/ grwa pa zhig gis ‘6skor lam nang dmag gi thun pa 'dug ha go 'gro na'ang thang zer bar/ a zhang rgya khor gyis ‘‘da ma sgug khyod tsho mgyogs po song / nga song nas khong tshor cha rgyag 'jog chos lung gong ma'i yar mda' nas sgug rgyu gyis/ da song / da mgyogs por song zer/ de nas rgyal sgo phyes te 'gro ba la/ nga rang skrag nas 'dar gyi 'dug thams cad 'jam cag ger bka' 'gyur 'khor khang rgyab tu slebs khar/ rta zhig gi sbur shar zhig brgyab song bas/ mi thams cad sa thog tu bsdad/ skor lam nang nas rgya dmag gis glog dkar sgron nas 'gro ba mthong gi 'dug la/ mtshams rer glog 'od nga tsho'i mi rta thams cad kyi thog tu phog 'dug kyang / rgya dmag gis ma mthong bas nga tsho ga ler gad zhabs su 'bab thub song / de dus gad zhabs nas/ yang rta gsum khrid pa'i grwa pa gnyis dang thug byung / nga rjes na yod pas su yin ma shes/de nas nga tsho dgon pa'i gad zhabs nas yar song la/ zla ba sprin gyi bar nas mtshams rer gsal la mtshams rer mi gsal/ rgya dmag gis dgon 'dabs nas phar tshur skad log brgyab nas skad cha bshad pa go yi 'dug la/ nga tsho 'gro bzhin yod pa sus kyang ma shes/ nga'i sems su gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen/ rgya dmag gis go yong bsam zhor du rta khrid nas khong tsho'i rjes ded de song / a bu 'ja' pe nga'i rtsib nas 'gro bzhin yod la/ thams cad 'jam cag ger cung re song / yang cung re bsdad/ yang sngon du song / do dgong ni 'di 251

leku 04 0 5 la 0rgyal5 i hripe45 'dra 'jam po dang / 'di 'dra'i 'jigs skrag che ba'i mtshan mo zhig red/ ngas rang gi rkang pa sa thog tu spo bzhin yod med mi shes shing / mi rta gzhan gyis dbugs len pa ma gtogs ci yang mi go/ snang ba zhig la nga rang gcig pu srog chags dbugs can med pa'i 'jig rten gzhan zhig tu 'gro ba'i snang ba shar song / da ni ngo ma rang yul dang bral nas sa mtha' ru 'khyam dgos byung //le tshan nga lja pa/skye ba sngon ma'i las kyis/ skya ser bcu gnyis 'dzoms song /zla ba cung tsam gsal ba'i 'od la brten nas/ nga tsho dgon pa'i gad zhabs nas sngar ltar cung re song / yang cung re bsdad/ de dus mtha' ba'i nang zhig nas/ bud med cig gis skad mthon pos ngu 'bod byed kyin 'dug la/ ma gzhi skrag snang gis 'gro bzhin pa'i nga tshos/ skad de go na lhag tu skrag snang skye ba zhig red/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘da ma bzang ba red/ ngu mkhan de nga'i a ma red/ nga phyir 'gro dgos song / khyed tsho song dang / ngas rjes chod kyi redami zer zhor du/ rta zhon nas phyir chas song / cung tsam nas/ bud med de'i ngu 'bod byed rgyu med song la/ a khu bstan 'dzin yang yong rgyu med/cung bsgugs kyang ma yong bar/ a phas ‘‘da 'gro/ sgug rgyu yod pa ma red/ kho mi gcig pu thar sla ba red/ nga tsho sngon la 'gronya zer nas song / cung tsam nas sku lung chu mgo kha ru song la/ 'jam cag ge red/ dgon mtha' nas rgya dmag gis glog sgron 'dug ‘‘da gad thog thon bzhag na rig rgyu ma redami zer/ de'i rjes nas a khu bstan 'dzin slebs yong ste/ da 'gro ma gtogs mtha' ba'i nang gi rgya dmag yar dgon nang du 'gro bzhin 'duganya zer la/ khos bshad pa'i tshig rnga ma bud gong / dgon pa'i stod nas/ me mda'i skad gnyis gsum grag song bas dgon nang gi khyi kha 'ur zhing / rtas 'tsher langs byas song / a phas ‘‘da ma 252

/ na ༅'u yo bzang ba red/ ci yin yang da rtar zhon nas gad thog rgyugs te/ yar g.yu sgra thang stod nas sgug rgyu yin/ rgya dmag gis kha 'dra gtor song na/ thar thub mkhan tshos g.yu sgra'i nyag nang nas sgug rgyu gyis/ da mgyogs po rgyuganya)zer zhor du/ nga rta thog tu bskyon te gad khar bud cing / lam chen ded nas rgyugs/ de dus thams cad kyis rta zhon nas/ rdig dir nyi le gad thog tu bud nas brgyugs/ rta thams cad dbugs kha ther re byed bzhin 'dug nga tsho mnyam du yun ring la rgyugs la/ rgya dmag go rgyu grag rgyu ci yang med pas/ yang thams cad ga ler song / a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘a khu grags pa kho tsho ma thar ba yin rgyu red/ nga tshos 'di nas cung sgug na ci 'dranya zer bar/ a phas 6‘da khyed rnams kyis byis pa tsho khrid nas sngon la song / 'di nas ngas shar skya rengs bar sgug 'dug de nas ma yong na nga khyed tsho'i rjes ded nas 'ong zer bas/ nga tsho sngon du gshar song /cung ma 'gor bar yang dgon mtha' zhig nas/ dngas shing gsal ba'i me mda'i skad re zung grag song / nga tshos phyir bltas byas na/ dgon pa'i g.yas kyi ri mgo nas rgya dmag gi glog brda rgyag gi 'dug nga'i sems su da rogs pa rjes ma rgya dmag gis ha go song ba yin rgyu red/ a pha rjes su lhag song bas da ci byas yong dran zhor du/ khong tsho'i rjes ded nas song / skabs shig la nga tsho'i rjes nas/ rdig dir nyil le rta ba mang po zhig rgyug yong ba go 'dug nga tsho yang sngon du bros/ nga rang gis rgya dmag slebs song bsam nas bros pa yin la/thams cad kyang bros lugs la bltas na/ rgya dmag slebs song bsam nas bros pa kho thag yin/ cung tsam nas a gas ‘‘dal mo gyis dang / nga tsho yinanyanyazer ba'i skad go song / ngas ‘‘a pha red/ a pha khong tsho slebs song ’zhes brjod par/sngon du bros pa'i mi tshos ga le byas song / a pha dang mnyam du rta ba 'ga' yod la/ su yin gsal po ma mthong / de dus a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘nga tsho'i rjes na khyi zhig slebs song / 'di yag po ma red/ ngas bsad e 'jog zer la ga pa zhig gis ‘‘ma gsod/ me mda'i skad go na dmag gis ha go yang sridanya zer 253

mi4 03 0snye5 4 09 5 i nye3laX la/ cung tsam nas rjes nas me mda'i skad grag pa dang mnyam du/ khyi zhig ngu zug byas song bas don ci yin ha go song / cung yar yong dus/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘6dmag gis khyed tsho'i thog la me mda' 'phangs pa e redami’ces dris par/ grwa pa zhig gis ‘‘me mda' kha shas 'phangs song yang gang yin shes ma song ’zer/ 6‘de dus mtha' ba'i nang gi dmag yar dgon nang du yong bar thug nas/ nga tsho 'khor khang rgyab tu gab bsdad/ dmag song tshar dus nga tsho yong ba yin la/ skor lam mthar slebs dus/ dgon pa'i g.yas ri'i gdong thog gi dmag mis nga tsho 'gro ba go ba yin rgyu red/ nga tsho'i phyogs su slog sbar zhing /me mda' mang po 'phangs song’’zer/ de nas nga tsho sngar ltar gshar/skya mda' 'then dus/ g.yu sgra'i nyag brgyab ste/ phar rgyab chu kha nags gseb tu slebs song / de dus ngas mdang dgong phyogs so so nas yong ba'i mi che chung thams cad gsal po shes song / sngon ma ni dgon pa'i gru pa blo chos/ mi skya/ lo lnga bcu tham pa yin/ blo chos kyi bu skal bzang / grwa pa/ lo bco lnga yin/a khu smon lam/ grwa pa/ lo nyi shu rtsa drug yin/ a khu smon lam gyi tsha bo 'khang sbral/ grwa pa/ lo bco brgyad yin/ khong bzhi nged tshang nas mnyam du sgor bud rnos yong ba yin/ a khu bstan 'dzin/ grwa pa/ lo sum cu so gsum yin/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyi tsha bo le kho/ grwa pa/ lo bcu dgu yin/ khong gnyis nga tsho dgon pa'i gad zhabs nas thug song bas mnyam du yong ba yin/ a khu grags pa/ grwa pa/ lo sum cu so gnyis yin/ a khu grags pa'i tsha bo tshe kho/ grwa ba/ lo bcu drug yin/ yang kho'i nye sa dung phrug grwa pa/ lo bco lnga yin/ khong gsum ni rjes nas slebs pa yin/ gong du yod pa'i skya ser dgu yi khar/ nga yi pha drin chen nags tshang 'dul kho/ lo bzhi bcu zhe bdun yin/ a bu 'ja' pe/ grwa pa/ lo bcu bzhi yin/ nga rang mi skya yin la/ de dus lo bcu yin/ nga tsho skya ser bcu gnyis 'di/ rgya nag po'i btsan gyis yin na'ang 'dra/ skye ba sngon ma'i las kyis yin na'ang 'dra/ mtshan gcig gi 'jigs skrag sdar gsum brgyud de/ rgya dmag mang 254

ma5 ( na 43lpi sam pos bskor yod pa'i rma sde chu kha ma'i bkra shis chos gling dgon pa'i nang nas ri bros te/ stod nyi ma lha sa'i phyogs su mnyam du 'gro dgos pa red song / da ni bzang 'dzoms ngan 'dzoms ci yin na/ las shig gis ri mgo nas sa mthar 'khyams pa'i lam sne 'di nas 'dzoms song / mi che ba lnga yis rang gi bu rgyud dang / nye sa byis pa lo chung bdun khrid de/ dbus nyi ma lha sa'i chos rar bskyal 'dod pa'i sems thag bcad nas/ 'gyod pa ci yang med par rang sa skyid po shul du bskyur nas/ lha sa'i phyogs su snyegs song /dus log sdug gi 'og nas bud de/ skyid kyi sne mor zin pa yin na'ang 'dra/ yang min na skyid kyi mtha' zad de/ dus log gi sdug myong ba'i mgo bzung ba yin na'ang 'dra/ da ni sngon du 'gro ba las kha phyir 'khor gyi lam ni med kho thag red/ de ring nga tsho g.yu sgra'i rgyab kyi nags gseb nas ja bskol nas bsdad/a pha dang blo chos gnyis thod mgo la so par bsdad/ gzhan thams cad ja 'thung tshar rjes gnyid bsdad/ mdang nam zhig rjes ded yong ba ma shes la/ dgon pa'i lha rta gseb gnyis kyang nga tsho'i rjes ded nas slebs yod/ ci byas kyang kha bkar ma thub par nyin mtshan kun tu nga tsho'i rjes ded nas slebs te/ mun rub kha a phas ‘‘do dgong nas/ nyi ma gnyis gsum nga tsho mtshan 'gro bya dgos/'dir rgya dmag sngon ma nas slebs tshar ba red’ zer bar/ de'i dgong mo zla 'od la brten nas nga tsho mtshan 'gro byas/ skabs shig la chu chung 'dam zug can zhig la thug song la/ 'bud ha cang dka'/ mtshams shig la a khu smon lam nga tsho 'bud thub song / rjes nas a bu 'ja' pe 'bud dus/ rta 'dam nang du zug nas mchongs lding byas/ ngas ‘‘a bu dam po 'thoms ma gtogs/ chu nang du lhung gi red’ zer bar/ a phas ‘‘'ja' kho/ rta'i rngog mar 'thoms/ rta thog nas lhung du ma 'juganya’zer nas bos/ a bu 'ja' pes skrag snang ci yang med par/ ‘‘'o ya a pha/ nga mi lhung khyod tsho ma yong / 'dir 'dam rgan zhig 'dug’ zer/ khos rta la lcag tshan gyis gzhus pas/ rtas mchongs lding lnga drug 255

3ku 0na 5 5 la /mirgyal5 i ze3la5 cig byas nas chu tshu rir 'bud thub song / gad khar slebs pa na/ rta ni'adar sig sig log la khad 'dug blo chos kyis ‘‘'ja' kho ngan pa red/ lhung na tshab song’)zer/ nga tsho 'gro dus/ rtsib nas khyi re brgyug yong / de dus ‘‘a phas khathal bas chod/ nga tsho ru skor zhig gi dkyil nas 'gro bzhin 'dug’’zer bar/da zhib tu bltas na khyim tshang la las khyim du mchod me sbar yod pa rig 'dug yophas ‘‘da 'gro rgyu ma gtogs yod pa ma red/ blo chos smon lam gnyis sngonalasong / a khu bstan 'dzin byis pa tsho khrid nas sngon la bros/ bstan 'dzin ngedaganyis gis bkag yong ’zer zhor du song / cung tsam nas ru mtha' ru 'bud thub song / nam smad cig tu sngon nas mi mang po zhig gi me phung brgyab nas bsdad yod la/ nga tsho gzur 'gro sa cang med par/ a pha dang / a khu bstan 'dzigoganyis kyis me mda' mgo nas blangs te sngon du song / de dus bud med cig gis ‘‘me mda' ma 'phen/ nga tsho gro rkon yinanya’zer/ a pha sngon du skad cha 'griru song la/ cung tsam nas da 'gro/ khang gsar ma rgya yis brlags shul du bud med gro rkon re zung ma gtogs red zer/ nga tsho me 'od du slebs dus/ bud med thams cad yar langs nas phyag 'tshal zhing / la las gsol 'debs byed kyi 'dug skya mda' 'then dus/ du ba 'thib pa'i sde mtha' zhig tu slebs song /zhib tu phar bltas na ga sa gang du sbra thed po dang / sgam chag mar phyur/ gon pa sogs ca lag mang po gtor 'dug la/ khyi sdom re zung mtsher shul du 'gro bzhin 'dug a khu bstan 'dzin gyis mar chur cung re blangs nas khyer yong /de dus blo chos kyis ‘‘'di nas 'gor mi nyan/ 'di rgya mis gtor zin tsam red 'dug gad zhabs na mi re zung bsad 'dug nyazer bar/ nga tsho sngar ltar gshar song / 'di ni ngas thengs dang por rgya dmag gis gtor yod pa'i sde pa mthong ba yin/ 'on kyang ngas mi bsad yod pa ma mthong //256
