5 / na rdzi nyi lha snyele tshan nga drug pa/smo sems mthun pa'i drin gyis/ rma chu sngon mor thar song /de ring kha sang / phar cher nyin mtshan gnyis kur 'gro tsam 'dug tsam/gab zhor dang skung zhor du 'gro dgos pas/ 'gro ha cang dka' 'dug mtshams rer lam du thug na mi tshos rgyang nas nga tsho mthong na bros 'gro la/ mtshams re lam nas mi yong ba mthong na nga tsho rir 'bro dgos pas/ da ni dred mong mi skrag rang skrag zer ba'i dpe ltar/ nyin mtshan kun tu skrag snang mi dgos pa'i dus gcig kyang med/ nga ni nyin re bzhin mi skrag par je dga' red/ khong tsho bros na nga rang bros/ khong tsho bsdad na nga rang bsdad/ nga'i sems su bzang ngan ci red na'ang / nga rang nyin mtshan nam yin yang / rta gong nas lhung ma song na 'grig yod bsam song / de ring nam smad nas lam du chas song / skya mda' 'then khar lung mdo zhig la slebs dus mar bltas pa na/ chu kha na gur kha shas phub yod la/ thang thog tu rta mang po zhig rig 'dug sa phas/ ‘‘'di yag rgyu mi 'dug sa 'di na rgya dmag ma gtogs/ rta ba gur phub cig yod dgos don medami’zer la/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘6nga song nas gcig bltas yong zer zhor du/ me mda' lag tu bzung nas sngon la song / a phas ‘‘ma 'gro/ nam langs song 'gro mi nyan/ dmag 'dra yin na nga tsho phyir 'gro thub kyi ma red/ de las nga tsho lung chung pha ki'i nang nas/ thad du bud 'jog dang rig rgyu ma red’’zer bar/ blo chos kyis ‘‘de bden/ ma mthong na dga' yi red/ kha lag 'thab tshar dus thar dka' ba red’ zer/ nga tsho lung nyag cig gi sked nas nyag brgyab par/ nyag kha nas zhib tu bltas pa na/ rgya dmag min pa 'dra zhig red/rta sum cu tsam yod la/ bar na grwa pa re 'gro ba mthong 'dug ci yin gsal po mi shes pas sus kyang ci yang ma bshad par/ nyag brgyab nas bud song / phar 257

leku 04 0 5 la 0rgya05 yi ze345 rgyab gzhung gi chu khar slebs dus ja bskol nas bsdad/ nyin gung ja 'thung tshar rjes yang gshar song / lung mda' ru slebs pa na chu chen po zhig 'dug la/thams cad kyis ‘6rma chu'i khar slebs song zer/ a phas ‘‘nga tsho de ring thabs ci drag gis rma chu'i phar nang 'bud dgos pa red/ de nas ha cang skrag dgos rgyu ma red’’zer/ rma chu'i khar slebs pa na ston chu kham pa ngo nag 'di na rma chu zheng che la/ chu rlabs mang sa zhig red/ thams cad kha gdang 'dug pa las/rma chur 'bud pa'i thabs bkod ci yang mi 'dug a khu grags pas 'di 'dra chu zheng chen po 'dug 'bud thabs shig e yod dam/ mi che ba tshos rta 'phangs nas chu brkyal na chod rgyu red de/ byis pa tsho ci byed’ zer la/ blo chos kyis ‘‘brkyal nas mi che bas kyang brgal thub kyi ma red/shing gdung re yod na thabs bkod yod pa red de/ da sa 'di nas shing zhig gang na yod’ zer/ a phas ‘‘a rogs 'di'i chu rgyud nas yar song na/ khang gsar ma'i sa mtshams red/ ru sde re yod na shing leb gdung yog re rag kyang sridaminyazer bar/ nga tsho chu rgyud ded nas gyen du song / chu kha khug kyog zhig la slebs dus/ sngon du khang pa re zung mthong rgyu 'dug rtsib la slebs pa na 'di dgun sa red/ da rung ru slebs med/ bla ma dkon mchog shing gdung ma ci bsam ci dgos spangs 'dug de la slebs rjes a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyis ja bskol la/ khorngo tsho thams cad kyis shing gdung chu khar bzhag nas gzings gru bzos/ dgong mo ri rtsar grib ma gon dus/ nga tshos ca lag thams cad gzings gru'i thog tu bzhag blo chos kyis ‘‘'dul kho/ a khu bstan 'dzin nged gsum gyis gzings rta rngar 'dogs rgyu yin/ byis pa chung ba tsho dkyil du sdod/ gzhan dag tsho gru mthar 'tham/ khog smad chu nang du yod pa gyis/ lag pas gzings gru skyor/ rta gzhan gru gzhug la btags na 'grig gi red zer/ de nas thams cad kyis khos bshad pa ltar/a bu 'ja' pe/ dung phrug skal bzang nged bzhi gzings kyi dkyil du bsdad/gzhan tshos gzings gru'i mtha' nas bskyor/ blo chos khong gsum gyis thag pa 258

ma5 (ḍa ༅shi lum rta rngal btags nas chu nang du babs/ rta chu rkyal bas gzings gru yang chu kha ru g.yeng song / mi thams cad kyis ki dir nyil le chur brgal/ chu dkyil du slebs dus/ gru gzhug btags yod pa'i rta gsum kha phyir 'khor song / a khu smon lam gyis rta de gsum kha phyir 'then nas gzings gru'i rtsib tu slebs la nye dus/ a khu bstan 'dzin dang / blo chos gnyis kyi rta rnga la btags yod pa'i thag pa gcig 'phro gcig byas nas chad song / gzings gru ni a pha'i rta gcig pus 'then ma thub par/ mi rta gzings gru dang bcas pa chu dkyil nas mar khur song / a khu bstan 'dzin gyis rta mngags nas stong rkyal byas te gzings gru yi rjes ded nas yong / a phas ‘‘da khyod yong mi dgos/ chu grang bas khyod stong rkyal byed thub kyi ma red/ da ma yong ’zer la/ a khu bstan 'dzin sngar ltar gru rjes de nas rkyal yong gi 'dug gzings gru ni chu dkyil nas ga le mar khur 'dug kyang / rta gcig gis 'then gyi yod pas/ chu pha rol dang thag je nye red 'dug a khu bstan 'dzin gyis da rung gzings gru'i rjes chod med/ de'i skabs a khu smon lam gyis gru rnga'i rta gcig gru rtsib nas yar sngon du 'then te gzings gru'i sngon du song bas/ cung tsam nas gzings gru yi sngon du slebs/ de nas a pha khong gnyis kyi rta gnyis kyis 'then pas/ gzings gru dal mo byas nas chu'i pha rol tu bud/ de dus 'khang spral kyis gzings rnga nas rta gnyis gshibs te/gcig sngon du 'phangs/ gcig༄ khrid nas/ chu dkyil du rkyal bzhin pa'i a khu bstan 'dzin bsu ru song / cung tsam nas khong gnyis chu'i tshu rol tu 'bud thub song / rjes nas bshad na 'khang spral yong med na/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘khos rkyal mi thub par shi kho thag redazlozer/ nga tsho rma chu'i tshu rol tu bud rjes yar lung khug cig gi nang du bsdad/ la las gur phub/ la las ja bskol/ a pha grang nas kha grag re med par/ slog pa gon nas bsdad 'dug a khu bstan 'dzin 'khyags nas cung 'dar 'dug pa las/ gnod pa chen po med/ blo chos kyis ja rgod nang sga skya btab nas/ a pha la blud cing lus thog tu gon pa mang po 259

les 04 5 5 la rgya 5:li ze345 bkab/ cung tsam nas a pha 'dar bas/ blo chos kyis ‘‘bla ma dkon mchog da drag song / 'dar thub dus shi yi ma red/ 'dar ma thub na mi lo lon red/ mchin pa 'khengs nas shi yi redanya zer/kha nyin rma chu bud rabs bshad na/ mi rer gtam rgyud thung ngu re bshad rgyu yod 'dug da ci yin yang rogs pa thams cad kha zhe mthun pa'i drin gyis/rma chu la bde 'tshams byas nas 'bud thub song / nga tsho bsdad yod sa lung pa chung chung 'di/ rtswa chu mgo 'dzoms kyi sa skyid po zhig red/ nga tshos ri zog cig bshas te sha btsos/ rgyu ma blug 'di'i nyi ma gnyis gsum la/ mi la zas yod/rta la rtswa yod/ skrag mi dgos par skyid po byas nas bsdad de/ mi rta kun gyis ngal yag po zhig gsos song / de ring snga mo nas yang lam du chas/ nyin phyed tsam slebs pa na/ nga tshos sa khug cig tu ja bskol nas bsdad/ mtshams shig la tshe kho rta khrid du song bas/ khos ri rtsa nas ‘6a rogs tsho lung mda' nas skya mi re zung dang / g.yag ded cig yong bzhin 'dug rgya e yin nam nyazer nas bos par/ thams cad 'tshub long nyil ler yar langs nas bltas pa na/g.yag ded de ni thag nye sar slebs 'dug yo khu smon lam gyis ‘‘rgya ma red/ bla ma grwa pa re yin pa 'dra/ gser zha gon 'dugaminyazer/ a phas a khu bstan 'dzin la ‘‘su yin ma shes gong me mda' ma 'phen/ thag nyer yong du chuganya’zer/ nga tsho lam du gab yod pa g.yag ded tshos shes med/ de dus a pha dang a khu bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis me mda' khur nas yar langs te 6‘khyod tsho gang nas yin’ zer bar/ de tsho skrag ste yar langs nas cer bsdad/ de dus nga tsho thams cad yar langs nas yong bas/ mi de tsho yang yar nged tsho'i sar yong ngas bltas na de ni grwa pa bla ma zhig ga nas yin/ mi skya rkyang rkyang gis bla ma'i gser zha gon yod la/ skad cha zhib tu dris par/ khong tshos ‘6khang gsar dgon pa rgya dmag gis gtor tshar thal/ nga tshos dgon pa'i ca lag rgya sgar thog bskyal 'gro ba yin/ da lta dgon nang na rgya med la sde ba yang med/ sde dgon thams cad 260

5 4 mthi pom rgyasabatsan po byas nas/ rma chu phar ri la ded tshar song sogs skad cha mang po bshad song / ma tshad/ khong tshos gon yod pa'i gser zhwa thams cad a khu rnams la phul song / mi 'ga' res da rung dngul sgor phul nas ‘‘khyed tsho lha sar slebs na nga tshor sku rim rim gro dang / shi bo'i bsngo rten yin zer/ a khu smon lam gyis sgor mo sogs bdag byas rjes 6‘nga tsho lha sar slebs song na/ jo bo'i mdun du khyed tshos bsngo rten rnams 'jog nges/ sems bde mo gyis zhes bshad/ nga tsho chu kha ma'i dgon pa yin zhes bshad par khong tsho lhag par dga' 'dug mi zhig gis ‘‘nga tshos rgya yi za ma bkal yod/ khyed rnams kyis za rgyu re khur song zer bar/ pha drin chen gyis 'o khyod tsho kha dro/ nga tshor za rgyu mi dgos/ nga tshos khyer song na/ sang nyin khyed tshos rgya la rtsis 'phrod rgyu ma red ces bshad rjes/ rang rang so sor lam du gshar song / de ring nga'i sems su yang 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig dran song / sngon na mi tshos bshad na chu kha ma dgon pa rgyas gtor dgos don ni/ chu kha ma'i dmag gis rgya mang po bsad bzhag pa red zer la/ de ring 'di'i dgon pa gtor lugs dang / ru sde rma chu phar rir ded lugs bltas na/ da ni chu kha ma kho na ma yin pa red/ phar cher rgya dmag sa gang du slebs kyang sde dgon thams cad gtor ba dang / de yang rang sa'i mi la rang gi dgon pa gtor du bcug tshar dus/ sku gsung thugs rten thams cad rgyal khab gzhung la sprad dgos zer nas/ rdzong thog tu bskyal song ba red//le tshan nga bdun pa/dus log chag sgo'i nang nas/ dgon sde gnyis ka brlags 'dugang tsho sngar ltar 'gro bzhin yod la/ ri mthon po zhig gi nyin khug na/dgon pa zhig gi gser khebs dang / gser tog ser lam mer mjal 'dug‘‘'o ya/ 'di khang gsar dgon pa yin rgyu red yanya’zer la/ bshad mkhan su 261

leku 0na 0 5 la rgyal5 likhye3la5 yin ma shes/ nga tsho dgon pa'i skor lam zhabs nas yar song / zhib tu bltas na/ dgon pa'i stod kyi lha khang la 'ga' me 'bar zhing / khang pa'i gseng na da rung du ba 'phyur bzhin yod/ dgon pa'i dar mo che me 'bar tshar 'dug da rung me gang nas 'bar ba mi shes/ ga sa gang du dud smug 'thib 'dug srang lam na grwa pa'i gzan sham kha shas dmar 'ba' le g.yugs 'dug 'du khang thog gi gser tog dang / ri dgas 'khor lo thams cad bsgyel yod/ skor lam nang 'khor chung mang po sa thog tu lhung yod la/ 'khor chen rnams bsgyel tshar dus gtor song bas/ nang gi yi ge skor lam phyi nang kun tu khra thar re rlung gis khur bzhin 'dug khyi sdom 'ga' res ngu zug byed pa las/ mi skad rna bas go rgyu med par 'jam cag ge 'dug dgon pa yongs su dud smug 'khrigs shing / yar bltas na sems skyo ba dang 'jigs snang skye ba zhig red/ a khu grags pas ‘‘snying rje 'dir dgon pas rgya dmag dang 'dzing pa yin rgyu red/ bla ma dkon mchog ci 'dra re shi med dmanya zer bar/ a khu smon lam gyis ‘‘'di dang bsdur na nga tsho'i dgon pa bshig med zer chog gi/ 'di nas mi shi ba ma zad/ dgon pa gtor tshar 'dug’nyazer la/ blo chos kyis ‘‘kha thal bas chod/ da nga tsho'i dgon pa 'di ltar tshar kho thag red’ zer/ nga tshos bshad zhor dang blta zhor du dgon pa'i ya na gyi gdong sna la slebs dus/ thang thog na gur ha cang chen po zhig phub 'dug la/ sgo kha na mi gnyis gsum gyis ja bskol nas bsdad yod/ nga tsho yong ba mthong nas mi de tsho yar langs te zhwa mo phud zhor du tshur yong / nga tsho gur sgo ru slebs pa na/ ‘6'di 'dra gur chen po zhig yod pa de dgon pa'i tshogs gur red’’zer/gur nang du dgon pa'i lha rten chos yig rnga dang / rag dung rol mo/ gser tog ri dwags 'khor lo 'dra mi 'dra gang spangs nas bzhag 'dug mi de tshos khong tsho ni ca lag 'di dag srung mkhan yin rār/ nga'i sems su ci 'dra'i dgon pa phyug po zhig yin 'dug da ni 'di 'dra sdug po gtor tshar ba red/ chu kha ma'i dgon pa gcig gi mgo la chag sgo lhung ba ma yin par/ da ni sa gang du song na 262

ma5 (ḍa tshunakhye yo 'di 'dra yin rgyu red dran song la/ ngas ‘‘a pha/ a zhang smon lam/ nga tsho lha sar slebs na/ lha sa/ dga' ldan tsho 'di 'dra gtor tshar e yod/ ngo ma gtor tshar na nga tsho gang du 'gro dgos pa red’ ces dris par/ a phas ci yang ma bshad/a zhang smon lam gyis ‘‘'o 'dis 'di 'dra re dran gyi 'dug kha ngan ma bshad zer bar/ tshig rnga ma bud gong a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘'di kha ngan zer rgyu med/ ha go yi ma red/ rgya dmag gzhes ning zhig nas lha sar song ba min nam zer/ a phas 6‘sdug na'ang thang / rgya dmag 'di ri me shor ba 'dra/ma slebs sa zhig med pa lta bu red/ 'di 'dra yin na nga tsho lam nas thar dka' rgyu red/ da ni bzang ngan ci red kyang yar 'gro rgyu ma gtogs thabs med song ba red/ nga rgan po shi ma song na/ ngas khyed rnam pa yar lha sar bskyal e thub cig blta rgyu yin ’zer/ a khu grags pas ‘‘'o ya dkon mchog gsum mkhyen/da ci zhig red 'gro shes kyi ma red/ las re yod na lam re yod rgyu red’ zer bar/ thams cad sems mi bde bar shar re 'gro 'duganyi ma gnyis gsum la song rjes/ da ni mgo log sa thog tu slebs zhing a myes rma rgyal sbom ra mjal gyi 'dug lam nang nas yar 'gro mar gshar gyi 'gro 'dug mang tsam la thug cing / kun gyis ‘‘khyed tsho 'og nas ma 'gro rgya dmag bsdad 'dug ’zer zhing / ‘‘khyed tsho 'og nas ma 'gro rgya dmag yod pa redami zer/'on kyang / nga tsho nyi ma mang tsam song zhing / rgya dmag gi shul tsam la'ang ma thugang tsho sngar ltar mtshan mo song la/ nam langs ran khar sa khug lung khug re nas gab bsdad pa yin/ de ring nas nyin dkar song la/ snga mo nas lam kha na rta zog bdag med dang / lug dum cha re spyang kis gtor song ba lta bu ga sa gang du 'gro bzhin 'dug yang cung song ba na ri mgo na khyi sdom mang po yod/ la las zog lug gi ro thed za zhing / la las kha gnam la gdang ste ngu zug byed la/ go ba tsam gyis sems nas 'jigs skrag skye dgos pa zhig red/ gnam du bya rgod mang po 'khor bzhin 'dug blo chos kyis 6‘a kha kha/ 'di zhig na yang ci ma nyan 263

leku 0nga 5 5 la rgyal5 i rgyo3la5 pa yin nam/ zog lug la bdag po med par/ khyi sdom gyis sa kha gang 'dug da yag po ma byung kho thag red zer/ tshang ma yang sems mi bde shar re sngon du song/cung ma 'gor bar thang sne zhig tu slebs/ 'o skyabs mgon mkhyen/ thang thog tu sbra gur bcu kha zhig yod la/ mang che ba bsgyel 'dug ri thang gnyis kur ca lag gtor yod pa dang / ga sa ga na mi ro dang / rta zog gi ro ma 'phangs ma log sa zhig med cing / a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘kha thal bas chod/ rgya dmag gis brlags 'duganyanyazer bar/ grwa pa tsho rta gong nas babs te/ lam sner yod pa'i mi ro gnyis gsum gyi rtsib nas bsngo ba smon lam re 'don/ sbra log nyer yod pa zhig gi sgo kha na khyi zhig btags yod par/ phar bltas na mu ges shi la khad du 'dug sa khu grags pas blo chos la ‘‘pha bzang ba/ khyi de mngags e thubanya zer bar/ a bu 'ja' pe/ blo chos gnyis song nas/ skor mgo'i phur ba bcags nas khyi de btang song / a phas ‘‘da nga tsho mgyogs po song na dga'/'di nas 'gor mi nyan kho thag red’ zer bar/ grwa pa tshos rta zhon nas lam du chas/ lam kha nas khyim tshang la las 'bras dang / mar rdo che chung mang po ga sa gang du 'phangs 'dug a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘a rogs 'dul kho/ nga tshos sha skam dang / mar cung tsam re len dgos pa min nam’ zer bar/ a phas kha ma grag gong / a khu smon lam gyis ‘‘rta lung la gnam rdib na/ khyi lung la nyi ma shar zer ba bzhin/ da sde ba 'di'i mgo la sdug 'di 'dra zhig lhung yod dus/nga tshos mi shi ro rtsib nas rgyu zhig len rgyu gang nas dran/ za rgyu ni yod/ gang yang mi len zer/ sus kyang kha ma grag par 'jam cag ger gshar/ nga'i sems su 'di sdeb gang nas yin/ snying rje/ rgya dmag dang phar 'dzing pa yin yang 'dra/rgya dmag gis tshur gtor ba yin yang 'dra/ mi shi rta 'gyel gyi chag sgo 'di 'dra zhig 'go la lhung 'dug da ni shi ba'i mi la ro bdag med par/ sbra rtsib na mig pho rog gis brus 'dug bsags pa'i rgyu la bdag med par/ ga sa gang du gtor 'dug rta zog lug gsum 'tsho bdag byed mkhan med par/ ri spyang sngon mos 264

skem snye ( na gye hri/lu khazas red/ snying rje can gyis bltas na snying rje ba/ sha tsha mkhan gyis rig na shatshab zhig red dran song /ngas thengs dang por mi zog 'di 'dra mang po shi yod pa mthong bas/skrag pa dang sdug pa yin pa mi shes par/ 'dang rgyag dgos pa zhig red/ a phas ‘‘snying rje 'di tsho rgya dmag gis bskor nas sog po mda' tshan brlags pa lta bu byas 'dug 'di sa tshod kyis byas na mgo log khang rgan yin rgyu red/ mgo log 'di sde ba rgod po red/ 'dzings yod kho thag redami’zer/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘mi ro dang / rta zog gi ro la dri ma med lugs bltas na/ brlags nas nyin gnyis gsum zhig ma gtogs ma redami zer/ nga tsho gtor brlags thebs pa'i ru nang nas bud de/ gdong sna zhig tu slebs pa nas/ phar bltas pa na/bya rgod mang po zhig gis ro thog 'tshub kha rgyag gi 'dug rgod mang che bas zos tshar te ri sgang du dang bsgrigs nas bsdad 'dug a khu smon lam gyis ‘6'o snying rje/ gna' snga mo glu ba zhig gis/ dus skya mo log pa'i nyin mor/ ro rus pas ri thang gang yod/ rgod thang dkar zhen pa log 'dug spyang sngon mo'i yid kha chad 'dug/ zer ba lta bu/ sa 'di ru de ltar byung 'dugami’zer/ nga rang 'gro zhor du yang sems su rang sa ru sde zho ltar chags yod dus/ chag sgo 'di 'dra ba mgor lhung rgyu yod na/ da nga tsho bros kyang ma bros kyang / snga gzhug med par chag sgo re mgor lhung rgyu red/ shi song na sngon gyi las red/ ro bdag po med na snying re rje/ de ring phan chad nas gtor bshig ngan pa 'di 'dra zhig mig gis mthong mi dgos par smon sogs mi dran dgu dran byed zhor du phar tshur la lta 'dod med par song /'di'i nyi ma gnyis gsum la bde 'jam gyi ngang nas gzhung lam ded nas song zhing / dngangs skrag dang / brel 'tshub dgos pa'i don gang la'ang ma thug 'on kyang nyin dkar mig lam du shar rgyu dang mtshan mo rmi lam du 'khrug rgyu tshang ma ni/ kha nyin mthong ba'i gtor bshig thebs pa'i dgon sde de tsho dang /265

ku 0ci 5 5 4 9 5 ikhyerwal5 mi zog rta gsum shi ba'i ro sogs yin/ a phas ‘(sngon ma rgya 'di 'dra'i ma rabs shig min mod/ da ci red song ba yin nam/ na ning zhig la sog sdes bshad bzhin 'dug rgya 'di thog ma yong dus a chen thang 'dra/ rta rgyug sa yod la 'dur sa yod/ rjes nas ra rdza'i sbug 'dra/ kha 'khor sa med la 'gro sa med pas mgo yangs gzhug btsan zhig yin pa red zer la/ de bden pa lta bu red ’zer/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘de bden pa red/ nga tsho'i dgon pa'i mgo btags dus/dar kha phul nas dga' bsu byas te bka' drin che zer zhor du/ phyi nyin nas dgon pa gtor song ba red/ 'di ko ba rlon pas lham ngo byas pa dang gcig pa red/ bsdad kyin bsdad kyin sde gyong je dam yin kho thag redami’zer/ nga'i sems su rang sderang dgon don med tu gtor dgos don ci yin nam zhes yang nas yang du 'khor song la/ lan 'debs mkhan gcig kyang med//le tshan nga brgyad pa/yar 'gro rgya dmag thug cing / dbus pa phyir yong brlags 'dugade ring nyin gung / nyi ma cung tsha bas/ nga tsho chu rgyud cig nas yar lhod cam 'gro skabs/ nga tsho'i sngon gyi thag nye zhig nas me mda'i skad gnyis 'phro rim 'phror grag song / don ci yin ma shes la/ thams cad skrag snang chen po skyes song / sngon ma tsho nga min pa rta thog nas babs 'dug de dus rgo ba re zung zhig zhogs nas/ nga tsho'i sngon gyi sa sgang brgyud g.yas ngos kyi ri la 'dzegs song /nga rta zhon te 0 ra sa sgang steng du slebs dus/ phar bltas pa na/ a ho ho/ rgya dmag zer ba/ gral mgo nas gral rnga mi rig pa zhig bsgrigs nas gshar yong gi yod pas/ ngas ‘‘a pha rgya dmag slebs song / sngon du rgya dmag yong bzhin 'dug ’ces bos/ a phas ‘6da gdong thug brgyab song ba red/ 'bro sa med/mgyogs po sgang gi lung shur nang du rgyugs’ zer bar/ thams cad kyis rta khrid 266

ga5 ('i 0tshelpi yo nas lam ltag lung shur zhig yod pa'i nang du rgyugs/ bla ma dkon mchog gi bka' drin los yin/ de na lung shur khug kyog ha cang zab mo zhig 'dug der slebs pa na nga tshos lam nang phyir mi mthong / lam nas kyang nga tsho yar mthong rgyu ma red/ da lta bros song ba'i rgo ba tsho yang nga tsho'i yan gyi ri ngo nas nga tsho la bltas nas bsdad 'dug sa pha dang / a khu bstan 'dzin/ blo chos gsum gyis me mda' bzung nas/ lung mdo'i gad kha nas rgya dmag la blta zhor du bsdad/nga tshos lung shur sbug nas/ rang rang gi rta bzung nas gab bsdad/ lam nang nas rgya dmag gshar ba'i rta'i rmig sgra dang / mi'i skad cha bshad pa gsal po go thub/ nga tsho 'jam cag ge bsdad yod la/ rang gi snying lding ba'i rdig sgra yang go thub pa 'dra/ rgya dmag gi rtsib nas bod pa re zung gis g.yag ded nas 'gro ba dang / skad cha bshad pa yang go 'dug de dus nga tsho'i rtsib kyi dgon pa'i lha rta gnyis/ rtswa za zhor du shor nas bud de nyin ngos kyi gdong thog tu 'gos song /nga tsho thams cad dngangs skrag dang brel 'tshub langs song yang / lha rta gnyis la sga srab med pas/tshur 'then thabs med la/ 'ded du yang 'gro mi phod/ dus der a phas nga tsho la ma 'gul zer ba'i lag brda rgyag gi 'dug ga pa zhig gis ‘8skyabs dgon mkhyen/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyenanyanyasogs gsol 'debs byed kyi 'dug lam nang nas bod mi zhig gis ‘‘ci 'dra'i rta yag po re 'dug 'di su'i yin nam sogs skad cha bshad pa go yang rgya bod su gcig rta 'ded du ma yong bar/ 'jam cag ger gshar song / nga tshos ci yin mi shes par da rung gab bsdad/ de dus a khu bstan 'dzin gyis yang nga tsho ma 'gul zer pa'i lag brda byed 'dug cung tsam nas yang bskyar lam nang nas rgya dmag gshar ba dang / skad log rgyag pa sogs go zhing / skabs shig la a pha khong gsum phyir nud byas nas sngar ltar nga tsho la ma 'gul zer ba'i lag brda brgyab song /dus der phag shir/ phag shir/ me mda'i skad gnyis grag song / nga tsho'i rta 'drogs rtsis byas kyang rang rang gis bzung yod pas 'drogs ma thub/ ri shog gi lha rta 267

miku 0nga 5 : rgya 5 i hrisprel gnyis kyang 'drogs nas nga tsho'i rtsib tu slebs/ de dus nga'i mig lam na/ nga tsho'i gong gi rgo ba yod sa nas thal skya log ge bud song la/ rgo ba tsho yar 'drogs song / nga rang sems bde nas 'o rgya dmag gis nga tsho mthong ba ma yin par rgo ba la me mda' 'phangs 'dug bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ rgo ba la phog ma song /gal te rgya dmag gis rgo ba zhig bsad na/ chag sgo nga tsho'i mgo la lhung kho thag red sogs dran song / a phas ‘‘snga gzhug thams cad rgya dmag lnga brgya lhag 'dug’’zer/ la las 66de ring nga tsho ma mthong ba de/ bla ma dkon mchog gis bskyabs pa redami’zer/ la las ‘‘yul lha gzhi bdag gis bskungs pa red nyazer/da ni ci yin yang / thengs dang po rgya dmag la thug pa'i 'jigs skrag 'di ltar mjug rdzogs song / nga tsho yang gcig rjes gnyis mthud du rgya lam ded nas 'gro ba la/ sus kyang skad cha ma bshad/ mi thams cad kyi rang rang sems su/ kha sang sdedagon gtor yod pa mthong rjes/ bshad mi shes pa'i skrag snang dang sems sdug cig yod 'dug ngas a bu 'ja' pe la ‘‘nga tsho rgya la thug na kha sang gtor 'dug pa bzhin gtor e yong’’zhes dris par/ khos ‘‘nga tsho rir 'bro chog gi red/ sla mo zhig gtor thub kyi ma redami zer/ ngas yang 6‘snga phyi ma gtogs gtor rgyu yin na/ nga tsho nyin ltar song ma song ci yodaminyazer bar/ tshig rnga ma bud gong nas a khu smon lam gyis ‘6'dre phrug de 'dra kha ngan re ma bshad ’ces nga la gshe gshe btang song / a bu 'ja' pes ‘6da gang yang ma bshad rjes chod pa gyisanya zer/ 'on kyang / ngas sngar ltar 'di 'dra zhig dran 'dug de dus a phas ‘6da ni mgo log dbyig gzhung la slebs pa red zer/ nga tsho chu kha brgyud nas yar song la/ sngon gyi lam kha na rgod mang po 'khor 'dug sa phas ‘‘blo chos/ 'di 'dra rgod mang po zhig ci red/ 'di yag rgyu mi 'dug nged gnyis sngon la blta ru 'gro/ khyed rnams ga ler phebs shog nyazer zhor du khong gnyis sngon du blta ru song / nga tsho gad zhabs nas chen po 'gro ma dgos par/ sngon na khyi sdom re zung gis rta zog gi ro za yi 'dug la/ nga tsho'i sna lam du rul dri ngan pa zhig bro 268

ske 5 tshe 4 ༅ skyi lum 'dug yang cung song na chu 'gram g.yas g.yon gang sar/ mi skya pho mo mang po'i ro gcer bur sngo nag tu gyur te ga sa gang du 'phangs 'dug chu kha nas 'gro thabs med par gad rtsa nas song / yang cung song na gad rtsa ru mi che chung bdun brgyad cig gi ro 'dug rogs pa tshos gsol 'debs byed zhor du ma ṇi bton/nga'i sems nas gsol 'debs ma byas/ kha la ma ṇi mi yong / da ni ro mthong nas skrag rgyu ci yang med/ gad rtsa na byis pa'i ro mang zhing / ma bu gnyis re mnyam du bsad pa yang yod/chu kha dang gad rtsa gnyis su ro che chung nyi shu rtsa drug bdun zhig yod la/ mgo'i skra la bltas na mang che ba bud med dang / byis pa'i ro red/nga'i sems su dus log nang nas byis pa nag mo 'di 'dra mang po bsad 'dugad ni nga rang yang nam bsad kyang skrag snang dang / 'gyod pa ci yang med snyam song / nga tsho chu rgyud nas yar gad pa dma' mo zhig gi thog tu bud/ gad pa mtho dma' gnyis yod la/ dma' sa'i gad thog na gur bcu lhag yod pa mang che ba bsgyel 'dug log med pa re gnyis yod pa me mdas brgyab nas gtsab 'duga.a pha dang blo chos gnyis gad kha mtho sa ru bsdad 'dug nga tsho gad thog tu bud dus thams cad kyis 66a ho ho/ skyabs mgon mkhyen ’zer nas ha las song /gad khugs na mi skya pho mo dang / grwa pa 'ga' re'i ro dang rta zog gi ro med sa zhig med la/ rta re zung ni rta lcags dang sga brgyab brgyab la bsdad 'dug mdzo dang g.yag kha shas rdang nang btags nas bsad 'dug log med pa'i gur thed zhabs nas kyang mi re gnyis kyi ro mthong gi 'dug da ni phyogs gang nas bltas kyang 'di dag su zhig yin yang / tshang ma bsad tshar bas blta ba mig gis mi bzod pa/ dran na sems kyis mi bzod pa zhig 'dug nga rang skyo snang skye ba las/gzhan dran rgyu ci yang med par/ rta zhon nas 'gro zhor dang blta zhor byas/ de dus a phas 66'di tsho'i zhwa lugs gos stangs la bltas na/ nga tsho'i phyogs kyi dbus pa zhig rgya dmag gis brlags song ba red/ blo chos nged gnyis kyis gad thog na/ rgya dmag gis 'phangs pa'i ci kon me mda'i rag shubs mang po spungs 269

leku 0ci 5 5 pha mirgya4dzi li nye3l snyeyod pa mthong songanya’zer/ blo chos kyis ‘‘shul chad rgyu rgya ngan tshos/ 'di 'dra bsad nas/ pho shi re/ ro lan re zhog e yod’’zer la/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘'di dbus pa yong tshod la bltas na/ lha sde 'am/ yang na smad ma yin rgyu red/gyon chas kyi thog na nor ba mi 'dug snying rje rgya ro tsho'i kha la brgyab song 'dug’’zer bar/ a khu smon lam gyis ‘‘rgya 'dre tsho/ 'dis byis pa tsho 'di ltar bsad/ 'di tsho gdon 'dre ngo ma redami zer/ a phas ‘‘'di nam langs kha brgyab pa yin rgyu red/ rgya dmag gis mi thog kun mnyam du bsad pa red/ de'i nang nas lo che chung zhig shes kyi ma red/ ro mang che ba shi lugs ltos dang / sgor bud nas chu kha dang ri ngo la 'bro sa nas bsad 'dug snying rje 'di tsho tshar 'duganya zer/ yang a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘da ni rgya dmag la thug na/ shi ma shi gang yang med/ ro lan re zung ma lon na mi min zer bar a phas 66nga tsho shi dgos na sla mo red/ ro lan re zung lon gyi red/ da dung shi rgyu yod pa ma red/sngon ma byis pa tsho yar lha sar skyel thub na/ shi yang drag gi/ da grwa pa rnam pas gong nas bsngo ba smon lam re gsung / nga tsho 'di nas yun ring 'gor mi nyan kho thag red ’zer/ de nas grwa pa tshos gong nas chos bton/ blo chos kyis nga khrid de gad thog nas so par bsdad/ ngas gad kha nas phyir bltas byas par/ gad zhabs/ thang thog ga sa gang na mi ro/ rta zog gi ro/ gur thed po log yod med gnyis ka/ ga sa gang du gtor yod pa'i ca lag shi ro za bzhin pa'i khyi sdom/gnam du 'khor bzhin pa'i bya rgod/ da ni lta bsam pa zhig med kyang / ngas sngar ltar zhib tu bltas shing sems la mi dran dgu dran red/ 'o dkon mchog gsum/ da thar ba'i lam zhig gang du yod/ nga la dbang zhig yod na/ da ni sngon du gom gang mi 'gro sems thag yin snyam song //270

5 3 rdzi skyi lum le tshan nga dgu pa/rgya sgar kha nas thar kyang / yul dmag gdong thug brgyab song /de ring nga tsho sngar ltar lam chen ded nas gshar bzhin yod la/ ngas kha sang gi don de dag sems su 'khor ba dang / yang bsam blo re btang na/ nyin gang du 'dang rgyag gis zas la yi ga med cing / mtshan gang por rmi lam 'khrug nas bde mo zhig gnyid thabs med/ don med du 'di 'dra mang po zhig gi tshe srog shor song / da ni 'jigs skrag gi snang ba med song la/ sdug bsngal gyi mchi ma thag tshar/ snying rje ba ni 'jigs skrag khrod du bsam ngo mi shes pa'i byis pa de dag red/ lhag tu snying rje ba ni bu phrug lag tu bzung nas bros kyang ma thar bar ma shi bu shi song ba'i ma drin can tsho red/ nga tsho gshar nas nyin gung la slebs dus/ lam nas bud med gnyis la thug pa na ‘‘'di tsho lha sa nas yong ba'i a mdo'i dbus pa yin 'dug nga tsho'i 'gram nas song ste nyi ma mang po ma 'gor bar/ sog po'i rgya dmag gis gtor tshar 'dug zer ba go song ’zer yang mos ‘‘da khyed rnam pa rgya lam nang drang mo ma 'gro ma gtogs/ rgyu mdo'i rgya sgar la thug gi red/ de ring kha sang dmag ha cang mang po 'dug’’zer/ de nas nga tsho 'gro mtshams bzhag nas ja bskol/ dgong mo a phas ‘‘da 'gro/ do dgong mtshan rgyu mdo'i thad nas 'bud ma thub dus/ sa 'di so g.yer che bas/ gab sa med par/ mgyogs po song na nam ma langs gong 'bud thub rgyu red’nyazer/ nga tsho mi rkyang rta rkyang lam du chas dus ha cang sla mo yin/ nam stod zla 'od cung yod pas 'gro bde mo zhig red/ mtshams rer ri rtsa na sde ba yod pas khyi zug pa dang /mi re gnyis kyis ki 'debs kyi 'dug skabs shig la glo bur du sngon nas 'bo ngar chen po zhig byas pas sngon du 'gro ba'i a pha dang blo chos kyi rta 'drogs shing /blo chos dang le kho gnyis thang du brgyab song / nga tsho'i rta cung 'drogs kyang skrag 271

mishu 0nga 0 5 rgya li ze3la snang chen po byed dgos ma byung / de'i mtshams nas me mda'i skad gnyis 'phro rim 'phror grag song la/ yang 'bo ngar chen po zhig byas song / sngon ma thams cad rta thog nas babs 'dug sa bu 'ja' pes ‘‘ma 'bab/ skrag dgos pa ma red/ dred mong redami’zer bar/ nged gnyis rta thog nas ma babs/ rjes nas bshad na khong tsho 'gro 'dug dus/ sngon nas dred mong zhig yar langs nas 'bo ngar byas la a pha rta nas ma lhung / blo chos rta nas lhung yang me mda' brgyab pas dred mong ri mgor bros song zer/ de nas cung song na ri rtsa nas lam chen zhig thug song / nga tshos lam de ded nas song la/ mtshams shig 'ur sgra ha cang chen po zhig grag gi 'dug sa khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘'di gnam gru 'phur ba yin pa 'dra nyazer/ a khu grags pas ‘‘ma red/ mtshan la gnam gru zhig 'phur ga la thub’ zer/ a phas ‘‘'di ni rlangs 'khor yin rgyu red/ de yin na skrag dgos pa ma red/ kho lam med sar 'gro thub kyi ma red’’zer/ yang cung song na sngon zhig nas 'ur sgra je che red la thag kyang je nye red/ de dus a phas ‘‘bzang ma song / nga tsho 'gro sa 'di rlangs 'khor gyi lam red 'dug da mgyogs po chu'i pha rol tu 'bud ’zer bar/ bshad ma tshar gong / sngon gyi gdong sna nas 'ur sgra dang bcas pa/ 'od chen po gnam kha gang ba zhig shar song / nga tsho tshang ma phyir 'khor nas bros/ glog gi 'od de nga tsho'i thog tu shar yod/ mi rta kun bros pa ha cang gsal po mthong gi 'dug phag shir/ phag phag shir/ me mda'i skad gcig 'phro gcig red la/ nga tsho bros 'gro sa'i bar du sa skya stog lhog me mdas rgyag gi 'dug a phas ‘‘lam nang nas ma 'bro ’zhes 'bod bzhin 'dug da ni cung skrag song / mgo thog nas mda'i zir sgra grag gi 'dug cung tsam nas nga tsho gdong sna glog med sa zhig la slebs shing de dus mi thams cad kha 'thor song / dung phrug skal bzang / a bu 'ja' pe nged bzhi mnyam du yod/ gzhan rnams gar song ma shes par phar bltas na rlangs 'khor bcu kha yod pa dal mo byas nas gshar song / de nas thams cad kyis phar 'bod tshur 'bod byas/cung 272

5 nga :malpi lham ma'agor bar kun mnyam du 'dzoms song / a pha dang a khu bstan 'dzin gnyis mabros par lam ltag tu rta bzung ste bsdad pa yin zer/ nam cung ma langs gong / nga tsho rgyu mdo'i rgya sgar 'og gi chu la bud nas song la/ gong gi nyag kha zhig la slebs dus nam langs song / nga tshos nyag kha nas phyir bltas na/ rgyu mdo'i rgya sgar thog tu gur dang dmag rta yis gang 'dug ming grags che ba'i rgyu mdo'i rgya sgar gyis nga tsho la gnod pa ci yang ma byas par thar song / de nas yang lung chung zhig gi phugs nas nyin gsum la tshugs brgyab nas bsdad/ grwa pa tshos rim gro bton pa dang a pha dang blo chos gnyis kyis bsangs btang / nyin 'ga'i sngon gyi mi shi rta 'gyel gyi 'jigs skrag kyang brjed pa 'dra zhig red/ da ni nyin mtshan nam 'gro dgos kyang lobs song bas/ dka' rgyu ci yang med la/ skrag rgyu sngar ltar mi 'dug da bar rang snge rang dgon nang slebs te zla gcig lhag 'gor/nyin mtshan ci 'dra yin yang / nga rang sgor bud nas rtas sa la brdab ma myong bas/ grwa pa tshos nga la ‘‘rta rgyab sbal ba’ zer/ nga'i sems nas kyang nyin mtshan nam song yang / rta gong nas lhung mi nyan bsam bsdad yod pas/ nga las sla mo lhung mi thub/ ngas dus rgyun rgya dmag dang thug nas gsod rgyu red bsam nas mi skrag gi/ nga rang mtshan mo rta thog nas lhung song na/ sa stong nas lhag rgyu red bsam nas skrag 'dug de bas shi ba srog la thug kyang / nga rang mtshan mo rta gong nas lhung mi nyan dran 'dug pas/ ci 'dra rgyugs/ ci 'dra bros kyang / rta thog nas lhung ma myong /de ring nga tsho lam la chas nas/ lung lag cig gi nang du slebs dus sngon nas du ba 'phyur 'dug a pas ‘‘nged gnyis song nas bltas yong / khyed rnams ga ler phebs shog’ zer nas a zhang smon lam khong gnyis sngon du phyin song / nga tsho der slebs pa na/ khong gnyis kyis me sbar nas ja bskol rtsis byas 'dug a phas 'di nas da nangs rkyang bda' zhig bsdad 'dug zer la/ thab kha'i shul na rkyang mgo dang / rkyang lpags dum bu re gtor 'dug da rung rkyang 273

leku 0nga snye5 5 la 8 rgyal5 i the3la5 sha zos rjes rus pa 'phangs 'dug nga tshos de ru ja bskol nas bsdad/ za 'thung tshar rjes nyin phyed du slebs yod la/ nga tsho yang sngar ltar lam la chas mtshams shig la brag rdo chen po mang po yod pa'i lung 'gag cig gi nang du slebs song/de dus sngon du 'gro ba'i a pha dang / a khu grags pa/ 'khang spral sogs rta gong nas babs te/ nga tshor ma yong zer ba'i lag brda byas song ༄/ nga min pa thams cad rta nas babs te sgug sa khu bstan 'dzin gyis rta bskyur te me mda' khur nas sngon du brgyugs/ ngas ci yin bsam nas snying tsha lang nge song / cung tsam nas sngon ma tshos phan tshun 'bod res byas nas skad cha bshad kyi 'dug phar phyogs nas ‘6me mda' ma 'phen/ khyed tsho skrag mi dgos zer la/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘nga tsho lha sar 'gro ba yin/ mang che ba grwa pa dang byis pa rkyang rkyang yin/ khyod tshos dogs pa za mi dgos’ sogs zer bar/ nga tshos rta khrid nas phar song / de dus nga tshos g.yon gyi brag kha nas/ me mda' bzung ba'i mi lnga drug cig langs te mar nga tsho'i phyogs su babs song / slog rgan gon par bltas na mgo log red bsam/ rtsib tu slebs dus khong tshos zha phud de nga tsho'i 'gram du slebs/ sngon nas a pha khong tsho dang mnyam du skya mi bcu lhag cig bsdad yod la/ mang che ba'i lag tu me mda' bzung 'dug ngas phar bltas pa na/ g.yag ded nas rkyang ro mang po bkal 'dug khong tsho ni mgo log rma stod kyi yul dmag rkyang bda' ru yong ba yin zer/ khong tshos kyang nga tsho grwa pa 'ba' zhig yin pa shes rjes me mda' ma brgyab pa yin zer/ khong tshos grwa pa rnams la mjal zhing / la las dngul sgor re zung phul/ da rung mi gcig gnyis kyis bsngo yig dang / bsngorten re grwa pa tshor phul/ de dus a pas ‘‘da ni rgya yis ha go song na/ khyed tshor gnod skyel gyi red/ de las nga tshos rgya la mgo btags na dga' ba min nam zer bar/ rgan po zhig gis ‘6de ring kha sang / grwa pa bla ma zhig gis rgya la mgo 'dogs sa zhig yod pa ma red/ nga tsho'i sde ba'i nang gi bla grwa thams cad 'dzin rgyu bzung tshar song / 'thab rtsod byas nas gsod rgyu ni bsad tshar song /274

5 (ḍa sku'ekhri yom da khyedarnam pa phebs song / nga tsho rang sde'i nang cung drag rgyu red’’zer bar/ grwa patshos ‘‘'o khyod tsho kha dro/ las lam du 'gro bar shog’nyasogs skad cha yag po bshad rjes/ nga tsho rang rang sar song / blo chos kyis ‘‘da snying rje/ rgan pos nga tsho mngags song / phar thon na khong tsho rgya 'og nas thar gyi ma red/ mi re gnyis kyi kha nas shor rgyu red go’ zer bar/ a phas mgo log gi mi 'di 66kha zhe mthun pas cung drag’’zer/ a khu grags pas ‘‘a rogs/ rgya 'di mtshar po/ bod pa'i lag tu 'di 'dra'i me mda' mang po re bzhag 'di tsho ngo log dang / yang na rir 'bro rgyur mi skrag pa yin namanya zer bar/ a phas ‘‘'di tsho rgya la mgo btags pa yin rgyu redanya ‘‘dang po nga tsho'i dgon pas mgo btags pa min nam/me mda' sprad pa mi dgos tshang ma bzung song ba min nam sogs bshad/ nga'i sems su rgya mtshar po/ yul dmag mtshar po/ ci yin na nga tshor phan btags song / rgan po sems bzang de tshor chag sgo re mi yong ba'i smon lam/ 'di ni nga tsho rang sa nas sgor bud nas da bar me mda' khur yod kyang / mi mi gsod pa'i drin chen zhig la thug pa bla ma dkon mchog gi bka' drin red dran song //le tshan drug cu pa/bdag po med pa'i zog lug bdag po med pa'i rmas ma/de ring gnam gshis ngan pa dang / snga dro gangs ma char 'bab bzhin 'dug sa phas da ni ‘‘a skyong gi sa thog tu slebs pa red/ ston kha nas kha ba chen po 'bab kyi red/ 'dir da rung rgya ma slebs pa yin rgyu red gomi zer/cung song dus lam gyi yar ngos shig na/ rta sga ma gnyis gsum gyis rtswa za bzhin 'duga.a khu bstan 'dzin gyis 6‘rta gan tsho bdag med yin pa 'dra red/ nga song nas khrid yong’’zer zhor du song / blo chos gyis 6‘lta yag gyis/ rtsib na mi yod srid ’zer/ nga tshos de nas sgug bsdad/ cung 'gor rjes a khu bstan 'dzin 275

mirgya 04 0 5 pha rgya 5 i tshe3la gyis rta sga ma gsum khrid nas slebs song / rta gcig gi sga sbodabs su drud 'dugarta bzang po 'ba' zhig yin pas a khu smon lam dang le kho gnyis dang / khal rta zhig cung ngan pas khong tshos rta de gsum brjes te khong gnyis kyi rta dang khal rta ri mgor btang song / nga tsho yang sngon du song / lam zur chu kha na rta bcu lhag dang / nor brgya tsam yod la / sus bshad pa ma shes ‘‘'o ya 'di na yang rta zog mang po zhig 'dug 'di tsho bdag po med pa mtshar po nyazer yang yar yar song bzhin ri thang kun tu/ bdag po med pa'i rta zog lug gsum gyis sa kha gang 'dug sa phas ‘6yag rgyu mi 'dug sa 'di tsho rgya dmag gis brlags tshar kho thag red/ de min 'di 'dra zog lug mang po zhig bdag po med zer ba mi srid ’zer bar/ a khu grags pas ‘‘yin rgyu red/ sa kha kun tu 'di 'dra lug mang po dang /'di khyim tshang mang po'i lug yin rgyu red/ ngas tshe 'dir lug 'di 'dra mang po zhig mthong ma myong zer/ de nas nga tshos nyag brgyab nas song bar nyag kha na khyi sdom mang po yod/ nga tsho thang thog tu babs rjes/ ri'i nyin khug na lug mang po spyang kis bsad yod pa mthong rgyu 'dug la/ khyi sdom tshos lug ro za bzhin yod/ri thang gnyis su phal cher lug brgya tsam bsad yod/ nga tsho chu rgyud ded nas yar song na/chu phar tshur du rta zog lug gsum bdag med ga sa ga na 'dug blo chos kyis ‘‘a rogs nga tshos zog lug 'di tsho bdag byas nas/ sa 'di nas lo re zung la bsdad bzhag na ci 'dra 'duganya’zer bar/ a zhang smon lam gyis 6‘smyo bshad ma byed/ 'di nas rang sde gtor tshar nas 'dug sa med par/ nga tsho de'i bar na 'dug sa zhig med pa los shesanya zer/ yang a khu grags pas ‘6'di sa stong yin rgyu ma red/ rgya dmag gis gang zhig la ded song ba yin rgyu red/ da 'di nga tsho'i mtha' ba dang gcig pa red/ mi tsho btsan gyis ded song nas/ zog lug bdag byed mkhan zhig med pa red/ rgya than 'di ma slebs sa zhig med pa 'di ci yin na/ bla ma dkon mchog dus 'di stod smad med par log 'dug zer/a phas ‘‘da 'di la bltas na/ lha sa phyogs kyang sdug rgyu red/ sde ba gzhung gi 276

5 4 8 skyi yo rkangadamag re zung gis rgya dmag mi khog kho thag redanya sogs zer zhor du song /da nithams cad yang sems mi bde shar re 'gro dus/ yang gong gi lam ltag na lug tsho bdag med cig yod par/ a khu bstan 'dzin/ 'khang spral/ tshe khogasum gyis lug ded nas slebs yong / nga'i sems su/ da yang gartor bsad thebs pa'i ru sde'i mtsher shul zhig tu thug la yod rgyu red bsam/ ya mtshan pa zhig la/nga tsho nyin gang por song yang / bdag med kyi rta zog lug gsum ga sa gang du 'dug la/ khyi sdom re zung las mi 'gro 'dug dang / yang na ru sde 'dra gcig la'ang ma thug nga'i sems su/ du ba gnam la 'gyur mkhan zhig med pa 'di ci yin nam/ bsad yod na shi ba'i ro med la/ ma bsad na gson po'i mi mi 'dug sogs mi dran dgu dran byas/ dgong mo nga tsho chu kha zhig tu bsdad/ do dgong nga tsho'i rtsib tu stong lug tsam bskor yod la/ ri mgo na rta zog mang po yod/ blo chos kyis ‘‘sang nyin nga tsho 'di nas ngal gso/ snga dro lug re gnyis ma bshas na bro sha mi 'dugazi zer bar/ a phas ‘‘thang thog 'di ru 'dug phod kyi ma red/ snga mo lug bshas tshar na yar cung 'gro dang / lung pa 'di'i stod na skung lung bde mo re yod kyi red/ de nas nyin gnyis gsum 'dug 'jog’ zer/mtshan kha ba ha cang chen po zhig babs 'dug nga tshos snga mor lug gsum bshas rjes yang bskyar bshar song / thag ring zhig la slebs dus/ ngas phyir bltas byas pa na/ lug mang che ba nyal 'dug la/ mdang kha ba babs pa'i ri ngos kyi rta zog kyang / lug gi rtsib tu slebs 'dug nga tsho 'gro shul na du ba sngon po 'phyur 'dug pas/ phar bltas na khyim tshang phyug po zhig bsdad yod pa 'dra/ don dngos thog 'di ni rta zog lug gsum 'dzoms pa'i sa stong zhig red/ nga tsho ri khug cig nas nyin gsum bsdad rjes/ da nangs nam ma langs gong nas lam la chas/cung tsam nas kha ma char re 'bab cing rlung grang mo zhig g.yug song / nga'i slog ngan ga sa gang du thed khung yod pas rlung mi rgyag sa zhig mi 'dug ga chung rnams kyang 'khyags nas kha 'dar khog 'dar byed 'dugacung tsam la chu'i pha rol nas 277

leku 0ci 0 5 la rgyal5 i nye3la5 skya mi rta khrid gnyis 'gro bzhin yod par/ blo chos dang a khu bstan 'dzin gnyis thad gar gtugs song / nga tsho sngon la cung nas song ste ja bskol nas bsdad/khong gnyis slebs dus blo chos kyis ‘‘sa 'dir yul sde ba gtor tshar nas mnyam las khang btsug tshar ba red zer/ sa 'di tsho gtor mkhan/ sog po'i rgya dmag yin pas thug tshad bzung rgyu dang / rig tshad bsad song zer la/ sog dmag la mgo btags sa mi 'dug zer/ khong tshos bshad na de ring kha sang 'di ru rgya dmag mi 'gro mi 'dug sa zhig med pas/ lam chen ded nas ma 'gro zer nyasogs mang po bshad song / a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘da ni lag tu shor song na/ 'gyod rgyu rta rnga tsam med/ yul sde ba shi gtor tshar sa nas/ nga tsho thar bas dga' rgyu ci yang medanyanyazer/ a khu grags pas ‘‘da thar yang ma thar yang / lha sar ngo gtad nas 'gro rgyu ma gtogs yod pa ma redami zer bar/ blo chos kyis ‘‘bla ma dkon mchog byis pa 'di tsho chos sa zhig la e zhog bsam nas/ rang sa bskyur nas sa mthar 'khyams yong ba red/ da ni mtha' ci red na'ang lha sa ma gtogs bsam rgyu ci yang medami zer/ a phas ‘‘de ring kha sang zhig nas rmi lam yag po mi 'dug zhe bde mo zhig ma red de/ 'gyod rgyu yod pa ma red/ shi gson ci 'dra byung yang / skya ser bcu gnyis 'di las kyis 'dzoms song ba red’ sogs/ yang thams cad kyis sems mi bde ba'i skad cha mang po bshad song / ngas ‘‘a pha/ de ring kha sang ngas kyang rmi lam ngan pa rkyang rkyang rmis song’’zhes bshad par/ khong tshos mtshar bgad shor zhing lan ci yang ma brgyab/ dngos gnas ngas rgya dmag gis me mda' brgyab nas/ a pha nged gnyis kyi mgo nas khrag bzhur ba sogs rmi lam ngan pa mang po rmis song / mdang yang nga tsho rgya mis gtor tshar 'dug la/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kho na thang stong zhig nas 'bro bzhin yod pa sogs rmis song yang khong tshor bshad ma phod/ da ni dgong mo nyal ran kha nas/ yang rmi lam ngan pa rmis rgyu red bsam nas nyal 'dod med pa ltar gyur 'dug nga tsho sngar ltar 'gro skabs zhig la/ sngon nas 'khang spral dang / le kho gnyis kyis 278 ༄

5 ( nga sres lpi yo ‘‘sngon du mi mang po bsdad 'duganya zer/ nga tsho der slebs pa na/ rgan rgon lnga drug cig bsdad 'dug mang che ba nyal yod par rmas phog nas 'gul mi thub zer/ yang rgan pa dang byis pa re zung rtsib na bsdad yod/ blo chos kyis ‘‘snying rje 'di tsho yang rgya dmag gi gtor song ba yin 'dug ’zer la/ a pha/ blo chos/a khu bstan 'dzin sogs kyis rmas ma rnams la rma las byas/ blo chos kyis phying ba dum bu zhig mer bsregs nas a pha'i lag tu bzhag sa phas brla bcad yod pa'i rmas ma zhig gi rma kha la phying ba sbyar nas bsdams te ‘‘da drag gi red/ khrag chod song / shi ni ma redami zer/ khong tshos rmas ma thams cad la rma las byas shing / grwa pa tshos rmas ma tshor sha dang / rtsam pa byin/ yang bu mo chung chung lo lnga drug can zhig gi lag par me mda' gnyis brgyab yod la/ rus pa bcag med/a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyis de la rtsam pa brdzis te byin/ mos ‘‘pha ma gnyis bsad tshar zer nas ngu 'bod byas pas/ nga rang kyang mig nas mchi ma rang dbang med par shor song / rgan po zhig gis 6‘nga tsho rdza chu kha/ rdza mu ra spral sku'i sde ba yin/ spral sku dang mi mang po bsad song / sde ba mang che bas rgya darmog dang 'dzings rjerlo stod la shor song / nga tsho gtor tshar rjes 'di nas lhag song / da rung gong du rmas ma bcu kha zhig yod/ de tshar za rgyu med pas kha dro rogs pa re ma 'chuganya ces bshad/ de nas nga tsho sngon du cung song ba na/ gad khug cig na rmas ma bcu tsam bsdad yod la/ snod chag cig gi nang du chu zhig bskol nas bsdad 'dug nga tsho der slebs pa na mang che ba yar langs nas phyag 'tshal/ a pha dang / blo chos gnyis kyis rta rgyab nas dro kha blangs shing / grwa pa tshos rmas ma rnams la dro kha sprad/ a pha dang blo chos gnyis kyis yang rmas ma rnams la rma las byas/ rmas ma mang che ba bud med rkyang rkyang red/ rgan mo zhig gis ‘‘nga tsho'i rogs pa mang che ba rgya dmag dang 'dzing rjes shor song / khyed tsho lam nas thug na/ nga tsho 'di na lhag 'dug zer rogs/ da ni nga tsho sa stong nas shi yi red1)zer zhor dang ngu zhor byas/ de'i skabs su stod kyi ri mgo zhig na zog 'ga' re yod 279

7 snye0ci 5 5 rgyapa5 ekhyemel pa rig nas/ a pha dang / blo chos gnyis song nas ded yong la/ 'bri yar khrid lnga drug dang g.yag lnga yod/ a kha khong gnyis kyis g.yag che ba gnyis bshas/ de dus a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘6rgan po zhig khrid yong nas/ da khyed tshos 'bri 'di tshor bdag gyis/ sha 'di tsho zos dang / mu ges shi ni ma red’’zer/ nga tsho blo sems ha cang mi bde bar gshar song / nga'i sems su snying rje/ rir bros nas thag ring po 'di 'dra zhig la slebs rjes gtor 'gro ba las/ rang sa nas shi song na dga' dran zhor du yang sngon du song //le tshan re gcig pa/me mda' 'grogs shing khal bcom/ dmag dang mi 'dzing thabs med/nyi ma 'ga'i ring la/ nga'i mig lam du/ pha ma gnyis ka bsad song zer ba'i bu mo mas ma de shar 'dug snying rje kho tsho lha sar slebs rgyu red bsam nas/pha yul bskyur te sa mtha' 'grim pa yin la/ 'di 'dra'i chag sgo mgor lhung ba sems su 'khor rgyu ma red/ pha ma bsad rjes sa stong nas lus song / nga tsho'i bsam pa gcig pa red/ 'gro lugs gcig pa red/ 'on kyang / chag sgo da rung nga tsho'i mgo ru cung lhung med/ da ni nyin re las nyin rer lha sa ru thar rgyu red bsam rgyu med la/ sems su dran pa ni de ring gtor na snga song / sang nyin gtor na 'phyi song / yul sde ba thams cad mi thar sa'i bar na/ nga tsho thar 'gro sa'i lam re e yod/ dka' mo red bsam pa sogs yin/ bye ma'i nyag sgang zhig la slebs dus/ yang sngon ma thams cad rta las babs 'dug 'khang spral gyis babs shog rgya dmag 'dug zer la/ nga rang sngon du ma song la rta thog rnos kyang ma babs/ cung tsam nas nga rang sngon du song nas/ sgang phar rgyab kyi thang thog chu kha nas/ rta dmag brgya phrag mang po gral bsgrigs nas gshar bzhin 'dug la/ rlung dmar g.yug pas mtshams rer mi mthong / a phas ‘‘'di lha sa'i phyogs 280

5 ( thi ༅ milu sa'agro ba yin rgyu redami zer/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘6shi re kho/ 'di tsho tshang zlo gsod dgos sa redanya zer/ a phas 6‘da sgug tshod mi 'dug khyod tshos phyir chu khar song nas ja skol/ ngas 'di nas so rgyag 'dug’ zer bar/ blo chos kyis 6‘ja bskol e phod dmanyanyazer/ ‘‘drag gi red/ rlung che bas rgya yis dud dri tshor gyi ma red’nyazer bas/ nga tsho phyir chu gzhung du babs te ja bskol nas za 'thung byas/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis sha dang / ja khyer nas a pha'i sar song / nyin gung khong gnyis kyis nga tsho yar shog zer ba'i brda brgyab song / nga tsho nyag brgyab ste song / dgong mo chu kha na rtswa yag po skyes yod sa zhig tu gur phub nas bsdad/skabs shig la dung phrug dang / skal bzang gnyis chu rgyud nas rgyug zhor du rgya slebs yong gi/ rgya dmag slebs yong gi 'dug zer/ skya ser thams cad 'tshub se langs song / blo chos kyis ‘‘khyed rnams bzhugs sdod nga tsho yin zer zhor du me mda' khur nas rta yod sar brgyugs/ de dus a pha dang a khu bstan 'dzin gnyis rta zhon nas slebs song la/ a phas ‘‘khyed rnams 'dir bzhugs sdod/rgya dmag mang nas gal srid nga tsho ma thar na/ khyed tshos mgo thogs dang drag rgyu red/ pha bzang bu tsho su rjes nas lhag na/ byis pa tsho la bdag yag po re gzab rogs ’zer zhor du khong gsum rgyugs song / nga rang yar gad thog tu bud nas bltas/ grwa pa zhig gis 6‘nus kho der ma 'bud/ phyir shog ’zer yang / nga phyir ma yong / ngas 'di nas rig 'dug g.yag ded cig yong gi yod pa las/ rgya dmag yong ba mi mthong bas nga cung tsam yang ma skrag sa pha khong gsum chur bud rjes rta chu kha nas mngags te/ g.yag 'ded sngon gyi ri 'bur zhig gi mgo nas bsgug 'dug g.yag ded kyis khong tsho mthong med pas/ sngar ltar khong gsum la gtad nas yong / ri 'bur 'gram du slebs pa na me mda'i skad grag song bar/rgya mi gos sngon po can zhig rta thog nas thang du g.yugs song / rta pa rjes ma re zung rta 'drogs nas thang du brgyab 'dug kyang / yar langs nas lag pa gnam la bkyags te bsdad 'dug de dus a pha khong gsum yar langs nas mi de tsho 281

leku 0nga snye5 5 la rgyal5 i che3la5 yod sar song / ngas phyir bltas byas pa na/ grwa pa rnams da rung gad khug na bsdad 'dug ngas khong tshor yar shog zer ba'i lag brda byas par/ khong tsho yar langs nas nga yod sar slebs song / de nas a zhang smon lam/ grags pa/'khang spral bcas rtar zhon nas blta ru song /chu pha rol na mi la las gur phub 'dug zlo/ g.yag 'ded tsho yang der bsdad song / cung ma 'gor bar nga tsho'i mi thams cad tshur slebs song / a pha dang / a khu bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis mi res me mda' bu ra gsar pa re dang / mda' mang po khur 'dug blo chos kyis mda' 'phra gsar pa zhig khur 'dug kho tshos ‘‘rang gi me mda' stong pa byas te g.yag 'ded tsho la sprad zin zer/ da rung phye 'bras dang go re mang po khur yod/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘blo chos dang 'dul kho khyed gnyis kyis bkag med na/ ngas rgya ngan gnyis ka bsad mi 'jog nanya zer bar/ a phas ‘‘khyod kyis rgya gnyis ka gsod shog dang / sang nyin rgya mis bod pa lnga po gsod rgyu red/rgya gcig ma bsad na/ khos skad cha bshad chog gi’ red la/ bod pa tsho'i mgo la chag sgo yong rgyu ma redanya’ces khong tshos rgya dmag gi brdal ba blangs pa'i skor kyi skad cha mang po bshad/ de ring rgya gcig bsad/ me mda' gsum dang / mda' mang po lon yod pas a khu bstan 'dzin khong tsho ha cang dga' 'dug da ni rgya dmag gi brdal ba blangs tshar bas nga tsho nam ma langs gong nas/ lam du chas te nyin mtshan gnyis la song / skabs shig la lung pa chen po zhig gi nang nas yar la 'gro dus/ nga rang da nangs nas mgo cung gzer 'dug pas/ a pha'i rta 'phongs la bzhag yod/ 'di ni khyim nas sgor bud de thengs dang po ngas kher rta ma byas par/ a pha'i rta 'phongs su 'byar ba yin/ dus rgyun nga a bu 'ja' pe dang mnyam du rta ba tsho'i dkyil nas 'gro ba las/sngon du 'gro ru mi 'jug rjes su yang lus mi 'jug de ring ni a pha dang mnyam sngon du song bar/ snang ba ha cang skyid po red/ nga tsho lung pa'i phug gi brag 'gag yod pa'i nyag khar slebs ran khar/ a khu bstan 'dzin sngon ma yin/ de'i 'phro na a pha nged gnyis yod/282

ske 5 (khyi tshurshalpi lug nyag kha nas khyi gnyis nga cho'i thog tu rgyugs yong / blo chos sa la babs nas rdo re blangs/ skabs der a khu bstan 'dzin gyis 6‘rgya dmag 'duganyanyazer zhor du mgo nas me mda' blangs/ phag shir/ phag shir zhes me mda'i skad mang tsam grag song zhing / nga'i mchan rtsib cig nas ldir sgra shig ge 'phar 'dra yong la/ a pha nged gnyis ka rta thog nas sa la brgyab song / nga'i sems su a pha la me mda' brgyab tshar song bsam zhor du mgo yar bkyags dus/ a phas me mda' bzung nas nyag khar rgyugs pa dang / blo chos kyang a pha dang mnyam du rgyugs song / de dus a khu bstan 'dzin gyis brag tho zhig gi thog nas rgya dmag thog tu me mda' 'phen bzhin 'dug ga pa thams cad kyis rang rang gi rta mi do bar 'tshub log nyil le byed 'dug nga rang yar langs nas a pha dang / blo chos gnyis kyi rta bzung nas/ brag tho che ba zhig yod pa'i rtsib tu gab bsdad/ mtshams shig blo chos phyir yong nas ‘6a khu grags pa khyod kyis byis pa tsho khrid de lung mda' nas sgug sdod/ rgya je mang red/ nged tshos khog rgyu ma red ’zer zhor du/ a khu bstan 'dzin kho gnyis kyis rta bzung zhing / nga rang a zhang smon lam gyi rta 'phongs su bzhag de nas nga tsho phyir bltas med par chu rgyud ded nas phyir lung mda' ru bros/ me mda'i skad go 'dug la mis mi mthong sar slebs/ nga rang gi rtar zhon/da ni skrag nas yin rgyu red/ mgo gzer rgyu med song / a khu grags pas ‘‘da 'bro ma gtogs/ khong tsho dang kha 'thor gyi redaminyazer bar/ a zhang smon lam gyis ‘‘da rung 'gro/ khong tsho ma thar na zer rgyu mi 'dug thar thub na nga tsho thag ci tsam ring na/ khong tsho skya rkyang 'bro bde ba redami’zer bar/ nga tsho yang sngon du song / skabs shig la me mda'i skad go rgyu med song / thams cad sems mi bde bar 'gro mtshams bzhag nas phyir bltas byas/ de dus kun gyis sems su dran rgyu gcig red/ da khong gsum po tshar song / cung tsam nas yang me mda'i skad go song bas nga tsho yang sngon dus bros/ de dus rjes ma zhig gis khong gsum ga slebs song zer/ ngas phyir bltas byas pa na khong gsum bros yong gi yod la/283

leku 0ci 5 5 la snye 9la5 e nyilel5 rgyang nas rgya dmag gis me mda' 'phen zhor du ded yong gi 'dug ngas 6‘a zhang smon lam rgya dmag gis ded yong gi 'dug nyabarjod par/ a zhang gi skad mthon pos ‘6g.yon gyi brag gdong thog tu bud shog da mgyogs po gdong thog la bud shog’ zer bas/ tshang ma rgyugs nas brag gdong du bud/ de dus a pha khong gsum yang ri rtsar slebs song / rgya dmag mthong rgyu med/ khong gsum sgang thog tu slebs ran khar/ rgya dmag skor zhig gis gzhug nas me mda' 'phen zhor du rgyugs yong gi yod par/ phar bltas na skya mi bcu tsam yod/ khong gsum gdong thog tu slebs dus/ rta mngags nas brag tho zhig gi rtsib nas me mda' bzung ste bsgugs/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis dpung g.yon pa cung rmas te khrag bzhur gyi 'dug a phas rma las byas/ a khu bsngan 'dzin gyis ‘‘pha bzang bu gnyis/ da res sa babs yag pas ma 'chug nyazer bar/ a phas ‘6yar thag nyer yong du chug do do tan tan gyis/ ma 'chug kha shas gsod thub na kha skor thub kyi redami zer/ nga tshos gong gi brag rtsa nas bltas bsdad/ rgya dmag thang gzhung nas rgyugs yong ba mthong gi 'dug la/ khong tshos rgyug zhor du me mda' 'phangs pa nga tsho'i mgro thog nas zir zir grag 'dug de'i skabs a pha'i me mda' kha grag song la/ rgya dmag sngon ma de rta gong nas skya log ger sa thog tu brgyangs song bas rta de kha phyir 'khor song / rgya dmag da rung rgyug 'dug la/ blo chos dang a khu bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis me mda' kha mnyam du grag song / yang rgya dmag sngon ma de mi rta gnyis ka skya log ger ril song / de'i 'phror yang a gas rgya dmag gcig mi rta gnyis ka bsgyel song / da ni rgya dmag sngon du rgyug ma phod par/ rta pa kha shas g.yas phyogs kyi shur nang du bros/ kha shas rtas thang la brgyab rjes/ rta shor song bas thang thog tu nyal nas nga tsho la me mda' 'phen 'dugacung 'gor ba na g.yas ngos kyi shur kha nas rgya dmag gcig yar bud de/ gdong dmar lang nge nga tsho'i phyogs su rgyugs yong bar/ a pha'i me mda'i skad grag ma thag dmag sngon ma rta gong nas ser nar re g.yugs te 'gril song / a khu bstan 284

ga5snye ( ci khu3 skyi pog 'dzin khong gnyis kyis yang de 'phro'i rgya dmag de/ mi rta gnyis ka nag 'a༄1ba se btang nas 'gril song bas/ rgya dmag rjes ma tsho mar shur nang du bros song /de nas rgya dmag gis kyang rgyang nas me mda' 'phen pa las sngon la rgyug mkhan med/ a phas ‘‘da mun rub song / nga tsho phyin 'gro/ rjes 'ded kyi ma red zer bar/ nga tshos rta khrid de brag rgyab nas babs te bshar song / rgya dmag gis da dung me mda' re gnyis 'phen bzhin 'dug/le tshan re gnyis pa/mkhar ri rdza rgan gzhung nas/ yang bskyar rgya dang 'dzing song /kha nyin rgya dmag 'dzing sa nas thar song bas/ nga tsho lung khug cig tu nyin gnyis gsum la bsdad/ phar bltas na rgyang nas mtsho storing mthong gi 'dugad nangs yang nam ma langs gong nas lam du song bar/ a phas ‘‘do dgong nga tsho mkhar gzhung du slebs rgyu red/ de nas bu rgyud kyi sa thog tu slebs pa red/rgya dmag 'dra slebs med na ngo shes grogs po re zung yod pas/ 'gro bde ba redami’zer/ dgong mo nga tsho mkhar ri tsha rdas dmar leb kyi rtsib tu bsdad/ 'dug sa ni khug cig yin pas gab sa bde mo zhig red/ gad thog tu bud na thang gzhung thams cad mthong 'dug nga tsho yang 'di nas nyin gnyis bsdad/ de ring snga dro a bu 'ja' pe dang / dung phrug gnyis 'bud shing 'thu ru song / phyir slebs dus ‘6thang mgo ri rtsa na ru sde mang po 'duganya zer/ nga tsho gad kha ru bud nas bltas par/ ri rtsa na sbra gur mang po yod cing / zog lug kyang ha cang mang po 'duga.a phas ‘‘da rung zer mi shes/ rta rnams gad thog tu 'bud ma bcug du ba chen po 'gyur du ma 'jug nga tsho gad thog ma bud na/ khong tshos nga tsho mthong ni ma red/ nyin gung rdzi bo yong na skad cha 'dri chog gi redaminyazer/ nga tshos lha rta gnyis ma gtogs rta thams cad btags yod/cung tsam nas nga tsho'i thad kyi ri rtsa nas/285

mi410na 5 5 la 8 09go5 ikhye345 rta pa bcu kha zhig dang g.yag 'ded cig yong gi 'dug le khos 6‘rgya red/ bar ma thams cad rgya dmag red zer bar/ 'khang spral gyis sngon ma tsho bod pa red de/ me mda' khur 'dug’nyazer/ a khu bstan 'ardzon gyis ‘‘'di tsho yang rgya dmag gis mnan yod 'dug ’zer la/ a zhang smon lam gyis ‘6kha thal bas chod/ da ni bod kyi sa cha yod tshad rgya dmag slebs med sa zhig yod rgyu ma red go’ zer/de dus a phas bu rgyud rgya zhabs su mnan tshar dus/ 'bri chu rab bdun rgya dmag gis bkag tshar rgyu red/ des na nga tsho lha sar thar dka' rgyu red/ 'jam gyis ma thar na/ rgya dmag dang 'dzing nas mi thar kho thag red ’ces bshad/ skabs shig la ngas gad kha nas bltas/ lug re thag nye sar slebs yod la/ gong gi na thog na bud med gnyis bsdad yod pa lug rdzi yin kho thag red/ ngas ‘6a pha 'di na lug rdzi gnyis 'dug ’ces brjod par/ a phas 6‘khyod tsho sdod dang / ngas skad cha zhig 'dri yong ’zer nas rgyang skor byas te/ bud med rdzi bo gnyis kyi sar song / yun ring kha brda byas/ skabs shig la a pha yar langs nas yang rgyang bskor te nga tsho'i sar slebs/ khos ‘‘bu rgyud dpon skor dang / stod tshang / sngo tshang ru ba red 'dug khong tsho'i dpon pos rgya la mgo btags nas/ rgyas btsan po byas nas mnyam las khang ngaXsags tshar 'dug gur tsho ni shog kha srid gzhung red/ khong tsho'i mi skya dang / grwa pa thams cad rgya mis bzung tshar song zer’ zhes bshad/ de dus a khu bstan 'dzin gyis rgan po zhig khrid yong la/ rgan po'i lag tu ras khug cig gi nang du bu ra'i mda' brgya tsam khur 'dug a khu bstan 'dzīn gyis rgan pos da rung gong gi ri ngo na me mda' bskungs yod zer/ ngas da mde' yod na chog ces bshad pa yin zer la/ rgan po des ‘‘da nga tsho ru sde thams cad tshar song / da ni me mda' rgya mis mthong nyan gyi ma red/ khyed tshor go re chod kyi red/ mda' 'di las med/ me mda' dgos na do dgong ngas blangs yong /nga tsho'i sde ba'i me mda' snga mo nas rgya dmag gis blangs tshar ba red/ dpon pos rgya la mgo btags tshar thal/ rgyas glo med byas nas bla ma/ grwa pa/ mi skya pho mo 286

ga5 ( ci rdzi nyi lum thamasacad bzung tshar song / nga'i bu/ mag pa thams cad bzung tshar song / da ni sa'adi na rgya dmag med sa zhig yod pa ma red/ lha sar 'gro mkhan dbus pathams cad 'bri chu rab bdun nas rgya dmag gis brlags tshar song / da khyed tsho thar dka' rgyu red’ ces skad cha mang po bshad/ a khu bstan 'dzin khong tsho ni ma bsam sa nas mda' 'di 'dra mang po zhig lag tu yong bas ha cang dga' 'dug sa khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘a pha la da yang mda' yod song / pha bzang bu khyod me mda' kha tsha bas ma 'chugashi dgos na las yin/ ro skyin re lon dgos pa red/ de min da thar rgyu red bsam rgyu cang med’ ces bshad/da nangs nam ma langs gong nas song la/ skya mda' 'then dus nga tsho sa de'u 'bur mang po yod sa zhig tu slebs song / nga tshos bye ma'i lam skya shar zhig ded nas 'gro skabs/ rjes nas me mda'i skad cig go song / gcig gis ‘‘rgya dmag slebs song nyazer/ nga tsho thang thog gyen du bros par me mda'i skad je mang red/ mda' ni nga tsho'i g.yas g.yon du thal skya lhog thal skya lhog rgyag gin 'dug sa phas rgyug zhor du ‘6a khu bstan 'dzin yan gyi de'u mgo la rgyugs/da sa zhig ma zin na ri bros nas thar sa ma red zer bar/ rgya dmag gis da rung nga tsho'i thog tu me mda' 'phangs te/ tshag dir sbag dir byed kyi 'dug kyang /nga tsho'i mi rta gcig la'ang ma phog nga tsho de'u de'i mgor slebs pa na thang nas rgya dmag nyi shu tsam gyis thal skya gor re me mda' 'phen zhor du rgyug zhor byed kyi 'dug a phas ‘‘grwa pa tsho de'u rgyab tu gab sdod/ nga 'di ru 'dug a khu bstan 'dzin/ blo chos khyed gnyis phar gyi thod 'go nas sdod/ 'di nas sa btsan pas ngo re lon yang srid/ mun rub na drag gi red’’zer zhor me mda' sngon du bzhag nas sgug nga dang a bu 'ja' pe/ 'khang spral gsum a pha'i rgyab tu bsdad/ mi gzhan rnams a khu bstan 'dzin yod sa'i rde'u rgyab tu rta bzung nas bsdad yod/blo chos kyis ‘‘ya 'dul kho pha bzang bu/ khyod kyis de ring bu ra gsar pas kha shas kha phab dgos pa redami zer/ rgya dmag thang sne ru slebs dus a khu bstan 287

leku 0tri 5 5 8 mi9la5 ikhye3lakhu 'dzin gyis me mda' brgyab nas/ rta ba sngon ma mi rta gnyis ka thal skya 'tshub be log song / de dus a pha'i me mda'i skad grag song / yang rta ba sngon ma zhigaskya na re rta thog nas g.yugs song la/ rta ba rjes ma'i nang nas mi rta gnyis skyalog ger ril song / dmag rjes ma da rung sngon du rgyug 'dug de dus a phas‘‘stob dkar po can de la ltos sdodami zer ba dang mnyam du me mda'i skad gragasong la/ rta dkar po'i gong gi rgya dmag de ser nar re thang la g.yugs song / skabs der yang a khu bstan 'dzin dang blo chos gnyis sus brgyab ma shes par yang rgya dmag sngon ma zhig mi rta gnyis ka skya log ger bsad song / dus der rgya dmag sngon du rgyug mi thub par/ phar tshur gyi de'u 'bur rgyab tu bros/ de ring rgya dmag gi nang du gon pa sngon po can 'ga' re yod 'dug a khu bstan 'dzin a pha'i sar yong nas ‘‘de ring sa btsan pas/ sems thag cig mi gcod na’ zer la/a phas 6‘mda' nyung 'phen gyis dang / da ngo lon song / da ni rgyang nas me mda' kha su tsha red ’zer bar/ de dus de'u 'bur rgyab tu bros pa'i rgya dmag de/ de'u mgo zhig tu bud nas/ ci kon me 'da' 'phangs song bas/ a khu bstan 'dzin sogs kyis de'u mgo nas sa ma zin par phyir nud byas/ phar bltas na de'u mgonas/ rgya dmag gnyis kyis ci kon me mda' 'phen bzhin 'dug yo phas ‘‘a khu bstan 'dzin 'dir shog nged gnyis me mda' kha bsgrigs nas/ khong gnyis e thub blta )zer/ a khu bstan 'dzin dang khong gnyis kyis me mda' mnyam du 'phangs pas ci kon me mda' sgug se song / blo chos kyis ‘‘thub song / thub songanya zer zhor du slebs song / de dus a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘a pha rgyab nas rgya dmag yong gi 'dug ’zer bar/ phyir bltas byas pa na/ nga tsho'i g.yon gyi de'u zhabs nas rta ba gsum yar nga tsho'i de'u mgo la gtad nas rgyug yong gi yod pas/ a phas ‘‘rta nag nag can der ltos zer zhor du me mda'i skad grag song /rgya dmag de rta thog nas g.yugs song / de 'phror a khu bstan 'dzin dang blo chos gnyis kyis kyang dmag gcig mi rta gnyis ka bsad song / rta ba gcig kha thur 288

ga5 'i spode nyi lu 'khor nas bros/ de dus yang ci kon me mda' yod pa'i de'u mgo nas dmag mi gcig bud yong bar/ blo chos kyis 6‘yang pha gi na dmag 'iduganya ces tshig rnga ma bud gong a pha'i me mda'i skad grag byung / rgya dmag de de'u mgo nas mar ril song / a phas ‘‘bstan 'dzin khyod de'u mgo pha kir mig thig zhog sdod/ ci kon me mda'i rtsib tu mi 'gro ru ma 'jug zer/ a khu smon lam gyis ‘‘ma ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ de ring thub song zer la/ a phas ‘‘khyod tshor mda' ci tsam yodami dris par/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘6nga la mda' bcu drug yodami zer/ blo chos kyis 6‘nga la da rung mda' nyi shu lhag yodami zer/ ‘‘mda' la tshod gyis ma gtogs/ rgya dmag bsad kyin bsad kyin je mang red/ mda' med na thub kyi ma redanya zer/dgong nyi ma'i grib chen 'gug dus/ thang rnga nas yang dmag tsho gcig slebs yong la/ phar bltas na sum cu tsam yod pa 'dra/ blo chos kyis ‘‘da mgyogs po sgang ded nas ri mtho sar 'gro ma gtogs/ thub ma song’ zer/ a phas 6‘da rung drag gi/ nga tsho 'gro rgyu sla po redami’zer zhor du/ lag tu za bzhin pa'i sha nga'i lag tu bzhag ste me mda' phar sngon du bzhag a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘'di tsho rgya dmag ngo ma red/cung thag nyer yong du 'jug e phod mi shes )zer/ rgya dmag sngar ltar nga tsho'i phyogs su rgyug yong / a phas ‘‘da nged gsum gyis sngon ma rta ba nag po de'i thog lag rub nas rgyag rgyu yin’ zer bar/ kho tsho'i me mda'i skad grag song / sngon gyi rta ba nag po de mi rta gnyis ka dang / rgyab kyi dmag zhig dang mnyam du thal skya log ge ril song / yang me mda' kha bsgrigs nas skor re zung 'phangs par/ sngon du rgyug pa'i mi rta gnyis gsum ril song bas/ de nas dmag mang che ba g.yas g.yon gyi de'u 'bur rgyab tu bros/ mar bltas na thang sne na mi rta lnga drug cig bsad 'dug de dus g.yon gyi de'u 'bur mgo ru rgya dmag 'ga' re bud cing / yang ci kon me mda' nga tsho'i phyogs su 'phen 'dug la/ mda' yi nga tsho'i g.yas g.yon gyi brag ngor brgyab nas me stag 'dra mched kyi 'dug rgya dmag gis da rung me skyogs 'phangs song bar/ nga tsho yod sa'i 289

ce 0ra 5:5:la 149la5 i nye3la5 de'u 'bur gyi dma' sa nas gad kyang / rgya dmag sngon du rgyug mkhan med/ a phas ‘‘mun rub kha rgya dmag rtsib tu yong gi ma red’ zer bar/ khong tshos kyang me mda' re gnyis 'phangs nas bsdad/ mun rub tshar dus/ nga tsho de'u 'bur rgyab nas bskor te ri rgyud nas bros song ba yin//le tshan re gsum pa/mang sna nyung gis ma brten/ mtha' ma gtor shi thebs song /mdang nga tsho ri sgang nas thar rjes/ a phas ‘6de ring nga tshos rgya kha shas bsad pas/ da rgya dmag gis nga tsho las sla mo mngag gi ma red’ zer bas nga tsho mtshan gang du bros te song / nam langs dus chu chen zhig gi kha ru slebs/ nyi ma shar dus nga tshos rdo ra zhig gi khug nas ja bskol/ za 'thung byed dus/ blo chos kyis ‘‘ston nas skya mi g.yag 'ded cig yong gi 'dug’nyazer bar/ a khu bstan 'dzin dang khong gnyis kyis me mda' bzung nas blta ru song / cung ma 'gor bar rta ba gsum dang g.yag sga stong bzhi bcu tsam 'ded mkhan zhig slebs song / khong tshos nga tsho'i sa nas za 'thung byas/ khong tshos ‘‘nga tsho chu dmar rdzong ba yan zer ba nas yin/ 'di na rgya dmag med sa yod pa ma red/ khyod tsho 'di nas ma 'gro ma gtogs thar rgyu ma redami ces bshad/ de nas nga tsho rang rang lam du chas song / nyin gung nga tsho bye lung chen po zhig gi khog nas yong dus/le khos ‘‘sngon na rgya dmag yong gi 'dug zer/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis 66rgya dmag mang po zhig yong gi 'dug da ni gdong thug brgyab song / 'dzing rgyu ma gtogs med songanya zer bar/ a phas ‘6sdug ma thug na 'dzings rgyu yod pa ma red/ da ci yin na'ang yan gyi bye lung de'i nang du 'go ’zer bar nga tsho rtsib kyi bye lung phra mo zhig yod pa'i nang du 'dzul nas/ nang gyen du rgyugs/ cung mtho sa ru slebs dus lung chung zhig nas gab bsdad/ mar bltas na rgya dmag 290

ci thurshalpi/yo brgyatsho gcig tsam chu rgyud du slebs nas gshar bzhin 'dug cing / nga tsho gong na gab yod pa ma mthong / de nas nga tsho bye lung de brgyud nas nyag brgyab/ nyag khar slebs pa na a phas ‘6'di rngam ri'i khog red/ lag pa g.yon gyi ri mthon po'adi/ rngam ri'i khyung gshog rgo mgo red/ da nga tsho 'di nas mar babs/ lung mdo nas rngam ri'i chu la bud na/ chu dmar rgod ma lung du slebs pa red/ do dgong yin gcig min gnyis chu dmar chu la 'bud dgos rgyu redami’zer/ nyag kha nas mar babs pa na/ lung chung zhig gi nyin ngos gdong khug na ma ṇi cung tsam spangs yod pa'i sa skyid po zhig tu slebs/ a khu grags pas ‘‘lung lu skyid po/ rdo dgong 'dug 'jog dgos pa min nam’ zer/ a zhang smon lam gyis ‘‘nyi ma gnyis gsum la mi rta thams cad dka' song / snga mo bsdad nanya zer/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘6ya 'dul kho/ da 'dug 'jog dang ci byedami’ces dris par/a phas ‘‘ci byed khyod tshos shes pa ci yod de/ ngas bltas na do dgong chu dmar chu 'bud thub na dga' rgyu red bsam/ 'di lung khug dogs pas/ rgya dmag 'dra slebs yong na nga tsho thar dka' rgyu red ’zer la/ rogs pa mang che bas 'dug 'jog zer bar/ de nas lung khug sum mdo ru gur phub nas bsdad/ la las ja bskol/ rta mang che ba'i sga blangs nas mngags/ a phar rta bra nag cig yod pa de/ gur rtsib tu lag 'dogs byas te ma mngags/ blo chos dang a khu bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis kyang rta ma mngags par thung stod byas yod/ grwa pa tsho gur yan gyi gad rtsa nas gnyid 'dug le kho dang 'khang spral gnyis ri rtsa'i na thog la rta skor du phyin song / a phas me mda' rtsib tu banog nas gur zur na gnyid 'dug ngas gur sgo'i ja skol sa'i thab rde'i thog rgyu ma zhig me la bsregs nas bsdad yod/ de'i skabs rgyang nas me mda'i skad cig grag pa dang mnyam du/ nga'i sngon gyi thab kha'i bar nas thal skya log ge song / de dus thams cad gyis ‘6rgya slebs song zer nas 'tshub cha nyil le yar rgyug mar rgyag byas/ a phas 'gre log cig brgyab nas/ me mda' bzung ste yar blta mar blta byed 291

leku 0ci 0 5 la 8 0rgya75 i nye3la5 bzhin 'dug a khu bstan 'dzin gyis gur nang nas me mda' bzung ste sgor bud nas 6‘rgya dmag gang nas slebs song’ zer/ a phas nga tsho'i nub ngos su lag brda byed kyi 'dug ngas yar bltas pa na/ nub kyi nyi ma shar mtshams kyi sgang thog tu mi mang po zhig mthong gi 'dug la/ nga tsho'i thog tu me mda' 'phen bzhin 'dug pas/ rta thams cad 'drogs song / a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘nga 'gro rta ded 'onganya zer zhor du rta yod sar rgyug a phas 6‘khyod ma 'gro/ dgra gar yod ma shes gong / rgyug rgyu yod pa ma redanya zer bar/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ma go ba yin nam/ ma nyan pa yin/ rta zur du thon rjes rta zhon zhing ki zhig brgyab nas mar rgyugs/ ri mgo g.yas g.yon kun nas mda' ni char ba 'bab 'bab red/ kho mi rta gnyis ka skya log ge 'gyel song / grwa pa tshos/ ‘‘a ha bo ma bzang thal’)zer/ me mda' 'phen mkhan ni nga tsho'i g.yon gyi gdong thog na yod pa'i rgya dmag red/ a phas ‘‘a ha bo/ shi mgo khrag la skor rgyu tshomi zer zhor du yar langs te me mda' gcig 'phangs nas/ gdong thog nas mar 'bab pa'i dmag gcig ril song / dmag gcig yar langs nas lag 'bom zhig 'phangs song la/ a phas yang me mda' 'phangs nas dmag de yang ril song / dus der sa 'gul 'dug pa'i skad sgra zhig grags song yang / mi la ci yang ma gnod/ gdong mgo'i rgya dmag 'gas srib ngos su yar rgyugs yong ba'i le kho dang 'khang spral gnyis kyi thog la me mda' 'phen bzhin 'dug sa phas ‘‘skad mthon pos zlo khu gnyis ma rgyug gab sdod/ yar ma rgyug zer nas bos kyang / khong gnyis ni sngar ltar nga tshor gtad nas rgyugs yong bas/ le kho rgya dmag gis me mda' brgyab ste dmar nar re ril song / 'khang spral mar le kho'i 'gram du rgyugs kyang / zur du ma slebs gong rgya dmag gis me rmoda' brgyab nas bsgyel song / de'i skabs a khu bstan 'dzin gyis gad zhabs nas 'phro rim 'phror me mda' gnyis gsum 'phangs song bar/ sgang kha'i rgya dmag de gnyis ser nar re bsgyel song / khos ‘‘gi ha bo/ kha khrag la skor rgyu tsho )zer zhor du yar ri'i ngos su rgyugs/ blo chos 292

5 khyi rdzi nyi yo kyis ‘‘gyen du ma rgyug sngon du dmag 'dug 'di na shoganya’zer bar/ a khu bstan 'dzin tshur nga tsho'i sa ru slebs song / rgya dmag gis kho'i rta bsad pa las mi la cang byas mi 'dug de dus a pha dang khong gsum gyis me mda' kha bsgrigs nas/ nub sgang gi dmag yod sar 'phangs pas rgya dmag 'ga' re yar langs nas bros/ nga da dung gur sgo na bsdad yod la/ a bu 'ja' pes 6‘nus kho ya 'dir shoganya zer bar/ ngas yar bltas pa na/ khong tsho thams cad gong gi gad zhabs shig na gab 'dug la/ nga rang yar langs nas der rgyugs dus nga'i mgo thog nas sbrid char se 'dra/ mig lam skar ma lta bu shar nas ril song / nga dran pa sos dus/ a phas pang du bzung 'dug ‘‘pha lo khyod ci 'dra 'duganya zer/ nga rang gis nga ci zhig byas pa shes ma song / de dus mgo nas khrag cung bzhur 'dug par a phas/ ‘‘skyon med/ mgo la mda' gsha' zhig byas 'dug nyazer/a phas ‘‘da nga tshos 'di nas sa babs sdug pas 'dzings nas thub kyi ma red/ a khu bstan 'dzin/ blo chos khyed gnyis kyis 'di nas khog dang / a khu rnams gad zhabs na sdod/ ngas 'di'i sngon gyi gdong mgo 'di e zin bltas yong / nga ma thar na khyod tshos ma 'dzings/ mgo 'dogs byas dga' rgyu red/ mi che ba tsho 'dzin rgyu red de/ byis pa tsho drag gi red/ pha bzang bu tsho/ mi che ba su lhag kyang byis pa tshor bdag re ma 'chug nyaces bshad tshar dus/ kho rang gi rta zhon te brgyugs/de dus sngon ma a khu bstan 'dzin gyis rgya dmag gnyis bsad yod sa'i gdong mgo ru yang bskyar rgya dmag re zung slebs nas/ a pha'i thog tu me mda' 'phangs song / a khu bstan 'dzin dang blo chos gnyis kyis rgya dmag gi thog tu me mda' 'phangs/ a phas rta kha gyen du bskor te me mda' 'phen zhor du sgang khar brgyugs/ sus brgyab pa ma shes par/ sgang kha'i rgya dmag gnyis ser na re bsgyel song / de dus gdong thog na gnar yod pa'i dmag zhig gis me mda' 'phangs nas/ a pha la brgyab song / a pha'i mgo cung bsgur nas/ lag gi bo'u sa thog tu lhung song la/ khos lag pa gnyis kyis sga mgo ru 'tham zhing / cung 293

leku 0ci 0 5 mi9la5 ikhye3 5 tsam nas rta thog nas sa ru lhung song / rta bra nag gis 'tsher langs shig byas te kha phyir 'khor nas 'drogs song / de'i skabs rgya dmag de sgang thog nas yar langs te mar a pha yod sar yong / thams cad kyis kha gdang nas bltas 'dug pa las thabs ci yang med/ de dus a zhang smon lam gyis ‘‘a lu gnyis ka/ da me mda' 'phongs ya/ da rgyob ya ’zer yang / khong gnyis kyis me mda' ma 'phangs/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis 6‘da 'phen yong rgyu'i mda' med zer nas me mda' mar la dbyug song / rgya dmag de pha drin chen gyi gong du slebs dus/ me mda' yar bkyags te pha drin chen gyi thog tu gtad song / dus der rgya dmag gis bo'u ma 'phangs gong du/ pha drin chen yod sa nas du ba sngo log se me mda'i skad chung chung zhig grag song bar/ rgya dmag de mgo thur du ril song / da ni nga rang la skrag snang ci yang med par/ yar langs nas pha drin chen yod sar rgyugs/ nub sgang gi dmag gis nga'i thog tu me mda' re gnyis 'phangs kyang /nga rang la brgyab ma song / de dus a bu 'ja' pe sogs mi mang che ba yar langs te nga'i rjes su rgyugs yong / nga tsho pha drin chen gyi rtsib tu slebs dus/ pha drin chen gyis lag tu thung mda' bzung 'dug la/ lag g.yon pas lto ba bskyor nas bsdad 'dug sa khu bstan 'dzin dang / a zhang smon lam gnyis kyis pha drin chen gyi khog stod nas skyor zhor du/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘khyod ci 'dra 'dug zer zhor du ngus song / pha drin chen gyis ‘‘me mda' longs shog zer bar/ a khu bstan 'dzin yar langs nas song ste/ a pha'i me mda' blangs yong ste ri mgo nas nub sgang du yod pa'i dmag gi thog tu 'phangs/ de'i skabs blo chos kyis gong na bsad yod pa'i rgya dmag yod sa nas me mda' dang / mda' bcu kha zhig blangs yong / nub sgang gi dmag gis me mda' re zung 'phen gyi 'dug kyang / gar brgyab 'dir brgyab ci yang med par/ blo chos kyis gdong mgo nas yang bskyar me mda' re gnyis 'phangs/ a zhang smon lam dang a khu bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis sngar ltar kha ci yang mi grags par pha drin chen bskyor 294

ga5 (ḍa ༅ nyi/po nas bsdad 'dug cung zhig nas pha drin chen gyis dal mo byas te a khu bstan 'dzin la ‘‘song nas le kho khong rnam gnyis la gcig ltos dang / da 'tshams ma song ba 'dra/ snying rje zer/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘da ni tshar thal blta yong rgyu zhig med/ bkrongs tshar kho thag redanya zer/ nga'i sems su dus log tshar song / dus log gi chag sgo ngo ma da ni nga tsho'i mgo ru lhung song / rogs pa bsad song / a pha rmas tshar song / phar bltas na shi rgyu red/ las ci zhig gis yin nam/ da ni rgya'i kha nas thar ma song / rgya dmag gis da rung gsod rgyu red sogs dran zhor du pha drin chen gyi 'gram du bsdad/ nyi ma sgang nas nub song /me mda'i skad re zung grag gi 'dug la/ da ni su yis su la 'phen pa mi shes la/nga rang sems ha cang sdug kyang ma ngus par pha drin chen la bltas nas bsdad//le tshan re bzhi pa/las kyis lha sar ma spebs/ drin chen a pha bral song /blo chos kyis da rung sgang mgo nas me mda' re gnyis 'phen 'dug a khu bstan 'dzin dang a zhang smon lam gnyis kyis sngar ltar pha drin chen bskyor nas bsdad yod/ pha drin chen gyi ngo ni skya sang nger gyur 'dug nga'i sems su da sa thag ring po 'di 'dra zhig la/ nyin mtshan mang por skrag snang gis song ba thams cad sdug gyong chags song / rang yul nas bsdad yod na 'di las sdug ci zhig red 'gro/ da pha drin chen ni shi kho thag red/ 'di ni las zer rgyu de yin rgyu red/ lha sar slebs ma song dran zhor du sngar ltar pha drin chen gyi rtsib nas bsdad/ de dus a phas ca na ta thung mda' a khu bstan 'dzin gyi lag tu bzhag nas ‘‘mda' mi 'dug ’zer/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis thung mda' nga'i lag tu bzhag song / ngas rum la bcug a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘khyi rdang / bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba thobs/ pha bzang bu’’zer bar/ pha drin chen gyis ‘‘'di'i 295

leku 0na 5 5 la 9la5 e nye3l0 gong na rdo brkos ma ṇi re 'dug khyod kyis nga der e zhog gi zer/ yan gyi gom pa bzhi lnga'i mtshams na ma ṇi rdo spangs zhig 'dug la/ khong tshos pha drin chen bskyor nas der bzhag yar skyor ༷)sa pha drin chen gyi rgyab nas/ khrag mang tsam bzhur 'dug rgya dmag gis me mda' brgyab pa'i mda' ni/ pha drin chen gyi sked gri yi dngul gyi rdo len thog tu brgyab cing / mdas thad kur phug ma thub par/rdo len thog nas shud de/ brang g.yas pa'i steng nas phug ste/ rgyab kyi sog zhabs nas phud song 'dug sa zhang smon lam gyis ‘‘'di la rma las re byed rgyu e yodanya’zer bar/ a phas ‘‘kha dro/ da gang yang yod pa ma redanya zer/ de dus rgya dmag gi ri mgo nas bod skad kyis ‘‘khyod tshos mgo ma btags na gsod rgyu yin zer nas 'bod kyi 'dug sa khu bstan 'dzin dang blo chos gnyis kyis skad rgyag pa'i rgya dmag phyogs su me mda' re zung 'phangs/ rgya dmag gis kyang tshur la ci gon me mda' mang tsam 'phangs song / a phas ‘‘bstan 'dzin/ a khu tsho/da ngas cang thub ma song / khyod tshos da ma 'dzings mgo thogs zhog mi che ba rnams la sdug na thang yang / byis pa tshor rgya mis gang yang byed kyi ma red/ 'dzings bsdad na rgya dmag gis mi che chung shes ni ma red/ byis pa tsho bsad song na sdug gi/ nga tshos khong tsho chos sar ma zhog na'ang / srog mgo thon pa zhig byed dgos pa red’ zer/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘'o ya go song / khyod sems bde mo gyis/da ni nga tsho bsad song rung / byis pa tsho srog mgo thon pa byedanya zer/ yang a phas ‘‘rgya dmag gis mgo ba su yin zer nas 'dri rgyu red/ mgo ba nga red ces shod dang / khyed rnams la cung drag rgyu red/ nga'i rum na rin chen ril bu khri dar lung ma za 'phro zhig yod/ da de nga la gcig sbyin rogs’ zer bar/ a zhang smon lam gyis a pa'i rum nas/ khrag gis g.yogs pa'i gos thum zhig blangs nas/ nang gi ril bu pha drin chen la sprad/ a phas ‘‘da lhag pa 'di khyod tshos zo/ rgya lag tu shor mi nyan nyazer bar/ a zhang gis nga tsho la bgos te za ru bcuga.a bu 'ja' pes ngu kha lug zhor du ‘‘a pha khyod ci 'dra 'duganya zer/ a phas ‘‘su 296

skem5snye (ḍa /de nyi sa ngu bzhin 'dug 'ja' kho ngu mi nyan/ skyes pa pho sdug na mi ngu zer ba go ma song ngam/ pha kho da ngu mi nyan zer/ ‘‘a pha nga nar son na ngas khyod kyi dgra sha len chog khyod sems bde mo gyis nyazer/ ‘6gces phrug khyod grwa pa zhig gis 'di 'dra dran mi rung / nga shi tshar na khyod kyis nus kho la bdag yag po gyis/ da khyod ni pha ma gnyis kyi tshab red/ rjes nas kha yul phyogs la 'khor na/ nga tsho'i sde ba brlags tshar yang / a lags gung thang tshang snyeg song dang / khyed gnyis la bdag byed kyi redami’zer/ ‘‘a pha khyod sems bde mo gyis dang / nus kho ngas bdag byed thub ni redami zer/ de dus ngas ‘‘a pha/ nar son na skyes pa pho red/dgra sha ngas len yong ’zhes brjod par/ a phas ‘‘da a pha dgra sha len rgyu yod pa ma red/ rgya dmag gis de ring kha sang bod kyi sa cha mang po nas gtor gsod byed bzhin yod pa red/ dus chen po log na gyod ya med zer ba red/ da dgra sha len sa zhig yod pa ma red/ da lta shi ba ni a pha gcig pu ma red/ nga tshos lam nas mthong song ba de red/ de ring le kho khong rnam gnyis yang bsad tshar song / da khyod kyis a bu'i kha la nyon/ a phas khyed gnyis lha sar bskyal ma thub par/ sa mtha' 'di nas skyur dgos thug kyang / da drag gi red/ a khu bstan 'dzin khong tsho bsad ma song na khyed gnyis la bdag byed rgyu red/ da ci yin na'ang bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rjes/ khyed gnyis kyi mgo thon thub kyi red’nyaces sogs bshad/ a phas skad cha bshad dus mig btsum nas bshad kyi 'dug blo chos yong nas da ni rgya dmag gang na yod mi mthong gi/ khyod ga 'dra 'dug zer zhor du/ a pha'i mgo bskyor te ngu lab byed zhor du bsdad/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘da byed rgyu gang yang mi 'dug rgad po dbugs chad na nga tshos mgo 'dogs 'jog rgya dmag kha shas bsad pa red/ nga tsho gson por mi mngags kho thag red de/ byis pa tsho cung e draganya’zer/ de dus a phas lu thung gcig gnyis byas shing / kha nang nas khrag bzhur 'dug a zhang smon lam gyis 6‘'dul kho/ pha bzang bu/ skrag mi dgos gsol 'debs re gyis nyazer zhor du 297
