leku 0ci 5 5 la skergyal5 i nye3la5 ngu lab byas/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘da khyod kyis sems bde mo gyis/ bu gnyis kur nga tshos bdag byed/ kha sang de ring rgya dmag mang po bsad pa red/ khyod kyi ro skyin lon yod pa red/ da sems bde mo gyisanya zer nas ngus song / rogs pa gzhan yang shub dur nyil le ngu 'dug de'i skabs pha drin chen gyis mgo yar cung bkyags nas ‘‘bstan 'dzin/ pha bzang bu/ ngu mi nyan/ da nga tsho las shig gis kha 'thor ba red/ khyod tsho rgya lag nas thar rgyu ma red de/ sngon la byis pa tsho 'jog sa bcol sa re e lon ltosanya zer/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘mi che ba tsho thar gyi ma red de/ byis pa tsho la khyed kyis sems bde mo gyis dang / bkod pa re yod pa red’ zer bar/ ngas 6‘a pha nged gnyis ngu yi med ’ces bshad/pha drin chen gyis ‘‘'o ya pha bzang bu gnyis ngu mi nyan/ a phas tshe 'di nas mi rta mang po bsad pa red/ snga mo rgya mā chi tshang la 'dzings dus/ nga tshos mā chi tshang gi rgya mang po bsad pa red/ kha sang de ring rgya dmar tshang bsad pa red/ do dgong rgya mis nga tshur bsad pa red/ da nga rang gi tshe tshad la slebs pa red/ nga skrag gi med/ ngas a lags tshang la gsol ba 'debs bzhin yodanya ces bshad zhor du/ pha drin chen gyi skad je gnyom du bud song / rjes nas ci bshad pa mi go bas/ mi kun 'jam cag ge bsdad song / grwa pa tshos gsol 'debs byed zhor du cig 'don bzhin 'dug a khu bstan 'dzin gyis dal mo byas te/ pha drin chen gyi mgo ma ṇi rdo leb zhig gi thog tu bzhag song / a bu 'ja' pe ngus ma song /nga rang ma ngus par/ sems nas pha drin chen gyis bshad pa los bden/ lam na mi ci 'dra mi mang po bsad 'dug thams cad 'dra 'dra red/ mi rang gi las red bsam song / gnam nas skar ma khra thar re shar dus/ nga yi pha drin chen dbugs chad de/ dal mo byas nas/ nged bu span gnyis ka shul du bskyur te/'jig rten 'di la kha phyir 'khor gtan nas merdo par bde zhing du phebs song /a khu bstan 'dzin dang a khu tshos pha drin chen gyi gon pa phud nas ro las byed gi yod cing / rgya dmag gis gnam du 'od mda' re gnyis 'phen 'dug pa las 298

tsho ci089 yo me mda' ma 'phangs/ nga ni der bsdad nas yid skyo ba'i 'dang mang po rgyag dgos par gyur/ ngas snying thag pa nas/ skyabs bla ma dkon mchog gsum po/nged pha bu sa mtha' 'di nas/ da shi gson kha bral byung song / rang yul sde shul du bskyur te/ stod nyi ma lha sa bsam nas/ sprin dkar po thod la bzung zhing /sa nag po 'dom la 'jal te/ sa 'di la slebs pa'i nyin par/ nged pha bu rang dbang med par/ rgya btsan pos lcags mda'i 'og nas/ pha drin chen srog khrag dmar po/ sa ma ṇi lung nang btab song / rdza rngam ri'i khyung gshog rgo mgo/ dgos ma ṇi lung chung 'di ni/ pha drin chen thod rus 'jog sa'i/ gshin bar rdo'i dur sar gyur song / sdug che bas kho thag chad nas/ yid skyo ba'i mig chu skam thal/skyabs bla ma dkon mchog gsum po/ pha drin chen rnam shes 'khyams po/ nub bde ba can gyi zhing la/ 'dren 'gro ba'i smon lam yang yang / sgos skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu/ bod kha ba can gyi sdug 'di/ da yang yang gzigs rogs mdzod cig dman ri bong glag gis khyer na/ yar 'bod sa a sngon gnam red/gnam a sngon ya lan mi 'dug mar 'dzul sa dog mo sa red/ sa dog mor 'dzul khung mi 'dug nga gnyom chung sa mtha' 'di nas/ sdug chag sgo mgo la lhung na/zhe 'khor rgyu khyed las med par/ sems skyabs sa khyed las med par/ skyabs 'khrul med yid bzhin nor bu/ nga'i brtse ba'i drin can a pha/ srog dmar po dgra lag shor dus/ yar sngas mgor bla ma med la/ chos 'don mkhan grwa pa med par/ 'dren chos skad rna bas ma go/ dge bsngo smon mig gis ma rig khyed drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mas/ pha'i rnam shes sbrang chung 'dra bo/ tshe phyi mar skrag tu ma 'jugarlung bser bus 'khyag tu ma 'jug yul gzhan la 'khyam du ma 'jug lus ngan pa len du ma 'jog yar 'dren pa'i lam ston khyed yin/ lus ci len skyabs sa khyed yin/ thugs ma g.yeng yid bzhin nor bu/ bod kha ba can gyi yul 'dir/shi chos med khri stong mang po/ yar 'dren pa'i dus la bab 'dug khyed thugs rje byin rlabs ma chung / zhes gsol smon brgyab cing / nga'i yang sems su dran 299

beku 0ci1 5 la rgyapaX i the3 5 pa/ pha drin chen bde zhing skye rgyu/ shi bar do'i 'phrang dmar nang nas/ khyod blo sems bde mo song dang / khyed chos med red bsam ma sdug ro bdag med red bsam ma 'gyod/ nga ma shi tshe 'dir bsdad na/ ngas pha shul bu yis bskyangs nas/stod nyi ma lha sar nga 'gro/ chos dge ba nga yis bsgrub chog khyed rnam shes gang du yod na/ sems gtad nas nga la nyon dang / yar 'dren pa'i dus re los yod/oṃ ma ṇi padme (ཿzhes/ tshe gcig la bton bton thams cad/ pha drin chen khyed kyi don du/ ngas bsngo ba smon lam byed chog/ ces gsol smon brgyab pa yin/nga rang gis 'di ltar dran zhor/ dus tshod ci tsam 'gor song ba ma shes/ yar bsam blo re btang na/ dus log pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ yul rgyal khams kyi mgo ru lhung ba'i sdug bsngal red ma gtogs/ nged pha bu tsho gcig pu ma red/ lam nang nas ci 'dra mang po bsad rmas byas shing / dgon pa mang po gtor bzhig byas 'dug dus ngan tshes na/ bros nas thar sa med pa/ da ni shes song / 'on kyang /'gyod pa byas rung ma byas rung / da ni yod tshad tshar ba red/ rjes nas ngas ha go song / nga tsho gtor nyin ni/ spyi lo 1958 lo'i zla 9 tshes 9 nyin red/da thengs kyi le tshan bshad mtshams 'di nas 'jog rgyu yin la/ khyed rnams kyis sems gtad nas gzigs par thugs rje che zhu/ le tshan rjes ma'i nang du/ da rung rang sems dga' skyo sdug gsum gyi lo rgyus mang po mu mthud nas zhu rgyu yod pas/ khyed rnams kyis sngar ltar zhib gzigs mdzad par dga' bsu zhu/300

le'u drug pa/ya nga ba'i dwa phrug gi 'tsho ba//de/de las bsam bzhin ma red gseg gis red/le tshan re lja pa/'jigs skrag che ba'i mtshan mor/ 'dzin bzung byas pas sems bde/pha drin chen ni dbugs chad song / da ni sngon nas 'jigs skrag mang po la thug pa yin na'ang 'dra/ yang min na lam nas shi rmas mang po mthong ba'i rkyen gyis yin na'ang 'dra/ sdug nas ngu rgyu ci yang med la/ a bu 'ja' pe yang ma ngus par nga'i rtsib tu bsdad yod/ cung zhig nas a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘da khyed rnams phar kha'i gad zhabs su song nas bsngo ba smon lam re thon/ blo chos nged gnyis kyis grwa pa gnyis kyi phung por bdag re byed 'jogami’zer bar sa khu thams cad yar langs nas gad zhabs su song / a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyang yar langs nas song / mtshan phyed red 'dug rgya dmag gis ri mgo nas da dung me mda' re zung 'phen bzhin 'dug la/ ri phar tshur gnyis kyi bar na skad brda rgyag gi 'dug nga'i sems su da nam langs na rgya dmag gis da dung me mda' rgyag rgyu red/ bla ma dkon mchog yang su zhig shi dgos pa ci shes bsam song / de dus blo chos kyis a khu bstan 'dzin la/ ‘‘da ci 'dra byas na dga'/301

mis 2 4 7 7)5 49mali tshe 0 mda' med pas me mdas ci byed’’zer bar/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis 66nam langs na mgo 'dogs rgyu ma gtogs thabs mi 'dug mgo 'dogs sa med na las red/ rgya dmag gis mgo ba su yin dris na tshang mas khong gis bshad pa bzhin/ mgo ba bu gnyis kyi pha mtho ris po yin zer rgyu ma gtogs yod pa ma red/ nga tsho mi che ba tsho mi thar sems thag red/ me mda' bcags nas chu shur nang skung mi zhes zer zhor du/ blo chos dang khong gnyis kyis me mda' rnams rdo mgor brgyab nas bcags te chu shur nang du 'phangs/ de nas nga tsho sngar ltar gab bsdad/ nam smad zla ba shar song la/ sprin gyis bsgribs pas de 'dra mi gsal/ nga tsho gab yod sa nas/ gur phub yod sar gom pa brgya kha zhig yod/nub ngo'i ri shog gi rgya dmag gis skad log rgyag zhor du/ mar gur gyi phyogs su 'bab pa mthong gi 'dug de dus nga tshos rtsib kyi ri shog nas 6‘kho re tsho/ da lag cha sprad nas/ mgo thogs dang dga' rgyu red/ mgo btags na gu yangs yodanyanyaces bod skad kyis bos song / nged tsho sus kyang kha ma gragacung tsam nas ri shog g.yas g.yon thams cad nas/ rgya dmag nga tsho'i rtsib nas mar babs te gur yod sar slebs grabs yod cing / me mda'i khog tu mda' ded pa go yi 'duga'on kyang khong tshos nga tsho ltag tu gab yod pa mthong gi med/ yang zhabs nas bod pa zhig gis ‘‘kho re tsho da mgo thogs/ mgo ma btags na gsod rgyu yin nyazer nas 'bod kyi 'dug de'i skabs a khu bstan 'dzin yar langs nas ‘‘'o nga tsho 'dir yod/ me mda' ma 'phen/ nga tshos mgo 'dogs kyi yin nyazer bar/ gur rtsib dang nga tsho'i zhabs na yod pa'i rgya dmag thams cad sa rgyug rdo rgyug byed zhor du/ thams cad sa thog tu nyal 'dug sa khu bstan 'dzin mar babs nas ‘‘me mda' ma 'phen/ nga tshos mgo 'dogs’ zer/ de nas nga tsho thams cad kho'i rjes ded nas mar babs/ bod pa zhig gis ‘6lag cha sa thog tu zhog lag cha sa thog tu ma bzhag na me mda' rgyag gi red nyazer bar a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘nga tsho grwa pa dang byis pa rkyang rkyang yin/ lag cha med zer 302

5 ('i thunalpi lha bar/ ‘‘sa thog tu sdod/ lag pa gnyis yar khyogs ’zer/ nga tsho sa thog tu bsdad de lag pa yar bkyags/ rtsib kyi rgya dmag re zung yar langs nas nga tsho'i zur du slebs/ de'i rjes nas me mda' khur ba'i bod pa gnyis gsum slebs yong bar/ gcig gis ‘6pha ro za rgyu tsho/ lag pa yar khyogs zer zhor du/ mi sngon ma tshor rkang tho re brgyab/ de dus rgya dmag cig gis bkag nas rgyag tu ma bcugacung tsam nas nam langs song / rgya dmag gnyis kyis blo chos khrid song nas/ ska rags bshigs te rum sngog song / bsngogs tshar dus sbo lug mar 'dug bcugayang cung tsam nas bod pa gnyis yong nas grwa pa tsho re re bzhin bsngogs shing /ska rags bshigs nas ske ru yod pa'i srung mdud rnams bcad/ bod pa zhig gis a khu bstan 'dzin gyi sham thab 'og na/ gri chung zhig yod pa blangs nas/ kho'i mgo la gcig brgyab ste 6‘pha ro za rgyu/ grwa pas gri btags nas ci dgos nyazer/nga'i sems su da ci byed/ nga'i rum nang du ja na ta thung mda' bcug yod/ da sa thog 'phangs na rig rgyu red/ ma 'phangs na sngog dus rig song na nga la rdung gi red/ nga lo chung bas cung e slog gam/ da ni 'phen thabs med pas/ mi shes mdog byas nas 'dug rgyu las thabs cang med bsam nas bsdad/ a bu 'ja' pe sngog cing / de nas nga yar longs zer/ khos nga'i rna 'byog nas bzung ste mar khrid song / nga'i ska rags bshig dus thung mda' sa thog tu lhung song /bod pa des mgyogs po yar blangs nas/ ‘‘pha ro za rgyu 'dis me mda' bskungs 'dugazi’zer zhor du/ nga'i rna 'byog nas bzung ste rgya dpon gyi sngon du khrid nas skad log brgyab/ rgya dpon des thung mda' lag tu bzung nas blta zhor du nga la bltas bsdad/ kho'i ngo la 'dzum gyis khengs nas dgod zhor du rgya skad gyis skad sgyur brgyud nas ‘‘me mda' 'di su'i red’ ces dris par/ ngas ‘‘nga'i a pha'i red ces bshad/ khos (‘khyod kyi a pha gang red zer/ ‘‘nga'i a pha khyod tshos bsad tshar song /’ ‘‘gang nas bsad song / ngas lag brda byed zhor du gong gi gdong mgo nas bsad songanya zhes bshad/ de dus yar bltas na ri ngos 303

5 3 rdzi miyo nas/ ri thang kun tu lag brda byed zhor du skad cha mang po bshad/ khos yang nga'imago la byug zhor du/ yar gyi ri gdong la lag brda byed zhor du skad cha bshad/ phar bltas na mdang gi 'dzing lugs sogs bshad pa kho thag red/ de nasargya dmag gi so ba de phar bud song / bod pa gnyis nga tsho'i rtsib tu thun pa byas nas bsdad/ de'i skabs su dmag dung zhig bus song bas/ rgya dmag thams cad phreng bsgrigs nas gshar song /cung zhig nas rgya bod re zung yong ste a bu 'ja' pe/ dung phrug nged gsum ma gtogs rogs pa tsho thag pas lag pa rgyab nas bkyig rta gong du bskyon nas ded song / nged gsum rang rang gi rta zhon nas khong tsho'i rjes ded nas yong / bod pa zhig gis ‘‘ngo log pa tsho/ mgyogs po 'gro/ rjes ma zin na me mda' rgyag gi yin’ zer nas bud song / ri 'dabs kyi gdong thog tu slebs dus/ ngas phyir bltas byas par/ ri gdong gi nyin ngo na bya rgod mang pos pha drin chen gyi phung po 'then rgyang byas nas za bzhin 'dug la/ na mtshams su le kho dang / 'khang spral gnyis kyi phung po dmar nar rer log 'dug par/ da rung bya rgod babs merdo/ nga'i sems su sdug snang dang / skyo snang zhig gis mi mtha' mchi mas bskor kyang ma ngus par chas song / ngas sngon du a bu 'ja' pe mig chu bzhur 'dug kyang / skad byung nas ma ngus shing / 'di ltar nged gnyis kyis pha drin chen gyi phung po sa mtha' nas bskyur te mi 'gro thabs med red song /de ring nyin gang por thal rlung g.yug sde dmag tsho gcig dang / rgya kha shas kyis nga tsho ded nas 'gro bzhin yod/ rlung ha cang che bas a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis mtshams rer thag ring por rjes su lus song yang / lta mkhan gcig kyang med la/ rgya bod thams cad gyis rlung nang nas rang mgo gar thon byas nas song zhing / lo cung che ba zhig yin na nged gnyis bros song yang chog mod/ 'on kyang nged gnyis 'bro rgyu phar zhog rjes su lus na mgo 'khor rgyu red bsam nas/ci mgyogs gyis khong tsho'i rjes chod par byas te song / dgong mo nga tsho ru skor 305

leku 2 5 7 ( ye /tshom thi tshe 0 zhig gi nang du slebs/ a bu 'ja' pe/ dung phrug skal bzang nged bzhi khyim tshang zhig tu khrid nas za 'thung blugs/ sbra nang na bud med cig dang / rgan mo lo lon zhig yod la/ khong tshos nga tshor ja blugs/ rtsam pa byin rjes/ yang zho blugs song / rgan mo des ‘‘snying rje 'di 'dra lo chung re bzung nas ci bsam pa red/ rgya 'di tsho tshe bla len rgyu tsho’ zer bar/ bud med cig gis ‘‘a ma smyos pa red dam/ rgya mis go na 'dzin rgyu red/ ya ja 'thunganya’zer/ rgan mos ‘‘nga gang yang mi skrag da mi tshang ma bzung tshar song / nga bzung ma bzung gang yang medaminyasogs/ rgya la mi dga' ba'i skad cha mang po bshad song / nga'i sems su khong tsho yang rgya mis brlags tshar 'dug bsam song / de dus me mda' 'dzin mkhan bod pa zhig yong nas dung phrug dang / skal bzang gnyis khrid song / bud med des nga'i slog pa sngon dang rgyab nas ral yod par bltas nas/ ‘‘khyod grang song ngamanyanyazer bar/ ngas ‘‘ha cang mi grang gi’ zer dus/ mos ‘‘ci mi grang /slog pa ral song nas blta yong sa zhig mi 'dug’ zer zhor du/ khab skud khur yong nas/ nga'i slog pa ral yod sa nas btsem rogs byas/ nga rang sems ha cang skyo nas/ rang dbang med par mig mtha' mchi mas bskor song / a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyis sngar ltar ja 'thung nas bsdad//le tshan re drug pa/rgyu 'bras med pa'i gshed ma/ gdug rtsub che ba'i mnar gcod/a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis sbra nang du ja 'thung nas bsdad/cung 'gor rjes sde dmag cig yong nas nged gnyis khrid song / sbra sgor bud nas cung song ba na/ rgya gur chen po zhig phub yod sar slebs/ gur nang du ma slebs gong nas mi zhig gis/ ‘‘pha ro za rgyu/ ngo log rgya gsod tsho/ da khyod kyis rgya sod/ da khyod kyis rgya sodami’zer zhor du/ lcag gis gzhus pa go song / nga'i sems su 'o 306

5 khyi khutshe nyi lum da nga tsho'i rogs pa tshor lcag gis gzhu bzhin 'dug la/ a bu nged gnyis la gzhu rgyured bsam zhor du gur nang du 'dzul dus/ gur gyi ma gyal na blo chos dang a khu bstan 'dzin/ a zhang smon lam/ a khu grags pa bzhi thag pas bkyig nas bsgyel yod/ khong tsho'i khog stod gcer bur/ lag pa gnyis rgyab tu bkyig cing /bkyig spyad thag pa sha gseng du zug nas chen po rig rgyu med/ blo chos mgo sar gtug nas bsgyel 'dug la/ phar bltas na mgo nas khrag bzhur bzhin 'dugakhos mtshams rer ‘‘a yo/ a yo zer bzhin 'dug sa khu bstan 'dzin ni sna khrag bzhur 'dug gdong gi gang sar khrag 'bur dod 'dug sa zhang smon lam gyi gdong nas khrag bzhur zhing / kha ngo skrangs song bas mig kyang mi mthong / de'i gong du tshe kho thag pas bsdams yod/ phar bltas na ngo cung skrangs yod kyang /ha cang ma brdung pa 'dra/ de'i zur du skal bzang dang / dung phrug gnyis mgo bsgur nas bsdad yod la/ rgya gzugs po thung thung / nang gos ser po gyon mkhan zhig gis lag tu rta lcag dang / 'or khyo (sa rko byed kyi lag cha zhig)zhig bzung nas/ kho tshor re re bzhin gcar rdung byed pa dang / ma gzhi gcar rdung byed mkhan ni yul 'di'i bod rigs 'ga' red/ bod pa yin na'ang 'di 'dra sha tsha snying rje med pa re zung 'dug khyod kyi pha gsod lag dmar ni ma red/ don med du grwa pa dang / rgan po lo lon re la 'di 'dra gshad rdung byas nas/ lag thebs pa mtshar po red/ nga'i sems su 'di 'dra 'khor zhor du der bsdad/ yang bod pa zhig yong nas/ a bu 'ja' pe'i mgo la dbyug pas gcig brgyab nas ‘‘der sdodami zer bar/ a bu 'ja' pe dung phrug gi rtsib tu bsdad/ yang nga'i mgo la dbyug pas gcig brgyab nas/ ‘‘ngo log chung ba sa thog tu sdodami zer zhor du yang gcig brgyab song / khos yang bskyar nga tsho'i mi re'i mgo la dbyug pas re re brgyab rjes/ blo chos yar drud de 6‘pha ro za rgyu khyod kyis shod/ khyed tsho'i mgo ba su redami zer bar/ blo chos kyis ‘‘khyod tshos nga red lab pa min nam/da nga yin rgyu gyis/ khyod tshos ci bsam pa de gyis/ khyod bod pa zhig gis nga rgan 307

leku 2 po 7 ( i5 ༅ga thi tshe 0 po lo lon zhig la 'di 'dra brdung na/ ngo mi tsha'am’nyazer nas skad cha mjug ma rdzogs gong / rgya bod gnyis kyis su mgyogs byas te gcar rdung byas/ de dus a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘da khyod tshos rgan por ma rdung / mgo ba bsad tshar ba red’’zer bar/ bod pa des ‘‘pha ro za rgyu khyod kha sdod mi thub na ngas khyod la bkod pa yodami zer zhor du a khu bstan 'dzin la gcar rdung byas/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘kha khrag dong nang la skor rgyu/ pha ro za na khyod kyis zo/ rgya dga' ma/ da khyod bu rab yin na nga sod shog khyod bod pa zhig gis rgan po lo lon zhig la 'di 'dra brdung nas khyod la ro dgos samanya’zhes 'ur brgyab/ a khu grags pas ‘‘a drin chen po khyod kyis lan ma byed/ kha tshum sdod’’zer bar/ de dus a zhang smon lam gyis 6‘da bshad ma bshad gcig pa red/ kha thal bas gcod rgyu gdon 'dre tsho/ rgya bsad na khyod kyi pha ma bsad pa ni ma red/ da de 'dra snying nad zhu mi thub pa ci zhig yod dam/ da sod shog snying khrag bzhes rgyu tsho/ snying rje cung tsam med par/ khyed tsho bod pa yin namanya zhes gshe gshe tshad med btang / skad cha de go bas rgya bod gnyis ka rgyugs nas a khu bstan 'dzin dang / a zhang smon lam gnyis ri bong glag gis khyer ba ltar byas nas/ drud de sgo mtshams nas bkyig sdom byas/ lag pa rgyab nas 'then te mgo ltag tu thon/thag pa sbom po sha gseng la zug nas mthong rgyu med cing / bod pa des ‘‘pha ro za rgyu gnyis dpa' bo yin mdog 'dra byas nas da ga 'dra 'dug’ zer zhor du khong gnyis kyi kha nang du 'or khyo brgyab ste so re gnyis bcag 'dug sa zhang smon lam brgyal song ba 'dra/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis da rung ci ngan ci sdug zer gyi 'dug cung tsam nas a khu bstan 'dzin yang brgyal song / rdung mkhan tsho'i mgo nas dngul chu bzhur bzhin 'dug nga'i sems la/ rgya bod gnyis kya'i nang nas da dung bod pa 'di tsho 'di 'dra'i snying rje med pa ci yin nam bsam song ngas mar sgo mtshams su blta dus a khu bstan 'dzin dang / a zhang smon lam gnyis ka da rung shi med par cung re 'gul gyi 'dug bod pa de cung ngal gsos rjes/308

ma5 ( 3 thun 3 yom yang blo chos kyis mgo yar bkyags pas ‘‘ya kho re/ da mthong song ngam/ shi ma bsam na/ skad cha drang mo shod/ khyod tsho'i mgo ba su yin/ ma bshad na da khyod ma shi bar dmyal bar 'phen rgyu yinanya’zer bar/ blo chos kyis ‘‘bshad zin pa yin/ mgo ba bsad tshar ba red/mi zer/ ‘‘kho re bsad 'jog rgyu slog pa ral po gyon mkhan zhig la thung mda' yod rgyu ma red/ mgo ba khyod yin nam/ pha ma gnyis ku'i ro za rgyu/ skad cha drang mo shodami’zer nas mgo lcag byas par/ blo chos kyis ‘‘shi mgo khrag la skor rgyu/ skyag zan tsho/ pha ma gnyis ku'i ro za lo na khyed tshos zos/ mgo ba nga yin/ da ci byed rgyu yod/shul 'chad rgyu tshomi’zer bar/yang rgya bod gnyis kyis rub nas rgad po shi la khad cig brdung / de dus skal bzang gis ngu 'bod byed zhor du/ bod pa der 'thams nas ‘‘shi mgo khrag la skor rgyu/ da khyod kyis gsod dgos na nga sod/ rgan po lo lon zhig la 'di 'dra zhig brdung nas khyed la snying rje spa tsam med dam/ khyi rgan/ da nga sod’ zer bar/kho tshe yar langs nas skal bzarngo bzung / rtsib kyi rgya des skal bzang gi mgo la rta lcag gis brgyab ste khrag bzhur 'dug yang bod pa des skal bzang la rgyag rtsis byed dus/ a khu grags pa yar langs nas bod de bkag par/ ‘‘da byis par ma rdung / khyod kyi snying na na nga la rgyob zer bar/ bod pa des a khu grags pa la mgo lcag gnyis gsum zhig gzhus shing / de'i skabs me mda' khur mkhan bod pa gnyis nang du 'dzul nas 6‘ci red song / ltas ngan 'di tsho ngo log pa red dam zer bar/ a khu grags pas ‘‘ngo log pa ma red/ khong tshos pha rgan la rdung dus bu ngus pa redami zer/ de nas bod pa des tshe kho/ dung phrug a bu 'ja' pe bcas la re re bzhin ‘‘mgo ba su yin’ zhes dris/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘mgo ba nga'i pha redami ces bshad/ mi re'i mgo la rta lcag gnyis gsum re gshad nas/nga'i sngon du yong nas ‘‘khyod kyis mthong song ngam/ skad cha drang mo ma bshad na shi la khad cig dung gi yin zer bar/ ngas ‘‘mthong song nyazhes lan btab par/‘‘mgo ba su red’ ces dris/ ngas ‘6mgo ba nga'i a pha red/ rgya dmag gis bsad 309

meku 2 5 7 yi ༅ma 3 0 tshar song’nyazhes bshad/ khos ‘‘khyod kyi a pha ma red nyazer zhor du blo chos la mdzub mo btsugs nas ‘‘rgan po 'di red dam nyazer/ ngas ‘‘rgan po gru pa red/ mgo ba ma red/ mgo ba nga'i a pha redami’ces bshad/ khos yang a khu bstan 'dzin la mdzub mo btsugs nas ‘‘mgo pa kho red dam’ zer nas dris/ ngas ‘6kho grwa pa red/ mgo ba ma red/ mgo ba nga'i a pha redaminyaces bshad dus khos ‘‘pha ro za rgyu lo ngog chung ba/ 'di 'dre 'dra zhig redami’zer zhor du nga'i rna 'byog nas 'then/ de dus a bu 'ja' pe yar langs nas/ nga 'geb zhor du ‘‘pha ro za dgos na khyod kyis zos/ byis pa chung chung zhig la rdung gi ma 'dug ’zer bar/ mi des a bu 'ja' pe la mgo lcag cig gzhus/ yang yar 'phyar nas rgyag rtsis byed dus/rgya zhig gis bkag song / ngas skad chen pos ‘‘pha ro za na khyod kyis zo/ kha dmyal ba'i nang du skor rgyu nyazhes bshad par/ bod des ‘6kho re sdug 'di tshos lan slog gi 'dug ’zer zhor du/ rta lcag gis nga la gzhu grabs byed dus/ ngas 66kha dmyal bar skor rgyu/ da khyod kyis rgyob/ da khyod kyis rgyob ya nyazhes brjod par/ kho'i rogs pa bod pa des bkag nas gzhu ru ma bcug par/ bod pa de'i gdong la bltas nas rgya skad mang po zhig bshad song / de dus rgya bod thams cad gur sgo ru song ba dang / a khu grags pa dang tshe kho/ skal bzang sogs song nas blo chos dang / a khu bstan 'dzin/ a zhang smon lam gsum yar bskyor nas/ gur nang du khrid de thag pa lhod nas cung 'gor rjes/ bud med gnyis kyis ja rtsam pa khyer yong nas khong gsum bkyig pa las bkrol nas za ma sprad/ khong tsho'i lag pa 'gul re med par bud med gnyis kyis rtsam pa rdzi rogs byas/ skal bzang dang tshe kho/ dung phrug bcas kyis khong gsum po'i kha nang du bcug rogs byas/ mun rub kha yang rgya dang bod pa re zung zhig yong nas mi che ba re re bzhin thag pas bkyig byis pa tsho gur nang du phya ra chen po zhig bkab nas nyal du bcug nga la gnyid cig gang nas yong / de ring khong tshor gcar rdung byas pa dran na/ a ho ho/ pha drin chen shi med na/ de ring brdung nas gsod rgyu red sogs dran 310

5 zhi43 3 yom byung / de dus a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘khyod gnyid med dam’nyazer bar ngas a bu 'ja' pe la 6‘ngas a pha dran nas gnyid med/ a pha bsad med na de ring brdung nas gsod rgyu red/ de las me mda' brgyab nas bsad na dga' 'duganya ces bshad par/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘de ring khong tshor ha cang brdung song / nged gnyis kyi a pha yod na/ rgya dmag bsad yod pas de las sdug cig rdung gi red/ a pha mgo ba red zer rgyu red/ de'i nyin rgya dpon des gdong kha nas/ khong tshos dmag mang po gsod mkhan nged gnyis kyi a pha red zer nas bshad 'dug zer/da rung a phar thung mda' yod pa red/ 'di tsho'i lag tu shor na brdung nas gsod rgyu red/ de las me mda' brgyab nas bsad song ba dga' 'dug yang a pha bros 'dra song yod na nged gnyis kyi sems bde rgyu ma red/ a pha yang sems bde rgyu ma red/ da 'grig song / de ring gi sdug myong ma dgos pa red/ nged gnyis kyi mthong sa nas bsad song ba red/ da phyin chad nged gnyis ma gtogs/bsam rgyu dran rgyu gang yang med song ba redami’ces bshad pas/ nga'i sems su ha cang babs song / snga phyi ma gtogs shi rgyu yin 'dug da sdug 'di 'dra myong ma dgos par/ nged gnyis kyi mthong sa nas shi song ba red/ kha 'dra 'thor song na nged gsum po sems bde rgyu ma red/ da ni bsam rgyu ci yang med par sems bde song / rang rang nad mu ges shi ma song na/ rgya tshang gis nged gnyis mi gsod kho thag red/ da ni las re yod na lam re los yod sogs dran song / yang a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘a pha sdug mang po myong ma dgos par shi song ba red/ da nga rang zhe bde ba yin/ nged gnyis nar son na/ chos dge ba re byed chog gi red’ zer bar bltas na/ a bu 'ja' pe'i sems kyang / kha sang dang mi 'dra bar/ de ring gi gcar rdung rig rjes/ sems ha cang bde 'dug khos ‘‘da nged gnyis drag gi red/ nar son na snga phyi ma gtogs yul phyogs su 'khor thub rgyu redami zer ba sogs/ nged gnyis kyis phan tshun sems gso'i skad cha mang tsam bshad rjes/nam zhig la gnyid song ba ma shes//311

le tshan re bdun pa/rogs pa'i dam tshig bsams nas/ btson du 'gro rgyur ma skraganam langs nas nyi ma shar song / gur sgo nas bud med gnyis kyis ja dang rtsam pa khur nas nang du 'dzul yong bar/ ngas ngo shes song / bud med gcig ni kha sang nga la slog pa btsem rogs byed mkhan de red/ mos a bu 'ja' pe/ dung phrug nged gsum khrid nas gur sgor bud cing / cung song na kha sang gi sbra de'i nang slebs 'dug de nas nged gsum gyis ja 'thung / rtsam pa zos rjes zho blugs song / bud med des ‘‘sdug de yin na/ 'di gnyis kyi pha kha nyin rgya mis bsad song ba redami’zer/ da ci dgos pa red zer zhor du ngus song /de min rgan mo gnyis yod pa de dag gi yang mig nas mchi ma bzhur song / nag mo des ‘‘bu khyed gnyis nged tshang du sdod shog e red/ nga'i pha dang / bza' tshang thams cad rgya mis bzung tshar ba red/ da a ma nged gnyis gcig pu red/khyed gnyis bsdad bzhag na nga'i bu 'dra 'dra yin9 zer/ ngas 6‘nged gnyis mi 'dug nged gnyis rogs pa tsho dang mnyam du pha yul la 'gro dgos zhes bshad/mos ‘ khyod gnyis kyi rogs pa tsho da rgya dmag gis mngag gi ma red/ nged tshang nas sdod zhog dang / khyed gnyis nar son na pha yul la 'gro chog gi red zer/a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘nged gnyis mi 'dug rogs pa tsho gang du song na'ang nged gnyis der 'gro dgos zer/ nga'i sems su bla ma dkon mchog 'di 'dra bud med sems bzang re 'dug rogs pa tsho med na/ nged gnyis 'di tshang nas 'dug sems thag red/ da ni khong tsho'i pha dang bza' tshang thams cad bzung tshar dus dka' mo red snyam song / bud med des yang bskyar rtsam pa brdzis te/a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyi phor pa'i nang du sbyar te lam nas zo zer/ de dus me mda' khur yod pa'i sde dmag cig yong nas/ nged gsum khrid nas rta rtsar 312

5snye 'a cha 7yo snyesong / cung tsam nas rogs pa thams cad der khrid yong la/ rgya re gnyis dang bod kyi sde dmag kha shas yong nas/ lag pa rgyab tu bkyig yod pa'i mi che ba bzhi rta thog tu bskyon/ nga tshos rang rang gi rta zhon nas kha sang ltar lam du chas/ nyin gung ma slebs gong nas kha ba babs shing rlung g.yug mi che ba bzhi rta gong nas rgyab lag byas nas bkyig yod pas tshe kho/ skal bzang / dung phrug bcas kyis khong tsho'i rta kha khrid yod/ a bu 'ja' pes nga'i rta kha khrid yod/ gangs sbud re brgyab dus nged gnyis kha 'thor grabs re byed 'dug bar zhig la ru skor zhig gi nang slebs song / ru nang gi mi thams cad 'dus nas nga tsho la bltas 'dugalhag par du a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis bskor nas blta zhor du ‘‘'o byis pa chung chung zhig bzung 'dug ga phrug rkyang rkyang red/ 'di tsho ngo log cang yin nam/lha sar 'gro mkhan yin rgyu redami ces mi bshad mkhan gcig kyang med/ ngas phar bltas na/ blta mkhan mang che ba ni byis pa 'ba' zhig red la/ da rung bud med mang po dang rgan rgon 'ga' re yod/ rgan po zhig gis ‘‘a ha bo/ 'di tsho ngo log pa zhig ma red/ khong rnams lha sar phebs mkhan red/ da tshar ba redami zer/ nga tsho'i mi che ba tsho kha kha zhig tu khrid par/chung ba tsho sbra chen po zhig gi nang du khrid song / sbra nang du thab kha chen po zhig gi thog tu zangs dkar gsum btsugs yod/ rgan mo zhig gis nga tsho la ja dang 'bras thug blugs/ yang bud med cig gis rag skyogs chen po zhig gi nang du/ rtsam pa brdzis te nga tsho'i rum du bcug de dus mi kha spa ring po can zhig slebs yong nas ‘‘'di 'dra'i ngo log pa zhig gang na yod/ shāsdi byis pa rkyang rkyang nyared zer la/ khos nga'i mgo la byug zhor du ‘‘'o snying rje/ pha bsad song ba 'di gnyis yin pa 'dra/ khyod kyi ming la ci zer ’nyazhes dris par/ ngas ‘‘nus kho zer ba yin zhes bshad pa na/khos ‘‘lo ga tshod yin zhes dris/ ngas ‘‘lo bcu yin zhes bshad/ khos ‘‘da khyed tsho 'di nas sdod/ nga dge rgan yin/ nga'i 'di na slob grwa yod pa red/ slob ma thams cad pha ma bzung tshar ba'i da phrug rkyang rkyang red/ za ma 'di nas za 313

leku 2 5 7 ( li5 mi tshe 0 dgos red/ rgya mi'i las byed tsho'i blor babs tshar ba redanya zer/ ngas yang slob grwar mi 'dug nga tsho rogs pa tsho dang mnyam du pha yul la 'gro dgosanya zhes bshad par/ khong gsum gyis kyang ‘‘slob grwar mi 'dug rogs pa tsho dang mnyam du 'gro rgyu yin7zer/ dge rgan des ru‘khyod tsho'i rogs pa tshos rgya dmag mang po bsad 'dug da btson khang nang nas thar gyi ma red/ khyod tsho slob gyur ma bsdad na btson khang du 'gro dgos rgyu red/ da sdod shog dang dga' rgyu redanya’zer/de dus ‘‘dung phrug gis nga tsho btson khang du 'gro dgos kyang / rogs pa tsho dang mnyam du 'gro rgyu yin nyazhes bshad par/ skal bzang gis 6‘da nga tsho sgo la 'bud ma gtogs/ 'di nas mgo bskor nas rogs pa tsho khrid rgyu redami zer bar nga tsho yar langs nas sgor bud/ bud med des ‘‘da rung ja 'thung dang / kha ba 'bab bzhin 'dug 'gro yi ma red’’zer/ nga tshos ma nyan par sbra sgor bud nas bltas par/ gangs 'azhesab rgyag gi 'dug mar bltas na/ nga tsho rgya bod thams cad kyi rta rnams zog rdang la btags 'dug skal bzang gis byis pa zhig la 6‘nga tsho'i rogs pa tsho gang du 'dug nyaces dris par/ ‘‘khyod tsho'i rogs pa rnams rgya mis gur nang bkag 'duganya’zer/ de dus dge rgan slebs yong nas ‘‘ya da sbra nang la song / do dgong 'gro rgyu ma redanya zer/ dgong mo der bsdad/ phyi nyin snga mo za 'thung tshar nas 'gro ran dus/ dge rgan de dang bud med byis pa tsho yong nas/ dge rgan dang bud med tshos ‘‘byis pa tsho 'gro sa yod pa ma red/ khyod tsho 'di nas sdod dang dga' yi red/ de ring nas btson khang nang la slebs kyi redanya’zer/ de dus yang sde dmag me mda' khur mkhan gnyis slebs yong nas/66ya kho re tsho/ khyod tsho de ring 'gro mi chog slob grwar sdod dgos red’nyazer/ ‘‘khyod tsho slob grwar mi 'dug na/ 'di nas mar song na btson khang nang du slebs pa red ces bshad/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘'o btson khang nang du 'gro dgos na drag gi/ slob grwar mi 'dug nga tsho rogs pa tsho dang mnyam du 'gro rgyu yin ’zer/ mi des nga la ‘‘ya kho re bu chung / khyed rang sdod zhoganyanyazer bar/ ngas nga mi 'dug 314

ske : (khri thutshe skyi/lu rogs pa tsho dang mnyam du pha yul la 'gro dgos nyazhes bshad/ cung tsam nas/rgya mi zhig yong nas khong tshos rgya skad mang po bshad rjes/ yang sngar ltar nga tsho khrid nas lam du chas song / nga'i sems su de ring btson khang nang la slebs kyi red/ da ni nga tsho thams cad btson pa red/ ya ci yin yang chog gi/ de ring nged mi dgu po da rung kha ma 'thor bar/ gson por mnyam du yod/ sdug rgyu ni shi bo gsum po snying rje bsam song la/ yang bsam blo zhig btang na khong tsho sdug ci yang ma myong bar/ bde 'gro thob song ba red/ ci yin na shi dgos pa'i las zhig yin na/ nyin re gnyis kyi khyad ci yod bsam song /de'i dgong mo mtshan phyed cig la/ thang thog tu sbra gur re zung phub yod pa'i sa cha zhig tu slebs song / sbra gur gyi g.yas g.yon thams cad na rgya dmag mang po thun par bsdad yod/ nga tsho rta las babs rjes rgya dmag dang / bod pa me mda' khur mkhan tshos ded nas/ sbra chen po zhig gi sgo ru slebs pa dang /mi che ba thams cad kyi bkyig thag bshigs shing / thams cad ska rags bshigs nas sbra nang 'dzul du bcug sbra nang du slebs dus nag dub be ci yang mi mthong /nga tshos gsal po zhig shes pa ni/ sbra nang du mi ha cang mang po zhig nyal 'dugang tsho yang der bsdad de gcig gi gcig la khen nas nyal bsdad/ nga'i rna lam du de ring khyod tsho btson khang nang slebs pa red zer ba go 'dug yang khyod tsho'i rogs pa tshos rgya mang po bsad tshar ba red/ da gson por mngag rgyu ma red zer ba sems su 'khor 'dug mi mang 'di tsho'i nang na kha sang bud med de'i pha dang / bza' tshang tsho e yod sogs mi dran dgu dran byas nas mtshan der gnyid ma yong / sbra rgyab nas rgya dmag gis skad log rgyag pa go zhing / de'i bar zhig la ci yin ma shes par gnyid song / nam langs nas nyi ma shar 'dug a ho ho sbra chen po 'di'i nang mi brgya lhag g.yas log g.yon log byas te nyal 'dugacung tsam nas sbra sgo phyes te mi tsho sgo ru phud/ mdang gsal po ma mthong ba las/thang thog 'di na sbra gur bcu lhag yod la/ tsho skor gnyis byas nas phub yod/315

'gronya zer bar/ gzhan zhig gis ‘‘kho re da tshar song / 'og na rta med/ lag na me mda' med/ da ni rgya khong tshos ci bsam ci 'dod red/ bsad song na ro lan lon gyi ma red’’zer/ de dus a khu bstan 5 'i tshude nyi yomasnyesong la/ yid skyo ba'i mig chu yang mang tsam bzhur 'dug nga'i sems su ya sdug de/ dgra bu rgyud sde ba zer nas grags chen po/ da rgya la thug dus rgod po cang med pa 'dra/ da skya ser/ bud med thams cad btson khang nang du sdug bshad re byas nas bsdad yod pa snying rje/ mtshar po zhig la/ rgya rta ma ded/ rgya mi ma bsad/ ngo log ma byas par mgo btags tshar dus thams cad 'dzin dgos don ci yin sogs dran song la/ go ba mi lon pa zhig red//le tshan re brgyad pa/btson grogs bla ma dbu bla/ rag shul ja thog drin che/sbra nang nas btson pa tshos/ rang rang gi khyim bza' tshang lhag yod pa'i skor kyi sdug bshad mang po byed bzhin 'dug a khu bstan 'dzin dang blo chos gnyis kyis / nga tsho dang rgya dmag 'dzings rabs/ rgya bsad rabs skor kyi kha brda mang po byed bzhin 'dug nga rang cung ltogs 'dug pas/ lag pa rum la brgyab ste phor pa'i nang nas rtsam pa cung bkog nas a bu 'ja' pe la sbyin/khos ‘‘nga la da rung yod/ khyod kyis zos/ cung tsam re las ma za’ zer/ kha sang bud med des nga'i phor pa'i nang du sbyar nas da bar ngas rtsam pa 'di ma zos/da ni a bu 'ja' pes mi dgos zer bas/ rang gis zos/ de dus rtsib kyi mi tshos ‘‘'o 'di 'dra rtsam dri zhim po zhig bro song / rtsam pa su zhig la yod dam’nyasogs zer la/ rgan po lo lon mgo dkar po can zhig gis ‘‘kho re bu/ nga rtsam pa cung tsam sprod rogs’nyazhes lag pa gzed song / rgan po 'di 'dra zhig gis lag pa gzed dus sems ha cang ma bde bar/ phor pa'i nang nas rtsam pa kham gang tsam bkog nas/ rgan po'i lag par bzhag par/ khos ‘6'o khyod tshe ring / bu drinachen po/ nga rgan po 'dir slebs nas nyin nyi shu'i nang yin la/ rtsam dri sna lam la bro ma myong / da mgo yom 'khor 'duganya zer zhor du/ rtsam pa lag 317

mikya:2 7 ( 6tshe5 49 thi mitshe:0 nang cung tsam phur te kho rang gi ske dang mgo la phur/ yang cung tsam bkog nas rtsib kyi rgan po zhig la sprad zhor du ‘‘ya kho re skodang rgyab la phur dang rlung la phan gyi red zer/ da rung rtsam pa cung tsam zhig lhag yod pa sna snum re byas te lag nang du bzung nas bsdad/ nga'i sems su snying rje za mi dgos pa ga la yin/ za mi bra ba yin rgyu red bsam song / ngas yang cung sprad bsam yang nga rang la'ang mang po med pas ma sprad/ dgong mo a bu 'ja' pes yang bskyar rgan po de la rtsam pa kham gang tsam sbyin/ rgan pos ‘6'o khyod tshe ring / da drag gi/ khyod gnyis sdug gi redami zer zhor du/ sngar ltar rtsib kyi rgan po kha shas la bgos te/ lag pa dang kha ngo la phur 'dug 'gram gyi rgan po gzhan zhig gis ‘‘'o khyod kha dro/ za rgyu med kyang rtsam dri re go na dge ba 'dra zhig 'dug zer/nyin gung btson pa thams cad sbra sgor phud nas 'dug tu bcug song /de dus gong gi gur nang nas/ stod 'bog ser po gyon pa'i grwa pa gnyis gsum sgor bud yong / a khu bstan 'dzin gyis rogs pa zhig la dris par/ des 6‘'di dga' ldan dbu bla red/ khong gi rtsib kyi lo che ba can de se ra bla ma redami zer/nga tshos ‘‘bsngo rten re 'jog par khong gi rtsib tu 'gro e chog gam’’zhes dris par/rgan pos ‘‘song dang chog gi red/ dbu bla tshang rgya la ngo so mthon po red/ chos 'don chog girinyazer bar a khu bstan 'dzin dang / a zhang smon lam/ a khu grags pa gsum yar langs nas/ bla ma dbu bla'i mdun du song / rgya mi thun pas ci yang mi zer/cung tsam nas a khu bstan 'dzin gyis nga rang shog zer nas lag brda byed bzhin 'dug la/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis yar bla ma'i mdun du song nas mjal/ khong gis ‘6ya phru gu chung chung red 'dug da khyed rang gnyis sems sdug gsog dgos pa ma red/ ngas shi bo la bsngo ba smon lam bton tshar nyazhes gsungs la/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyis kyang ‘‘a lags kha dro sogs skad cha stong pa re bshad/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis a lags tshang / da nga tsho mi che ba rnams thar rgyu ma red/ khyed rgya la ngo mtho bas/ rjes nas bu 'di gnyis khyed la 318

phyir yong / a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘da yag po red song / nga tsho shi yang sems bde ba yin / khyod gnyis a lags kyi rjes ded song dang / sdug mthong dgos kyi ma redami zer la/ a bu nged gnyis kyang ha cang dga' song / de dus btson pa tsho za ma zo zer nas bos song / mi thams cad su mgyogs gang mgyogs kyis brgyugs nas/ snod kyi nang nas khu ba phor pas bcus te 'thung / nga'i ca ne'i nang rtsam pa cung tsam yod pas khu ba lon thabs med la/ a bu 'ja' pes ca ne'i nang gi rtsam pa bkog nas sha khu cung lon 'dugacung tsam nas khu ba tshar song / a zhang smon lam dang /a bu 'ja' pe gnyis kyis nga la khu ba cung re blugs song / de dus ja skol mkhan rgan po rkang ba gyol po can zhig yod pa des/ nga la ‘‘kho re bu chung / 'dir shog dnganya’zer bar/ ngas a bu 'ja' pe'i ngo la gcig bltas dus/ khos ‘‘song dang drag gi red’’zer/ de nas nga kho'i rtsib tu slebs dus/ rgan po des lcags kong che ba zhig gi nang nas/ nga la khu ba sha snyigs yod pa phor pa gang blugs song / rgan pos ‘‘sdug nag khur rgyu tsho/ su mgyogs gang mgyogs byas song nas/ nga'i bu la thug pa rag yod ma red/ kho re de ring nas khyod kyis nga la ja skal rogs gyis dang / za rgyu ngas khyod la len choganya’zer bar/ ngas ‘‘ja skol rogs nga yin/ a khu rgan po khyod kha dro nyazhes bshad/ khos ‘‘snying rje mgo log cig red mo/ nga'i ming la rag shul ja thog zer/ rgya yi ja g.yog red/ khyod do dgong nas nga'i ja g.yog yin zer/ ngas sha khu khur nas a bu 'ja' pe dang / a khu smon lam nged gsum pos 'thung / de dus blo chos gyis ‘‘dri ma btsog po zhig 'dug 'di ci zhig gi sha yin nanya zer bar/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘dri ma gshis dri red/ 'di 319

tshar ba red zer la/ yang khos phar blta tshur blta byas rjes/ skad dma' mos 66da khyed gnyis kyis ltos dang / nyi ma gcig gnyis mtshams nas/ ngas rgya yi thun pa bsad nas ri la 'bro rgyu yin zer/ de mngags song / skal bzang gis ‘‘ha bo shi re go/ 'di nas rta kha shas brkus nas bros 'gro nyazer bar/ dung phrug gis ‘6da gang la 'bro dgos pa red/de las shi gson ci red kyang / rogs pa tsho dang mnyam du yod na dga' ba 323

beku 2 5 7 ( i5 ༅ thi ca 0 red’’sogs bshad/ mun rub la yod dus nga tshos rta ded nas ru mtha' ru slebs dus/ btson pa yod tshad dang / de na yod pa'i mang tshogs thams cad thang thog na gor gor byas nas 'tshogs 'dug a khu bstan 'dzin dang a zhang smon lam/ blo chos gsum mtha' na yod par/ nga tsho der bsdad/ khong gsum thag pas sbrel 'dug rgya dmag dang sde dmag mang pos mtha' nas bskor te bsdad yod/ de dus rgya dpon zhig gis skad bsgyur brgyud nas 6‘btson pa tsho skrag mi dgos/ ngo ma log rir ma 'bro dang / rdzong thog la slebs pa dang / rang rang gi khyim la mngags yong gi redami sogs kha sang bshad pa dang gcig red/blo chos gyis ‘‘kha dmyal ba'i nang la skor rgyu tsho/ ngo log rgyu red bsam nas skrag gi yod pa red/ da mngags mi yong ba los shes nyazer la/ a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘da gar ded sar 'gro rgyu ma gtogs bkod pa med’ zer/ de dus yang skad bsgyur des 6‘da 'di nas ming su bos kyang de yar langs nas gur nang la song / nangs dus 'gro dgos pa ma redanyanyazer/ de'i rjes khos ‘‘bla ma dbu bla/se ra bla ma/ rag shul ja thog thub rgyam/ hor sdug khyed tsho yar longs shoganya’zer/nga'i sems su/'o/ a pha'i mna' ya hor sdug lag lo kho yin rgyu red bsam/ ngas rtsib kyi rgan po zhig la ‘‘a khu/ hor sdug zer ba 'di su redanya dris par/ khos ‘6jag rkun hor sdug lag lo red ’zer/ ngas yang bskyar ‘‘des na khyod kyis ke 'ba' chos sems e shes’nyazhes dris/ rgan pos ‘‘nga'i gdong la gcig bltas nas chos sems rgya mis bzung nas/ rdzong thog tu slebs dus me mda' brgyab nas bsad tshar song / ci dgos/ khyod kyis e shes’ zer bar ngas ‘‘'o ngas go myonganya zhes bshad/ de dus rtsib kyi rgan po zhig gis ‘6ci bshad kyang 'dra ni ma red/ dbu bla dang / se ra bla ma tsho rgya la ngo mtho bas/ de'i drin gyis thub rgyam dang ja thog tsho thar song ba redami’zer/ yang gcig gis ‘6da sdug rgyu thams cad nga tsho red/ mngags zer ba rdzun kho thag red ’sogs mang po bshad 'dug nga'i sems su da ni rag shul ja thog gis thun pa bsad nas bros ma dgos par/ las 324

3 rtsi nyi/lu la nye yis thar song ba red bsam song / a khu bstan 'dzin gyis 66zhi lu gnyis dbu bla shes kyi 'dug gam/ yag po ltos/ khyod gnyis mngags tshar dus khong snyeg song dang / bdag byed kho thag red’ ces bshad/ de'i skabs rgya dmag gnyis kyis btson pa gnyis thag sbrel byas nas ded yong gi yod par/ a zhang smon lam gyis ‘‘bstan 'dzin/ blo chos/ ltos dang / btson pa rjes ma de/ khar nyin nga tshor gcar rdung byed mkhan ngan pa de yin pa 'dra zhig redaminyazer/ de dus skal bzang gis ‘‘red ya/ kha dmyal bar skor rgyu/ ngas ltad mo ltos/ kho la las rgyu 'bras de 'khor ba yin’ zer/ rgya dmag gnyis kyis btson pa de gnyis ded yong nas/ nga tshos sngon du thag sbrel byas nas phyin song / de'i mtshams sus brgyab 'dis brgyab med par/ skag long nger mi de'i mgo la rdo zhig brgyab nas bsgyel song / kho yar langs nas ‘‘a ra ra/ pha ro za rgyu nga la rgyag mkhan su redanya zer zhor du kha phyir 'khor skabs/ mgo nas khrag dmar shar re bzhur song / khos nga tsho rgyab na bsdad yod pa mthong rjes/ ngo mdog nag por gyur nas ‘‘'o nga la rdo brgyab song zer nas bos/ rgya dmag gi thun pa rtsib na yod rung / su gcig gis ya lan ma byas par/ de dus a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘pha ro khyod kyis zo/ da khyod kha gcig grag na/ ngas khyod sa 'di nas bsad mi 'jog nanya zer bar/ khos yar blta mar blta zhig byas nas sa thog tu bsdad song /mgo nas da rung khrag shar 'bab byed kyi 'dug sa zhang smon lam gyis 6‘bla ma dkon mchog khyod la 'di las rgyu 'bras red/ da khyod rdung mkhan dang / nga rdung sa gnyis ka btson khang nang nas mnyam shi byed dgos pa red nyasogs/ khong tsho sems ma bde bar du bshad song / ngas rdo rgyag mkhan ni skal bzang yin pa shes song / mun rub kha yang btson pa thams cad gad khug tu ded song / a bu 'ja' pe/ dung phrug skal bzang / nged bzhi rgya yi rta dang ca lag srung mkhan la bzhag ngas ‘‘a bu skal bzang / rdo rgyag mkhan khyod e yin’nyazhes dris par/khos ‘‘yin/ khyos kyis ji ltar shes song zer/ ngas ‘‘khong tsho'i lag pa bkyig 325

leku 2 0 7 li5 49 thi 0 yod pas rgyag thabs med/ dung phrug nged gsum gzhug na yod/ da khyod min na su yin’ zer bar/ khos ‘‘yag po zhig phog ma thal/ ngas gser yum kho bsad dgos kyang mi gsod na’nyazer/ de dus pho gsar tsha ru yag po zhig gyon nas me mda' khur mkhan zhig yong ste‘‘ya/ a rogs chu kha ma tsho/ ci bsam gyi yodami zer zhor du der bsdad/ skal bzang gis 6 khyod gang nas yinanya dris par/ khos ‘‘nga a mdo mtsho sngon nas yin/ nga'i ming la 'jigs med rdo rje zer/ nga tsho do dgong 'di nas mnyam du nyal zer/ skal bzang gis ‘ khyod rgya'i las byed e yinanyanyazhes dris par/ khos ‘‘min/ nga rgya yi g.yog po yin/ ngas khyod tsho shes/de'i nyin par slob grwa'i nang nas 'dug rogs ma byas pa min nam/ da red de/rdzong thog tu slebs dus slob grwar 'dug sa yod rgyu red/ khyod tsho byis pa tsho skrag dgos pa ma red’ zer/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘a khu 'jigs med/ da lta mi gnyis bzung yod pa gang nas redanya’zer bar/ khos ‘‘de khyod tshos ngo shes kyi 'dug pa ma zad/ da lta khos rdos brgyab song / rjes nas de 'dra ma byed ma gtogs rgya mis mthong na ma 'grig pa red/ byis pas mi shes pa red/ da zhag khyed tsho 'dzin dus khong gnyis sde dmag red/ da nyes pa shor tshar ba red’ sogs skad cha mang po bshad song / nga rang gnyid song / nam langs dus/ kha ba ha cang chen po babs 'dug cung tsam nas sde dmag gnyis yong nas rta la sga bstad/skal bzang gis ‘‘nam tshod 'gro rgyu redanya ces dris par/ sde dmag cig gis 6‘mdang ru nang la 'dug pa'i dmag gi rta rku la shor tshar 'dug de ring 'gro thub rgyu ma redanya zer/ cung tsam nas phyogs g.yas g.yon thams cad nas mi mang po zhig 'di ru 'dus 'dug nga tshos yun ring 'dra bsgugs kyang / da rung 'gro zer ba'i brda med/ cung zhig nas bud med cig yong nas nged bzhi khrid de sbra nang du song / sbra nang du rgya dmag kha shas bsdad yod la/ nga tsho slebs dus kho tsho sgor phyin song / de dus bud med des ‘‘khyad tsho de ring tshogs 'du 'tshogs sar 'gro mi nyan/ 'di nas ja 'thung nas sdod/ nga ma song na chog gi ma red’ zer 326

ma5 (khyi rdzi'u yo bar/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘'gro mi nyan pa ci zhig 'tshog rgyu yod pa redanya’ces dris par/ mos skrag snang chen pos/ ‘‘de ring bla ma dbu bla dang / se ra bla ma tsho la 'thab rtsod brgyab nas gsod dgos zer’ zhes zer/ ha las dgos pa'i skad cha/ bden la 'dzin mi phod pa'i skad cha de go dus/ nga tsho sus kyang kha ma grag par za 'thung byas nas bsdad/ mo rang sgor bud song / cung ma mgor bar mi mang tshogs sa nas 'ur brgyab song / nga tsho sgor bud nas blta dus/ mi mang gi mtha' na rgya dmag gis bskor yod/ bod pa zhig gis ‘‘de ring cig cig de ring nyug nyuganyanyaces skad mthon pos bshad kyi 'dug kyang / nga tshos gsal po zhig go mi thub/ de'i skabs rgya dmag kha shas kyis/ gur nang nas bla ma dbu bla sogs mi lnga drug cig khrid yong nas/ mang tshogs kyi dkyil du yar langs bcugayang rgya zhig gis skad cha bshad/ de'i tsam nas der tshogs yod pa'i mi mang thams cad yar langs nas rgyugs te/ dbu bla sogs mi lnga drug po la mi mang gis bya rgod ro thog tu slebs pa dang 'dra bar/ yar drud/ mar drud byas nas ki ldir nyil le khu tshur brgyab/ rkang tho brgyab/ bar zhig la mi mang gis rdzi 'khrab byas song / nga tsho phar cung song ste gad kha nas bltas/ de dus rgya dmag rgyugs nas mang tshogs la rgyag mtshams byed du bcug phar bltas na mi lnga drug po yar langs thub pa gcig kyang med la/ ro bzhin du gyur 'dug gdong yod tshad la sngo nag dang kha khrag sna khrag yong gi 'dug bla ma dbu bla'i gon pa bshus tshar nas/ gcer bur dmar sgog se pho mtshan lag pas bkab nas bsdad 'dug nga rang skrag pa yin nam/ sdug pa yin/ yang na mtshar ba yin pa mi shes par ha las song / nga rang gi mig gis mthong yang yid ches thabs med par/ sems la kha thal bas chod/ de ring gi 'di tsho ci red/ a pha shi med na yang 'di ltar gsod rgyu e yin nam/ 'di gang gi gsod lugs red sogs mi dran dgu dran byed zhor du bsdad//327

le tshan bdun cu pa/snying rje med pa'i dmar gsod/ phan thogs med pa'i ngo loga'agog mkhan med pa'i chu log dang / rang tshod med pa'i mi mang zer ba los bden/ yang bud med cig gis mi mang gi dkyil nas skad cha zhig bshad rjes/ mi mang gis ki ldir byas nas shor te/ khu tshur rkang tho ci phog gang phog gis bla ma dbu bla sogs mi lnga drug de ko ba dung rdung byas song / yang rgya mi dang sdedamag rnams rgyugs nas mi mang la rdung mtshams byed du bcug de dus mdang 'jigs med zer ba'i las byed de yong nas ‘‘ya kho re tsho/ phar thag nye sar song nas blta’ zer bar/ nga tsho cung thag nye sar song / mi mang skor ba byas nas bsdad yod la/ bla ma sogs mi drug dkyil na bsdad yod/ phar bltas na se ra bla ma khog stod gcer bur/ lus po nyis lteb byas nas 'phangs 'dug la/ da grongs tshar 'dug rgya mi zhig gis skad bsgyur brgyud nas 6‘sla mo byas nas gsod mi nyan/ dang po khong tsho'i nyes pa mtshang brtol byed dgos/ de nas 'thab rtsod rgyag dgos zer la/ bud med skra nag sbar can zhig gis se ra bla ma'i mgo la brdzis te ‘‘bshu gzhog pa 'di tsho shi song ba 'dra/ khos mi dmangs kyi sha khrag za rgyu mang song ba red/ de ring rtsa med gtong rgyu yin’nyazer nas bla mar rkang thos brgyab/ de dus yang mi mang gis nang nas mi zhig gis skad mthon pos 6‘de ring sha gzan spyang ki 'di tsho 'thab rtsod rgyag dgos samanya zer bar/ mi mang gis ‘‘'thab rtsod rgyag dgos’ zhes skad brgyab/ ‘‘de ring sha lan sha dang / khrag lan khrag len dgos samanya zer bar mi mang gis ‘6len dgos zhes skad brgyab/‘‘bshu gzhog pa thams cad rtsa med du gtong dgos sam zer bar thams cad kyis ‘ rtsa med du gtong dgos zer nas/ yang rgyugs te rgyag rdung byas par ma zad/ sngar ltar mi mang gis rdzis 'khrab byed bzhin 'dug yang rgya mi zhig 328

nga ༅skyi1lham gis skad cha bshad nas/ bla ma sogs mi lnga po mang tshogs kyi dkyil na/ nag nar re g.yugs 'dug nga'i sems su da bsad tshar song / ci 'dra'i dge sems med pa/ rang sde yi bla dpon la rgyag rdung rdzi 'khrab byas nas/ 'di 'dra bsad zer ba 'jig rten 'di na e yod dam/ ci 'dra rgyu 'bras med pa'i sa cha sogs mi dran dgu dran byed skabs/ dung phrug gis ‘‘da bsad tshar nas ro 'drud bzhin 'dug’ zer bar/ nga tshos phar bltas pa na/ mi 'gas rkang pa nas bzung ste drud nas gad khar song / mi mang gis ki ldir nyil le yang kha g.yang 'bod zhor du rjes ded nas yong zhing / gad khar slebs dus ro thams cad gad ngo nas mar 'phangs pas/ gad zhabs kyi chu kha ru 'gril song / de nas mang tshogs kyis ki dir byed zhor du yar 'tshogs sar song / a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘ltos dang mi gcig shi mi 'dug mgo yar bkyags 'dug’nyazer bar/ nga tshos bltas pa na rag shul ja thog gis mgo yar bkyags nas lham gon bzhin 'dug gcig gis bla ma dkon mchog gan shi mi 'dug zer/ de dus gad kha nas yar 'gro ma tshar ba'i bud med re zung gis ‘‘rag shul ja thog shi mi 'duganya’zer nas bos pas/ rgya mi zhig gis skad brgyab nas cig bshad par/ mi mang yang gad kha nas mar babs te/ rag shul ja thog rgod kyis ro za ba bzhin/ rgyag rdung dang rdzi 'khrab byas/ mi mang la las ro gzhan dag rdzi 'khrab byed bzhin 'dug yang nga'i sems su ci 'dra'i rgan po las ngan/ khyod sos yong dus cung zhig la shi mdog byed pa las/ 'phral du mgo bkyags nas ci dgos pa yin nam/ da ni ngo ma bsad tshar song / sa 'di nas nga'i ngo shes/ nga la za ma sprad mkhan gyi rgan po drin chen rag shul ja thog da ni bsad tshar song / mtshar po zhig la/ mi thams cad kyis rgya la ngo mtho ba red zer ba'i bla ma dbu bla yang / de ring 'thab rtsod byas te bsad tshar song / da ni khong gis nged gnyis la bdag byed rgyu phar zhog khong yang srog mgo thon ma song / dkon mchog gsum mkhyen/shi mi dgos pa zhig su yod kyang / 'di ltar shi ba ni/ mi ma shi dmyal ba myong ba 'dra/ da ni 329

leku 2 0 7 ( i ༅ma thi 0tshe 0 ci yin na'ang mi rang rang las kyis shi lugs re yod rgyu red/ de ni rang gi bdam rgyu med kho thag red/ a pha la me mda' brgyab nas bsad pa de/ 'di tshor bltas na shi lugs yag po red 'dug da nangs bud med des nga tsho tshogs 'dur 'gro mi nyan zer ba bden 'dug 'di 'dra zhig mig gis mthong ma dgos par shog sogs dran zhor du bltas nas bsdad/ mi thams cad gshar tshar song / gad zhabs na 'thab rtsod byas te bsad pa'i ro rnams nag nar re 'phangs 'dugagad kha nas byis pa 'gas ro thog la rdo 'phen 'dug la/ khyi sdom kha shas re ro 'gram na skor ba byed bzhin 'dug de dus sde dmag cig gis ‘‘khyod tshos do dgong yang 'di tshang nas za 'thung gyis/ de ring 'gro rgyu ma red’’zer nas 'bod bzhin 'dug nga tsho yar sbra nang du slebs dus skal bzang gis ‘‘sa 'di nas mi ngan gsod de 'dra byed kyi 'dug’’zer bar/ dung phrug gis 6‘sa 'di zer rgyu med/ de rgya dmag gis btsan btsugs pa redanya zer/ ngas ‘‘a bu dung phrugang tsho'i sa nas rgya dmag gis 'di 'dra btsan 'dzugs kyi e yod dam’ zhes dris par/ khos ‘‘sdug na mi thang na ’zer/ yang nga'i sems su des na da sa mtha' yod pas dga' 'dug rang sde nang nas 'di 'dra byas nas rang bla rang dpon la 'thab rtsod byas te gsod dgos na/ ha cang dka' mo red bsam song /cung tsam nas bud med de yong nas nga tsho la za 'thung blud cing / mos de ring 'thab rtsod brgyab pa'i skor kyi skad cha mang po bshad song / mtshan mo nyal rjes/ mtshan gang du de ring gi gnas stangs skor rmi lam 'khrugs nas gnyid ma yong / nam langs te nyi ma shar song / btson pa thams cad sbra sgor khrid yong nas za 'thung blugs par/ tshe khos ‘‘kha sang nyin gang du zhogs ja zhig las gang yang blud ma song / kha khrag la skor rgyu tsho/ nga tsho ltogs nas mgo yom 'khor gyi 'duganya zer/nged bzhi pos snga mo nas za 'thung tshar/ ngas rta khrid nas phar song ste bltas pa na/ gad zhabs su kha sang ngan gsod byas pa'i ro de dag khyi re zung gis za bzhin 'dug la/ g.yas g.yon na bya pho rog mang po babs 'dug nga'i sems su snying 330

ma5 ('i rdzi nyi pom rje/ ro bdag med ngo ma 'di tsho red/ rang bla rang dpon 'di tsho rang sde'i 'gram nas ro khyis za dus/ bdag po med sa nas/ chos ma ṇi zhig gang na yod bsam song / de dus a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘nus kho 'gro ran song ’zer nas 'bod kyi 'dugang rang tshur yong dus/ sbra sgo'i btson pa yod sa nas mi mang yar langs nas 'ur cha rgyag 'dug phan tshun gyi las byed dang dmag kyang der rgyug gi 'dug mi tshang ma dmag gis bkag yod pa'i don ci byung ma shes shing / phar bltas na btson pa tshos rgyag res byed pa 'dra/ de'i skabs rgya dmag gis btson pa rnams tsho skor tsho skor byas nas ded/ de dus sde dmag cig gis ‘‘ci yang ma red/ 'di tsho'i rogs pa zhig dang nor tshe gnyis rgyag res byas song ’zer/ 'o da nga tshos shes song / a khu bstan 'dzin gyis kha sang gi mi der brgyab pa dang / de dus tshe kho yong nas ‘‘de ring a khu bstan 'dzin gyis mi de thub 'dug phor pas mig sgam thog brgyab nas 'gyel ba dang / yar langs dus yang gcig brgyab nas/mig sgam bcag 'dug mi tshos ci yin ma shes par/ khyed gnyis ma 'dzings zer nas bar byas song / mi de mgo khrag lus la g.yog 'dug rgya dmag gis kyang 'gan blangs ma song ’zhes bshad song / nga tsho thams cad sems ha cang dga' 'dug nga'i sems su 'di ni rgyu 'bras 'khor ba los yin bsam song /btson pa tsho gangs nang nas lam du chas song / de ring chu che chung mang tsam brgal dgos la/ mang che ba dar chags 'dug de ring dung phrug skal bzang / a bu 'ja' pe nged bzhi mnyam du 'gro chog cing / phal cher lta rtog byed mkhan med pas/ ga ler rjes ded nas song yang chog blo chos/ a khu bstan 'dzin/ khong tsho lnga po yang mnyam du rjes ma'i nang 'gro 'dug pas/ nga tsho mtshams rer gshibs nas skad cha bshad zhor du 'gro chog skabs shig la btson pa sngon ma tshos 'tshub log nyil le 'ur brgyab song la/cung tsam nas me mda'i skad gnyis gsum grag song / btson pa bar ma ni bud med tsho red/ thams cad sa thog tu bsdad 'dug rgya dmag kha shas sngon du rgyugs shing / nga tsho thams cad yang 331

mishu 2 5 7 ( yi 5 49ma thi tshe dzi sa thog tu sdod zer nas bkag song la/ yang bskyar me mda'i skad kha shas grag song / rgya dmag re zung da rung sngon du rgyug gi 'dug cung tsam nas rgya dmag ṭwāṃ tt+waṃ ni ṭwāṃ~X byeX zloṭwāṃṭwāṃ ༵ ṭwāṃg ba ṭwāṃ~X ṭwāṃ~X dīs ༵ ༵ja/'a ṭwāṃ rnyirdo rsharshatā ༵ /ra hā~X ṭwāṃsdi /soX dudī ༵༵ snyaṭwāṃ ༷ ༵ ༷ rno /ṭwāṃ dargyu ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ ༷༵ba~Xnaya ༷ ṭwāṃtrī~X ༵ ༵swā cad yar langs nas gshar/ yar cung song na lam ltag na rgya dmag kha shas ༵ṭwāṃrsha ༵sngi /ṭwāṃ/sa ni rnyi~X ṭwāṃ dā~X/ ༵ ṭwāṃ ༵ sdi~Xṭwāṃ rshaṭwāṃsna rshakyā ༵ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ rdoṭwāṃ~X rgyag gi 'dug mar bltas na lam zhabs kyi chu kha na mi gnyis bsad 'dug la/ṭwāṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃg py-i kyā ṭwāṃ~X ༵༵dīṭwāṃsdo kā ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ tyā ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃtta mngagle ṭwāṃ ༷gaj-i hā ṭwāṃ / 'aṭwāṃ dmag mang po 'di'i 'gram nas rkang thang la 'bro rgyu med pa los shes/ sems 'dre yis ded pa los yin bsam song / dgong mo yang ri mtha' zhig nas bsdad ṭwāṃ /de ༵ ༷ gā'i rnyi ༵ ༵thu ṭwāṃ / kyārto zlo / ri/ ༵nga snedi kā~X ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃkā ṭwāṃrsha ‘‘/ zlo am phrag tu gri yod 'dug thag pa bcad nas rgya dmag gi mabe| la rgyugs te/ rtsib kyi rgya dmag gnyis bsad cing me mda' 'phrogs nas bros/ rgya dmag sngon ma tshos me mda' brgyab nas bsad song / tshur rgya dmag la me mda' re zung ༵ ༵༵༷ṭwāṃrsha sa/ ༵༷ ༵ ༵// ༵ ṭwāṃ ༵ /'aṭwāṃ sdiṭwāṃ rsha ṭwāṃhā ༵tyā ṭwāṃṭwāṃs/ ṭwāṃ ༵tt+waṃ ṭwāṃrsha 'di tsho bu ngar ba re yod 'dug 'di 'dra ngo log rgyu zhig gang nas dran pa yin nam/ snying rje da ni mi ma thub la rang srog kyang shor song / yang shi bo bdag med re zung khyi spyang gis za rgyu red/ rang rang gi las zer ba bshad mi shes pa dka' mo red/ ci yin na shi dgos pa'i las la gzur rgyu med na/ kha sang de tsho lta bu 332

5 (khri thutshe nyi lumi ngan gsod byed pa las/ de ring 'di tsho shi stangs yag rgyu red/ rgya dmag gcig bsad gcig rmas yod pa khong tshos los shes/ ro lan zer rgyu med kyang /shi sems cung bde rgyu red/ kha sang ngan gsod byas pa tsho/ rang sde rang mis khu tshur rkang tho brgyab nas bsad pa yin pas/ shi sems mi bde ba'i shi bo red dran song //le tshan don gcig pa/rgan po bde zhing bskyal nas/ nga tsho dong du g.yugs song /de ring ni spyi lo 1958 'o'i zla 10 tshes 16 yin zer/ snga mo za 'thung byas rjes/ 'gro ran khar rgya dpon zhig gis skad bsgyur brgyud nas ‘‘do dgong chu dmar rdzong thog tu slebs kyi red/ thams cad yag po song / ri la 'bro mkhan dang / ngo log mkhan yod na gsod rgyu yin’’zer/ btson pa thams cad sngar ltar lam la chas/ ri nyag mthon po zhig gi ri sked la slebs dus/ btson pa bar ma'i nang nas/ bud med gnyis dang rgan po zhig ga ler rjes su lhag de dus rgya dmag rjes mas rgan po de ded nas btson pa'i rjes su song / phar bltas na bud med chung ba de pho ba na ba 'dra/ cung re song nas sar bsdad/ yang cung re song nas sar bsdad/ mtshams shig la a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyi 'gram du slebs/ nged gnyis 'khyags nas rta zhon med par/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘6nus kho/ khyod kyi rta de bud med nad pa 'di cung tsam zhon du chuganya zer bar ngas rta khrid nas bud med de la ‘‘a ne khyod kyis rta 'di zhon dang / 'di nga'i rta redanya ces bshad par/ bud med che ba des ‘‘zhon phod kyi ma red/ khyod tshe ring zer/ ngas 6‘skyon yod pa red/ 'di rgya dmag gis nga la g.yar ba red zer zhor du rta khong gnyis la sprad/ bud med nad pa des rta zhon zhing / rogs pas khrid nas nga tsho mnyam du song / de dus btson pa rjes ma'i nang nas 'ur brgyab song / nga tshos der slebs pa na rgan po de sa thog tu bsdad 'dug btson 333

miku 2 pa 4 li ༅ 3 tshe 0 pa tsho thag sbrel byas yod pas mi gcig ma song dus/ rogs pa thams cad 'gro mi thub/ cung tsam nas rgya dmag gnyis yong nas rgan por rkang tho brgyab nas song zer bar/ rgan pos da khyod tshos nga sod cig nga shi na'ang 'gro thub sa ma redanya zer/ rgya dmag gnyis kyis yang rgan po la rkang tho dang / me mda' yi zhwa ngos brgyab par/ rgan pos ci zhig bshad zhor du yar langs nas song / cung ma 'gor bar/ rgan po yang sa thog bsdad nas ‘‘nga da sod zhog 'gro thub rgyu mi 'duganya zer nas sa thog tu bsdad/ de dus rgya dmag gis kho'i thag pa bshig nas btson ma gzhan rnams sngon du 'gro ru bcug nga tsho der cung bltas par rgya dmag gis skad log brgyab nas dod song / nga tsho sngon du song nas chen po ma 'gor bar/ rjes nas me mda'i skad cig grag song / ngas phyir bltas byas kyang ci yang ma mthong la/ de dus 'gram gyi rgya dmag gis/ bud med nad pa'i rogs pa de khrid nas btson pa dang mnyam du thag sbrel byas song / nad pa de rta zhon zhing ngas khrid yod/ cung 'gor rjes/ da lta rgan po gsod mkhan rgya dmag de gnyis yong yang / rgan po mthong rgyu med pas/ nga'i sems nas ha cang gsal song / snying rje/ mda' gcig gis rgan po bde ba can la bskyal tshar 'dugayang ro bdag med cig rjes su lhag song dran zhor du song / nyin gung btson pa tsho chu chen zhig gi kha ru slebs song / de na rdo brkos ma ṇi brtsigs pa ha cang ring po zhig yod/ de ni 'bo'u chen rdo kha zer/ btson pa tsho der bsdad bcug de dus sde dmag gnyis kyis rta zhig la rgya dmag gi ro zhig bkal nas slebs yong la/ der slebs pa na ro rta la bkal sdom zhig byas par/ nga la rta kha bzung zer/ngas rta kha bzung nas bsdad/ kho 'gro ran kha ngas ‘‘a khu/ rjes na rgan po zhig yong gi 'dug gam’’zhes dris par/ khos phar blta tshur bsta byed zhor du/ ‘‘kho re 'dre phrug kha tshum ma gtogs rgya mis go yong / rgan po rgya dmag gis bsad tshar 'duganya zer zhor du bud song / de dus bud med nad pas ‘‘bu chung lo lo/gang yang bshad kyi ma 'dug ma gtogs/ rgya mis khyod la dung gi red go zer/334

5: zhi spode 3 lum dgong mo mun ma rub bar du rdo kha nas bsdad cing / za 'thung ci yang blug rgyu med/ zla ba shar dus btson pa snga ma rnams gshar song / nga tsho yang rjes ded nas song / rgya dmag gis skad rgyag gi 'dug la/ skad bsgyur bas ‘‘mgyogs posong / mgyogs po songami zer nas 'ur rgyag gi 'dug do dgong zla 'od ha cang gsal po red/ ngas rta zhon/ a bu 'ja' pes rta kha khrid nas song / de dus de ring gi bud med nad pa de gnyis yang rjes nas 'gro bzhin 'dug nad pa de nga'i rtsib tu bcar nas ‘‘bu ltogs sam ’zer/ ngas 6‘cung skyon mi 'duganya’zer bar/ mos nga'i lag tu nar nar zhig bzhag nas ‘‘de zo dnganyanyazer/ngas ‘‘a ne kha dro ’brjod par/ mos ‘‘kha ma grag ’zer zhor du phyin song / ngas cung tsam nas bltas na rgyu ma skam po mtho gang tsam yod pas/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyi bgos nas zos/ rgyu ma skam po der tsha dri bro 'dug pas ha cang zhim po zhig red/ de dus bod pa zhig gis ‘‘rdzong thog tu slebs na kha grags mi chog nyazer zhor du 'bod kyi 'dug yang cung song na gur yod pa dang / khang pa dkar po mang po yod sa zhig tu slebs song / btson pa thams cad lam dkyil nas ded de song / lam gyi g.yas g.yon gnyis kur khang pa mang po 'dug la/ zla 'od 'og nas ha cang gsal ngo mthong gi 'dug btson pa 'di 'dra mang po 'jam cag ge rang rang 'gro ba'i dog sgra ma gtogs ci yang go rgyu med la/ mtshams shig la gyang mthon po gnyis kyi bar nas/ sgo chen zhig gi nang du 'dzul song / btson pa tsho'i thad du mi drug re thag sbrel byas yod pas/ sgo nang du 'dzul dus/ mi tsho 'tshang kha ma brgyab na nang du 'dzul mi thub/ de dus rgya dmag kha shas re yong nas/ me mda'i nya rngas brgyab ste btsan po byas nas nang du rdzong gi 'dug de'i skabs a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis/ a zhang smon lam dang / a khu bstan 'dzin gnyis kyi bar du gral bsgrigs nas 'gro bzhin yod/ rgyal 19) nang 'dzul rjes rgya ra ha cang chen po zhig gi nang du slebs 'dug la/ rgya ra'i kha ru rgya dmag gi thun pas glog sgron zhor du/ me mda' khur nas phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa zla 'od 335

le༄ 2 pa 7 ( li5tsho le tshe 0 las mthong thub/ ra skor nang du slebs dus btson pa thams cad bkyig thag dang / thag pa bshig song / da rung ska rags dang / lham sgrog thams cad blangs song zhing / thams cad sbo lug nya lug mar gral bsgrigs nas sdod bcug song/ngas zhib mor bltas pa na/ sngon nas mi tsho re tsho re khrid pa na/ rgya ra'i dkyil du slebs tshe mthong rgyu med par gyur song / yang tsho gcig khrid nas rgya ra'i dkyil du slebs dus sngar bzhin mi mthong bar gyur song / nga'i sems su mtshar po/ 'di ci zhig byed bzhin yod dam/ phar bltas na rgya ra skya khor re zla 'od nas mthong 'dug la/ mi mang po khrid song ba'ang gcig kyang mthong rgyu med/ de skabs rgya dmag yong nas yang mi sum cu'i mtshams nas bcad de sngon du ded song / de ni a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis mtshams nas bcad song bas/ a zhang smon lam dang a bu 'ja' pe gnyis sngon du ded song / ngas ‘‘a bu 'ja' penya zer nas 'bod zhor du a bu 'ja' per 'thams nas cung song ba na/ rgya dmag mi zhig gis nga'i rna 'byog nas bzung ste phyir khrid yong / de dus a khu bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘'o drag gi/ nus kho ngas bdag byed 'dug’nyazer nas bos/ a zhang smon lam dang a bu 'ja' pe gnyis sngon du ded song / ngas kyang zhib tu bltas na/ mi sum cu'i nang de rgya ra'i dkyil du slebs pa na/ yang brlags song / da ni ngas blta yag byas/ ngo ma ci zhig byed pa mi shes par/ btson pa thams cad mthong rgyu med la/ rgya dmag tsho phyir yong nas/ yang nga tsho mi sum cu'i nang mnyam du ded song / nga tsho rgya ra'i dkyil la slebs dus/ rgya dmag cig gis sa thog nas shing leb gru bzhi zhig yar bkyags song bar/ de ni sa dong zhig gi kha leb red 'dug dong kha phyes na dri ma ngan pa zhig sna lam du bro song / btson pa tsho 'phro rim 'phror dong nang du mchongs bcug pas/ dong nang nas mi tshos a ra a na zer nas 'ur rgyag 'dug nga rang dong khar slebs rjes dmag mi zhig gis bod skad kyis ‘‘ya kho re/ zhabs nas 'di len rogs gyis dang’ zer zhor du/ nga'i sked pa nas bzung ste dong nang du mar gnar/ de dus zhabs nas mi zhig gis 336

5 (ḍa 43lpi po ‘‘byis pa zhig red’ zer zhor du blangs song / dong nang du skyag dri dang / gcin dri/ mi mang gi gshis dri yis sna tsha zhing / dbugs len thub mi thub red 'duganang gi mi sngon ma tsho 'khun dir nyil le ga sa gang du nyal 'dug nga tsho rjes nas slebs pa tsho nyal sa ma dgos/ rkang pa gnyis sa thog brdzi sa med par/ mi sngon ma nyal yod pa tsho'i lus thog mgo thog brdzi zhor du song bas khong tshos a ra a na mang po zer 'dug nga'i sems su 'o da ni chu dmar rdzong gi btson khang nang du slebs song ya/ 'di btson khang ma red btson dong zhig red bsam song /mtshan der nga la gnyid ma yong / sa dong nang du dri ngan bro ba ma tshad/ mi tshos ngor ba dang gnyid log byed pa/ rtug dri btang ba/ da rung so sgra 'cha' ba sogs rtso yin na/ rna lam du lkog dir nyil le 'dra byed 'dug nga'i sems su 'di dong ci 'dra zhig yin na/ 'dis nang mi ci tsam yod dam/ sngon ma rgya mis rgas pa 'bu dong nang 'phen gyi red zer ba bden 'dug da rgas pa dang de ma tshad btson pa dang byis pa yang 'phen bzhin 'dug la/ dong 'di'i nang 'bu ci 'dra zhig yod dam/ 'bus mi ci 'dra byas nas za ba yin nam/ a bu 'ja' pes ci byed bzhin yod dam/ da nga tsho ngo thug gam sogs mi dran dgu dran dang / snang ba mi shar dgu shar byas nas bsdad/ sa dong nang mi mang bas ha cang dron po red 'dug la/ nga rang mgo nas rngul chu 'bab bzhin/ mtshams rer zhen kha log nas skyug grabs byed kyi 'dug dong nang nas nam tshod ci yang mi shes par/ yar bltas na/ dong kha min nam bsam pa zhig na khra har cung yod la/ dong nang gsal po mi mthong bar/ dong nang mi ci tsam yod pa yang mi shes/ cung tsam/ dong kha yi shing leb yar bkyag song / da ngas zhib tu bltas na/ sa dong 'di zheng ha cang mi che yang / phal cher 'phred du mi brgyad dgu tsam 'dug chogs dong sna ha cang ring la/ phal cher mi lnga bcu tsam 'dug chog nga tsho yod sa dong 'di'i nang btson ma sum brgya drug cu nang yod 'dug dong gi dkyil na shing gi zo ba gsum bzhag yod/ de ni btson pa tshos gcin pa gtong sa dang /337

leku 2 5 7 ( li ༅ ri tshe 0 la las nang skyag pa yang btang 'dug de dus rgya mi zhig gis dong kha nas lcags skas shig btsugs te/ skas phyed tsam babs rjes/ mi re re yi ming nas bzung ste bos/ rgya mi'i ming bos pa des rang rang gi brang kha sbyar yod pa'i ras dkar po'i thog gi ang grangs skad bkyags nas 'don dgos/ mang che bas ang grangs 'don mi shes pas/ nga bsdad yod zer dgos 'dug skabs shig la ming re gnyis thengs mang po bos kyang nga bsdad yod zer mkhan med par/ rogs pa la las ‘‘'o kho 'di na shi 'dug nyazer/ de'i dgong mo nga tsho yod sa'i sa dong nang nas btson pa gnyis shi 'dug/le tshan don gnyis pa/btson pa gsum gnyis dgu dgu/ pha yul grogs por thug song / rgya des da rung btson dong nang gi skas kha nas/ btson ma re re bzhin ming 'bod kyi 'dug la/ nga tsho'i 'gram na rgya skad go mkhan btson pa zhig yod pas/ de kho rang gi thag nyer bsdad yod pa'i btson pa tsho'i ming 'bod dus/ rgya skad kyi yong grangs 'don rogs byed kyi 'dug thams cad kyi ming bos tshar rjes/ sngon la nang du gcin skyag yod pa'i shing zo gsum yar dong khar bzhagade nas ming bos tshar ba'i mi thams cad dong khar yar 'bud du bcug rjes/dong nang shi yod pa'i mi gnyis kyi ro dong khar len du bcug rgya mi gnyis dang /skad bsgyur zhig dong nang du yong ste/ nga tsho mdang slebs pa tsho dong nang du gral sgrig tu bcug nas/ nga tsho mi re'i brang khar ang grangs dmar po bris yod pa'i ras dkar po lag mthil tsam re sbyar 'dug sa ho ho/ rgya ra chen po de'i nang du btson pas gang 'dug la la gral bsgrigs nas rgya ra'i sgo ru 'bud bzhin yod/ la la yar nang du 'dzul bzhin 'dug rgya ra mthon po'i kha thog nas rgya dmag mang po phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed bzhin 'dug rgya ra'i nub sgor bud rjes 338

ga5 'i rdzi hri pom ri rtsa zhig tu slebs yod la/ de na skyag gcin gtong sa zhig yod/ rgya sgo gong 'og gnyis kyi nang nas mi rnams gral bsgrigs nas gshar gyirne yod la/ skyes phomo thams cad sbo lug ma yin/ ri rtsa'i gad kha zhig tu spo tho shar shar brkos te gsang spyod bzos yod/ nga tsho gsang spyod du slebs ma slebs kyi mtshams su gcin skyag gtong khom med par btson par blta mkhan rgya 'ga' re dang / rgyang na bskor nas bsdad yod pa'i dmag gi thun pa tshos rdo dang / spo tho lag ci zin gyis rgyag ci thub byed pas/ thams cad mgyogs po yar langs nas tshur yong /yang gral bsgrigs te rgya ra'i nang du 'dzul/ de dus a bu 'ja' pe dang a zhang smon lam gnyis rgya sgor 'bud kyin yod/ sgo kha nas nged gnyis thug song / ngas skad brgyab nas ‘‘a bu/ a bu 'ja' pe zhes bos par/ khos kyang nga la bltas nas bgad 'dug de dus a khu bstan 'dzin gyis nga'i rgyab nas ded de a bu'i sa la rgyug song zer bar/ nga phar rgyugs nas a bu'i rtsib tu slebs nyer yod dus/btson bdag rgya mi zhig rgyugs yong nas/ skad log rgyag zhor du nga'i rna 'byog nas bzung ste phar khrid song / de dus a zhang smon lam gyis ‘‘skyon med/ khyod a khu bstan 'dzin sa nas sdod dang khyed gnyis thug gi redami zer/ nga la bkod pa ci yang med par/ yang a khu bstan 'dzin dang mnyam du sngar gyi dong nang du song / dong kha ru ro gnyis da rung bzhag 'dug phar bltas na dong gzhan rnams kyi kha na'ang mi ro re gnyis bzhag yod pa 'dra/ gsal po ma mthong / cung 'gor rjes btson pa mi re la gro phye rlangs btsos gnyis re dang / 'bras chu phor pa gang re blugs song / nga rang brgyags pas mi tshad/ gro phye rlangs btsos gcig a khu bstan 'dzin la sprad/ phar bltas na mi che ba rnams de 'dra 'grang gi med pa 'dra/sbra yi btson khang dang bsdur na/ za ma 'di na cung drag 'dug de'i mtshams nas/ dong kha shing leb kyis sgo brgyab song / btson pa tshos rang rang so sos dga' sdug shi gsum gyi skad cha shod bzhin 'dug mang che bas rang gi khyim na lus yod pa'i pha ma dang / bza' tshang / yang na byis pa tsho'i lo rgyus bshad kyi 339

le4 2 pa 7 ma ༅ma thi tshe 0 'dug mi re la rang rang gis bshad mi tshar ba'i sdug re yod/ a khu bstan 'dzin nged gnyis kyi rtsib tu pho gsar rgya skad go mkhan zhig yod pa des/ ‘‘nga sngon ma rgya'i las byed pa yin/ rjes nas rgya mis nga tsho ngo log 'char 'dug zer nas/ nga'i rogs pa las byed lnga mnyam du bzung song / da nga la lo nyi shu'i khrims thag bcad tshar song / btson khang nang la shi rgyu red/ nga'i ming la bstan pa tshe ring zer ba yin/ chu dmar ra tshang sde ba'i yin/ ma rgan dang sring mo gnyis rdzong thog rgya mtha' na bsdad yodami ces bshad/ dgong mo mun rub dus yang dong sgo phyes te gsang spyod du btang song / rgya ra'i nang nas sgor ba bud gong / ngas a bu 'ja' pe rgya ra'i nang gral bsgrigs yod pa mthong song / khos kyang nga mthong nas lag brda byed kyi 'dug cung song dus nged gnyis thag je nyer song / nga yang kho sar rgyugs/ nga der slebs pa na a bu 'ja' pes gro phye rlangs btsos shig nga la byin/ ngas ‘‘nga tsho da nangs go re gnyis re sprad song nyazhes bshad par/ khos ‘‘nga tsho la sprod mkhan bod pa zhig red/ nga la gsum sprad song zer/ de nas sgor slebs ran khar/ yang da nangs kyi rgya ngan des sgo rtsar bsdad yod pas nga rang phyir a khu bstan 'dzin gyi 'gram du 'gro ru bcug spyod khang nas yang bskyar nga tsho la rdo dang spo tho yis mang po brgyab song / yar dong nang slebs rjes mun rub song la/ de'i skabs yang btson ma rnams la phye thug phor nga thutshe rdziyo0 grags pas ‘‘don med du ji ltar bsad pa yin namanya zer ba la/ 6‘ston ma gsang spyod du gtong dus bud med cig glo bur du smyos nas skad chen po brgyab ste yar rgyug mar rgyug byas/ bud med mang che ba de la skrag nas bros/ de dus rgya dmag dang / btson bdag tsho rgyugs nas lcag g.yog dang / me mda' yi nya rngas brgyab nas bud med tsho bkag bud med gcig btson bdag ma he hran gyis bsad song zer bzhin 'duganyanyaces bshad/ nga tsho sgo chung nang du blta ru song / bud med thams cad rgya dmag gi rgya ra'i dkyil du bkag 'dug rgya lha'i 'gram na bud med gnyis kyi ro yod pa mthong gi 'dug gcig smyon ma de red zer/ de dus las byed pa bsod nams nor bu slebs nas ‘‘a kho re tsho/ da yar nang la 'gro/ da 'di tshor ci blta yonganya zer bas/ nga tsho ja khang nang du yong /grags pas ‘‘bud med de tshos ci byas song zer dris par/ bsod nor gyis ‘‘ya kho re mi shes/ bud med kha shas kyis ngo log nas dmag la rdo brgyab song zer/ sdug rgyu nag mo gnyis gsum bsad bzhag pa de redanya’zer bar/ bzod pas ‘6ngas mthong song / nag mo gcig gsod mkhan ni he hran red zer bar/bsod nor gyis ‘‘hin/ pha ro za rgyu he hran kho rang btson pa red/ mi gsod rgyu'i dbang cha gang du yod/ ngas kho la ga le ltos sdodaminyazer/ de nas bsod nor gyis nga la ‘6ya kho re 'di nas 'dug dus e skrag gi nyazhes dris par/ ngas ‘‘mi skrag gi’nyazhes bshad/ ‘‘kho re mtshan dong nang nas mi skrag gamanya zer bar/6‘gang yang mi skrag gi nyazhes lan btab/ ‘6gin/ kho re bu rgod po/ da chen po 'dug dgos pa ma red/ da lta rdzong thog slob grwa yod ma red/ de ma gtogs snga mo nas mngags tshar ba redami zer/ ‘‘nged gnyis kyi rogs pa tsho mngag gi e redanyanyaces ngas de ltar dris tshe/ ‘‘lo chung ba thams cad mgyogs po mngag gi red/ mi che ba da rung mi shes ’zer/ de nas khong tshos yang bud med btson ma tsho'i gnas stangs mang po bshad/ khos ja 'thung rjes bud song / dgong mo mun rub khar yang a khu grags pas a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis rang rang gi sa dong 347
