leku 2 5 7 i tshog si tshe 0 su da shi ran song ba 'dra/ yun thung thung zhig gi nang mi gsum shi song da rung gnyis shi la khad du 'dug 'di 'dra yin na sa dong gang po do dgong phal cher shi rgyu red/ ya ha las rgyu ci yang med/ mi sum brgya lhag shi 'gro sa nas/ nga shi bar 'gyod rgyu ci yod/ nga shi song na a bu 'ja' pe sems bde rgyu ma red/ da ci yin na/ bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen zhes dran nas bsdad yod skabs/ yang dong nang du dmag gon pa dkar po gon yod mkhan gcig babs yong la me mda' bzung mkhan dmag lnga drug cig kyang dong nang du babs song / gon pa dkar po can ni sman pa red/ khos btson pa nad pa tshor sman sbyin/ 'gro ran kha thams cad mig btsum sdod/ sman chu gtor dgos zer nas dong gi nang thams cad du/ chu 'dra rlangs pa skya bo can zhig gtor song / gtor tshar rjes khong tshos dong sgo brgyab nas song / de dus btson ma thams cad lu thung byed pa dang / sna dang / mig tsha nas mchi ma bzhur/ nga rang yang lu zhing mig nas mchi ma bzhur song la/ gon pa thams cad rlon pa byas 'dug de dus mi zhig gis ‘‘'o 'di nas yang gcig shi songanyi)zer la/ yang mi zhig gis ‘‘pha ro za rgyu/rgya ngan tshos dug btab song / da tshang ma shi rgyu red’ zer bas/ mi mang tsho skrag snang zhig gis 'ur ldir nyil le yar langs song / yang rgan po zhig gis ‘‘da rgyas dug btab yod kho thag red/ skad brgyab na lta mkhan yod pa ma redami zer bar/yang thams cad kyis skad brgyab nas bos/ skabs shig la glog ngang shar re dong kha phyes song / mi zhig gis ‘‘'ur ma rgyag khyod tsho ci red song dris song bar/mi zhig gis ‘‘da lta rgya dmag gis 'gro ran kha dug btab song / mi gcig shi song /da nga tsho shi yi redami zer bar/ dong kha'i mi des ‘‘pha ro za rgyu/ rdzun ma bshad a/dug chu ma red/ sman red/ khyod gcig pu gang nas shi 'gro/ dong thams nang btab yod red/ dong sgo phye 'jog cung tsam nas med 'gro yi redanya zer/ da ngas dong kha'i mi des skad ngo shes song / kho ni las byed pa bsod nams nor bu red 'dug cung tsam nas khos ‘‘kho re de ru bu chung chung zhig yod pa de/ yar 350

'a5 ḍa ༅ skyi yog ṭwāṃbhe ṭwār zloṭwāṃ~X ṭwāṃ /༵ ṭwāṃrno ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ༷dīX ༵/ ༵ra khu yaXsta ṭwāṃrmi dziṭwāṃ ṭwāṃrdo ṭwāṃ~X ddhihā dong kha nas nga yar blangs te ‘‘ya kho re/ rlon pa 'di 'dra ci red song ba red’ zer la/ ngas ‘‘da lta sman pas chu gtor song nyazhes bshad pa na/ ‘‘kho re chu ma red/ gtsang sbra byed pa'i sman red/ skyon ci yang yod pa ma red’nyazer/ khos dong gi kha leb rgyag zhor du ‘‘ya kho re tsho/ da khyod tsho skrag dgos ma red/ kha rogs ༷༷ ṭwāṃsdo )ṭwāṃze ༵ kha/ ༵ rno~X ༵ zlo~X gro/ /deṭwāṃ ṭwāṃkyāṭwāṃ ༵ sdi ༵ ༵ sdo ༵༷ ༵ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ~X /na~X du bsdad yod/ grags pas bsod nor nged gnyis la ja blugs/ nga la yang phyur ba spar gang sprad song / da khong tshos skad cha bshad par nyan na/ 'di nas nyin bcu tsam gyi nang / gcig nas btson pa tshor za ma chad pas 'khyags ltogs dang /sdug thog rgyu tshad ngan pa zhig na nas mi brgya dang sum cu tsam shi song / de ring kha sang gnyis la lhag tu tshabs che la/ mi sum cu lhag shi tshar zer/ bsod nor gyis ‘‘do dgong nas rdzong dpon tshos sman pa khrid nas rgyug gi yod pa redami zer la/ grags pas ‘‘da 'di'i zhi lu gnyis ka mgyogs po ma mngags na/ rgyu tshad kyis shi nyen che/ drin chen po khyod la thabs re e yodami zer bar/ bsod nor gyis ‘‘ya ya/ ngas sang nyin cu'u krang la bshad yong / do dgong khyod kyis 'di py-i ༵༵ ༵ṭwāṃgabye ṭwāṃga~X rno ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃhāng swā ༵ ༵ ༵ byākāṭā ༵ hā ༷ ṭwāṃ ༵/da ṭwāṭwāṃṭwāṃ ༵ṭwāṃ song / dgong mo nga der nyal bsdad/ phyi nyin skad cha cang go rgyu med pas/ a bu ༵༵ ༵ ༵ nge~Xsta ༵nyi~Xrsha ༷༷ trī di~Xdadu/ bheṭwāṃ~X ṭwāṃ ni ya~X ༷༈rsha ṭwāṃrdo ṭwāṃ~X hā ༵༵ ṭwānghru ṭwāṃ nghru / kyāj-i rsha/ 'a/ ṭwāṃ snyi~X ༷ /khu ༵sta ṭwāṃlta 'a zlo ñtshan‘ ༵༵ ༵ bhe~X kha/ ṭwāṃ~X 'dug la/ nyi ma shar 'dug de dus grags pas nga 'bod 'dug par/ a khu 351

leku 2 0 7 li /༅gali0tshe 0 bstan 'dzin gyis nga yar dong khar bkyags/ grags pas nga yar 'then nas dong khar bud/ de nas nga grags pa'i rjes su song / de ring ya mtshar ba ni grags pas ja khang du ma khrid par/ rgya sgo che ba la gtad nas song ba yin/ 'di'i nyi ma mang tsam khos nga 'bod mi dgos par/ nga rang gsang spyod du song tshar nas ja khang nang du yong chog nga'i sems su de ring khos nga ja khang nang la mi khrid par gang la 'gro ba yin na dran zhor du/ kho'i rjes ded nas song / ngas mar bltas na rgyal sgo che ba'i nang na/ rgya bod las byed gnyis kyis skad cha bshad zhor du/ langs nas bsdad yod/ nga der slebs dus bsod nams nor bu de ru slebs 'dug khos nga khrid nas rgya mi rkang snam dkar po can/ du ba kha nang drud bzung byed mkhan zhig gi 'gram du slebs nas/ rgya skad mang po bshad/ rgya des nga'i gdong la 'gos yod pa'i thal rdul 'phyi rogs byas rjes skad cha bshad/ bsod nor gyis ‘‘de ring khyod sgor phud pa red/ da ra tshang slob grwa'i nang songanya zer/ngas ‘6nga slob grwar mi 'gro/ nga a bu 'ja' pe dang mnyam du 'dug dgosanya zhes bshad/ ‘‘de ring khyod a bu dang mnyam du 'gro dgos red nyazer dus/ ‘‘nged gnyis 'di nas rogs pa tsho bsgugs nas pha yul du 'gro dgos nyazhes brjod par/ rgya bod thams cad bshad zhor du gad mo shor 'dug yang rgya des ‘‘khyed gnyis slob grwa 'gro dgos red/ yi ge shes na/ rjes su nar son na pha yul la 'gro choganya ces bshad/ ngas ‘‘a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis mnyam du song na pha yul la slebs rgyu redaminyazer bar/ khong tsho yang gad mo shor song / grags pas ‘‘nus kho ya lobs/ sngon ma slob grwar song dang / rjes nas nga tsho mnyam du pha yul la 'gro chog redaminyazer/ de dus rgya dpon des nga'i brang thog gi/ ang grangs dmar po bris yod pa'i ras dkar po de bkog song / khos nga'i slog pa'i dum bu zhig kyang bkog 'dug la/ ang grangs 3299 khris yod ba'i ras dkar por slog pa cung tsam 'byar yod pa de/ khos sa thog tu g.yug/ song / de dus rgya mi zhig gis a bu 'ja' pe khrid yong 'dug nga a bu'i rtsib tu song nas kho'i lag par 352

ga5 ( na 6tshe nyi/lug 'byar/ bsod nor gyis a bu 'ja' pe'i brang thog gi ang grangs 3289 dris yod pa'i ras dkar po bkog nas sa thog tu 'phangs/ bsod nor gyis yang slob gar 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po bshad/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘nged gnyis slob grwar song ma song med/ 'di nas rogs pa tsho bsgugs nas/ mnyam du pha yul la 'gro dgos ’zer bar/ khong tshos skad cha mang po bshad rjes/ bsod nor gyis ‘‘des na khyed gnyis de ring 'di nas sgor bud/ rdzong gi mtha' nas bsdad de nyi ma re zung sgug shog khyod tsho'i rogs pa tsho mngags na mnyam du pha yul du song e redanya’zer bar/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘'o red ’zer/ grags pas nga tsho rjes nas thug gi red zer zhor du rtsam pa khug chung gang sprad song / de nas rgya bod las byed tshos nged gnyis khrid nas rgya sgo'i nang nas song //le tshan don lja pa/rdzong gi mtha' ru bsdad de/ rang phyogs rogs pa bsgug bsdad/nged gnyis rgya sgor 'bud ran khar grags pas ‘‘da bde mo gyis 'ja' kho khyod kyis nus kho la bdag gyis dang / nga sgor bud na ngas khyed gnyis btsal chog zer/ nged gnyis kyis ‘‘a khu grags pa bde mo gyis))zer zhor du/ ngas ‘‘a khu grags pa/ khyod kyis a khu bstan 'dzin khong tsho la nged gnyis sgor bud song zhes bshad rogs’ zhes bshad par/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘6khong tsho la nged gnyis kyis rdzong mtha' nas sgug 'dug ces bshad rogs nyazer/ de nas btson ra yi sgo chen brgyab song / a khu grags pa dang nged gnyis kyi rogs pa tshang ma rgya ra'i nang du lhag song / nged gnyis ni btson khang sgor bud pas dga' ba zhig red de/ rogs pa tsho btson khang nang du lhag song bas lhag par sdu ga song / de ring nas bzung / chu dmar leb rdzong btson khang gi dong nang nas thar song /da ni sgo chen lcags sgo khrog sgra grags nas brgyab song la/ nged gnyis ni ngo ma 353

7༅ 2 5 la ( yi 5 ༅gali tshe spyo btson khang nang nas thar song ba red/ nga'i sems su da ni skye ba sngon gyi las yin na'ang 'dra/ deng sang dus ngan tshes pa'i rkyen yin na 'dra/ nga rang lo bcu'i thog nas/ a pha dang mnyam du pha yul lha sde dkar po dang bral nas/ zla gcig nyi ma bco brgyad yong zhing / mthar lha sa mig gis ma mthong bar/ a pha dang bral rjes/ chu dmar leb rdzong sa dong btson khang nang nyin bco brgyad bsdad cing / nyin zhag sum cu so drug la/ nyin dkar gyi nyi ma song na/ mun nag gi mtshan mi chod/ phyi yi 'khyags ltogs skom gsum dang / nang gi 'jigs skrag 'dar gsum/ mi ma shi dmyal ba zer ba bshad mi dgos par rang gis mthong song / rje bla ma dkon mchog gsum po/ sgos skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu/ma 'gro ba sems can mgo la/ sdug 'di 'dra mi yong smon lam/ zhes dran song /de nas rgya bod las byed tshos nged gnyis khrid nas/ khang pa ha cangayag po zhig gi nang du slebs/ bsod nor gyis yang bskyar slob grwar 'gro dgos pa'i skad cha mang po bshad kyang / a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyis rdzong mtha' nas rogs pa sgug dgos zer bar/ khos ‘‘hin/ ci 'dra bu 'khyog tho gnyis/ ya da bshad rgyu med na khong gnyis ci bsam gyis ’zer/cung tsam nas bod rigs las byed pa pho gsar sked gri yod mkhan ming la skar ma bkra shis zer ba zhig slebs nas/bsod nor gyis nged gnyis kho la rtsis sprad song / khos ‘8kho re 'dzam bu gling 'di 'dra phru gu chung chung gnyis/ ngas ci byed dgos red/ da gang du 'jog dgos red nyazer/ bsod nor gyis ‘‘da ngas bshad/ dmag tshang thad mgo log ma rgan kha shas yod sa na spo khang stong pa yod sa yod/ de'i nang zhog shog zer/ khos 6‘za rgyu ci dgos red’ ces dris pa na/ bsod nor gyis ‘‘ngas btson khang nang nas rtsam pa cung tsam re khur yong / gzhan khyod kyis bkod pa 'then ’zer la/khos ‘6da gon rgyu re ci byed ces zer zhing / ‘‘ya da pha bzang bu khyod kyis bkod pa re 'then dang’nyabasod nor gyis de ltar bshad pa na/ skar ma bkra shis kyis ‘‘'o ya da ngas thabs re e yod bltas yong zer/ de nas cung bsgugs pa na 354

ma5 ci phuri nyi yo bsod nor gyis rtsam khug chung chung zhig khyer yong nas/ rtsam phyur de'i gang nged gnyis la sprad/ ‘‘da de red/ nga tsho la mar mi 'dug’ zer/ skar ma bkra shis kyis 6‘ya bu chung gnyis da 'gro ’zer bar/ nged gnyis kyis rtsam khug khur te kho'i rjes su song nas/ las khungs kyi rgya ra'i sgo ru bud/ de dus ngas phyir bltas byas pa na/ btson khang rgya ra'i kha nas rgya dmag gi thun pa phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa mthong gi 'dug nga'i sems su snying rje nga'i rogs pa thams cad dmyal ba'i sa dong nang du lhag song / da khong tsho dong nang 'di nas thar te/ sgor 'bud pa'i dus re e yod snyam song / skar ma bkra shis kyis nged gnyis khrid nas/ rgya srang gi tshong khang che ba zhig gi sgo ru slebs dus/ ‘6kho re gnyis/ da slob grwa song dang za rgyu gon rgyu thams cad yod pa red’nyazer la/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘nged gnyis rdzong mtha' nas rogs pa tsho sgug dgos ’zer bas/ khos ‘‘da khyed gnyis 'di nas sgug sdod/ gang la'ang rgyug ma 'gro/ nga mgyogs po slebs yonganya zer nas song / cung 'gor rjes/ khos nas khug ma dkar po zhig gi phyed tsam khur nas slebs song / ‘‘ya da slob grwar mi 'gro na nga'i rjes ded shog’nyazer nas song /mtshams shig la rgya grong mtha' na dmag mi mang po yod sa zhig tu slebs/ de'i thad kyi lam 'gram na spo thos brtsigs pa'i khang chung 'ga' yod la/ khos /lang chung zhig gi sgo phyes te nga tsho nang du song / khang chung nang du nyal sa/ slog pa dang phying ba sogs gon rgyu yod la/ thab ka dang snod cha ci dgos kyang 'dug da rung 'bud shing dang rdo yi mchig chung chung zhig kyang 'dug khos 6‘'di nas kha sang mgo log mi kha shas bsdad pa red/ de ring nas khyed gnyis sdod/ nga nyi ma kha shas re'i mtshams nas blta bar slebs yong nya zer nas bud song / nged gnyis kyis khang chung phyi nang thams cad gtsang ma phyags rjes/ nga chu len du song / yar slebs dus a bu 'ja' pes me sbar 'dug de nas nged gnyis kyi chu bskol nas rtsam pa zos/ de ring nged gnyis ha cang dga' 'dug da ni btson khang nang nas thar song bas ma tshad/ nged gnyis rang la dbang ba'i khang chung zhig kyang 355

leku 2 5 7 ( li ༅ thi tshe 0 yod pas/ 'di nas bsdad de rogs pa tshor bsgug na stabs bde red/ dgong mo rtsib kyi khang pa'i nang du bsdad yod pa'i mgo log gi rgan mo gnyis nged gnyis sar yong nas ci yin gang yin gi skad cha dris kyang / nged gnyis kyis drang mo ma bshad/ rgan mo chung ba des ‘‘khyed gnyis 'di nas 'dug nyan gyi ma red/ sang nyin nga tsho'i rogs pa slebs na 'dug dgos red zer la/ nged gnyis kyis kha ya ma byas/ dgong mo nged gnyis kyis za ma zos rjes/ snga mor sgo nang gtan brgyab ste nyal bsdad/ do dgong nyal sa skyid po red/ btson khang sa dong nang gcin skyag gi dri ngan dang / mi mang gi 'khun sgra/ so sgra ci yang med la/ skrag snang 'dar gsum ci yang mi dgos par/ gnyid thengs gcig gis nam langs pas mi tshad/ nyi ma shar 'dug nga sgor bud nas bltas pa na/ khang chung rtsib kyi thang thog na rgya dmag mang po gral bsgrigs nas yar rgyug mar rgyug byas te dmag rtsed byed kyi 'dug dmag tshang gi rgya ra sgo khar rgya dmag 'gas nor gnyis bsha' bzhin 'dug la/ rgyu ma dang mgo sug glo mchin thams cad sa thog tu 'phangs 'dug nga yar yong nas a bu 'ja' pe la bshad/ khos ‘‘da khyod ga le song nas khur e 'jug ltos dang / ngas 'di nas blta 'dug’ zer/ nga ga le dmag gi nor bsha' sar song ste/ sa thog tu 'phangs yod pa'i mchin pa zhig khur nas yong / de dus rgya dmag zhig rgyugs yong / ngas mchin pa sa thog 'phangs nas tshur bros par/ khos nga'i rna 'byog nas bzung ste phar khrid song /nor bsha' sar slebs pa na khos sha dog chen po zhig bkog nas nga'i rum nang du bcug yang thag pa zhig gis nor mgo dang / sug ti bzhi mnyam du bsdams te ste nga'i rgyab tu bkyags nas/ dgod zhor du/ da song zer ba'i lag brda byas/ngas kho la khyod kha dro zer zhor du mthe bong bstan/ kho dang rogs pa tsho dgod zhor du rgya skad kyi ci zhig bshad song / nga tshur yong la/ lam nas mchin pa de yang khyer yong / de dus a bu 'ja' pe tshur yong nas/ nga la khur rogs byas/nged gnyis ha cang dga' song / dang po sha dang mchin pa btsos shing / mgo kha 356

ga5snye / ci sku'e 3 yo gtor nas lce blangs/ ya mgo gses mi thub pas sgo rtsa nas bzhag cung tsam nas nga sgo bud pa na/ nor gyi ya mgo dang sug ti rnams gar song cha med du gyur 'dug rjes nas ha go song / mgo log rgan mo gnyis kyis khyer ba red/ snying rje ltogs pa yin rgyu red bsam/ nged gnyis kyis ci yang ma bshad/ nyin gung a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis/ dmag gi rgyab kyi ri shog tu 'bud shing 'thu ru song /tshur yong dus dmag gi nor bsha' sa na/ nor gyi grod pu 'phangs yod la/ nged gnyis kyis grod rdzab yod sa nas blangs/ khyim du slebs nas cung ma mgor bar/rgya dmag gnyis sgor slebs nas skad log rgyag gin 'dug ngas sems su nor gyi grod pu khyer ma nyan pa yin rgyu red bsam song / de dus dmag mi zhig gis a bu 'ja' pe'i lag mgo nas bzung ste khrid/ ngas yang bskyar bzung 'gro ba yin rgyu red bsam nas/ a bu 'ja' pe la 'thams nas 'gro ru ma bcug dmag mi gnyis dgod zhor du nga rang khrid/ a bu 'ja' pes da 'gro dang drag ni red zer bar/ rgya dmag gnyis kyis nged gnyis kyi lag mgo nas bzung ste khrid song /rgya dmag gi rgyal sgo na thun pa yod la/ rgya ra ru 'dzul rjes khang pa zhig gi nang du song / de na da nangs nga la sha sprod mkhan dmag mi de bsdad yod/ phar bltas na kho dpon po yin pa 'dra/ khos nged gnyis la zhim po 'ga' re sprod/ cung 'gor ba na skad bsgyur zhig yong nas khos‘‘khyed gnyis skrag mi dgos/ sang nyin nasakhong tshor nor bcu kha zhig yod pa 'tsho rogs gyis dang / nyin rer sgor mo bzhi re sprod zer/ khyed gnyis e 'gro/ nyi ma lnga drug cig las 'gro dgos rgyu ma red ’zer bar/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘6'gro chog nangs dus snga mo nas nor rdzir 'gro chog zer/ de dus rgya dpon des a bu 'ja' pe'i lag tu yi ge zhig bzhag ste/ yang skad bsgyur ba brgyud nas 6‘khyod la yi ge 'di yod na sang nyin nas dmag gi rgya ra'i nang du yong chog pa red/ snga mo nyi ma shar tshar dus rgya ra'i nang nas nor ded song / dgong mo snga se nor rgya ra'i nang ded shog de dus nyin re nyin re'i sgor mo sprad yong ’zer/ a bu 'ja' pes 6‘'o ya’nyazer bar/ rgya dpon 357

7ku 2 0 7 ( li5 ༅ thi tshe 0 des dgod zhor du nga'i rna 'byog nas 'then zhor du nged gnyis rgya ra'i sgo la bskyal song / de nas nged gnyis phyir nang du yong / da ni ngo ma ha cang dga' song / ngas ‘‘a bu khyod nangs dus nor rdzir song / ngas khyim nas ja bskol/nas 'thag yong zhes/ sems dga' ba'i skad cha mang po bshad/ de'i phyi nyin nas a bu 'ja' pe dmag gi nor rdzi ru song / 'tsho rgyu ni g.yag rgan nyer gnyis yod la/ dgong mo snga mor ded yong nas dmag gi rgya ra'i nang du brgyab/ nga nang du bsdad de nas brngos nas rtsam pa 'thag rgya dmag gis nyin re nor gnyis re bshas song la/ nga rang gis nyin ltar dmag gi nor bsha' sa nas nor mgo dang snying / grod pu yag sa nas blangs/ sug ti 'ga' re yang khyer yong / dgong mo a bu 'ja' pe nang du slebs pa na/ ja khol yod la/ mgo sha/ nor lce/ snying sogs btsos nas za chog chog byas yod/ a bu 'ja' pes dgong ltar shog sgor bzhi re dang / dmag gis sprad pa'i go re dang / 'bras rlangs btsos mang tsam khur yong / da ni nged gnyis nyin mo las ka yod la/ gla cha len rgyu yod/ khyim du sha/ rtsam pa'i thog tu go re dang / 'bras sogs za rgyu yod pas/ skyid po red bsam song //le tshan don drug pa/ra tshang slob gyur song nas/ bde skyid khang du bsdad pa/snga mo mgo log rgan mo gnyis yong nas ‘‘a le/ zhi lu/ nged gnyis la za rgyu med/ nor gyi sug ti dang / a mgo 'di e spradanya zer/ ngas ‘‘mi sprad/dgos na khyed gnyis len par song dang mang po 'dug ’ces bshad pa na/ ‘‘nged gnyis dmag gis mthong sar 'gro mi phod pas/ kha dro cung tsam e sprad nged gnyis ltogs 'dug zer/ de nas ngas mgo sug dang / mchin pa cung tsam re byin/ rgan mo che bas ‘‘'o khyod kha dro/ sang nyin glo ba dang sug ti re khyer yong 358

5 (khri rdzi nyi lumasnyerogs zer bar/ de'i phyi nyin nas ngas nor gyi glo ba dang sug ti 'ga' re khyer yong nas khong gnyis la byin pa yin/ 'di ltar nyin bcu lhag 'gor song / a bu 'ja' pe la da lta nor gsum bzhi las 'tsho rgyu med la/ nyin re sgor mo bzhi re dang go re sogs dgong ma re re bzhin sprod kyi 'dug sa bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis mtshams rer tshong khang nang du song nas ja dang / tsha/ zhim po re sogs nyos shing / nged gnyis kyi 'tsho ba ha cang skyid po yin/nyin zhig nga tshong khang du song nas sgor 'bud skabs/ rgya mo zhig gis nga'i lag pa nas bzung ste khrid song / mo'i khyim du slebs dus/ sa cung spangs 'dug la/ chu yang blugs 'dug mos lcags khem zhig nga'i lag tu bzharge canas/sa stos zer ba'i brda brgyab song / ngas sa bsnos te mo'i thab mar sa rgyag rogs byas/ sa brgyab tshar rjes mos nga la shog sgor gnyis dang zhim po/ go re rlangs btsos gsum bzhi zhig sprad song / ngas de tsho khur nas khyim du slebs dus/ a bu 'ja' pes ja bskol nas bsdad 'dug nga rang dga' spro chen po skyes song /'di ni nga rang gis las ka byas nas gla cha lon pa yin pas/ a bu 'ja' pe yang ha cang dga' 'dug 'di ltar dga' dga' skyid skyid nyi ma bco brgyad 'gor song / rgya dmag gi nor mtshams rer gnyis gsum las med la/ mtshams rer yang bcu lhag yod/ dmag gis nyin rgyun du nor bsha' bzhin 'dug la/ nga nyin ltar nor mgo dang snying / grod pu sogs len du song zhing / nyin de dag ji ltar song ba ma shes/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis nyi ma gsum bzhi re'i mtshams nas/ btson khang gi rgya ra sgo nas rogs pa tsho phyir e yong blta ru song / 'on kyang nyin re bzhin ri mgo nas btson pa shi ba'i ro khur nas 'gro ba las gzhan ci yang mthong rgyu med/ ngas sems su snying rje/ da nged gnyis kyi rogs pa tsho shi tshar yod rgyu red bsam song /de ring ni spyi lo 1958 lo'i zla 12 tshes 20 yin zer/ snga dro nyi ma ma shar gong / skar ma bkra shis yong nas ‘‘kho re gnyis/ la mo yar longs/ de ring 359

leku 2 0 7:( li tshog si 0ca 0 'gro dgos redanyanyazer/ nged gnyis yar langs/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘gang du 'gro dgos pa redami ces dris par/ khos ‘‘da 'di nas 'dug chog gi ma red/ rwa tshang slob grwa'i nang 'gro dgos red/ slob grwa tshang bsu ru slebs song / rang rang gi phor pa rum nang la chugs/ de min gang yang khur dgos pa ma red/ slob grwa'i nang slebs na za rgyu gon rgyu ci dgos kyang yod pa red )zer/ de nas nged gnyis kyis ja 'thung zhor du sgug bsdad/ ngas ‘‘a bu 'ja' pe/ nged gnyis za rgyu rnams mgo log rgan mo gnyis la sprad e 'jog ’ces dris par/ khos ‘‘song / khong gnyis bos shoganya zer/ ngas mgo log rgan mo gnyis bos yong la/a bu 'ja' pes nged gnyis kyi rtsam pa/ sha sogs za rgyu thams cad khong gnyis la sprad/ rgan mo che ba des ‘‘'o khyed gnyis kha dro bkra shis/ da gang la 'gro yi yinanyanyazer bar/ ngas ‘‘nged gnyis slob gyur 'gro yi yinami zhes bshad/de nas cung tsam 'gor rjes/ rgan po zhig dang nag mo gnyis kyis ca lag bkal yod pa'i g.yag lnga drug ded nas slebs song la/ nged gnyis g.yag 'phongs su bzhag nas song / cung 'gro mi dgos par chu bud nas phar ri la slebs pa na/ chu kha'i gad thog tu sbra brgya tsam zhig gcig sne gcig mthud byas nas lam gyi phar tshur gnyis na phub 'dug nged tsho lam dkyil nas song / g.yas g.yon gyi sbra sgo nas byis pa mang po dang rgan rgon mang pos nged gnyis la blta bzhin 'dug cung tsam nas nga tsho sbra chen po zhig gi sgo ru slebs/ mi tshos ca lag phab rogs byas/ de'i skabs slob ma byis pa mang po zhig gis a bu nged gnyis bskor nas/ ci yin gang red zer nas mi 'dri dgu 'dri dang / mi bshad dgu bshad byed 'dug bar zhig la pho gsar gzugs ring zhig yong nas/ nged gnyis khrid de sbra nang du song nas za ma byin/ khos nged gnyis la ming dang / lo/pha yul gang nas yin/ 'di ru ji ltar yong ba sogs zhib tu dris song la a bu 'ja' pes re re bzhin zhib tu bshad/ khos ‘6nga dge rgan yin/ ming la tshe ring rdo rje zer ba yinanya zer/ mi gzhan dang mi 'dra bar kho'i skad ni ha cang 360

5/ ( ci sredelpi/pog gsal po go thub/ nged gnyis mgo log gi yin tshul bshad rjes/ kho ha cang dga' song / khos ‘6nga mgo log nas yin/ nga tsho pha yul gcig pa red/ da khyed gnyis slob grwa'i nang skyid po byas nas sdod/ nga rdzong thog la song nas khyed gnyis gi rogs pa tsho mngags e yod bltas yonganyanyazer/ nged gnyis kyis dge rgan khyod kha dro zhes bshad par/ khos ‘‘rjes su don ci yod na nga la lobs shog ngas blta rogs byed/ da drag gi red/ rgyal po ma'o kru'u zhi yi bka' drin gyis za rgyu 'thung rgyu yod pa red/ da bde skyid khang du skyid po byas nas 'dug chog gi redami’ces skad cha mang po bshad song / de nas kun chung zer ba'i slob ma zhig gis nged gnyis khrid nas nyal sa'i sbra nang du song / sbra ha cang chen po zhig red/ sbra nang du byis pa bcu gsum mtha' bskor nas nyal 'dug nged gnyis sbra yi ya gyal ngos sgo mtshams su bzhag sa bu 'ja' pe sgo rtsar nyal/ nga de'i yan du nyal/ sbra gcig gi nang du da lta byis pa bco lnga nyal yod/ de nas kun chung gis nged gnyis khrid nas slob khang nang du song / slob khang ni yul de'i dgon pa'i sbra yis bzos pa'i 'du khang chen po zhig red 'dug la/ de'i nang du byis pa sum brgya lhag 'ur ldir nyil le 'tshogs nas ka kha sogs 'don bzhin yod/ kun chung gis ‘‘nga tsho ru khag dang po red/ da rung ru khag gnyis pa/ gsum pa yod pa red/ 'di la bde skyid khang zer ba red/ ru khag gsum la slob ma phal cher stong tsho gcig drag cig yod rgyu red/ mang che ba ni pha ma bzung tshar ba dang / bdag po med pa'i dwa phrug rkyang rkyang red/ ru khag gsum la/ da rung khyim mi tsho bzung tshar rjes/bdag po med pa'i rgan rgon drug brgya lhag cig yod rgyu red/ 'di thams cad rgyal khab kyis bde skyid khang nang gsos bsdad yod pa redanya ces skad cha mang po bshad song / nyin gung za 'thung byed dus/ ja khang nang nas bud med re zung gis zangs dkar chen po gnyis gsum gyi nang du/ mar khu phyed tsam re bzhus rjes/ de'i nang rtsam chur btab ste brdzis shing / byis pa re la rtsam pa rdog rdog chen po re sbyin/ byis pa tshos rtsam pa za mi dgos par/ ga sa gang du gtor 'dug361

le4 2 pa 7 ( li tshoga' 0tshe 0 nga'i sems su ro rgyags ma rung ba'i da phrug 'di tsho/ 'di 'dra rtsam pa snum po g.yugs nasag re phan bsam song / a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis da snga sdug myong mkhan yin/ 'di 'dra rtsam pa zhim po/ za ma dgos kyang g.yug mi phod pas/ ngas rgo lpags kyi khug ma zhig gi nang du bsags bsdad/ da rung byis pa tshos g.yug yod pa'i rtsam pa yang re zung sa thog nas blangs te bsags/ dgong mo za ma sha khu red/ da ni nyin rgyun 'di ltar yin par/ nga'i sems su mi mang 'dis 'di 'dra zos rung / zad rgyu med pa zhig gang nas khyer yong ba yin nam/ ngo ma bde skyid khang / yang na rgan gso khang zer ba los bden/ sa 'di tsho nas rgas pa 'bu dong nang ma g.yugs par/ byis pa tshor zho blud rjes khang thog nas ma g.yugs par/ thams cad 'di 'dra skyid po bsdad 'dug 'di 'dra yin pa shes na/ nga tsho yang rang yul nas ri la 'bro dgos don ci zhig yod/ sdug rgyu ni sa 'dir 'dzin bzung byas pa'i mi tsho red/ thams cad sa dong nang du g.yug 'dug sogs dran zhor du/ nga rang sbra chen po zhig gi sgo ru slebs song ngas sbra nang la bltas par 'o ho ho/ zos na zad rgyu med pa'i mar chur/ rtsam pa sogs 'di na bzhag yod 'dug zhib tu bltas na/ sbra chen po 'di'i nang phyogs bzhi la mar phyur dang / nas sgro brtsigs nas phar cher gang 'dug mar thams cad ko yis g.yog yod la/ phyur ba sgro nang du blugs yod/ ngas 'gram gyi bud med cig la 66a ne 'di 'dra mar phyur mang po gang nas khyer yong ba red ces dris par/ mos ‘‘'di thams cad phyug bdag phyug po tsho'i rgyu 'phrogs yong ba red/'di'i yan gyi sbra nang du sha gang yod pa redami zer/ 'o bla ma dkon mchog bde skyid khang ni za rgyu 'dug la/ da 'di na yod pa'i dwa phrug rgan rgon bdag med tsho skyid po los yin/ za ci bsam yod la/ las rgyu ci yang med/ 'o bde skyid khang / 'o rgan gso khang / dus ngan skabs su sa cha 'di na/ 'di 'dra skyid po re yod 'dug ngas 'di ltar mi dran dgu dran byas song / dgong mo za ma zos tshar rjes/ dgong ltar dge rgan tshe ring rdo rjes slob ma tsho khrid nas/ gor gor 362

rka5snye (li tshude phyi sag byas te zhabs bro 'khrab pa'am/ yang na rtsed mo rtsed bzhin yod/ nyin zhig dge rgan tshe ring rdo rjes/ slob ma thams cad tshogs yod sa nas ‘‘byis pa tsho/ de ring kha sang nga tsho 'byor med gral rim gyi srid dbang bzung yod la/ rgyal po ma'o kru'u zhi'i bka' drin gyis 'di 'dra skyid po yod pa red/ de ngos zin dgos red/ khyod tshos slob sbyong yag po gyis’nyasogs skad cha mang po bshad/ nga'i sems su yang bla ma dkon mchog bde skyid khang dang rgan gso khang ni 'di 'dra skyid po red/ 'dzin bzung byas pa'i pha ma dang / bza' tshang tsho'i rang gi bu rgyud dang /pha ma rgan rgon tshos 'di 'dra skyid po bsdad yod pa shes na/ khong tsho btson khang nang nas shi song yang shi sems bde rgyu red/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyang /rang gi las shig gis skyid po 'di 'dra zhig tu slebs 'dug bsam song / skabs rer yang rang gis rang la yid ches thabs med/ yul rgyal khams ni dus log nas sdug myong dus/ 'di tsho gcig pu 'di 'dra skyid po zhig ci yin nam/ ngas kyang rang dbang med par bsam blo re btang ba yin/ 'di bden pa e yin nam/'di 'dra skyid po zhig yun ring rgyu e yin na/ nyin zhig 'di yang gtor e yong /rgya dmag gis pha ma thams cad bsad bzung tshar rjes/ shul du lhag yod pa'i byis pa dang rgan rgon tshor/ 'di 'dra bzang po zhig e byed sogs mi dran dgu dran red/ ngas bsags yod pa'i rtsam pas khug ma gang song / da ni dgos don med pas/ ngas khur song nas ri ngos kyi brag khung zhig tu sa sbas byas pa yin//le tshan don bdun pa/rmongs dad che 'dug zer nas/ btsan po byas par ma skragamatshan nyal tshar dus/ ngas a bu 'ja' pe la nged gnyis kyis rtsam pa bsags yod pa de/ ngas ‘‘de ring ri mgo ru bskungs brgyab bzhag yod’ ces bshad par/ khos 6‘'o red 'dug da za ni mi dgos pas ci byedami’zer/ de ring 363

miku 2 5 4 ( li5tshog si tshe 0 yar langs dus/ kha ba chen po zhig babs 'dug ngas sbra sgo yi kha ba phar phyags tshur phyags byas nas/ 'gro lam zhig btod/ nangs ja 'thung tshar dus/ slob ma tsho slob khang gi sgo ru 'tshogs 'dug a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis ma song /cung tsam nas slob ma thams cad kyis rtsam pa khur nas/ sbra phan tshun du yod pa'i khyi thams cad bzung ste/ gad zhabs su khrid song nas bsad/ yang rdo brgyab ste ri rtsar khyi gu bzhag yod pa'i khyi ma dang / khyi phrug thams cad bsad/ de dus rgan mo zhig gis ‘6a tshe thung rgyu da lu tsho/ khyi bsad nas ci byed dgos/ 'di 'dra byas na/ khyed tsho la las lam 'gro yong gi ma red ’sogs zer nas gshe gshe mang po btang / kha skad la nyan na mgo log phyogs kyi rgan mo zhig red/ cung tsam nas slob ma dgra bla sna sho zer ba sogs yong nas/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis la ‘‘mgo log zhi lu gnyis de ring khyi gsod du ma song bas/ do dgong za ma mi spradanya sogs zer zhing / 66da khyi gsod du 'gro zer nas nged gnyis kyi lag pa nas 'then/ nged gnyis ma song / de dus ru khag gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i slob ma dang / dge rgan me mda' khur mkhan zhig gis ri rtsa nas khyi la me mda' brgyab nas bsad pas/ khong tsho der blta ru rgyugs song / nyin gung thams cad kyis khyi bsad tshar nas khyim du yong / de dus pad nor dang kun chung tshos bshad na/ de ring bde skyid khang nas khyi brgya kha zhig bsad tshar song zer/ za 'thung tshar rjes ‘‘slob ma tsho slob khang sgo khar shog nyazer nas 'bod kyi 'dug a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis song bar/ slob ma dgra bla sna sho yis ‘‘de ring gsar brje byed dgos/ thams cad kyis rang rang ske yi srung 'khor dang / mdud pa thams cad blangs nas 'dir zhog zer bar/ phar bltas na mi mang dkyil du chos thum che chung mang po zhig spungs 'dug mi che chung thams cad kyis rang rang gi ske na yod pa'i srung 'khor dang / mdud pa blangs nas dkyil du bzhag rgan po re gnyis kyi ske nas slob ma tshos btsan po byas te blangs/ chos nor zer ba'i rgan po zhig gis ‘‘sdug khur rgyu sprang phrug tsho/ da nangs khyi bsad song / da chos 364

5 ( ba thutshe skyi yo yig dang srung 'khor tsho mer bsregs nas ro dgos samanya zhes bshad 'dug a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘da khyim du 'gronya zer bar/ nged gnyis song nas nyal sa'i nang du bsdad/cung tsam nas chos yig dang srung 'khor sogs mer bsreg pa'i 'tshig dri dang / dud dri yis sna tsha yi 'dug de dus dgra bla sna shos slob ma kha shas khrid nas sbra nang 'dzul yong ste/ khyod gnyis srung 'khor sreg sar mi 'gro ba ci yin zer bar/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘nged gnyis la srung 'khor medanya zer/ khos ‘‘da 'gro khyed gnyis chos yig bsreg sar ma song na/ gsar brjer mi dga' ba yin zer zhor du/ slob ma tshos btsan gyis nged gnyis ded nas song / chos yig sreg sar slebs dus/ dgra bla sna shos ‘‘mgo log zhi lu gnyis chos yig sreg sar ma yong bas/ de ring 'thab rtsod rgyag dgos 'dug nyazer nas bos par/der yod byis pa tshos ‘‘'thab rtsod rgyag dgos nyazer nas bos/ de dus kun chung gis dge rgan tshe ring rdo rje khrid nas thon song / dge po/na gyis ‘‘khyod tshos ci byed bzhin yod/ mgo log zhi lu gnyis kyis ci ma 'grig pa red zer zhor du/ nged gnyis kho rang gi 'gram du khrid/ dgra blas 66mgo log zhi lu gnyis chos lugs rmongs dad che bas/ da nangs khyi gsod du ma yong / da srung 'khor sreg sar mi yong gi ’zer bar/ dge rgan gyis ‘‘ma yong na'ang ma yong / de khyod la 'gan khur ci yod/ thams cad phar rang khyim du song / dgra bla khyod kyis tshod gyis a/ ma rabs/ song song songanya zer nas thams cad phar bskrad song / khos nged gnyis khrid nas ja khang nang du song / de dus ja ma sbug los ‘‘ngas kun chung khyod 'bod du mngags pa ma gtogs/ de ring zhi lu gnyis kur 'thab rtsod byed kyi 'dug ya zer/ dge rgan gyis ‘‘ma rabs de tshos ci mi byed/ da khyed gnyis skrag mi dgos/ rjes nas khong tshos khyed gnyis la ngan pa byas na/ kun chung / pad nor tsho la lobs/ yang min na nga'i sar shog nyazer/ ngas sems su sa mtha' 'di na/ nged gnyis bdag byed mkhan drin chen 'di 'dra zhig yod 'dug da rung kun chung / pad nor sogs nged gnyis la 'di 'dra bzang gi 365

leku 2 7 la ( li//༅/ /li batshe 0/sogs dran song / de'i phyi nyin slob ma mang che bar cham pa phog 'dug rgan mro zhig gis ‘‘kha sang chos yig dang srung 'khor mer bsregs pas redanya zer/ nga'i sems su de ci e yin nam/ dgon pa bshig 'gro dus mgo zhig gzer rgyu med sa nas/ chos yig kha shas mer bsregs pas yin nam dran song /nangs mo zhig la a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘dgra bla sna sho/ tshe skyabs gnyis gas nam yin yang thub tshod lta bu byed kyi 'dug pas/ de ring ngas ltos sdod’ zer/ngas kyang rum du rdo shar shar zhig bcug nas song / a bu'i lag tu ci yod ma mthong / yar song ba na dgra bla dang slob ma 'ga' kho tsho'i sbra sgo na rtsed mo rtsed bzhin 'dug dgra bla lo bco lnga red zer/ a bu 'ja' pe las lo gcig che/ kho gnyis kyi gzugs po che chung phal cher 'dra/ a bu nged gnyis der slebs ma thagakhong tshos nged gnyis bskor te ‘‘ya dgra mgo log ci bsam gyi yodanya ces zer ba dang / ‘‘srang phrug khyed gnyis 'dir skyag pa za ru yong ngam/ 'di gnyis la skyag pa shor ba zhig rdung dgos sogs/ mi btsan byed pa'i skad cha mi bshad dgu bshad byas song / de'i mtshams dgra blas a bu 'ja' pe'i brang kha nas bzung / ngas dgra bla'i rgyab nas bltas bsdad/ de dus a bu 'ja' pes rum nas lcag phur zhig blangs te/ dgra bla'i rna zur du gcig brgyab/ ngas rum nas rdo blangs te dgra bla'i mgo ltag tu gcig brgyab par/ khrag dmar shar re btang song / dgra bla kha phyir 'khor song la/ de dus a bu 'ja' pes yang lcag phur gis kho'i gdong la brgyab nas bsgyel song / dgra bla ngu 'bod shar re btang la/sa thog nas gog zhor bros zhor byas/ sna khrag dmar shar re yong bzhin 'dug par/ byis pa kha shas bros zhor du 6‘mgo log zhi lu gnyis kyis mi bsad song zer nas bos/ de dus a bu 'ja' pes tshe skyabs kyi brang nas bzung ste yang lcag phur gyis rna rtsa la gcig brgyab nas mnan/ tshe skyabs lo bcu gnyis yin zer/ nga rgyug thengs gcig gis tshe skyabs kyi gdong la sbar shad cig byas nas khrag bzhur 'dug pa byas/ khos ngo la mdzub mo bzhi yis dmar shar re rma 366

ma5 yo ci cha'u lug byas 'dug de dus a bu 'ja' pes yang kho'i rna rtsar khu tshur gyis brgyab nas mngags par/ kho ngu zhor du bros song / slob ma tshos ki ldir byas/ la las ‘‘dgra bla sna shor de dgos sa yodanya’zer/ de'i skabs ja ma sbug lo yong nas nged gnyis phar khrid/ mos 6‘a rogs ci byung song zer/ a bus ‘‘dgra bla khong gnyis kyis nam yin 'ang mi btsan 'dra byed kyi 'dug sdod re med na da rung ltos sdod’nyazer/ de'i phyi nyin dge rgan gyis lkog nas/ ‘‘'grig song / de dgos sa zhig redami’ces bshad tshar rjes/ yang skad bkyags nas ‘‘khyed gnyis kyis phyin chad rgyag res byed mi chog a zer nas bgad 'dug de'i rjes nas nged gnyis mi btsan byed mkhan mi dgos/ tshig ngan pa zer mkhan zhig mi 'dug slob ma mang pos a bu 'ja' pe la 66a bo 'ja' pe ’zer nas/ ha cang dga' zhing /a bu 'ja' pe khyim gyi rgan bdag dang / za ma blugs mkhan du bzhag da ni nged gnyis kyi slob ma sum brgya tsam gyi nang nas sa zin song / 'di gtso bo ni mgo log dge rgan tshe ring rdo rje'i drin yin/de ring ni rgya lo'i lo sar yin zer/ snga mo nas kha ba ha cang chen po zhig babs 'dug nga tsho snga mor yar langs nas sbra sgo'i kha ba phyags/ nyin gung ru khag gsum pa tshang du rdzong thog nas gzhas 'khrab mkhan slebs yod pa red zer bar/ nga tsho der blta ru song / rdzong thog nas skyes pho mo mang po slebs 'dug la/ thams cad kyi tsha ru sum shan gon zhing / gos chen dkar dmar gyi phu thung ring po can gyi stod thung gyon nas/ gzhas dang bro sogs 'khrab/ 'di ni ngas thengs dang por bod kyi bro 'khrab pa mthong ba yin la/ khong tsho gral bsgrigs te/gor gor byas nas 'khrab cing / skad 'grig byas nas ‘‘da dga' lo dgyes song /da lo lo ma yag song nyasogs 'don zhor dang 'khrab zhor byas pas ha cang yag po red/ bro 'cham mkhan nang du bud med gsi lu ma/ tshe lha mo/ g.yu sgron ma zer ba sogs yod la/ khong tshos glu dbyangs mang po blangs song / skar ma bkra shis slebs yod la/ a bu nged gnyis kyis nga tsho'i rogs pa'i gnas stangs dris 367

leku 2 5 7 ( yi tshomathi tshe 0 kyang / khos ‘6a de 'dra ha go ma song / phar song na skad cha go thub pa byas yong zer/ khos a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis la bu ram dang / go re snum btsos sogs mang po sprad/ dgong mo dge rgan tshe ring rdo rjes/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kho'i gur nang du khrid song / de na mgron po 'ga' re yod la/ las byed pho gsar zhig yod pa des nga la byams po dang / nga'i mgo la byug zhor du/ nga la sha sprad/ zho blug song / de dus dge rgan gyis ‘6'di nga'i grogs po red/ ming la chos dga' zer ba red/ kho nang chen rgyal po'i sde ba red/ da lta bde skyid khang gi las byed red nyazer/ za 'thung tshar rjes nged gnyis phyir sbra nang du song /dgong mo yang slob ma tshos lo sar gyi gzhas 'khrab cing / rgan pa mang pos skor ba byas nas ltad mor bltas/ nga tshos kyang dga' dga' skyid skyid kyi rtsed mo rtses nas/ thengs dang por rgya lo sar ba yin/ de dus las byed chos dga' yis nga la 66kho re mgo log zhi lu 'dir shoganya zer bar/ nga kho'i rtsib tu song / khos ‘‘ras thum zhig nga'i lag tu bzhag nas 'di khur song / khyed gnyis zo/ gzhan la ma ston zer/ ngas ‘‘a khu chos dga' khyod kha dro nyazer zhor du/ de khur nas khyim du song / sbra nang du slebs dus rogs pa mang che ba slebs med/ ngas ras thum kha phyes te bltas pa na/ nang du sha dang / rgya yi go re 'ga' btum 'dug de nas a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyis ga ler zos shing / nga'i rtsib tu nyal yod pa'i bu bu mo gnyis la cung re byin/ ngas khong gnyis la de ring lo sar red/ nga tshos skyid po byas nas lo sar dgos/ da 'di tsho lo sar za ma red zer bar/ zhi lus 66a bu nus lo/ 'di khyod la sus sprad song zer zhing / 'di tsho ‘‘ngas ri mgo nas rnyed pa yin ’zhes bshad zhor du/ nga tshos skyid po byas te sha dang go re zos nas lo sar ba yin//368

skeg5 ( na ༅ skyi lugasnye le tshan don brgyad pa/phyi bcom tsag dang lhags pa/ nang bcom nad dang mu ge/nga tshos lo sar za ma zos tshar/ de ring nga'i 'gram du yod pa'i bu bu mo gnyis ha cang dga' 'dug bu lo brgyad dang / bu mo lo lnga yin zer/ khong gnyis ming sring yin pas sbra gcig gi nang du bzhag pa red/ khong gnyis kyis rang gi pha ma'i ming mi shes zer/ rjes nas dge rgan gyis ‘‘byis pa 'di gnyis ngo log pa gtor shul nas rnyed pa yin zer nas/ dmag gis 'di ru bskyal yong ba red/ gang nas yin mi shes zer/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyis dus rgyun du/ byis pa 'di gnyis la bdag byas nas za 'thung blug rogs dang / dgong mo nyal gos 'geb rogs byas/ khong gnyis gyis nga la a bo nus lo zer ngas kyang byis pa 'di gnyis la lhag tu sha tsha zhing snying rje/ 'di gnyis dang a bu nged gnyis 'dra 'dra red/ las ngan pa 'di gnyis kyis rang gi pha ma'i ming mi shes pa mtshar po red/ da ni nga tsho las dbang gis sbra gcig gi 'og nas skyid sdug mnyam myong byed dgos song / lo sar nas zla gsum tsam 'gor rjes bde skyid khang dang / rgan gso khang gi za ma nyin re bzhin je nyung je ngan red/ sngon ma mar zangs dkar phyed tsam gyi nang la rtsam pa blugs nas brdzis te/ phyur ba mang song na za 'dod med/ da ni mar med la/ rtsam pa nyung zhing phyur ba mang po za bsam kyang za rgyu med/ dgong mo khu ba'i nang du sha med/ rgan rgon re zung gis khong tsho za ma je sdug red zer nas/ slob gra'i nang du za ma slong du yong gi 'dugaslob ma tshor rtsam phyur nyung tsam re ster rgyu yod kyang / lto 'grangs pa zhig med pas nyin re bzhin je ltogs red/ da ni slob ma dang rgan rgon thams cad/ ltogs na mnyam ltogs dang rgyags na mnyam rgyags red/ su zhig la'ang rang nyid mi ltogs pa'i bkod pa ci yang med/ long ba'i lag la ci bzhag long phor nang 369

7 2 5 7 ( i / ༅ma si 0tshe 0 la ci blugs/ da ni ja khang nang nas ci sbyin blta ba las thabs ci yang med/ nyin zhig dge rgan gyis ‘6khyed tsho'i sems bde mo gyis dang / nyi ma kha shas rjes rdzong nas phye 'bras za rgyu khur yong gi redami zer/ phar bltas na nga tsho las rgan rgon tsho sdug pa 'dra zhig red/ khong tsho phyur ba cung tsam ma gtogs ci yang med zer/de ring kha sang za ma dkon thog la slob ma dang rgan rgon mang po zhig la nad phog yod/ la la cham pa phog yod la/ nyung shas la rgyu tsha'i nad byung zer/ da ni ngo ma nad mu ge'i thog la zla lhag zer ba'i dpe ltar/ dgun kha nam zla ha cang 'khyags shing / za ma je nyung nad pa je mang red/ ja ma sbug los ‘‘'o dge rgan dang las byed pa tsho/ da za ma re bkod pa 'then ma gtogs/ nga'i byis pa tsho mu ges shi shor sa redami zer bar/ dge rgan gyis ‘‘nga sang nyin rdzong thog tu za ma len du 'gronya’zer/ nyin re zung mtshams nas dge rgan tshe ring rdo rje dang chos dga' gnyis kyis rdzong thog nas za ma blangs nas slebs song / nga tsho blta ru song /mthong sa na gro phye khug ma bzhi lnga dang / sran ma rtswa sgye gnyis khur 'dug da ni 'di 'dra dka' mo red/ slob ma dang rgan rgon bzhi brgya lhag gi za ma 'di yin pas/ mi che chung thams cad kyi ngo la sdug snang dang / bshad mi shes pa'i 'jigs skrag cig shar 'dug dge rgan 'bru rigs lon pas dga' spro zhig skyes med cing /ngo mdog la bltas na/ kho'i sems su sngar las mi bde bar gyur 'dug khag yod rgyu ma red/ za ma ma lon na byis pa dang rgan rgon mang po 'di dag rjes nas ci 'dra zhig tu gyur pa kho'i sems nas ha cang gsal rgyu red/ phyi nyin nga dge rgan gyi gur nang du chu len rogs su song / de dus dge rgan dang chos dga' gnyis sems sdug chen pos gur nang du bsdad yod/cung tsam nas ngas kyang ha go song /chu dmar rdzong gis kha sang nas bde skyid khang la 'bru rigs nas 'bru gcig sbyin rgyu med/ khyed tshos rang kha rang gso gyis zer bar/ dge rgan gyis ‘6da mi mang po 'di 'dra zhig lag tu rta zog lug gsum ni med/ nas 'bru gcig gi yong khungs med pas/ rang kha rang gso zhig ji ltar byed dgos redami’zer la/370

5 ma ci spodelpi po chos dga' dang khong gnyis sems ji ltar bde/ mi mang che bas ltogs nas skad rgyag pa las/ rgyu mtshan ci yin sus kyang mi shes/ nga'i sems su da nyi ma re zung zhig phyur ba dang sran ma zos tshar na ci dgos red/ da ni mu ges shi rgyu red/ nad nga/ 'di 'dra mang po/ sngon du rdzong nas sman pa yong nas nad bltas nas sman sprod kyi 'dug la/ da ni gal che dus sman pa mthong rgyu med par/ sman sprod mkhan yang med/ yin na'ang da rung nad kyis shi song zer ba go rgyu med pa yag po red sogs dran song / nged tshang gi sbra nang du byis pa bco lnga yod la/ da rung nad pa gcig kyang med/ ltogs nas skad shor mkhan 'ga' yod/ nga'i sems su/snying rje/ da rung ltogs tshod la ma slebs pa red/ chur ba dang sran ma cung tsam re zos tshar na/ de'i rjes nab// nas 'bru gcig med pas/ da ngo ma ltogs rgyu red la/ sdug na mu ges shi rgyu red dran song / nga'i rna lam du rdzong gis nas 'bru gcig kyang sprod rgyu med zer ba yang yang go 'dug 'on kyang nga'i skad cha 'di su la'ang ma bshad/ nam zla dgun kha red/ phyi nas grang lhags kyis bcom zhing /nang nas nad dang mu ge yis bcom par/ da ni nyin re bsdad bzhin je 'khyags dang je ltogs red/ ngas nyin gung lkog nas a bu 'ja' pe la de'i skor bshad par/ khos 6‘da ci yong blta rgyu las bkod pa gang yang yod pa ma red/ tshang ma shi na nged gnyis shi rgyu red/ ha las rgyu yod pa ma red/ tshang ma ma shi na nged gnyis gcig pur shi yi ma red/ sdug rgyu nad gyis shi ma song na/ mu ges mi shi bar bkod pa re 'then rgyu yod pa redanya’zer/ do dgong khu ba'i nang du sran ma kha shas re btab yod pa las phyur ba btab med/ nga'i sems su ya phyur ba zad tshar song / da sran ma sgye gang do zhig gis nyi ma ci tsam 'dang yong dran song / de dus dge rgan gyis ‘‘ja ma la da skrag mi dgos/ sang nyin ru khag rer nor re bsha' rgyu yodami’zer/ ngas yang skad cha de a bu 'ja' pe la bshad/ khos ‘‘da drag gi red/ nged gnyis na ba re ma byung na/ mu ges shi thub rgyu ma red/ sdug thug na bkod pa re yod rgyu redami zer bar/ nga yang sems cung bde song / a 371

rāku 2 0 7 ( li ༅ thi tshe 0 bu 'ja' pe 'di 'dra snying phod yod sa nas/ nga gcig pur skrag dgos don med pa 'dra red/ mtshan nyal tshar dus sha dang rtsam pa mang po za ba rmis song /de ring snga mo nas yar langs pa yin/ mdang nas de ring sha za rgyu yod pa shes nas gnyid yag po ma yong / 'on kyang de ring snga mo gangs sbud chen po rgyag gi 'dug sgo khar 'bud du mi 'jug pas/ nyi ma shar nas yun ring 'gor song / ja khang nas za ma zo zer nas brda brgyab song / a bu 'ja' pes ka do ra khur nas ja khang nang du song / cung tsam nas sha khrag gtub yod pa'i khu ba ka do ra gang khyer yong nas byis pa tshor blugs/ byis pa tshos su mgyogs byas nas 'thung / nyi ma bcu lhag la thams cad cung ltogs song bas/ khu ba 'thung dus heb ha cang che/ a bu 'ja' pes khu ba blugs dus/ nga'i phor pa'i nang mchin pa rdog rdog cig lhung song / ngas mchin pa de blangs nas phyed ka nga'i rtsib kyi bu chung bar byin/ de dus byis pa zhig gis 6‘'ja' pes khu ba blugs dus ngo che chung blta gi/ nus kho la sha chen po zhig blugs song ’zer nas bshad/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘6ya de na ngo che chung med pa khyod rang gis blugs/ ngas blugs mi shes ’zer nas ka do ra kho'i sngon du bzhag cung tsam nas khu ba blugs mkhan med la/ khu ba khur nas 'gro mkhan yang med/ de'i skabs byis pa zhig gis ‘‘da khu ba blugs nas ja khang nang khu ba len du song ma gtogs/ nga tsho'i skal chad kyi redanya zer/yang 'ug pa zer ba'i byis pa zhig gis 6‘da lta ngo che chung bltas song zer mkhan byis pa de la pha ro za rgyu sngo rde ngo shor/ mchin pa chung ngu zhig blug na ci red/ ltas ngan da khyod song nas khu ba khur shoganya zer bar byis pa des ngu zhor du mgo sgur nas bsdad/ khos yang ‘‘a bo 'ja' pe/ song nas khu ba khur shog 'di tshos ci mi zer ’zhes zer bar/ a bu 'ja' pes ka do ra nang gi khu ba blugs rjes/ yang ja khang nang khu ba len du song / 'di ltar nyi ma lnga drug la sha khu cung re 'thung rgyu yod pas/ de 'dra mi ltogs/ de ring kha sang yang sran ma btsos ma phor pa phyed re las za rgyu med pas/ da yang ngo ma cung ltogs kyi 'dug 'on kyang 'di 'dra 372

ga5 nga rdzi 3 pog cung re za rgyu yod bsdad na/ mu ges shi thub rgyu ma red/ byis pa dang / rgan rgon tsho'i nang du ltogs pas skad shor ba dang / ngu 'bod byed mkhan 'ga' re 'duganyin gcig rgya dmag mang po zhig yong nas/ rta thog tu rgya sran kha che dang / ma chos lo tog bsgye bcu kha zhig bkal 'dug pa thams cad ja khang sgo kha ru phab song / 'di ni dge rgan tshe ring rdo rjes dmag sa nas bslangs yong pa red zer/yang mi che chung thams cad ha cang dga' song / thams cad kyis ha go 'dug pa ni/ sang nyin nas yang za rgyu yod song / de'i phyi nyin yang ru khag re yis nor re bshas song la/ nga tsho la yang sha khu 'thung rgyu dang za ma za rgyu yod/ yang nyi ma kha shas mtshams nas/ chos dgas rgya bod las byed tsho zhig khrid yong la/ de tshos kyang gro phye khug ma bdun brgyad cig sprad song / khong tshos ‘‘byis pa tsho sems bde mo gyis/ khyed tsho mu ges shi 'jug gi ma redami sogs skad cha mang po bshad/yang nyi ma kha shas la za rgyu re yod pas/ mi che chung thams cad la mu ge dang 'khyags ltogs kyi skrag snang de 'dra med/ dgong mo za ma zos tshar rjes slob ma mang che ba sngar ltar gzhas 'khrab nas rtsed mo rtsed kyi 'dug dge rgan tshe ring rdo rje dang / las byed chos dga' gnyis kyis ngo la yang 'dzum mdangs cung re shar 'dug mi mang za ma yod na khong gnyis spro 'dug mi mang la za rgyu med na khong gnyis la'ang sdug bsngal chen po yod 'dug dgong mo zhig la thams cad 'tshogs nas sang nyin chu pha rol hor rta 'gab ma la ru spor rgyu yin/ rang rang gi gyon chas sogs khur nas snga mo dar thog nas song / za ma pha rol tu slebs nas za rgyu yin zer/ phyi nyin nam ma langs gong nas nga tsho nyal yod dus/ mgo nas sbra bsgyel nas song / da ni ru spor dgos song / chu phar rol slebs rjes rdzong gi 'gram gyi lung pa zhig gi mda' na bsdad yod pas/ mar bltas na chu dmar rdzong mthong gi 'dug/373

leku 2 5 7 ( li / ༅ thi tshe 0 le tshan don dgu pa/zas chad mu ge byung ste/ ko lpags zos kyang shi 'dugaru spor dgos pas nga tsha'i mgo nas/ sbra ni snga mo nas khur tshar/ nga tsho yar langs nas/ rang gi nyer mkho'i ca lag tsho bsdu gsog byas/ a bu 'ja' pes nged gnyis kyi nyal slog dang gdan gnyis khur/ phor pa dang za ma len snod ka do ra sogs ngas khur/ de'i thog bu bu mo ming sring gnyis kyis slog pa zhig khur zhing / bu mo dang lag sbrel byas te nged bzhi mnyam du dar thog nas bud de/ sbra gsar pa phub yod sar song / sbra yod sar slebs pa na rgya dmag mang po thun par bsdad yod/ 'o da ngas ha go song / ru spar rogs byed mkhan ni btson pa tsho yin/ ngas lkog nas btson pa re zung la nga tsho'i rogs pa tsho dris kyang / nga tsho'i rogs pa shes mkhan med/ skad cha ci yang ma go/ dgong mo btson pa brgya lhag yod pa gral bsgrigs nas rgya dmag gis ded song / nga tsho'i sbra ni gad pa mthon po zhig gi kha ru phub yod la/ nga tsho sngar ltar sbra nang nas rang rang nyal sa nang du nyal ba yin/ mun rub kha zhig la za 'thung cung blud song / mtshan nyal dus sbra la mtha' ra ci yang med pas/ rlung g.yugs te mtshan mor ha cang 'khyags pas/ nam langs rjes/ a bu 'ja' pes nga tsho khrid de/ de'i gad zhabs nas rdo khur nas sbra mtha' mnan zhing / rdo thog tu sa blugs/ yang de'i thog tu chu blugs nas 'kheng du bcug cung ma mgor bar sa rdo dang mnyam du 'byar nas 'khengs song bas sbra mtha' rlung gis rdeb mi thub/ chu tshu rol la spor rjes/nyi ma gnyis gsum la sran ma dang lo tog cung re za rgyu red/ nyin re la rgyags thub pa'i za ma za rgyu med la/ mu ges shi dogs yod/'on kyang nyin 'ga'i mtshams nas bzung / nyin rgyun gyi nyin gung slebs na phye khu chu 'dra ba phor pa gang re 'thung rgyu yod/ mtshams rer phye khu'i nang du glo ba skam po cung re gtub yod la/ las 374

5 ḍa ༅lpi)yog yag na phor pa'i nang du glo ba mtheb mgo lta bu re lhung rgyu yod/ de malhung na chu lta bu red/ de'i nang du bro ba gzhan ci yang med/ da ni nyin re bzhin je ltogs red/ da ni dngos gnas mu ges shi rgyu yin pa 'dra/ lus yongs su shed shugs med la/ gnyid babs nas yar langs mi bsam zhing / 'gro dus mgo yom 'khor nas mgo yis drud de log grabs byed kyi 'dug byis pa tsho'i nang du nyin mtshan kun tu ltogs nas ngu 'bod byed mkhan je mang red/ de'i nang nas rgan rgon lo lon tsho sdug byis pa rnams ltogs nas kha grag rgyu med par/ sgo kha nas 'gro zhor dang log zhor byed kyi 'dug nga'i sems su ya da mu ges shi rgyu red/ sa stong lung stong nang du mi che chung thams cad nas 'bru gcig gi yong khungs med pa'i thog rgas pa ni rgas che/ chung ba ni chung che bas/ rang rang gis mu ges mi shi ba'i thabs shig med sems thag red/ dge rgan dang las byed tsho de ring kha sang mthong rgyu med cing / nga tsho thams cad phar ngo tshur bltas byed sa nas/ mu ges thi rgyu sgug pa las thabs gzhan ci yang med song / da nangs snga dro yar langs rjes/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘nged gnyis de ring rdzong thog tu 'gro )zer ba bzhin snga mo nas song / rdzong la thag mi ring bas/ nga tsho 'dug sa gad kha nas bltas na mthong gi red/ 'on kyang / de'i skabs mi che chung su yin yang rdzong gi rgya sgar thog 'gro phod pa gcig kyang med/ nged gnyis cung ltogs te lam nas mgyogs por 'gro ma thub par/ chu kha dar khung kha nas chu 'khyags 'thung zhor dang ngal gso zhor du song / rdzong thog tu slebs dus/ sngon la tshong khang du song zhing / a bu 'ja' pes zhim po nag po dang / ka ra go re/ rgya gro ma bcas sgor lnga drug cig gis nyos la/ de nas nged gnyis tshur yong ba'i lam bar dmag gi thad du slebs dus/ rgya dmag gi rta 'dogs sa ru song ba'i tshe/ de na rgya sran kha che mang po 'thor 'dug nged gnyis kyis thams cad btus par/ phal cher rta'i chas khug gang tsam yod/ de dus dmag gi rgya ra gyang rtsa na/ dmag rgan lo lon zhig gis go re sreg bzhin 'dug nged gnyis kyis de nas cung bltas par rgya rgan gyis nga 375

leku 2 5 7 ( 3 / ༅mthi tshe 0:la shog zer nas lag brda byas pas/ nga kho'i rtsib tu song bar/ khos nga'i rum du go re bsreg ma che ba zhig bcug song / go re kha la ma zos gong nas dri zhim po zhig sna lam du brgyab song / ngas ‘ khyod kha dro zer zhor du kho la mthe bong bstan par/ khos skad log rgyag zhor du bgad 'dug de nas a bu nged gnyis tshur 'dug sar yong / de ring rdzong thob/song nas za rgyu mang po lon par/ da ni nga rang ha cang dga' zhing 'gro thub pas/ 'dug sa'i sbra yod sar slebs ran khar/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘de ring rdzong thog tu song ba mi gcig la'ang bshad mi dgos/ da nged gnyis mun rub tshar dus 'gro/ de min za rgyu 'phrog 'gro rgyu redaminyazer bar/ nged gnyis chu kha gad zhabs su gab bsdad cing / mun rub tshar dus nang du song / sbra nang du byis pa mang che ba nyal 'dug kha shas gar song med/ nged gnyis kyis za rgyu rnams nyal sa'i zhabs bskungs/ ngas lkog nas bu bu mo gnyis la ka ra go re re re byin/ cung tsam nas/ 'ug pa yong nas ‘‘kho re khyed gnyis de ring gang la song ba yin/ ru khag gnyis pa nas de ring mi che chung gnyis mu ges shi tshar 'dug zer/ de dus a bu 'ja' pes 'ug pa la rgya sran spar phyed tsam sprad/ ngas kyang bu bu mo gnyis la rgya sran gsum re sprad/'ug pas skad dma' mos ‘‘a bu la kho re sran ma zhig gang nas rag songanya zer bar/ a bus ‘‘rnyed songanyanyazer/ cung tsam nas dge rgan gyis ‘6'ja' pe zer nas 'bod bzhin 'dug 'ug pa dang khong gnyis sgor phyin song / yun ring tsam mgor nas slebs song la/ nga tsho dang po tshang nas bu mo gcig shi tshar 'dug de'i ro 'phen rogs gyis zer/ ngas 6‘mu ges shi ba red dam’ zhes dris par/ a bus ‘6red 'dug da rung gcig shi la khad 'duganya zer/ dgong mo nga rang gnyid mi yong bar sems su ya da shi mgo brtsams tshar song / da ni shi mkhan gcig gnyis shig gis tshad rgyu ma red sogs dran zhor du gnyid song / snga dro a bu nged gnyis yar ma langs par nyal bsdad/ nyin gung khu ba 'thung du ma song / nang na ci yang med pas khu chu de 'thung ma 'thung gcig pa red/ nged gnyis kyis zhim 376
