re khur nas nang du song /shul na lug ro gnyis yod pa ngas bsrungs nas bsdad/ cung mgor dus gad kha nas rgan po zhig yong /khos lug ro mthong nas ‘‘kho re khyod kyis lug ro zhig gang nas khur yong zer bar/ ngas ‘‘chu nang nas blangs pa yin zhes bshad pa na/ ‘6da rdzun ma bshad/chu nang du lug ro zhig gang na yod/ da sha nye nga ltogs nas shi la khad du yod/ nga la lug ro gcig e spradami zer/ ngas ‘‘mi sprad khyod chu nang du len par songanyanyazhes bshad par/ khos chu kha nas gcig bltas rjes/ yang yar yong nas ‘6da sha nye nga tsho rgan rgon kha shas dkar po'i dge ba mug shi thebs grabs yod/ pha 410

5 / nga thursha 3 yom bzang bu nga la lug ro gcig sprod dang’’zer zhor du/ lug ro zhig blangs nas khur song / ngas cang ma bshad/ nga'i sems su da snying rje ltogs nas shi la khad du yod pa yin rgyu red dran song / khos ‘‘'o khyod tshe ring las lam la song bu drin chen ponya zer zhor du lug ro khur nas phyin song / a bu khong gnyis phyir slebs dus ngas 66lug ro gcig pha ki'i rgan pos/ kho mu ges shi la yod zer nas khur song’ zer bar/ 'ug pas ‘‘kho re ’zer nas bos pas/ rgan pos phyir blta zhig byas song / de dus a bu 'ja' pes 66ya da skyur shog ltogs nas sdug thug pa yin rgyu redami zer/ de nas nga tshos lug ro de khur nas khyim du yong / de ring a bu nged gnyis la lug gnyis bsha' rgyu yod pas/ nyin gang du rgyu ma blugs shing /sha rgyu ma btsos nas zos/ yang byis pa tsho la khrag khu yag po cung re dang / rgyu ma mtho gang re tsam sprad/ nga'i sems su nged gnyis la za rgyu yod na rtsib kyi byis pa brgyad dgu 'di mu ges shi mi shor kho thag red dran song / dgong mo 'ug pa yong nas ‘‘sha nye 'ja' pe/ 'jigs skyabs khong tsho do dgong rdzong thog la dmag gi rta chas rku ru 'gro dgos zer bzhin 'dug nga tsho e 'gro zer/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘'gro na'ang 'gro ste/ rku rgyu cang e lon zer bar/ yang khos nga la ‘ khyod 'gro mi dgos ’zer/ ngas ‘‘nga 'gro dgos/ rku sar ma slebs na'ang ngas rgyang nas bltas chog’ zer bar/ khong gnyis 'thad pa byung / do dgong mun nag yin pas/ lag pa bsrings na mdzub mo mi mthong bas/ nga tsho rdzong gi dmag yod sar slebs dus/ dmag gi thun pas glog dkar gang sa gang la gsal 'dugangs ‘‘da 'gro nyan rgyu ma red/ thun pas mthong na me mda' rgyag rgyu red’ zer bar/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘srung mkhan thun pa yod dus song ma song yod pa red/de las skrag mi dgos par/ sang nyin sran ma 'thu ru 'gro dang gcig pa redami zer/cung bsdad na dmag gi thun pas skad log rgyag pa go song / de nas a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘da phyir khyim du 'gro nyazer bas/ nga tsho kha phyir 'khor nas nang du yong / nga tsho yar cung tsam song dus dmag yod sa nas 6‘phag shir/ phag phag 411

leku 2 0 7 (snye(tshe559 li 0 0 shiranya me mda'i skad mang tsam grag song la/ phyir bltas byas pa na/ dmag mang pos glog dkar khur nas yar rgyug mar rgyug byed bzhin 'dug de'i mtshams dmag gis yang nga tsho'i mgo thog thad nas 6‘phag shir/ phag shir nyame mda' gnyis gsum 'phangs song / me mda'i skad la nyan na nga tshor 'phen pa ma red/nga tsho mthong ba yin rgyu ma red/ da ci yin na'ang nga tsho mgyogs por lam zhabs su babs nas nang du bros/ de dus gangs char cung tsam 'bab bzhin 'dug la/ nang du slobs dus gyon pa thams cad rlon pa chags 'dug nga tshos ja bskol nas za 'thung byas/ 'ug pas 66cung tsam min na nga tsho tshar song’ zer/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘nga tsho der slebs dus/ khong tsho dmag gi rta chas yod sar slebs zin yod 'duganya zer/ za 'thung tshar rjes 'ug pa kho rang gi nang du song / phyi nyin kha ba chen po zhig babs 'dug nyi ma shar dus nga sgo ru bud par/ ru nang thams cad na dmag mang po 'gro bzhin 'dug la/ chos dga' dang dge rgan tshe ring rdo rje gnyis kyang mnyam du 'gro bzhin 'dug nga yar sbra nang 'dzul nas a bu 'ja' pe la bshad/ khos ‘‘da mdang gi rkun ma btsal ba yin gyi red/ kha ba'i nang rkang rjes yod pa yin rgyu redami’zer/ ‘‘nged gsum gyi rkang rjes yod pa e yin nyazhes dris/ khos ‘‘yod gyi ma red/ nged gsum tshur nang la yong dus gangs char gzhi nas 'bab bzhin 'dug rjes yod kyi ma redami zer/ nged gnyis kyis ja bskol nas 'thung bsdad/ skabs shig la dge rgan tshe ring rdo rjes dmag mi gnyis khrid nas/ nged gnyis kyi sgo khar slebs te ‘6a rogs 'ja' pe/ khyed gnyis mdang dgong sgo phyi la e song nyazer la/ ngas ‘‘nged gnyis snga mo nas nyal bsdad pa yin/ sgo la ma song zhes bshad par/ de nas kho tsho chas song / cung tsam nas 'ug pa yong / ‘‘kho re da nangs gnyis pa tshang nas/ byis pa gnyis dmag mis bzung nas khrid song / mdang me mda' 'phen dus 'jigs skyabs kyi brla bcad tshar 'dug zer/ kho'i rogs pa zhig dmag mis bsad tshar 'dug sogs skad cha mang po bshad song / nga'i sems su bla ma dkon mchog 412

5 ( ci sku'e nyi po mkhyen/ mdang cung tsam min na/ sran ma kha shas kyi don du srog shor 'a dug bsam song / ngas ‘‘byis pa gnyis ci byas nas bzung song ba redami’ces dris par/ khos ‘‘mdang mtshan phyed du yong bas/ kha ba'i nang rkang rjes 'dug zer/ da nangs dmag mis rkang rjes ded nas yong ste bzung ba redami zer/ de dus thams cad ja khang sgor shog zer nas 'bod bzhin 'dug nga tsho song ba na chos dga' dang dmag kha shas re yod la/ chos dgas mdang gnyis pa tshang gi byis pa kha shas dmag gi me mda' dang lag cha rku ru song nas/ gcig bsad gcig rmas/ byis pa gnyis bzung tshar song / de ring dmag gi byis pa 'di gnyis lo chung bas mi 'dzin zer/ da mngags tshar song / de ring nas mi su yin yang rdzong thog tu 'gro mi chog sogs mang po bshad song / nga'i sems su rta chas brkus yong / dmag gi ca lag spangs yod pa go lag cha yin 'dug dran song / khyim la slebs pa na 'ug pas sgro shibashad dgu bshad/ ci bshad pa red/ pha ro za rgyu tsho/ rta chas ma yin pa red’nyazer/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘sran ma yin na'ang mtshan thun pas mthong song na me mda' rgyag rgyu red’’zer/ de nas nga tshos ab gro mog mog re re dang /gro ma zhag rtsam cung re zos shing ja 'thung nas bsdad/ 'ug pas/ ‘‘nga tsho dang bsdur nas bshad na/ khyed gnyis nyin bzhin lo sar dang gcig pa red/ za rgyu mang po 'dug zer/ ngas ‘‘nged gnyis la da rung nga tshos bshas pa'i nor lug gi sha skam dang / gro ma rus zhag ab sha skam po mang po yod/ phyur ba 'di chos dga' yis sprad pa yin/ rtsam pa cung tsam 'di a ne sbug los sprad song / da za rgyu 'di tsho yis lo gcig la za rgyu ma 'dang na'ang / zla ba kha shas mu ges mi shi kho thag yin nyasogs bshad par/ khos ‘‘nga tshor de ring kha sang yang ci za 'di za ci medanya zer bar/ a bu 'ja' pes kho la nor sha skam po cung tsam dang / ab sha skam po drug bdun zhig byin zhing / khos ‘‘'o ya sha nye drin chen gnyis nyazer zhor du/ rang khyim du song / a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘khong tsho za mkhan mang bas nyi ma gcig gnyis las 'dang gi ma redami zer/ de ring nyin gang du gangs char 413

miku 2 0 7 li5 ༅ gi mitshe 0 babs song / nga rang sbra nang du bsdad nas sgo ru ma bud/ skabs shig la nga'i rna lam du byis pa zhig gi ngu skad go yi 'dug sgo gseb nas bltas pa na/ char 'bab che bas chu je cher song 'dug la/ chu gnyis kyi bar na byis pa gnyis ngu bzhin 'dug gcig langs 'dug la gcig sa thog tu gnar 'dug nga sbra nang nas sgor bud de/ chu chung 'bog nas chu bar du slebs dus/ chu bar du yod pa ni sangs rgyas ming sring gnyis red/ sring mo sa thog tu log 'dug la/ 'khyags nas kha grag rgyu mi 'dug ngas bu mo de rgyab tu khur te sangs rgyas dang lag sprel byas nas chur bud cing / chu tshu rol tu 'bud thub song / de nas gad ngo nas yar mi theg par/ ngas sangs rgyas la ‘‘khyod song nas ja ma bos shog zer bar/khos cung 'gor rjes ja ma dang / dge rgan tshe ring rdo rje khrid nas slebs song /char pa ni sngar ltar 'bab bzhin 'dug de nas khong tshos bu mo ja khang nang khrid nas/ ja blud cing drod gsos rjes/ cung tsam nas bu mo 'dar sug sug byas song la/ chen po ma 'gor bar kha grag rgyu yod/ a ne sbug los ‘‘'o nus lo med na/ de ring khyed gnyis ka chu nang shi tshar song / gangs char gyi nang nas gang du 'khyam song ba yin’’sogs gshe gshe btang song / khong gnyis bde 'tsham yin pas nga rang ha cang dga' song //le tshan gya bdun pa/shi thag sos thag chod dus/ rang phyogs rogs par thug song /kha sang nga ja khang nang me khur du song ba yin/ de dus dge rgan tshe ring rdo rje dang ja ma sbug lo gnyis kyis skad cha bshad pa go song / dge rgan gyis ‘6da ni sems bde song / sang nyin nyin gung nas ru khag gsum gyi byis pa thams cad mnyam du/ rtsam pa za rgyu yod pa redami zer bar/ nga yar nang du yong nas skad cha go ba rnams a bu 'ja' pe la bshad/ nged gnyis ka ha cang dga' song /414

ma snye ( 4 rdzi'u3pom mdang mtshan nga rang ha cang dga' che bas yun ring zhig tu gnyidam yong / nga'i sems su da ni shi 'phro lhag rdum kha shas yod pa/ mug kha nas thar ba yin rgyu red/'di 'dra yin na nga tsho da nas mu ges shi rgyu red bsam nas skrag dgos don mi 'dug sogs dran song / de ring snga mo yar langs pa na/ kha ba chen po zhig babs 'dug ngas ja bskol zhing / sgo kha nas kha ba phyags/ kha sang char shag nang nas sangs rgyas kyi sring mo khur rogs byas pas/ ja ma sbug los nga la rtsam pa dkar yol gang sprad song / de ring ngas ab sha gtub nas rtsam khu cung bskol/ yang mtshams rer sgo bltas byas la/ de ring rtsam pa sbyin rgyu yod zer ba bden pa e yin nam bsam/ yang cung tsam nas sgo bltas byas te rtsam pa sprad kyi e yod bltas/ khyim nang 'dug bzod 'dra med pas/ nyin gung ‘6thams cad ja khang sgo ru 'dus shog’ zer nas/ mkhar rnga rdung zhor du 'bod gyi 'dug sa bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyis phor pa bzung nas song / ja khang sgo kha na ru khag gsum nas yong ba'i dge rgan dang / byis pa rnams slebs yod la/ byis pa tsho gor gor byas nas sa thog tu bsdad de/ rtsam pa sprad par bsgug yod/ de dus ru khag gnyis pa tshang gi dge rgan thogs med kyis/ rtsam pa ka do ra gang khyer yong zhing /da rung khem bu chung chung zhig khur yod/ dge rgan tshe ring rdo rjes ‘‘de ring nas bzung / ru khag gsum gyi slob ma lnga bcu nga gsum yod pa/ thams cad kyis nyin gung 'di nas mnyam du za 'thung byed rgyu yin/ nyin gung mkhar rnga rdung dus su ma slebs na rang rang skal ba chad kyi red/ go e song’ zer bar/ byis pa tshos skad mthon pos ‘‘go song’nyazer/ de nas dge rgan thogs med kyis rtsam pa khem bu gang re bcus rjes/ g.yug g.yug nas khem bu kha ma gang tsam re byas te blugs pas/ byis pa rnams ha cang mi dga' bar 'dug nga'i sems su ci 'dra'i dge rgan ser sna can/ da rtsam pa khem bu gang 'di 'dra g.yug nas/ kha mi gang ba byed dgos don med pa 'dra zhig red dran song / de ring ni mu ge byung ba nas bzung / thengs dang po rtsam pa za rgyu yod pa red/ mi re la rtsam pa khem 415

miku 2 5 7 / yi / ༅ 4 0 bu kha ma gang tsam re sprad song / dgong mo mi mang che bas ‘‘de ring rtsam pa zos pas/ thams cad gnyid song nyazer/ dge rgan gyis ‘‘khag med ltogs yun ring song ba red’nyazer/ 'di ltar nyi ma gnyis gsum mtshams su/ nyin zhig rtsam pa ma sprad gong nas/ byis pa zhig gis ‘‘tsam pa sprod mkhan dge rgan thogs med mi dgos’nyazhes skad brgyab par/ byis pa thams cad kyis ‘‘dge rgan thogs med mi dgosanya zer nas 'ur brgyab song / de nas bzung / gsum pa tshang gi dge rgan stag lo dang / gnyis pa tshang gi ru dpon rig 'dzin gnyis kyis res bskor nas sprad/ khong gnyis kyis rtsam pa khem bu gang re sprad pas/ byis pa thams cad ha cang dga'/ de'i skabs nga'i sems su bla ma dkon mchog 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi mgo la 'di 'dra mu ge mi yong ba'i smon lam 'debs/ bde skyid khang gi ru khag gsum la/ byis pa stong tsho lhag cig dang / rgan pa drug brgya yas mas yod zer ba'i nang nas/ bdag po yod mkhan byis pa dang / rgas pa kha shas khrid song ba ma gtogs/ da ni shul na ru khag gsum la byis pa lnga bcu lhag dang / rgan pa bcu kha lhag yod/ de min lo phyed ka ma 'gor bar thams cad shi song / dngos gnas bshad na zla gnyis gsum las ma mgor bar thams cad shi song / bdag med kyi zog lug yin na'ang / 'di 'dra shi ba ha cang nyung nyung red/ da ni ci yin yang shi rgyu thams cad shi tshar song / shi lugs bzang ngan bshad nas dgos pa ci yang mi 'dug ma shi gong bdag po byas nas gso mkhan zhig med/ shi ran kha su gcig yong nas blta mkhan zhig med/ shi tshar dus ro la ngo bdag byed mkhan yang med/ mtha' na mang po zhig la ro 'phen mkhan yang med/ las ngan pa 'di tshos tshe sngon ma nyes sdig ci zhig bsags pa yin nam/rgan rgon lo lon tsho shi ba snying los rje/ ci bshad kyang / khong tshos mi tshe skyid sdug gi 'tsho ba rol nas mtha' la slebs yod pas/ tshe mtha' yag po ma byung ba khong tsho'i sems na ha cang gsal po red/ lhag tu snying rje dgos pa ni/ bsam ngo gsal po mi zin pa'i byis pa 'di tsho red/ khong tsho 'jig rten 'di ru yong nas yun 416

5 mo ḍa cha 3 po ring po ma song la/ rang gi pha ma dang / nye ring span mched 'dzin bzung byed dgos don ci yin dang / rang nyid 'di ltar bdarsha med du gyur dgos don ci yin sogs ci yang ha mi go bar/ don med du mgo la chag sgo 'di 'dra zhig byung nas/ mu ge a tsha ske ring gis shi song ba/ 'di ni sha tsha snying rje ba dang yid skyo ba zhig red sogs mi dran dgu dran byas song / ngas da rung dge rgan tshe ring rdo rjes/ ‘‘snga thog cig la ja khang nang nas bshad pa'i skad cha da ni bde skyid khang dang / rgan gso khang gnyis ka mu ges shi tshar thal/ ri kha'i rtswa ni za mi lo/ chu kha'i rdo ni za mi lo/ da ni nga tshos sa stong 'di nas bkod pa ci yang mi 'dugasems sdug gi/ ngo tsha gi/ de las mu ge yis shi song na dga'anya)zer ba yang nas yang du dran byung la/ yang nga'i sems su khong tshor ci khag sa stong dmar po 'di nas khyim na rgyu med/ lag na dbang med/ rgas pa rgas che bas las med 'gro med red/ chung ba chung che bas bsam med thabs med red/ khong tsho'i sems bzang gcig pus/ mi mang 'di 'dra zhig gi kha mi sos pa sems thag red/ mgo la ci yong rang rang gi las red bsam rgyu las ci yang med sogs mang po dran song /rtsam pa ni nyin re bzhin je mang red/ da ni phal cher phor pa sked tsam re yod cing / nyi ma bcu kha 'gor dus/ nyin zhig las byed chos dga' yang rtsam pa ster sar yong / de dus dge rgan tshe ring rdo rjes/ ‘‘byis pa tsho/ rgyal po ma'o kru'u zhi'i bka' drin gyis/ sang nyin nas nga tsho la 'bras khu 'thung rgyu yod’ zer bar/ der yod pa'i rgan gzhon thams cad kyis/ dga' spros thal mo brdab song / chos dgas nga la ‘‘ya kho re mgo log bu/ da mug kha nas thar ba red/ khyed gnyis ma shi bar skyid kyi sne zin pa redanya zer/ ngas phar dge rgan la bltas pa na/ dge rgan tshe ring rdo rje dang / stag lo gnyis ngo 'dzum mdangs kyis gang nas/nga la bltas te bgad 'dug nga rang yang ha cang dga' 'dug nga'i sems su 'o ya/ da ni ngo ma mug kha nas thar ba yin rgyu red dran song /417

beku 2 5 5 ( i5 49maḍa tshe 0 de ring snga mo nas yar langs/ de ring yang dga' dgos pa'i nyi ma zhig yin/ 'bras thug 'thung rgyu yod pa'i nyi ma zhig red/ nyi ma shar dus nas ja khang sgo kha ru mi mang po 'dus 'dug skabs shig la 'ug pa yong nas ‘‘kho re de ring ngo ma 'bras thug bskol 'duganya’zer bar/ nga rang yang ja khang nang du blta ru song / sbra sgo nas 'dzul dus nas sna lam du dri ma zhim po zhig 'dug thab chen thog gi zangs dkar nang du 'bras khu khol nas sbag sbag sbag zer bzhin 'dugang phar song nas a bu 'ja' pe la bshad/ khos ‘‘da rung rgyun ring por 'thung ran yod kyi ma redanya zer bar/ nged gnyis kyis sha skam re za zhor du rtsam ja 'thung nas bsdad cing / yang sgo kha'i byis pa rnams la ab sha dang / rtsam ja cung re blugs/ de nas ngas snod bzung nas chu len du song / nga chu kha ru slebs dus/ chu pha rol nas/ bud med gnyis kyis ca lag bkal yod pa'i g.yag lnga drug ded nas yar 'gro bzhin yod/ cung tsam nas yang pho gsar ska rags dmar po bsnar mkhan zhig gis me mda' rwa can zhig khur nas rkang thang du rjes nas yong 'dug nga'i thad kyi chu khar slebs dus/ khos ‘6kho re bu chung / su'i ru ba yinanya zer zhor dang 'gro zhor byed bzhin 'dug ngas 6‘ru khag dang po yin’nyazer bar/ khos yang ‘‘de ru 'ja' pe dang / nus lo zer ba'i byis pa re e 'dug ’zer nas dris song / nga'i sems su 'di su yin nam/ nged gnyis kyi ming ci ltar shes pa yin nam bsam zhor du/ khyod kyis ‘‘khong gnyis dris nas ci dgos ’zhes dris par/ khos 'gro zhor du ‘‘khong gnyis kyi rogs pa dung phrug dang / skal bzang tshos 'tshol bzhin 'dug ces shod shoganya’zer/ nga'i rna lam tu dung phrug skal bzang zer ba go dus/ pha drin chen la thug pa lta bu'i dga' spro zhig skyes song / 'di nged gnyis rogs pa tsho'i ngo shes yin kho thag red/ ngas de ma thag tu ‘6nus lo nga yin/ 'ja' pe gad thog na yodanya’zer bar/ khos 'gro mtshams bzhag nas ‘‘khyod su yin zer’ zhes yang bskyar dris/ ‘‘nga nus lo yin/a bu 'ja' pe gad thog na yodami’ces bshad par/ khos sngon gyi bud med gnyis 418

5 ( nga thutshe rdziyo la/ ‘‘a rogs gnyis/ g.yag 'dir ded shog’ zer zhor du chu chung gi tshu rol tu mchongs yong nas/ ‘‘khyod ngo ma nus lo e yin’’zer/ ‘‘ngo ma yin/ tshe kho/dung phrug skal bzang bcas nged gnyis kyi rogs pa redami ces bshad par/ kho yang ha cang dga' nas ‘‘nga'i ming la blo gros rab gsal zer/ dung phrug khong tsho rgyal gnyer phyugs ra'i nang nga tsho mnyam du yod/ da khyed gnyis 'gro e redanya’ces bshad/ ‘‘nged gnyis 'gro dgos/ da ngas a bu 'ja' pe 'bod yong ’zer nas nga gad kha ru rgyugs/ khos khyed gnyis ca lag ci yod kyang khur shog zer/ nga khyim du slebs nas a bu 'ja' pe la skad cha bshad/ kho yang ha cang dga' nas ‘‘da 'gro ca lag nyal snod rtsag rgan dang / phor pa ma gtogs gang yang dgos pa ma redami’zer nas/ yar langs te phor pa dang slog rgan khur nas sgo ru bud/ ngas sgo kha nas byis pa tsho bos yong nas/ khyim nang gi za rgyu yod tshad khong tshor sprad cing / sbra nang du su 'dug bsams kyang sdodami’sogs bshad rjes/ ja khang sgo na ja ma sbug lo yod par ‘‘a ne sbug lo/ khyod kyis dge rgan la nged gnyis rogs pa tsho bsu ru slebs song bas/ da nged gnyis phyin song lab shoganya zer bar/ mos ‘6a rogs khyod gnyis kyis 'bras khu 'thung nas song ’zer/ ngas 6‘'o da kha dro/ 'thung mi dgos’’‘‘'o de na khyed gnyis tshe ring lo brgya zer/ ngas kyang ‘‘a ne sbug lo tshe ring ’ zer bar/ der yod byid pa mang pos ‘‘khyed gnyis tshe ring / a bu nus lo tshe ring ’zer ba'i skad yun ring por go 'dug nged gnyis chu khar slebs pa na/ blo gros rab gsal gyis g.yag 'phongs su bzhag nas rgyal gnyer phyugs ra'i phyogs su song //419

leku 2 0 7 05༅ thisnye ca 0 le tshan gya brgyad pa/sdug chen myangs nas ma shi/ skyid kyi sne mo zin song /blo gros rab gsal gyis/ nged gnyis g.yag 'phongs su bzhag nas song la/ dgong mo rgyal gnyer phyugs ra'i nang du slebs song / sngon ma nged gnyis ja khang nang du song nas za 'thung byas/ ja ma a go zer ba'i mkhar nang sde ba'i grwa rgan zhig yod pas/ ‘‘'o 'di gnyis kyis mang po za nyan rgyu ma red/ ltogs yun ring song bas za che na shi rgyu redaminyazer/ de dus phyugs rar mi mang po 'dus yod/ phyag rdor zer ba'i rgan po zhig gis ‘‘'di gnyis kyi kha ngo la bltas na/ ha cang ma ltogs pa 'dra’ zer/ yang zhes mnog zer ba'i rgan mo zhig gis ‘‘sdug de yin na/ 'di 'dra'i chung chung re ma shi ba yag po red zer bar/ zhes dga' zer ba'i rgan mo zhig gis ‘6mgo log gi mi de 'dra'i las sla mo shi thub kyi ma red/sa 'di'i mi dang 'dra ni ma red ’sogs kha su mgyogs byas te/ skad cha mang po bshad song / ngas khong tsho thams cad kyi kha skad dang zhwa lugs/ gos stangs gang nas bltas kyang / mgo log 'ba' zhig red 'dug de'i skabs skal bzang / tshe kho gnyis sbra nang du slebs te nged gnyis kyi ske la 'thams nas ngu zhor du/ ‘‘pha bzang bu gnyis da ma shi ba yag po byung zer/ a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis kyang dga' ste mig nas mchi ma bzhur song / dgong mo nub zas za dus/ tshe kho/ skal bzang dang / phyugs ra'i mi mang po yod sa nas a bu 'ja' pes nged gnyis bde skyid khang nas bsdad rab kyi gnas tshul cha tshang khong tshor bshad/ phyi nyin dung phrug gis me mda' zhig khur nas slebs song / yang nged gsum thug pas dga' spros mig chu mang po babs song la/ dung phrug gis ‘‘nged gsum na ning rgya lo ma sar gong / mnyam du rgyal gnyer phyugs ra'i nang du mngags song / khyed gnyis gar song gi skad cha mang po dris kyang / gar song gar bsdad ha ma go/ rogs 420

ma5 'i ༅ rdziyo 1pa che ba tsho btson khang nang nas shi gson gyi skad cha ci yang ma go ’sogs bshad/dung phrug ni rgyal gnyer phyugs ra'i yig skyel yin pas me mda' khur rgyu 'dugaskal bzang / tshe kho gnyis ni lug rdzi yin/ rjes nas skad cha bshad dus/ sngon ma nga tsho phyugs ra'i nas lug rku dus/ rdzi bo khong gnyis yin 'dug skal bzang gis ‘‘lug rku mkhan bde skyid khang gi byis pa yin pa shes song yang / bde skyid khang gi mi mu ges shi bzhin yod pa go song / de'i rkyen gyis mi mthong mdog byas nas bsdad/ rjes na g.yag 'ded yong gi yod pas/ g.yag 'ded kyis mthong nyan rgyu ma red bsam nas/ ha bo rkun ma zer zhor du 'ur rdo 'phangs pa yin’)sogs gsal po bshad song / nyin gnyis gsum mtshams nas a bu 'ja' pe/ skal bzang / tshe kho gnyis mnyam du lug rdzir song /nga rang gi mgo log rgan mo zhes dga'/ zhes mnog kun 'dzam gsum gyi bzho 'bri yi be'u 'tshos pa yin/ khong tshos kyang dus rgyun nga la ma bzhin du bdag skyong dang / dga' zhen byed kyi 'dug la/ ngas kyang zhes dga'/ zhes mnog gnyis la a ne zer nas 'bod pa dang / kun 'dzam gyis nam yin yang /nga rang mtshan rum rogs byed pas/ ngas mtshams rer mo la ‘‘a mnya zer nas 'bod pa yin/ lhag tu rgan po phyag rdor gyis nga ni kho'i bu yin zer nas/ dus rgyun du lta skyong byed cing / gyon pa btsem rogs dang / nang gos sogs sbyin pas/ ngas ma shi bar du mgo log rgan rgon 'di tsho'i drin ni brjed thabs med pa zhig red/ khong tshos nga rang nar son na pha yul du khrid rogs byed zer bar/nga rang lhag tu dga' spro skyes/ nga'i sems su bla ma dkon mchog da ni yang bde skyid khang dang mi 'dra bar/ mi nyung phyugs zog mang bas/ da ni mu ge mi yong kho thag red dran song / nyin zhig phyugs ra'i bu tshe zer ba'i nya mtsho'i rgan po zhig yod pas nga khrid nas chu kha ru song ste/ kho la me 'bud rogs gyis zer/ ngas kho la khol mo brgyab nas me bus pas/ khos thab rde'i thog snod cig gi nang du sha btsos 'dug sha tshos tshar dus kho rang gis zos/ nga la cung sprad nas 6‘ya 421

le 2 0 7 ( (tshe 49 thi tshe 0 da zo ’zer/ ngas ‘‘ci zhig gi sha red/ ngas mi zanya zhes bshad par/ khos ‘6ci zhig gi sha yin min gyis ci byed/ ma zos na skyag pa shor ba zhig dung gi yin zer bas ngas cung zos/ dgong mo ja ma a gos ‘‘bu tshe las lam du mi 'gro rgyu/ khyed kyis za dgos kyang bu la sprad nas ci byed kyi yin ’zer nas bshad la/ a ne zhes dga' yis ‘ shul chad rgyu 'phyi zan/ khyod kyis nga'i bu la 'phyi sha sprad nas ro dgos sam’ zer nas gshe gshe btang song / de dus ngas ‘‘da drag gi bde skyid khang nas/ mi sha min pa ma zos pa ci'ang med/ da ha cang btsog rgyu yod pa ma redanya zer bar/ ja ma a gos 6‘de 'dra ni ma red/ de dus ltogs nas mi za ka med red/ da lta nor lug gi sha za mi thub pa yod dus/ 'phyi sha zhig za dgos don mi 'dug ces bshad song /nyin gcig a bu 'ja' pe/ skal bzang / tshe kho gsum nga tsho bsdad yod sar slebs yong / khong gsum dus rgyun phyugs ra'i lug ba'i nang du bsdad yod/phyugs ra'i mgo bdag tsho go yon gyis khong tsho la skad cha mang po bshad song /dgong mo 'gro ran khar khong tsho nga'i sar yong nas/ a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘sang nyin nged gsum chu dmar rdzong slob grwa la 'gro dgos/ khyod lo chung song bas/ da lo 'gro thub rgyu ma red/ tsho go yon gyis sang lo mngags yong zer nyasogs bshad rjes khong tsho bud song / ngas dgong mo ja ma a go la ‘‘nga a bu 'ja' pe khong tsho dang mnyam du slob grwar 'gro dgos/ khyod kyis tsho go yon la bshad rogs e byedanya ces bshad par/ khos nga khrid nas phyugs ra'i mgo bdag tsho go yon yod sar song / tsho go yon gyis ‘6da lo gsum las 'gro chog gi ma red/ khyod lo chung song ba red/ sang lo mngagasanyanyazer/ ngas tsho go yon ‘‘khyod kha dro/ nga a bu 'ja' pe dang mnyam du slob grwar 'gro dgos/ nga mngags rogs gyis khyod kha dro sogs bshad la/ ja ma a gos kyang skad cha mang po bshad rogs byas song / de nas tsho go yon gyis ‘‘da res khyod 'gro chog gi ma red/ khong gsum lo che ba red sngon du 'gro ru bcug nga rdzong thog tu 'gro dus/ ngas slob grwa la skad cha bshad 'jog422

5 ( nga 83 po lo mjug tu ngas khyod slob gyur bskyal 'joganyanyazer bar/ nga rang ha cang dga' song / da ni a bu 'ja' pe song tshar bas/ nga rang 'dug 'dod med la/ nyin re bzhin sems sdug ha cang che 'dug nyin bcu kha re'i mtshams nas a bu 'ja' pe/ skal bzang gnyis yar yong nas/ nga la zhim po kha shas sprod cing / khong gnyis la slob gas gnang ba sprad pa yin pas/ do dgong phyir slob grwar slebs dgos zer/ 'gro khar a bu 'ja' pes ‘‘yang nyi ma bcu kha re'i mtshams nas a bu khyod la blta ru yong ’zer nas bud song / yang nga gcig pur lhag song /da ni nyi ma mi chod kho thag red/ dgong mo zhig la gcig pur phyugs ra'i mgo bdag tsho go yon sar song nas/ ‘‘nga slob gyur 'gro dgosanya zhes bshad par/khos ‘‘slob grwa'i blor babs tshar song / nyin shas mtshams nas ngas khyod slob grwar bskyal 'jog’’zer bar/ nga rang ha cang dga' song / nga phyir slebs rjes ja ma a go/ phyag rdor/ kun 'dzam bcas la bshad par/ la las ‘‘slob gar ma 'gro ma gtogs/ rgya yul zhig la mgo bskor nas 'khrid kyi red ’zer/ la las ‘‘song na dga' ni red/ 'ja' pe/ skal bzang khyed tsho mnyam du yod na dga' ’zer bar/ ja ma a gos ‘6slob grwar los 'gro/ yi ge cung tsam re shes na rjes nas phan thogs yod kyi red’ sogs bshad song la/ ci bshad kyang nga rang ni nyin mtshan kun tu slob grwar 'gro bsam 'dug la/ tsho go yon gyis nyin shas rjes slob grwa'i nang du bskyal 'jog zer ba dran na/ dga' nas mtshan mo gnyid mi yong la/ yang slob grwar slebs tshar ba'i rmi lam mang po rmis song da ni nyin ltar nam 'gro bar bsgugs nas bsdad/nyin gcig ngas snga mo be'u ded nas chu khar 'gro skabs/ ja ma a gos 'bod bzhin 'dug nga yar ja khang sgo kha ru yong ba na/ tsho go yon dang ja ma a go gnyis kyis ja 'thung nas bsdad yod/ tsho go yon gyis ‘‘nus lo/ de ring khyod slob grwar 'gro e red’ zer bar/ nga ha cang dga' nas ‘‘red/ tsho go yon khyod kha dronya zhes bshad par/ de nas tsho go yon gyis nga la mi che ba'i bod lham 423

leku 2 5 7 ( li / ༅ le mitshe 0 ngo ma zhig rkang mgo la bskon song / ja ma a gos lham sgrog sdom rogs byas/ yang tsho go yon gyis nga'i slog ngan phud de/ ras sngon po'i nang gos gsar pa zhig nang du bskon/ de'i thog la rgya yi stod gos/ nang du srin bal brdzangs yod pa chen po zhig bskon nas/ ras kyi ska rags dmar po zhig bcings/ de nas khong tshos nga la bltas te bgad 'dug nga ma a gos ‘‘tsho go yon khyod kha dro/ da rgya min bod min gyi gon rgyu zhig red de/ dron po zhig red/ da chog ni redami’zer/de nas tsho go yon gyis nga rta 'phongs su bzhag nas rdzong thog tu song / nged gnyis rdzong slob grwa'i sgo kha ru slebs dus/ a bu 'ja' pe dang / khong tsho slob ma mang po zhig gis nged gnyis bskor nas bsdad/ de dus lis tshe brtan zer ba'i dge rgan zhig slebs yong / tsho go yon gyis nga rang dge rgan la rtsis sprad de kho bud song /de ring ni spyi lo 1959 lo'i zla 12 tshes 30 nyin yin zer/ da ni rdzong slob grwa'i nang du slebs song / spo thos brtsigs pa'i nyal khang zhig yod/ slob ma brgya lhag yod zer bar/ de dus nga'i sems su bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ yang slob grwa skyid po zhig gi nang du slebs song bsam song / dge rgan lis tshe brtan dang / tsho de sogs kyis rang gi pha ma bzhin nga tsho la bdag skyong byed kyin yod la/ da rung slob grogs phyug lo/ dgra 'dul/ rag kho/ tshe dga' lha mo/ rag le/a go/ kun bzang / bde 'jags/ rdas lo sogs ni rang gi span mched dang ming sring gcig pa lta bu red/ nga tshos nyin rgyun mnyam du slob sbyong byed pa dang /rtsed mo rtses nas dga' dga' spro spros bsdad yod/ nga'i sems su yang 'di 'dra 'ga' dran song / bla ma dkon mchog 'di da brtan po e yin nam/ nged gnyis bde skyid khang du slebs dus/ ci 'dra skyid po zhig red de/ rjes nas lo phyed ma 'gor gong nas cung tsam min na mu ges shi song / 'di la yang 'gyur ldog re byung e yong ngam/ 'di rdzong thog yin pas/ sa stong dang 'dra rgyu ma red/ mu ges shi rgyu ma red/ da ci yin yang bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ rang gi las red/424

snye ḍa thu3 3 lu da nas bzung ngo ma skyid kyi sne mo zin pa e yin nam/ de yin na mu ges shi song ba'i byis pa tsho snying rje/ de ring skyid kyi nyi ma 'di mig gis mthong ma thub pa red/a bu 'ja' pe nged gnyis 'di 'dra skyid po yin pa pha drin chen gyis tshe phyi ma bar do'i yul nas shes yod na/ sems cung bde 'gro rgyu red/ da ni nged gnyis nar son nas pha drin chen gyi don du/ chos dge ba re bsgrub thub pa'i go skabs yod cing / rjes su pha yul du 'gro ba'i go skabs kyang yod kho thag red/ de dus nye sa tshang mas/ skyid de/ nags tshang tshang gi bu gnyis ma shi bar/ rang yul du 'khor thub song zer ba'i nyi ma re yod rgyu red// //

mjug gi gtam/nga rang gis lo chung dus kyi skyid sdug gi lo rgyus deb chung 'di bris tshar zhing / bzang ngan yag btsog sogs la bsam blo ci yang ma btang bar/ gzigs mkhan rnams kyi phyag tu phul ba yin/ gzigs mkhan rnams la lta tshul bzang ngan dang / bstod smad ci 'dra yod pa mi shes la/ rang gis deb chung 'di bris tshar bar ma zad/ mi rabs rjes ma'i lag tu bzhag pas sems bde song / mjug tu nga rang chung dus slob grwar 'dug skabs dang / rjes su bya ba sgrub pa mtshon byed kyi rtsom thung bsdus pa gnyis 'dir bkod yod pas gzigs mkhan rnams dgongs 'gal med par zhu/ 'di ni ngas deb chung 'di bris nas mjug rdzogs pa'i gtam gyi tshab tsam yin/nags tshang nus blo nas/426

bdag gi ma yum ste chu dmar leb rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring /(bsdus pa/spyi lo 1959 lo'i zla 12 pa'i zla 'jug tu 'brel yod rtsa 'dzugs kyis bkod sgrig ltar/ nga rang chu dmar leb rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring du bskyal/skabs der slob zhugs kyi slob ma brgya lhag yod la/ de'i nang gi slob ma kha shas ma gtogs/ gzhan tshang ma sa gnas so so nas bskyal yong zhing / de tsho ni 1958lo'i zing 'khrug khrod pha ma gnyis tshe las 'das pa'i dwa phrug 'ba' zhig red/ slob gyur zhugs rjes/ nga tsho sa khang rnying rul can zhig gi nang du bsdad pa dang / slob grogs rnams kyis sa khang der spo khang skya ril zhes zer/ skabs der/ spyi tshogs kyi zing 'khrug dang rang byung gnod 'tshe sogs kyi rkyen gyis/ nga tsho slob ma rnams kyi 'tsho ba ha cang sdug mod/ 'on kyang nga tsho zing 'khrug khrod khyim tshang dang / pha ma tshang ma shor ba'i bdag med da phrug rnams la mtshon nas bshad na/ slob gar zhugs nas/ gtan 'khel gyi 'tsho gnas shig yod pa ni/ bsam yul las 'das pa'i don zhig yin la/ nga tshos nyin rer dpe cha klog pa dang glu dbyangs len pa/zhabs bro 'khrab pa bcas dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang 'tsho ba rol zhing / spro snang dang bde skyid ma gtogs/ zing 'khrug gis bzos pa'i gnod 'tshe tshabs chen dang / khyim dang pha ma med pa'i skyo gdung dang / sdug bsngal tshang ma dran ngos las ye nas brjed pa 'dra/ lo bzhi bcu'i sngon la/ las dbang gis ded pa'i da phrug skor zhig gi sems dang sems gnas sa 'di nas gzhi gcig tu 'brel ba red/ skabs der tshang ma'i lo ha cang chung mod/'on kyang skyid kyi rta phor mnyam zhon dang / sdug gi khur bo mnyam 'khur byed pa'i/ skyid sdug mnyam myong gi phu 427

wel ca 'u rgya sag nu ming sring zhes brjod chog la/ nga tsho slob grogs bar gyi brtse dung dang mdza' brtse de/ ches dka' tshegs che ba'i dus skabs su nyams tshod dang sbyong brdar mang po brgyud cing / de ni 'jig rten gyi rnam par dag cing lhad med pa'i brtse dung dang mdza' brtse yin/ dus nam yin yang nga tsho slob grogs kyi bar du rigs rgyud dang tsho khag mi dbye zhing / kun su'u dang mtsho sngon/ zi khron/ bod ljongs zhes sa phyogs kyis mi 'khyer bar mthun sgril ha cang bzang la/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas yong ba'i nga tsho phu nu ming sring ltar brtse 'dang ha cang che ba yin/nga tsho spo khang skya ril gyi slob grogs mnyam 'dzoms byung thengs rer mi re rer lo ngo sum cu lhag gi mi che'i dga' skyo zung 'brel gyi rnam thar brjod rgyu yod mod/ 'on kyang nga tsho tshang mar thun mong gi 'dod pa zhig yod pa ni/ chu dmar leb kyi 'dzugs skrun las don dang /chu dmar leb mi dmangs kyi ched du rang nus ci lcogs sgos bya ba bsgrubs pa de yin/ da lta'i bar du/ nga rang ha cang dga' 'os shing / nga tsho'i 'tshar longs dang bskyed bsring gi thad du rang nyid kyi yod tshad phul ba'i dge rgan rnams dga' 'os pa ni/ lo sum cu lhag gi tshun la/ nga cho'i slob grogs rnams kyis bya ba ci zhig bsgrubs kyang / mi dmangs la gtor brlag thebs pa'i zhabs 'dren gyi bya ba ci yang bsgrubs ma myong la/chu dmar leb mi dmangs kyi re ba stong zad du'ang btang ma myong / kho tsho ni bcings 'grol byas tshun gyi chu dmar leb sa khul gyi ches phul du byung ba'i bod rigs kyi bu dang bu mo zhes brjod chog lo ngo bzhi bcu lhag 'das zin la/ nga'i sems su rgyun par skabs de'i byams brtse ldan pa'i dge rgan rnams dran bzhin 'duganang sgos su nga tsho da phrug rnams la pha ma ltar gces pa'i dge rgan lis tshe brtan dang / tsho sdis/ bkra po/ bkra shis sogs dran pa dang / byis pa rnams kyi thog dus rgyun thugs khur gnang ba'i ja ma ma khron yon dang / pad yag sogs kyang dran bzhin 'dug slob grwa thog mar 'dzugs skabs kyi rnam pa de ngas nam yang 428

ma5 ci rdzikhyi pom brjed mi srid/ sa gnas so so nas bskyal yong ba'i byis pa rnams/ zing 'khrug gi skabs su pha ma shi ba'i dwa phrug yin la/ lo'ang brgyad dgu la son ma thag red/la la'i lus kyi rma kha da rung sos med la/ 'tsho ba rang mgo mi thon/ gyon chas rgya lwa gon rgyu lobs med pas/ slob ma mang shos kyis da rung rkang snam nang du gcin skyag gtong ba red/ nga tsho'i dga' zhing gus pa'i dge rgan lis tshe brtan lags/ skabs der lo bco brgyad yin mod/ 'on kyang khos rgyun par da phrug 'di dag la lhag tu sha zhen dang sems khur byas pa red/ khos da phrug 'di dag ni rang gi byis pa ltar/ rgyun du nangs snga langs dang dgung phyi nyal/ dka' ba phrag tu 'khur zhing / ngal ba rgyab tu blangs te/ byis pa rnams kyi gyon chas 'khrud pa dang lus phung la gtsang sbra byas pa red/ slob ma la lar nad byung tshe ngu ba dang /dge rgan lis lags kyang skyo gdung gis mig chu bzhur ba red/ khong gis da rung rgyun par nad byung ba'i slob ma khur nas sman khang du 'gro ba dang / skabs 'gar pha ma med pa'i byis pas/ dgong mo ngu skad chen pos pha ma 'bod pa sogs byas tshe/ dge rgan lags kyi gdong yongs su mig chus gang zhing / kho tsho gnyid rag bar du byams brtse ldan pa'i ngang sems gso dang zhu ba byas pa red/skabs der/ slob ma rnams ni za 'bru mi 'dang bas pho ba mi rgyags la/dge rgan rnams kyis gnas tshul de mthong nas/ sems nas ma bzod par/ la la ri 'gor song nas ri dgas rngon pa dang / la las khug ma bzung nas srid gzhung gi 'bru khang dang / bcings 'grol dmag gi sdod gnas sogs su song nas/ za 'bru lhag ma dang gzan chas(dmag dpung gi rta chas)sogs khyer yong nas/ rang nus ci lcogs kyis slob ma rnams kyi 'tsho ba je legs su btang /skabs der dge slob rnams kyis za ma mnyam du za bzhin yod pas/ ltogs na mnyam ltogs dang / rgyags na mnyam rgyags byas pa yin/ de ltar dka' tshegs che ba'i khor yug gis dge slob bar gyi bla med ya rabs dang mthun sgril dam zab kyi brtse mdangs dang mdza' brtse bskrun pa red/ zhor nas ngas sngon du ma 429

welalo khurna gye 0 drin che/ ngas rang dang lo tshod mnyam pa'i gzhon rabs pa yongs kyi tshab byas nas khyed la bka' drin zhu bzhin yod/ khyed kyi lo rgyus dang skabs de'i spyi tshogs hril po'i nang du rang dngos su slebs pa ltar skyo lhang nge ba zhig red/ dpe deb der bltas pa'i 'char snang gi ngos nas 'di ni khyed de 〈nags tshang zhi lu'i skyid sdug〉gi skyes skar la btegs pa'i slad med kyi me tog chung chung zhig red zer na'ang mi chog rgyu ci yod/ nga'i sems su khyed kyi dpe deb la bltas rjes khyed dang dngos mjal sgos kha brda mang po byed rgyu dran gyi yod mod dus tshod kyis go skabs e ster mi shes/mjug mthar khyed kyis bzhed don gegs med lhun 'grub yong ba dang chabs cig tu nga tsho snga mo nas mnyam 'dzoms yong thub pa'i smon lam 'debs so// ra rgya dga' ldan bkra shis 'byung gnas bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling gi gral mtha' ba mkhas bzang du 'bod pas phul ba dge'o//nya yang klog mkhan 'brong pa tshe ring chos rgyal gyis phyag yig nang du gsung don/ ‘‘gus par 'os pa'i rtsom pa po nags tshang nus blo lags/ khyed sku khams bde mo zhu/ khyed kyi rtsom yig 〈nags tshang zhi lu'i skyid sdug〉klog pa ni ches spro snang dang sems 'gul thebs pa zhig red/ ches phal pa'i don ni skabs rer ches rlabs che ba yin/ khyed kyi rtsom yig nang du ngo mtshar gyi dper brjod dang rgyan tshig yang na mdzes ldan gyi ched brjod dang rgyas bshad ci yang med la/ don bzang ngan ci yin yang zhe sdang dang khong khro med pa'i ngang nas 'brog phrug cig gi rgyun ldan gyi za 'thung 'gro 'dug dga' skyo sdug gsum gyi brgyud rim cha tshang bris yod pa ni go bde la brgyud rim gsal ba/ ngon re re bzhin glog bsnyan la blta ba bzhin nga tsho'i sngon du bshams yod/'di ni khyed nags tshang zhi lu gcig pu'i skyid sdug ga la yin/ 'di ni dus rabs de'i skabs kyi bod gangs can yongs kyi nyams rgud dang / dka' sdug gi lo rgyus gnas tshul ngo ma zhig cha tshang ba dang go rim ldan pa/ dngos don 448

5 (li tshun skyi yog bden 'tshol gyis ji ma ji bzhinadu bris te/ nga tsho bod rigs yongs kyi mdun du phul yod pas/ glog mkhan kun la slob gso dang / skul ma'i nus pa dang rin thang chen po yod pas/ nga tshos klog pa po kun gyi tshab byas te blo sems rtse bcig gis khyed la bka' drin che zhu ba yin/khyed kyis dpa' snying chen pos rang gi bde sdug la bsam blo ma btang bar bod gangs can yongs kyi dka' sdug mtshon pa'i lo rgyus yig cha 'di 'dra zhig bris pa ma tshad/ dpe deb dpar nas rin gong sosas la mi blta bar 'grems spel byas te/ bod mi mang tsam gyis blta thub par byas pa 'di rlabs che ba'i don zhig yin la/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog dus yun ring por snying don dang rin thang yod pa'i byas rjes chen po zhig yin/nga tshos kyang khyed— kyis ‘‘rig gnas cung tsam yod pa'i rgan rabs tshos rang rgyud dang rang gi mi rigs 'di'i ched du dka' khag la mi 'dzem par lo rgyus kyi don rkyen 'di dag yig thog tu bris te bu tsha bo'i lag tu bzhag na mi gsungs pa ltar 'di lta bu'i lo rgyus yig cha re 'bri dgos pa'i sems thag bcad yod/ mi 'gyang bar khyed kyi re ba ltar bod gangs can yongs su khyed kyi rtsom yig 'dra ba'i lo rgyus kyi don rkyen dngos su mtshon pa'i dpe deb mang tsam mi rabs rjes ma'i mdun du 'bul thub par nga tshor yid ches brtan po yod zhu/bod pa zhig yin pas bod rang gi lo rgyus mi brjed par ma tshad/ lo rgyus kye nyams myong spyi sdom bzang po byas te/ bod spyi don ched du 'bad brtson byed dgos pa ni bod mi kun gyis gnam bskos kyi 'os 'gan yin pas bod chol kha gsum rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis 'bad brtson byed rgyu ni ha cang gal chen po yin zhu/nga tsho'i re ba zhig ni/ khyed kyi rtsom yig 'di da dung mang tsam spel ba'i re ba dang / dus mtshungs su rtsom yig 'di bod gangs can yongs kyi klog pa pos blta bde ba'i ched du yul skad mang tsam yod par bcos bzo cung re mdzad 449

yelalo 'u8 rgya ma de bris na ha cang bzang bar 'dod zhu/nya 2007 zhu zla 8 pa'i tshes 12 nyin klog mkhan sgrol ma 'a66) phyag yig nang du gsung don/ ‘‘nus blo lags/ khyed sku bde 'tshams yin nam/ nga'i ming la sgrol ma 'tsho zer/ sngar mgo log nas mi lo sum cu lhag la bya ba bsgrub myong / da skabs ngal gso byas nas zi ling na bsdad yod/khyed kyis 〈nags tshang zhi lu'i skyid sdug〉ces pa'i dpe deb de sgrol ma brgyud nas gnang bar dga' spro'i ngang nas zhib mor bltas tshar/ dpe cha ha cang rin thang can zhig red bsam/ rgya mir mtshon na rig gsar nad mug dang / yang na las 'gul so so'i skabs su byung myong ba'i don rkyen mang po ji ma ji bzhin du bris pa mang po yod par bshang/ rang rigs la mtshon na skyid dkon mchog gi thugs rje sdug na sngon bsags kyi las dbang 'di sems can spyi mthun gyi las red zer nas bsdod pa las zin bris su 'debs mkhan dkon/dus 'gyur skabs su bod kyi sa char ci 'dra'i ya nga 'jigs skrag dang gdug rtsub can gyi don gang dag byung myong ba su dang gang gis shes mi thub/ lo lon tshos bshad na rgyal ba'i nang du bcug nas skung ba yin pas/ sus kyang mi shes pa'i 'dzam gling gi gsang ba chen po zhig red zer/ da lta don rkyen chen po kha shas yig thog tu dngos su bris yod pa mthong bas dga' spro tshad 'das skyes/ blta ba mig gis mi bzod pa dang / dran na sems kyis mi bzod pa'i gtam rgyud chen po re re bzhin nyal na gnyid mi 'gro ba/ 'dug na sems nas gnog thabs med par 'dang rgyag dgos pa zhig red khyed chung dus da phrug gi 'tsho ba'i gtam rgyud tshan pa re re las skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba mig lam du shar thub la/ skabs de'i 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen cung zhan yang mi yi bsam pa ha cang bzang po yin pa mthong thub/ mi nyams chung la phan 'dogs pa/ phan tshun gces skyong / gshis bzang la rgyud 'jam nga// drang bden la rgyab skyor/ drin chen la drin lan 'jal ba sogs bod mi'i 450

ga5 (ḍa ༅lpi yol srol rgyun gyi yul srol goms gshis bzang po rnams mthong thub pas nga rgyal skye 'os pa zhig red/ 'di 'dra'i dpe cha rin thang can zhig bris par kho mos snying thag pas nas khyed la bka' drin che zhu/)nya 2007 zhu zla 8tshes 23nyin las byed rgan pa tshe ring rdo rje dang / bkra shis rgya mtsho/ ma'e yon krang / tshe dpal bcas kyis phyag yig nang gsung don/‘‘bod la sha zhen che ba'i rtsom pa po nags tshang nus lo lags/ khyed bde mtshams yin lags/ thog mar nga tshos khyed kyi rtsom yig 〈nags tshang zhi lu'i skyid sdug〉dngos su 'grems spel byas par bkra shis bde legs zhu/nga tshos bod kyi lo rgyus cha tshang yag po 'di 'dra zhig mthong thub par dga' spro ha cang che song la sems steng nas khyed la bka' drin che zhu ba yin/ sngar krung dbyang gis nga brgyad lo'i zing 'khrugs skabs kyi ngo log byas te ri bros pa sogs la dkar 'don byed dgos zer dus// nga tsho bod rigs las byed mang tsam blo 'bab byed pa nyung / nged tshos bsam na nga brgyad lor bod mi mang pos rgyal khab la ngo log cing ri bros te dmag mang po bsad yod pas de tshor dkar 'don byed dgos don med snyam pa yin/ da thengs khyed kyis rtsom yig la zhib blta byas rjes nga tsho dngos gnas sems pham pa dang ngo tsha dgos pa zhig red byung / nga tsho bod rigs las byed lo sum cu bzhi bcu tsam byas la/ bod rang nyid kyi lo rgyus dngos tshul ngo ma mi shes pas tang krung dbyang gis dkar 'don dgos tshul bshad kyang nga tsho'i blo mi 'bab pas gnas tshul ngo tsha dgos pa byung yod/ khyed kyi rtsom yig bltas rjes dus skabs kyi lo rgyus ngo ma gsal song bod sa gnas yod tshad nas khyed tsho dang 'dra bar bod mi mang che ba ni rgyal khab la ngo log pa/ yang na dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur la ngo log byas te dmag phud nas ngo log byas pa ma yin par/ dus ngan dang zing 'khrugs skabs rang gi srog thar thabs su mang che ba lha sar song ba red la/ lam nas dmag gi ngo log pa red zer nas gsod gtor byas pa red/ lhag par du snying rje dgos pa ni chu dmar 451

yel༅/'u8 ོ 0 leb sa cha'i mi dmangs red/ da ni dkar 'don skabs krung dbyang dang mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi yig cha'i nang du gsal po bris yod cing nga tshos gnas tshul ngo ma ma shes pa red/ chu dmar sa cha nas dpon sde thams cad kyis mgo btags rjes gsod shi dang / 'dzin bzung byas zhing mi mang che ba ngan shi song ba sogs khyed kyi rtsom yig nang du gsal por bris yod pa nga tshos mthong rjes/ nga tsho'i sems nas 'gyod pa ha cang chen po skyes song / de ring nga tshos go skabs 'dir brten nas gcig na rang sems kyis 'gyod bshags dang / gnyis nas khyed kyi chu dmar rdzong yang na bod khams yongs nas de'i skabs ngan shi song ba'i mi rnams kyi ched du rgyu 'bras ldan pa'i skad cha re bshad yod par sems steng nas bka' drin che zhu ba yin la/ lhag tu khyed kyis bod ljongs yongs kyi de'i skabs chag rgud gnas tshul cha tshang ba zhig bris te/ bod mi rabs rjes ma'i pag tu bzhag yod pa ra yang yang bka' drin che zhu ba yin/ bod kyi nga brgyad dang nga dgu'i skabs kyi lo rgyus ni da bar stong pa yin/ khyed kyis dpa' ngar dang phod pa chen pos lo rgyus stong gnas 'di'i nang du rlabs che la rmang gzhi rang bzhin ldan pa'i rma/nga rdo zhig 〈nags tshang zhi lu'i skyid sdug〉'di bzhag yod pa 'di ni lo rgyus kyi snying don ldan pa'i don rlabs chen zhig yin la/ 'di nags tshang zhi lu gcig gi skyid sdug min par/ 'di ni bod gangs can yongs kyi skyid sdug yin pa bod pa kun gyis ngos 'dzin byed bzhin yod/ khyed kyis bod spyi don la bsam blo btang ste bod pa'i skyid sdug gi lo rgyus cha tshang zhig nga tsho la phul yod la/ nga tsho klog mkhan tshang ma ni khyed kyis blo gtad chog pa'i rgyab rtsa dang khyed la blo sems rtse gcig gis gus bkur byed mkhan gyi grogs po yin/ nged tshos khyed nyid dus nam yang sku khams bde bar gnas pa'i smon 'dun zhu/)mid dung phyag yig mang tsam 'byor yod kyang 'dir bkod med pas de lugs dgongs 'jags zhu/ rtsom pa po nags tshang nus blos/spyi lo 2007 76) zla 12 tshes 18 nyin gnas mchog lha sa nas bris/452

ga5 oṃ( ba ༅khri yom dge bshes bsod nams pun tshogs kyis ‘‘rgyal khab kha bral gtong ba'i ngan skul byas yod’ ces pa'i nag nyes nyes don gyi dag sel zhu yig /dag sel mkhan/ nags tshang nus blos 2000 'i6) zla 9 tshes 21 nyin dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul 'bring rim mi dmangs khrims khang nyes don 'dri gcod khrims ra nas bshad pa/khrims gcod 'go 'dzin dang khrims dpon rnam pa lags/rang gis dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs kyi re ba ltar/ de ring khrims ra la zhugs te khong la nyes don gtug bsher byas yod pa'i gyod gzhi 'di yi dag sel ba'i 'gan 'khur rgyu yin/ rang la mi dmangs khrims khang gis dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul mi dmangs zhib dpyod khang gi nyes don gtug bsher yig cha sprad byung ba ma tshad/ mi dmangs khrims khang gi bkod sgrig ltar dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs dang mjal byung / de ring khrims khang gi khrims ra nas khrims khang gi 'dri gcod gnas tshul yod tshad go byung ba ma zad/gyod ya dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs dngos kyis gsungs pa'i gnas tshul tshang ma go byung / da dung bden dpang mkhan dang bden dpang yig cha sogs kyi nang don cha tshang ba go byung bas rang gis zhib dpyod las khungs kyis gyod ya dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs la ‘‘rgyal khab kha bral gtong ba'i ngan skul byas yod nyi zer ba'i nag nyes/ nyes don 'di rgyu mtshan cha tshang ba gsal yod/ de bas nyes gyod 'di dang 'brel yod kyi gnas tshul tshang ma la gom gang mdun spos kyi ngos 'dzin dang rgyus lon thub pa'i gzhi rtsa'i thog nas rang gi lta 453

khrelalo 'u‘ rgya sam la gyod ya dge bshes bsod nams rang gis kyang gsal bshad byas yod/ des ma tshad/ dngos don yod tshad dang bden dpang mkhan gyis dpang rtags yod tshad kyis gsal por ra sprod byas yod pa ni/ gyod ya yis sa cha gang dang / tshogs ra gang 'dra zhig la sku dngos kyis ‘‘bod rang btsan’nyazer ba'i skad cha tshig gcig bshad ma myong ba red/ 'di ni dngos po'i bden don yin/ de las gzhan gyi skad cha sogs la nyan mkhan dang go mkhan tshos rang rang gi go ba len stangs ltar go ba len bzhin yod pas/ balngatshul mi 'dra ba yod pa ni lugs mthun red/yin na'ang 'di nas gsal por bshad dgos pa ni/ gtug bsher mkhan gyis tshod med du ‘‘bod rang btsan gyi nang don yod pa'i log spyod skad cha bshad yodami zer rgyu yod pa ma red/ lo nyi shu'i sngon du rgyal khab khrims med lugs med skabs 'di ltar zhwa mo skon chog la de ring 'di ltar bshad pa ni 'grig gi ma red/gyod ya rang gi kha nang nas ‘‘bod rang btsan zer ba'i skad cha tshig gcig bshad ma myong na gtug bsher mkhan gyis skad cha gang dang tshig gang 'dra zhig la 6 bod rang btsan gyi nang don yod pa go byung / de ni tshig re re bzhin gsal po ston rgyu yod dgos pa ma gtogs long bas mdzab ston byed rgyu gtan nas med/khrims kyis rgyu 'bras dang snying rje khas len gyi dmed kyang chog 'on kyang khrims lag star byed mkhan gyi mi la rgyu 'bras dang snying rje yod dgos rgyu red la/ khyod tshos don med kyis khong gi skad cha la 'di ltar 'grel log rgyab na sems gting nas ngo tsha yi mi 'dug gam/ 'di na da dung nges par du gsal bshad dgos pa'i don zhig yod pa ni 66bod rang btsan dgos pa'i ngan skul ’dang ‘6bod rang btsan skor gyi nang don yod pa'i log spyod skad cha bshad yod’’zer ba'i don 'di gnyis ni ngo bo rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ba'i don gnyis yin pas 'di mnyam bsre byas te bshad na rtsa ba nas nor 'chug song ba yin/ gzhan phyogs kyis log spyod skad cha kha shas bshad yod pa'i dbang du btang na yang de la nag nyes nyes par 'dzoms dgos pa'i dngos don cha rkyen dang nyes don gyi khyad chos 'dzoms med 462

5 tshe nga ༅ 3 yo pas skad cha 'di dag ji srid du nor 'khrul du brtsi dgos pa las ‘‘rgyal khab bde 'jags la gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i nag nyesanya la rtsa ba nas brtsi rgyu yod pa ma red/nga tshos ha cang gsal thag chod ni 6‘rgyal khab kha bral dang gcig gyur la gtor brlag zer ba ni rgyal khab kyi bde 'jags gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i nyes chen yin/ 'di nas yid 'jog dgos pa ni/ nyes pa 'di dag ni nges par du bsam 'dod kyis bsgrubs nas nag nyes bzos pa yin dgos/ de ni nyes pa sgrub mkhan la bsam thog nas nges par du ‘‘rgyal khab kha bral dang gcig gyur gtor brlag’ byed pa'i 'dod tshul dang / dmigs yul yod dgos/ de nas bya spyod nges par du ngan skul byed pa'i gnod byed bya spyod yod dgos shing / bya spyod de yis nyes don rtsa khrims kyis srung skyob byas yod pa'i rgyu rkyen la gnod 'tshe btang na/ da gzod bya spyod de la nyes don rtsa khrims kyis nyes chad gcod chog pa red la/ bya spyod de ni nyes pa yin zhes bshad chog pa red/ gal te gyod ya yi bya spyod la bsam 'dod gtso byas te 'dzoms dgos pa'i rgyu rkyen dang yang na nyes don la 'dzoms dgos pa'i khyad chos gsum sogs 'dzoms med na/ gyod ya yi bya spyod de nag nyes la brtsi rgyu med/ da lta nga tshos don dngos gnas tshul ha cang gsal yod pa ni/ gyod ya dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs kyis ‘‘bod rang btsan skor gyi skad cha tshig gcig bshad med la/ rgyal khab kha bral gtong ba'i ngan skul bya spyod kyang ci yang sgrub med/ de bas don 'di'i thog khong gi nag nyes sgrub yod med kyi skad cha mang po bshad dgos don mi 'dug ma rung sems ngan bzung mkhan zhig min na mi gzhan gyis ‘6bod rang btsan dang 'brel med kyi skad cha btsan po byas nas rang btsan dang 'brel ba yod zer thabs med pa red/ dge bshes bsod nams sku dngos nas ‘‘bod rang btsan dgos pa ha sogs zer ba ma gtogs gzhan gyi mi su 'dra zhig yin yang khong gi gsung bshad la cha 'jog 'khyog bshad dang yin rgyu red sogs zer ba'i dbang cha rtsa ba nas yod pa ma red/ mi su yis 'di ltar byas na des mi gzhan gyi rang 462

wel lo 'u 4 zha 0ga dbang la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen btang ba dang / 〈krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims〉la rdog rdzis tshabs chen byas pa red/gong gsal bshad pa'i thog nas gsal thub pa zhig ni/ dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs kyis sa cha gang dang / dus tshog gang zhig thog rtsa ba nas sku dngos kyis ‘‘bod rang btsan nyadagos min gyi skad cha tshig gcig gsung ma myong la rgyal khab kha bral gtong ba'i ngan skul gyi bya spyod kyang ci yang sgrub ma myong / 'di ni dngos gnas kyi bden don yin la mi su 'dra yin yang dngos don bden don 'di khas len dgos la/ mi su 'dra yin yang dngos yod kyi bden don 'di bzo bcos byed thub kyi ma red/khrims dpon rnam pa lags/ mi zhig gis rang gi kha nas bshad pa dang lag gis sgrub pa'i don la 'gan khur dgos pa dang / gal te de yis gnod skyon ci 'dra byas kyang des khrims thog gi 'gan khur dgos rgyu red ma gtogs mi gzhan gyis kho'i mgo la btsan 'jog byas pa'i tshig dang don dag la 'gan mi khur ba ma tshad/ rang gi bya spyod dang 'brel ba med pa'i gnod skyon byung bar khrims thog nas 'gan rtsa ba nas khur rgyu ma red/ 'di ni 〈krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims〉kyis 'bangs mi la gnang ba'i dbang cha yin/de bas re ba zhig ni khrims dpon rnams kyis zhib dpyod khrod du gong du bshad pa'i don 'di dag la do snang gal chen byas te khrims ltar nan tan zhib ldan gyis rtogs dpyod zhib 'jug byed par bka' drin che zhu ba yin/ rang rgyal gyis khrims 'dzin sger dbang khrims gcod lam lugs lag bstar byed bzhin yod la rgyal khab kyis khrims khang la 'di ltar dbang cha rtsa chen gnang yod pa de la mi gzhan dang / las khungs dang tshogs khag su yis kyang the gtogs mi chog pa red/ da thengs gyod don khyad par can 'di'i thog rang gis khrims dpon rnams la gzhan dbang gi gnod pa dang / 'gan lci ba gsal 'dug 'on kyang nga rang la yid ches brtan po yod pa ni/ khrims lag star byed mkhan rnams kyi dpa' 464

ga5 thi ༅ 3 lug ngar chen pos dngos yod bden don ltar rgyu 'bras drang ba byed thub na gyod 'di la nges par du bden drang lugs mthun dang / khrims mthun blo sems bde ba'i sdom tshig cig 'byung thub kho thag red la de dang mthun pa'i thag gcod kyang thub rgyu red/gsum pa/ rgyal gces bla ma dang dgon pa gra tshang bar dkrug shing rgyab yod zer ba nyes 'dzugs byas yod pa'i skor/gyod ya dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs la dkar mdzes mang tshogs kyis blo 'khel yid ches yod la tshang mas rang gi grong pa'i chos tshogs skabs bla ma che ba dang / dgon khag gdan 'dren mi thub pas/ khong tshos sprang po'i bla ma gdan 'dren byed par dga' po byed bzhin yod/ mi ming grags che na skyon/shing sdong rgan che na rlung len zer ba'i dpe ltar/ khong la phrag dog dang mi dga' mkhan gyi bla spral kha shas re yod pa los yin/ phal cher phan tshun phrag dog byed pa ni chos lu'es phyogs so so'i bar nang gi 'gal zla chung chung red/gnad 'gag ni tang dang srid gzhung gi 'go khrid kha shas kyis sger gyi khe phan ched/ de'i bar lag pa 'tshang rgyu de mi 'grig pa dang / lhag par du phyogs ris yod pa'i bya ba sgrub pa mi 'grig pa red/ de ring nas rgyal khab srid 'dzin las khungs kyis phyogs gcig rgyal gces yin mdog dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nyes khug tu btum pa 'di nga rang gis bltas na rtsa ba nas mi 'grig pa red bsam song / dus rgyun spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod du dkrug shing rgyag mkhan gyi mi spyod ngan re gnyis yod pa'i dbang du btang yang de la rgyal khab kha bral gtong mkhan zer ba'i nyes don gtugs bsher byed dgos don yod dam/ gyod ya dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs kyis dus rgyun chos gsung skabs kha tsha po'i ngang nas phyi la grwa pa'i chas gos gyon zhing ngos nas chos khrims mi srung mkhan gyi grwa pa bla ma la skyon brjod byed kyi red/ lhag par du bla spral kha shas kyi mang tshogs lag nas rgyu nor blangs rjes dge rtsa mi sgrub par radro gi gza' tshang la rgyan cha spras 465

we ca 'u 4 0 snyepa dang / khang pa rgyag pa/ rlangs 'khor nyo ba sogs byed par kha rdung drag po btang 'dug la khong gis ‘‘bla grwa 'di dag ni chos phyogs kyi rul sungs mkhan yin la/ dge 'dun pa'i ngo tsha yin 'dug ’sogs gsung gi red/ de bas dkar mdzes sa cha'i bla spral 'ga' res ha cang mi dga' zhing kha shas kyis rang gi mtho rim gyi 'brel ba drorgyud de dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs la phrag dog ci ngan byed kyi yod pa ni rong pa tsha phyogs kyi long ba min pas rig thub pa dang /'on pa min pas go thub pa zhig red/ nga'i bsam tshul la de ring kha sang srid gzhung nang dang / yang na chos lugs tshogs pa'i nang gi mi re gnyis kyi rul sungs kyi spyod ngan 'di dag ni mi mang che ba'i snying na khong khro bzod bsran mi thub pa'i tshad la thon yod/ mi re gnyis kyi spyi tshogs thog gi spyod ngan 'di dag la skyon brjod dang / rul sungs bya spyod la phar rgol byed pa'i snying stobs 'di ni rgya che'i mang tshogs dga' 'os pa'i bya spyod bzang po zhig yin pa las/ 'di 'dra la dkrug shing rgyag pa zer bar gnas lugs ci yang med pa red/ rgyal khab srid khrims las khungs kyis don 'di nag nyes su brtsis te gtug bsher byed pa 'di rtsa ba nas dgos don med pa zhig red/don tshan lnga pa/ mjug mtha'i gsal bshad dang re 'dun/gtug bsher yig cha'i nang gi nyes 'dzugs byas pa'i don tshang mar lan btab tshar rjes/ nga rang gi gyod 'di dang 'brel yod kyi gnas tshul kha shas dang / rang gi dag sel 'gan khur yod pa'i mi dmangs khrims khang la nges par du yid 'jog bya dgos pa'i gnas tshul kha shas zhu rgyu dang / rang gis nyes gyod 'di thad kyi mjug mtha'i bsam tshul dang re ba 'ga' bshad rgyu yod pa gsham gsal/khrims dpon rnam pa lags/ mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi mig ni ha cang gsal po yin/ lo gcig gi sngon dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs 'dzin bzung byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ dkar mdzes rdzong du bcing 'grol byas nas da bar 466

5 'i thutshelpi yo snyerig ma myong ba'i mi mang khri stong mang pos rang gi bde 'jags la mi 'dzems par rang 'gul gyis dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs kyi don du srid gzhung dang spyi bde las khungs la re ba rgyag pa'i don rkyen byung yod/ 'di ni gangs ljongs yongs la 'ur cha rgyab pa'i ‘‘dkar mdzes rdzong gi 10 25don rkyen yin/ mang tshogs kyis srid gzhung dang spyi bde las khungs la gnas tshul zhib dpyod bzang po dang las rgyu 'bras kha grag byed rogs ma gtogs rdzun gtam la mgo 'khor nas kho tshos sprang po'i bla ma la btsan zhwa ma skon sogs zhus yod/ de yi don du mi mang po la khrims thag bcad pa dang mi mang po ngal rtsol btson pa byas pa ma tshad/ mi la la de'i don du rang srog kyang btang 'dug don rkyen 'di byung ba'i rjes nas bzung gyod ya dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs kyi don 'di rgyu 'bras ltar thag gcod bya thub min ni dkar mdzes sa khul gyi dge sems dang rgyu 'bras yod pa'i mi tshang mas sems khur dgos pa'i don du 'gyur ba red/ rgyu 'bras kyi re ba yod mkhan kun gyis don 'di thag gcod bzang po dang don med kyi mi 'di lhong zhabs su mi 'gro ba dang mi re gnyis kyis skabs 'di btsal nas khong la btsan zhwa 'geb pa'i re ngan de mngon 'gyur mi thub pa'i re smon byed kyi yod/kha sang nyin kha shas sngon la gyod 'di thag gcod byed bzhin 'dug zer ba'i skad cha go rjes dkar mdzes sa cha so so'i mi khri stong mang pos don 'di thag gcod rgyu 'bras ldan pa zhig thob pa'i re ba dang re sgug byas yod/ 'di ni mi nyung shas shig ma yin la dkar mdzes sa khul mang tshogs khri stong mang po'i re smon red/ de ring khrims khang nas nga yis kho tsho'i tshab byas te thad kur re smon byed pa'i dbang cha med kyang / nga rang la de ring bden drang dang 'dra mnyam gyi go skabs bzang po 'di nas 'os 'gan yod pa ni/ na ning mi khri stong mang pos re smon brgyab yod pa dang / de ring yang rgyu 'bras dge sems ldan pa'i mi mang khri stong mang po'i re ba dang re sgug byas yod pa'i dngos don gnas tshul 'di khrims 467

yel༅ khu8 rgya sa spyokhang gi khrims dpon rnams la yang yang zhu dgos pa de yin/ dngos yod gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i 'og nas ngas ha cang gsal po rtogs yod pa ni/ gyod don 'di rgyu 'bras ltar thag gcod bya thub na rjes su dkar mdzes sa khul yongs rdzogs su spyi tshogs bde 'jags dang mi sems bde 'jags/ mang tshogs dang las byed bar gyi 'brel ba je bzang / mi rigs mthun sgril bcas la ches gal che ba'i lo rgyus kyi snying don yod pa ma tshad/ dus yun ring por spyi tshogs kyi phan nus chen po yod kho thag red/ rgyu 'bras mkhan la rogs skyor mang / rgyu 'bras med na kher rkyang gyur/ lo rgyus kyi 'phel phyogs dang dkar mdzes sa khul la phyin chad spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i lag len thog nas don 'di dag ra sprod bya thub kho thag yin/ de bas nga rang gi re ba ni khrims dpon rnam pas khrims ltar zhib dpyod byed pa'i dus mtshungs su da lta'i dngos yod gnas tshul 'di dag la bsam blo cung tsam gtong ba dang / mang tshogs khri stong mang pos thengs mang re smon rgyab pa'i 'bod sgra la cung tsam nyan rogs yang yang zhu ba yin/ mi khri stong mang pos rang srog la mi 'dzems par re ba rgyag pa 'di ni rtsa ba chen po yod pa la nga tshos nges par yid 'jog dang gzab nan ma byas na gyod gzhi 'di thag gcod 'chug pa'am nor 'khrul song na mang tshogs khri stong mang po'i sems la gnad phog gin yod pas mi sems shor song na rgyal khri mi bde ba kho thag red/gyod ya khong rang la cha bzhag na mi mang po 'di 'dra zhig gis dga' mgu yi rangs byed pa ni bde skyid cig red/ ngas gong gsal gyi don la bsam blo btang na sems ha cang skyo po zhig red 'dug dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs kyi don du re ba 'jog sa nas khyim tshang ha cang mang po la gnod skyon tshabs chen bzos song / nga rang tsho'i dkar mdzes phyogs kyi re ba rgyag mkhan khri stong mang po sems pham dgos pa byas pa dang / lhag par du de'i ched du khrims chad phog pa dang ngal rtsol btson pa byas pa mtha' na rang srog btang ba sogs la sems pham chen po bzos song ba la snying thag pa nas yid skyo po byung 468

tsho sa na tshun skyi yo song / khong tsho tshang ma ni byams skyong dge sems ldan la snying rje ldan pa'i mi bzang po rkyang rkyang yin la/ de bas nga dang dge bshes bsod nams gnyis kyi sems ni gcig pa yin/ de ring mi dmangs khrims khang gi bden drang gi khrims ra'i nang du ngas dge bshes bsod nams kyi tshab byas pa ma tshad rang ngos nas gong gsal gyi re ba rgyag mkhan rnams dang / lhag tu btson khang du yod mkhan rnams dang tshe las 'das pa rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che yang yang brjod pa yin/ skye ba rjes mar nga rang tshos phan thogs dgos pa'i las re yod na nga rang tshos rta nor gyi lus blangs te khyed rnams la 'jal thabs med pa'i las 'bras kyi dom 'di sprad nges yin zhu/khrims dpon lags/ gyod ya dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs la rgyal ba rin po cher zhabs brtan 'bul ba'i nor 'khrul byung yod/ yin na'ang khrims kyi rgyu mtshan cung tsam shes mkhan rnams kyis gsal thub pa ni/ khrims nang dngos su yig thog tu gtan la phab med pa'i don ni nag nyes brtsi rgyu med pa rang red/ de bas da lta shin tu gsal po zhig la/ gtug bsher mkhan gyi gtug bsher yig cha'i nang nyes 'dzugs byas pa'i gnad don sogs ni rgyal khab bde 'jags la gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i nyes don dang 'brel ba ci yang med pa sha stag red/ dper bzhag na/ gtug bsher mkhan gyi gyod ya la nyes 'dzags byas pa'i ‘6khrims 'gal gyi phyir skyod lam yig nyos yod ’ zer ba dang /rwasger gyis phyi la song yodami zer ba ni nag nyes la brtsi rgyu med/ ‘‘tā la'i dang mjal zhing mnyam du par rgyab yodami zer ba yang nyes par brtsi rgyu med pa red‘‘chos tshogs rgya chen po 'tshogs pa midang‘‘tā la'i la zhabs brtan phul ba ’zer ba la nor 'khrul yod kyang / de yang rgyal khab bde 'jags la gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i nyes par brtsi rgyu med/ de nas ‘‘dkrug shing rgyab yodami zer ba lhag tu nyes par brtsi rgyu med pa red/ de nas gtug bsher gyi gnad 'gag gtso bor gyur pa'i ‘‘bod rang btsan gyi nang 469

yel ca/'u8 rgya 0ga don yod pa'i dril bsgrags dang ngan skul gyi log spyod gtam bshad byas yod zer ba'i don 'di yang de'i skabs kyi brnyan phab 'khor lo dang de ring gi bden dpang pa'i dpang rtags tshang mas bden dpang gsal po byas yod pa ni/ gyod ya dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs kyis dus tshod gang dang / sa cha gang 'dra zhig nas sku dngos nas ‘‘bod rang btsananyarinang don yod pa'i skad cha tshig gcig kyang bshad ma myong kho thag red/ des na gtug bsher 'di yang chu la chu mgo med pa bzhin gyod la 'byung rtsa med pas 'di'i bar lhag tu 6‘rgyal khab kha bral gtong ba'i nag nyes ’shig med pa ni bshad mi dgos pa red/gus bkur 'os pa'i khrims gcod 'gan 'dzin pa dang / gzhan gyi khrims dpon rnam pa lags/gong du bshad pa mdor bsdus na ngas dngos don gnas tshul gzhir bzung ste gsham gyi skad cha bshad pa'i gnas lugs yod bsam 'dug de ni/gyod ya dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs kyi bya spyod yod tshad kyis 〈krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi nag nyes nyes don rtsa khrims〉dang rtsa ba nas 'gal med pa ma tshad rgyal khab bde 'jags la gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i gnod skyon ci yang byas med/ de bas khong gi bya spyod kyis rgyal khab kha bral gtong ba'i ngan skul nyes pa gtan nas bzos med pas khong la nag nyes nyes khrims kyi nyes chad gcod dgos don rtsa ba nas med bsam 'dug de bas ngas da lta gyod don 'di'i dag sel ba'i 'dod tshul ltar nan mo bsgrags dgos pa ni/ gtug bsher mkhan gyi gyod ya dge bshes phun tshogs mgo la ‘‘rgyal khab kha bral gtong ba'i ngan skul nag nyes yod ’zer ba'i nyes ming nyes 'dzugs byas yod pa 'di nyes 'dzugs byed thub rgyu ma red/ dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs ni nyes pa ci yang med pa red 'dug de bas kho rang nges par khrims ltar mngag gtong byed dgos pa red/khrims dpon rnam pa lags/ nyes can la khrims ltar nyes chad gcod 470

dzi ( na rdzikhyi/po dgos la rgyal khab bde 'jags dang mi dmangs kyi tshe srog rgyu nor srung skyob byed pa ni mi dmangs khrims khang gi khrims dpon rnams kyi phul du byung ba'i 'os 'gan yin par ma zad/ nyes med la khrims ltar srung skyob byas te khong gi ches rtsa ba'i spyi 'bangs kyi khe dbang la mi gzhan gyi gnod skyon byed du mi 'jug pa 'di yang mi dmangs khrims khang gi khrims dpon rnams kyi phul du byung ba'i 'os 'gan zhig kyang red bsam gyi 'dugadage bshes bsod nams phun tshogs la nyes pa ci yang med pas kho rang gi lus dbang la rgyal khrims kyis srung skyob byed thub dang mi thub/ mi nyes med la nyes pa btsan 'geb byed thub dang mi thub 'di dag tshang ma ni de ring dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul 'bring rim mi dmangs khrims khang gi sger sems ci yang med la rgyu 'bras ldan pa'i khrims dpon rnam pa la thug yod/ nga tshos re ba yod tshad kyang khyed rnams kyis don dngos gzhir bzung nas khrims ltar rgyu 'bras drang ba'i thag gcod bzang po zhig byed pa la thug yod pa red/nga tshor yid ches yod pa ni rgyal khab khrims ltar skyong ba'i lam du song nas lo nyi shu lhag 'gor song / khrims ni cha tshang ba yod la/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims 'og mi rigs tshang ma 'dra mnyam dang mi tshang ma 'dra mnyam yin bsam gyi 'dug de ring bden don gyi mdun du rgyal khrims btsan po'i bden drang gi ral gri de nges par du mi nag nyes can gyi mgo la thebs rgyu red ma gtogs mi nyes med mgo la thebs rgyu red gtan nas bsam gyi med/bden lung pa gnyis de phu thag ring / nga rang dang nye sa kun lhag par du dkar mdzes sa phyogs mi dmangs khri stong mang pos de ring gi nyin 'di la skad cha rgyu 'bras drang ba zhig go thub rgyu'i re ba ni ltogs pas zas dang skom pas chu sgug pa bzhin re sgug byas yod/ gal te rgyal khab khrims la rgyu 'bras re yod na/ gal te dge bshes bsod nams phun tshogs kyis tshe gang por sems bzang 471

wel phe/'u rgya snye ma po byas te bya ba sgrub par rgyu 'bras kyi lam re yod na/ nga tshos nges par du kho rang btson nas glod song ba'i gtam bzang zhig go thub par yid ches brtan po yod la/ nga tshor bden don mtha' gsal ba'i nyi ma zhig yod rgyu red/ khrims gcod 'go 'dzin pa dang khrims dpon rnam par thugs rje che zhu/dag sel mkhan/ nags tshang nus blo nas/2000lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes 21nyin dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul 'bring rim mi dmangs khrims khang nyes don 'dri gcod khrims ra nas bshad pa/
